c64:125479.description: Pilot a futuristic mini-submarine through a high-tech undersea complex, blasting biological and mechanical horrors in slow-scrolling stages and weaving past obstacles in fast ones.
c64:125479.title: AquaVile

c64:125480.description: Personality quizzes meant to be played socially, revealing what players are really like and whether friends are bluffing.
c64:125480.title: The Real You?

c64:125482.description: A police officer whose badge has been stolen blasts through the wall it is hidden behind and then shoots the badge to recover it.
c64:125482.title: Badge Bandit

c64:125485.description: A vertically scrolling SEUCK shooter with a tongue-in-cheek backstory about a mad dictator named Stalin, included in the third Shoot 'Em Up Destruction Set.
c64:125485.title: Barakon

c64:125486.description: The Bellringer makes his way through castles collecting bags of gold worth 750 points each while avoiding evil knights; a 2013 RGCD cartridge competition entry.
c64:125486.title: Bellringer III

c64:125487.description: Cross-country skiing combined with rifle shooting, raced along a snow trail broken up by shooting rounds.
c64:125487.title: Head to Head Biathlon

c64:125488.description: Grab the ring and reach the entrance to the next level before time runs out in this platformer.
c64:125488.title: Big Mad

c64:125489.description: Locate atoms hidden in an 8x8 grid by firing rays in from the sides and observing whether they are absorbed, deflected or reflected.
c64:125489.title: The Black Box

c64:125490.description: Amidar-style game: run along the grid to enclose rectangles across the field while avoiding enemies, which can be made to jump out of the way up to three times.
c64:125490.title: Blind Man's Bluff

c64:125494.description: Human biology learning game: place bones and organs in their correct positions and study body systems, functions and diseases.
c64:125494.title: The Body Transparent

c64:125495.description: Send bombers on precision runs against enemy tanks massing at the border and the factory producing them before they reach your city.
c64:125495.title: Bomb Ace

c64:125496.description: Guessing game for one to nine players in which the computer and player take turns working out an object through yes-or-no questions, with the computer learning new objects as it goes.
c64:125496.title: Botticelli

c64:125499.description: Logic puzzle of grouping identical blocks, sometimes in a required pattern, within the move and time limits shown at the start of each level.
c64:125499.title: Brain Artifice

c64:125500.description: A music lesson program from HES's Magic Music series that teaches how notes are written on the staff and how long each symbol lasts, then drills you on naming notes and playing songs, with a mini-composer for writing your own tunes.
c64:125500.title: Bravo!

c64:125501.description: In 11th-century China, the dying Duke Zhao of Chongqing banishes his Buddhist priests and lets sorcerers chase immortality, and their rites call forth the demon Narodakini.
c64:125501.title: Brothers of the Bow

c64:125504.description: Computer companion to the Buzzword board game: enter the number of a category card such as Things That Bite or A Rainbow of Colors and the program runs timed rounds from its word lists, with difficulty levels, a letter count, play-or-pass choices and a bonus round.
c64:125504.title: Buzzword

c64:125505.description: The bandit roams the screen collecting candy while dodging the sheriff and sour grapes, slipping through gaps in moving walls that hold him fast on contact.
c64:125505.title: Candy Bandit

c64:125506.description: Computer version of the children's board game: young players move gingerbread pieces down a rainbow-coloured path through candy lands in search of the missing King Kandy.
c64:125506.title: Candy Land: A Child's First Game

c64:125507.description: On Sesame Street, young players assist Big Bird and Little Bird with the mail, sorting it and taking each package to the correct shop to practise object recognition.
c64:125507.title: Sesame Street: Big Bird's Special Delivery

c64:125519.description: Solve logic puzzles to reveal pictures of cars as the reward.
c64:125519.title: Car-O-Matic

c64:125526.description: Bet against the bank on the outcome of single or successive rolls of two dice at a craps table.
c64:125526.title: Casino Craps

c64:125527.description: Playing as Mark or Becky, trapped inside the cave of the Word Wizard, run and jump past hazards to gather enough magic crystals to escape.
c64:125527.title: Cave of the Word Wizard

c64:125529.description: Following notes left by the aged explorer Jesmon Hys, search the ancient Tombs of Ledromica for a temple of Rah hidden deep inside.
c64:125529.title: Caverns of Doom

c64:125530.description: Defend a patch of the body from a spreading virus that hijacks cells to copy itself. Switch rapidly between cell layers, placing B-cell antibodies to guard blood vessels and T-cells to destroy infected cells; losing too many labile, stable or perennial cells ends the game. Infection rate, regrowth and starting health are set beforehand.
c64:125530.title: Cell Defense

c64:125531.description: Jacques dashes around New York grabbing dropped banknotes while dodging muggers and tax collectors, then banks the cash or gambles it on Wall Street shares. Loans are available, but missing the two-month repayment brings a visit from the loan shark's thug.
c64:125531.title: C'est La Vie

c64:125533.description: Pac-Man clone with four boards per level, each round repeating slightly harder, and the first three boards selectable from the menu.
c64:125533.title: Chomper

c64:125534.description: A knight climbs a tower to save a kingdom in this vertically scrolling SEUCK game from the 2010 compo.
c64:125534.title: C'Notte D'Knight

c64:125535.description: Educational program for learning computer concepts and BASIC, covering memory, addressing, registers, loops and problem solving.
c64:125535.title: Coco

c64:125536.description: Head-to-head shooter where the player designs the sprites for both their own ship and the enemy, as well as the backgrounds.
c64:125536.title: Coco II

c64:125537.description: Steer a ship along the bottom of the screen through oncoming celestial objects of varying speeds, avoiding all contact to reach the next sector.
c64:125537.title: Comet

c64:125538.description: Design simulated fireworks displays and launch them across the night sky in time with music.
c64:125538.title: The Complete Computer Fireworks Celebration Kit

c64:125540.description: A multiple-choice quiz drawing on a large bank of general-knowledge questions, from literature and history to sports, science and old television, such as naming the captain of the Pequod or Orphan Annie's dog.
c64:125540.title: Trivia: General Interest

c64:125542.description: A text-based college basketball simulation: pick starters and an offensive style, call for a full-court press, follow play-by-play of steals, blocks, rebounds and fouls, and save and compile season statistics for each team.
c64:125542.title: Courtside College Basketball

c64:125543.description: Fix Rube Goldberg machines with wrong or missing parts by choosing the right replacements, from pulleys upward, to accomplish silly tasks; a forerunner of The Incredible Machine.
c64:125543.title: Creative Contraptions

c64:125545.description: Choreograph a dancing bear's stage show, design the scenery and compose the music, then save the routines; meant as a gentle introduction to sequential programming.
c64:125545.title: Dancing Bear

c64:125546.description: SEUCK shooter set in a department store haunted by monsters, where even the merchandise has come to life.
c64:125546.title: Dante's Department Store

aliases: The Dark Side: The Return of the Christal Ball
c64:125547.description: A text adventure through a swamp, a troll cave and spider-webbed caverns, fighting goblins, a slimy troll and a golden dragon while gathering healing potions, a silver ring and the crystal ball, as an emperor tempts you to give up the ring and side with darkness.
c64:125547.title: The Dark Side: Return of the Christal Ball

c64:125548.description: Six mini-games framed as a TV documentary hosted by Salisbury Smythe, following a caveman's daily struggle to survive dinosaurs and wild animals.
c64:125548.title: A Day in a Life of a Prehistoric Man

c64:125550.description: In Sengoku-era Japan, play Kuruhito, an oni who has rebelled against the Demon Shogun and his invading demon armies; a 2013 RGCD cartridge competition entry.
c64:125550.title: Devil Ronin

c64:125552.description: A two-disk dinosaur study: the first side presents illustrated readings on dinosaur types, drifting continents and extinction theories, and the second offers games such as a fossil dig where you identify a dinosaur from successive clues, flashcards, and judging whether two dinosaurs lived at the same time.
c64:125552.title: Dinosaur Dig

c64:125553.description: Steer a skier left and right around obstacles, pushing forward to speed up and pulling back to slow down, with harder skill levels earning higher scores.
c64:125553.title: Downhill Racer-64

c64:125554.description: Overhead racer strictly for two players, written for the 2001 Mekka Symposium party: both drivers enter names, pick cars and a lap count, then compete over four circuits, the last one the trickiest, and whoever wins the most courses takes the title.
c64:125554.title: DreamCars

c64:125555.description: The Duke boys race down the road, jumping every obstacle in their path to get themselves out of trouble.
c64:125555.title: Duke Boys

c64:125556.description: SEUCK shooter in which a pilot breaks through the meteoroids' defences and destroys their army before it can reach Earth.
c64:125556.title: Earth Super Force

c64:125558.description: Three frontier simulations about American history - Furs, Voyageur and The Oregon Trail - in which children make decisions, solve problems and navigate as early settlers.
c64:125558.title: Expeditions

c64:125559.description: Waking in a sealed wing of Dracula's Transylvanian castle, explore its secret passages over several days and learn the Count's nightly habits in order to destroy him.
c64:125559.title: The Count

c64:125573.description: Uncover 20 themed words laid criss-cross over the faces of a 3D cube; vowels score points and grant another turn, blanks end it, and the Wuzzle tracks progress.
c64:125573.title: Crypto Cube

c64:125646.description: Gold Box role-playing set in the 25th century: Buck Rogers, revived after centuries of frozen sleep, and a party of New Earth Organization fighters battle RAM's grip on the solar system.
c64:125646.title: Buck Rogers: Countdown to Doomsday

c64:125664.description: Captured by the Treens and held on their research satellite orbiting Venus, Dan Dare breaks free and searches the ship for a way to get an escape shuttle running.
c64:125664.title: Dan Dare III: The Escape

c64:125694.description: Enter the Black Knight's haunted castle to overthrow him, crossing 14 increasingly hard side-view zones of ropes, cages and trapdoors.
c64:125694.title: Dark Castle

c64:125712.description: Side-scrolling space shooter in which a Guardian Warrior can choose to fuse with defeated foes to gain their power or carry on with mortal abilities alone.
c64:125712.title: Dark Fusion

c64:125713.description: Stock car racing based on the Tom Cruise film, driving as Cole Trickle through a NASCAR-style season.
c64:125713.title: Days of Thunder

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Death Knights of Krynn
c64:125715.description: Second Dragonlance Gold Box adventure: import a Champions of Krynn party to face an undead plague that turns old allies into foes and fills Krynn with rotting monsters.
c64:125715.title: Death Knights of Krynn

c64:125742.description: Based on Sam Raimi's film: as Peyton Westlake, back from the dead as Darkman, hunt mobster Robert G. Durant through set pieces such as a helicopter fight, a skyscraper shootout and a dangle above freeway traffic.
c64:125742.title: Darkman

c64:125847.description: A one-button game from RGCD's 2014 16KB cartridge competition: a bouncing character has to be kept between the top and bottom edges of the screen, and judges found it fiercely difficult. Artwork is by Saul Cross.
c64:125847.title: Falling

c64:125848.description: Race across a metallic planet surface avoiding obstacles; best with two players, each trying to force the other into collisions without any weapons.
c64:125848.title: Fast

c64:125849.description: A light-handed car race through Tokyo in which the computer handles much of the steering at low speeds, demanding more from the driver the faster you go. Choose 1, 5 or 10 laps, view the whole circuit from above or check the world rankings.
c64:125849.title: Fast Tracks: Tokio Race

c64:125850.description: Unofficial port of the Spectravideo and ColecoVision game: firefighter Freddy runs along the street dodging falling debris, spraying water at burning windows and rescuing trapped cats.
c64:125850.title: Frantic Freddy

c64:125851.description: The last part of the Little Sara Sister trilogy, a sideways-scrolling platformer modelled on The Great Giana Sisters, first entered in RGCD's 2012 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:125851.title: Little Sara Sister II

c64:125852.description: Drive a lunar rover across the moonscape, dodging alien blasts and shooting back, with limited shields for emergencies.
c64:125852.title: Final Mission

c64:125853.description: Four-in-a-row board game for one or two players where completed lines of four vanish from the board, and the goal is to form ten of them horizontally, vertically or diagonally.
c64:125853.title: Fields

c64:125854.description: An arithmetic drill with a fishing theme for one or more players: correct answers score points, wrong ones cost more as the levels rise, passing on a fish earns a few points, and a bonus is paid on finishing each level.
c64:125854.title: Fish-Metic

c64:125855.description: A programming genius fights off sentient computer viruses that have swarmed his machine and threaten the wider web.
c64:125855.title: FlawShow

c64:125856.description: Three jungle men, the player plus George and Floyd, race to rescue a girl lost in the jungle past alligators, elephants and birds, scoring points by grabbing birds and pygmies.
c64:125856.title: Floyd of the Jungle

c64:125857.description: Fly a paper airplane up and down to keep it from hitting anything, to a remix of the Blue Danube.
c64:125857.title: Flyer

c64:125858.description: European Super League edition of Brian Clough's Football Fortunes, rewritten with ESL clubs and player data.
c64:125858.title: Football Fortunes II: European Super League

c64:125860.description: Wheel of Fortune-style game: spin the wheel and guess letters in a hidden phrase, revealed by a smurf hostess named Vanna.
c64:125860.title: Fortune Wheel

c64:125861.description: Early text adventure with a two-word parser set in the land of Hebryptia, notorious for a tough opening.
c64:125861.title: The Fourth Sarcophagus

c64:125862.description: Bounce on a pogo stick up to the twentieth floor, finding the Fraction Elevators by matching fraction pictures to the one shown at the top, with a radar map of the floors.
c64:125862.title: Fraction Fever

c64:125863.description: Platform game in which Fröhn sets out to free his Fröhnline, following clues in a joke poem and carrying one item at a time, starting with the Dong.
c64:125863.title: Fröhn

c64:125864.description: Fan-made follow-up to the covertape game Frosty the Snowman. Santa and his elves are too drunk to collect the presents, so Frosty, optionally with a second player, must run long distances fetching gifts back to the cave while jumping the hazards that roam each screen.
c64:125864.title: Frosty the Snowman 2

c64:125865.description: Glob must recover the 16 scattered pieces of the Scroll of Evolution before a candle burns down, dropping between flick-screen rooms with reversed gravity and lifts, then sliding the collected pieces into order in a puzzle mode.
c64:125865.title: Future Shock

c64:125867.description: Explore the galaxy's 200 billion stars searching for life in a scientifically grounded space exploration and trading game modeled on 1970s Empire-style games.
c64:125867.title: Galactic Frontier

c64:125868.description: Simple retro shooter: blast aliens swooping onto the screen to music by Rage.
c64:125868.title: Galaxys

c64:125871.description: Computer version of Awari, a mancala game of sowing stones around pits, won by whoever ends up holding more stones in their kala.
c64:125871.title: The Game of Awari

c64:125872.title: The Game of Trivia: Children's Trivia

c64:125873.description: A trivia game on television, film and comics characters for up to six players: questions appear one at a time and each answer must be typed in before the time limit runs out, with the speed and length of the game chosen beforehand.
c64:125873.title: The Game of Trivia: Entertainment Trivia

c64:125874.description: A general-knowledge trivia game for up to six players: questions appear one at a time and each answer must be typed in before the time limit runs out, with the speed and length of the game chosen beforehand.
c64:125874.title: The Game of Trivia: General Trivia

c64:125875.description: Quiz program with four difficulty levels from elementary to graduate school, offering a word-scramble hint when an answer is elusive.
c64:125875.title: General Knowledge Builder

c64:125876.description: Copy the pattern displayed on the right into the left-hand grid using the supplied shapes before an ever-shrinking time limit expires.
c64:125876.title: Geo-Matrix

c64:125878.description: Sent by the Allfather to execute wicked gods, fly through a sideways-scrolling shooter made with SEUCK for the 2010 Sideways SEUCK Compo.
c64:125878.title: God Slayer

c64:125879.description: A grammar board game for up to four players who act as budding newspaper reporters, moving around the board and earning money by answering grammar questions. A computer rival named Melvin can join with adjustable intelligence.
c64:125879.title: The Grammar Examiner

c64:125880.description: Children furnish a playhouse with things gathered on visits to a series of magical places.
c64:125880.title: Grandma's House

c64:125881.description: Turn-based wargame covering the opening months of World War I, August to October 1914, in 27 turns of three days each on a map reaching from Paris to Minsk. Command the Western Allies or the Central Powers.
c64:125881.title: The Great War 1914

c64:125882.description: Hop Freddie Frog across a busy road with growing traffic, then over a fast river by jumping between logs, to get him and his friends safely home.
c64:125882.title: Grebit

c64:125884.description: A puzzle styled like a sprite editor: restore a scrambled pixel pattern to its original image before the time limit runs out.
c64:125884.title: Grid

c64:125885.description: As Ned the Dog, break out of eight single-screen levels of the Traxonians' Grid Zone, seen from above, to rescue his owner Daisy after the Chiggiz walled them in.
c64:125885.title: Grid Zone

c64:125886.description: A reworking of Grid Zone with redesigned levels and new attack formations. Ned the dog gathers gems while dodging lasers, black holes and a lethal orb, and can shield himself a limited number of times.
c64:125886.title: Grid Zone Remix

c64:125887.description: A stylized remake of Flappy Bird: tap to keep a bird aloft and steer it through gaps between obstacles. Published in Commodore Free issue 79.
c64:125887.title: Happy Flappy

c64:125888.description: An early build of Heavy Metal Deluxe that blends falling-block puzzling with shooting: match the colours of descending blocks and shoot them back up to score, over 32 levels that gradually speed up.
c64:125888.title: Heavy Metal Solid

c64:125889.description: Fly a rescue helicopter through a sprawling maze, gathering the 30 keys that unlock the cells where hostages are held. Four helpers, each marked by its own colour, must be picked up and dropped at the matching houses along the way. From Mario van Zeist and Jacco van het Riet, first released on a German disk magazine.
c64:125889.title: Heli Rescue

c64:125890.description: A Pong variant for one or two players in which the ball is struck with your head, made by Oliver Jones with music by Rob Hubbard.
c64:125890.title: Hellball

c64:125891.description: A horizontally scrolling space shooter notable for letting two players fight side by side; published in 64'er 1993/11.
c64:125891.title: Hermetic

c64:125892.description: The knight from Hero Time returns to save a village from an evil king, fighting skeletons, bats and spiders through four stages (forest, village, cemetery and church dungeons) and opening treasure chests for points and extra lives.
c64:125892.title: Hero Time II

c64:125893.description: In an alternate world, the nation of Malexheim fights back against invading legions sent by Hel, the death goddess, then pushes on into Niflheim to strike at the core of her empire.
c64:125893.title: Heroes of Midgard

c64:125894.description: Leaking Delta Radiation has mutated underground creatures that now aim to destroy the research plant and the world; drive a tank into the complex to stop them.
c64:125894.title: Hideous

c64:125895.description: A text adventure with simple pictures, set in and around a monastery in the Himalayas.
c64:125895.title: Himalayan Odyssey

c64:125896.description: Overhead ice hockey where players skate, score and improve their skills between matches, with multiplayer for friends. From GO64! issue 2003/12.
c64:125896.title: Hockey Mania

c64:125897.description: A text adventure about searching for the cup of Christ, written by Andrew Field.
c64:125897.title: The Holy Grail

c64:125898.description: A two-part program that helps students understand and solve math word problems.
c64:125898.title: Homework Helper Math

c64:125901.description: Updated release in which Buzzy, a clumsy worker bee, gathers pollen across 16 levels while dodging natural hazards and wild animals, to lift honey output for the Queen Bee.
c64:125901.title: Honey Bee Redux

c64:125903.description: Science-fiction adventure about a hotel run by a kindly old lady called Grandma, where odd new guests began checking in after a flying saucer was spotted nearby.
c64:125903.title: Hotel Alien

c64:125904.description: An adventure in which the hotel caretaker faces the worst winter of his time there, with the building and grounds buried under deep snow.
c64:125904.title: Hotel Hell: Not A Nice Place To Die

c64:125905.description: Scrolling platformer in which Howard jumps past moving spikes and bats to gather fragments of his program code, finishing it to impress his girlfriend.
c64:125905.title: Howard the Coder

c64:125906.description: Pilot a pulsing light ship through hazardous caverns against a friend or the computer; grazing rocks drains your shields, which recover if you keep clear. Published in GO64! 2003/01.
c64:125906.title: Hyper

c64:125907.description: A Defender-style shooter: protect the moons of Mughal, where new defence systems are being trialled, from unknown attackers while managing radar shield, auto-fire and life gauges.
c64:125907.title: Hyper Active

c64:125908.description: An auto-scrolling platformer where a square that can only jump must clear deadly triangles and floors, using black blocks as stepping stones, to cover as much distance as it can.
c64:125908.title: The Impossible Game

c64:125909.description: An illustrated lesson on Native American life before European settlement, covering the Algonquin wigwam, Pueblo adobe villages and the buffalo-hunting Sioux among others, followed by questions that are scored.
c64:125909.title: Indians, Indians

c64:125910.description: Educational simulation of a car engine: test-run a faulty motor, diagnose the fault and repair it, using a cross-section view where each component can be inspected.
c64:125910.title: Injured Engine

c64:125911.description: A fishing adventure set at the Inner Lakes, where the goal is landing the Irish record tench.
c64:125911.title: The Inner Lakes

c64:125912.description: Side-on five-a-side football featuring a tournament of eight national teams, two difficulty levels and adjustable match length; each side fields four outfield players and a keeper.
c64:125912.title: International 5 A-Side

c64:125914.description: Platformer starring Tommy the tomcat, who wanted to be the first to leave the Dream Islands, served a wizard, and now must find his way back home after teleporting away.
c64:125914.title: It's Magic II

c64:125916.description: Horizontally scrolling jet shooter in which you fly as either George W. Bush or Saddam Hussein, dodging bombs, planes, gunfire and ground structures while attacking the other side.
c64:125916.title: Jihad: Raid over Baghdad

c64:125917.description: A blob locked in a cell in Puzzle Land by a flying monster must solve 32 puzzle levels to escape; a level editor is included. Entered in RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:125917.title: Invert

c64:125918.description: As a cowboy, walk along train carriages or across their roofs to stop robbers fleeing by rail, viewed side-on from a raised angle, sometimes choosing between the two routes.
c64:125918.title: Iron Horse

c64:125919.description: Text adventure in which you must keep a frazzled hotelier's business open, and him sane, for a week of 1000 moves while troublesome guests demand service and a health inspector is due.
c64:125919.title: Faulty Towers

c64:125920.description: After a storm forces your plane down on an uncharted island ruled by dragons, the friendly dragon Wycorn asks you to rescue your girlfriend Linda from the evil wyvern Reptilican; explore the island for keys, potions and weapons and fight beasts like a Tyrannosaurus by choosing kicks, punches or a knife.
c64:125920.title: Island of The Dragons

c64:125921.description: Gather eight music boxes and set them playing at the mansion's way out, fending off four ghosts by throwing heavy objects and working out what the many items in the haunted house are for.
c64:125921.title: I-Wizard

c64:125923.description: Side-scrolling arcade game in which James the fly searches a castle for gold coins and useful items; he has no weapon, and a map of explored areas is drawn below the play screen.
c64:125923.title: James Fly

c64:125925.description: Chess tutorial laying out a full system of openings such as the King's Indian Defense and the Najdorf Sicilian, bundled with the Coffeehouse Chess Monster playing program.
c64:125925.title: Jeremy Silman's Complete Guide To Chess Openings

c64:125926.description: Computer version of the five-letter word game: pick a secret word from almost 5000 on disk and trade guesses with the Genie, or play a solo version.
c64:125926.title: Jot-a-Word Genie

c64:125927.description: Return rescued kangaroos to Australia by choosing a route on a world map, then driving through side-scrolling levels.
c64:125927.title: Kangarudy II: The Adventure Continues

c64:125928.description: Blackjack simulator built on Ken Uston's methods, recreating the house rules of over 70 US casinos, from deck count and dealer behavior to surrender, splits, doubling and insurance.
c64:125928.title: Ken Uston's Profe$$ional Blackjack

c64:125929.description: Galaxians-style blaster: slide your ship along the bottom of the screen and shoot down the alien formations, with a counter showing how many more invaders must fall before the next wave arrives.
c64:125929.title: Kernal's Chaos

c64:125930.description: A port of Kobo Deluxe, the multidirectional space shooter about destroying enemy bases. It placed fourth in RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition and was improved several times afterwards.
c64:125930.title: Kobo64

c64:125931.description: A board-style quest for one to six players across a randomly assembled land of woods, desert and swamp, optionally hidden until explored: fight monsters, buy horses, ladders and lanterns in town, and visit seven sites, from a blackjack house to a haunted church and a gold-filled pyramid, to earn the most fame points.
c64:125931.title: The Land

aliases: Lapis Philosophoroum: Der Stein Der Wiesen
c64:125932.description: The King of Alkanien has been poisoned by a stepson too impatient to wait for the throne, and only the Philosopher's Stone, which can also transform metal into gold, can cure him.
c64:125932.title: Lapis Philosophorum: The Philosophers' Stone

c64:125933.description: Walk a man to the top-left corner of the screen to take control of a laser, then shoot only the balls that match. Printed in COMPUTE! 1985/10 among other magazines and collections.
c64:125933.title: Laser Gun

c64:125934.description: Help Perry the Penguin find matching capital and small letters in the letter loft and load them onto trucks bound for an alphabet city.
c64:125934.title: Learn The Alphabet

c64:125935.description: SEUCK-built side-scroller in the vein of Golden Axe: two mercenary heroes, one of them an Amazon, cut down undead hordes that have overrun a peaceful village.
c64:125935.title: Legion of the Damned

c64:125936.description: Sequel set a thousand years after the vampire tyrant Stryxia fell, when a church built over her resting place to keep her down now stands in a growing town that swallowed Hameria village.
c64:125936.title: Legion of the Damned II

c64:125938.description: After two years in a prison camp hut, put your escape plan into action in this adventure by Paul Eves.
c64:125938.title: Libérte

c64:125939.description: Two-player dots and boxes: draw lines, take a box and another turn when you close its fourth side, and win with the most boxes once the grid is filled.
c64:125939.title: Linus Vs Simon

c64:125940.description: A two-level platformer modeled on The Great Giana Sisters, made for the 2004 4K Minigame Competition and serving as the prelude to the Little Sara Sister trilogy.
c64:125940.title: Little Sara Sister

c64:125941.description: Second Little Sara Sister platformer in the Giana Sisters mould, with nine levels and a reworked soundtrack.
c64:125941.title: Little Sara Sister 1.5

c64:125942.description: Enhanced collection of the three Little Sara Sister games (the original, version 1.5 and the sequel 2), covering around 50 locations from caves and Antarctica to an Egyptian pyramid, each picked from a menu.
c64:125942.title: Little Sara Sister Trilogy

c64:125943.description: Introduces programming to ages 9 and up: give a robot commands such as Forward and Repeat to paint polka-dot and checkerboard patterns, then show off the pictures.
c64:125943.title: Logo Robot

c64:125944.description: Sci-fi take on Keystone Kapers: chase an escaping prisoner before he reaches the airlock, with a subgame that awards a jetpack for extra speed. From Commodore Format 38.
c64:125944.title: Lunar Jailbreak

c64:125945.description: Pac-Man variant with overhead mazes to clear of pellets while ghosts give chase; some levels let you transform into other forms.
c64:125945.title: The Pepsi Challenge: Mad Mix Game

c64:125946.description: Defend Caer Del Taryn by moving a crosshair over the map and zapping invaders; let the city be looted too often and its civilization perishes.
c64:125946.title: Magess of Midgard

c64:125947.description: The gods of Endoria turned themselves into crystal splinters, and whoever collects them all rules the realm; play one of two rival archmages racing to find them.
c64:125947.title: Magic of Endoria

c64:125948.description: Crosshair shooter: aim at drifting asteroids and blast them.
c64:125948.title: Magyk

c64:125949.description: Business simulation teaching children about production costs, advertising, profit and loss, played competitively by up to six players.
c64:125949.title: The Market Place

c64:125951.description: General-knowledge quiz for up to six players who must type the correct answer before time runs out.
c64:125951.title: Master Trivia

c64:125952.description: Compact Boulder Dash-style game with design ideas borrowed from Pushcat and Portal, made for RGCD's 2012 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:125952.title: Match Buster

c64:125953.description: Blast alien invaders by answering arithmetic questions in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, with adjustable difficulty for ages 4 to 12.
c64:125953.title: Maths Invaders

c64:125954.description: As captain of a cargo ship moving Blibbles off their overcrowded planet, round up the creatures that got out of their cell and are wandering into the engine room.
c64:125954.title: Mayhem (Mr. Micro)

c64:125959.description: Text adventure from the Adventure Master pack in which the goal is to defeat the Black Knight.
c64:125959.title: Medieval Adventure

c64:125960.description: Partly turned into a bird by the invading Kremins' magic but still in possession of your mind, fly through an arcade platformer to defeat them and free family and friends changed into birds and mice.
c64:125960.title: Metabolis

c64:125961.description: Minimal action game reinterpreting Super Hexagon, by Paul Koller with a Mikkel Hastrup soundtrack: rotate around the centre to slip through gaps in closing walls. Second place in RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:125961.title: Micro Hexagon

c64:125962.description: Stock market simulation: start with $10,000 and trade shares in companies across sectors such as computers, oil and gas, retail, autos and heavy industry, reading weekly news that moves prices.
c64:125962.title: Millionaire: The Stock Market Simulation

c64:125963.description: Clear every block from the screen before a very short timer runs out. Firing on a block flips it and its four neighbours, so empty squares next to it fill with new blocks; later levels switch the effect to the four diagonal squares instead.
c64:125963.title: Mind Maze

c64:125966.description: Three contestants supply questions to the given answers across several categories, gaining money for correct responses and losing it for wrong ones; the richest player wins.
c64:125966.title: Jeopardy! New Second Edition

c64:125967.description: A tribute to 1980s LCD handhelds: as a boiler repairman, the player dodges scalding water running through pipes and steam bursting from release valves, grabbing a spanner that appears on the far left and carrying it to the boiler on the right.
c64:125967.title: Mini Arcade: Climax

c64:125970.description: Defend your home planet against giant alien nuclear missiles in deep space; each hit scores 100 points, while collisions cost one of five shields.
c64:125970.title: Missile Blasta

c64:125971.description: Catch falling missiles in the Missile Compaction Container to save your planet from alien attack.
c64:125971.title: Missile Busters

c64:125972.description: Again gather falling missiles into the Compaction Container, now with power-ups and a contamination meter that dooms the planet if it reaches 100%.
c64:125972.title: Missile Busters II

c64:125973.description: A tricky isometric maze game built around odd search-and-rescue missions. Released on Commodore Format 16.
c64:125973.title: Mission Impossibubble

c64:125974.description: Property-trading board game modeled on Monopoly, with an optional auction rule.
c64:125974.title: Monopole

c64:125975.description: Puzzle Bobble-style shooter where you clear monsters instead of coloured bubbles. Made for RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:125975.title: Monster Buster

c64:125976.description: Tetris variant in which the squares left uncleared gradually reveal a cute background picture.
c64:125976.title: Motley Tetris

c64:125977.description: Pick or design cartoon characters and combine them into your own animations.
c64:125977.title: Mr. Pixels Cartoon Kit

c64:125978.description: Pac-Man-style maze game: eat every dot while four ghosts chase you, using the power dots in the corners to turn the tables briefly; you have three lives.
c64:125978.title: Munch Man 64

c64:125979.description: Muppet-themed keyboard and software for children three and up, designed to teach typing and first steps on a computer.
c64:125979.title: Muppet Learning Keys

c64:125983.description: Adventure in which you must find and destroy the eggs of giant mutant spiders before they overrun the world, battling natural obstacles along the way.
c64:125983.title: The Mutant Spiders

c64:125984.description: Word game for one to four players against family or the computer, with four levels and thinking time adjustable from 99 seconds down to under 5.
c64:125984.title: My Word: The Ultimate Family Word Game

c64:125986.description: Text adventure where the player is carried from the distant past into the far future, inside a vast dome where humanity's last survivors sheltered from a ruined, radioactive Earth.
c64:125986.title: Nightwing

c64:125987.description: Port of the Soviet clone of Game & Watch Egg: as the wolf from the cartoon Nu, pogodi!, catch eggs rolling down four chutes, scoring a point for each.
c64:125987.title: Nu, pagadi!

c64:125988.description: Snodge the Biblet sets out to free friends held by the evil Biblet Ruler in a guarded hut on a riverbank, fifteen years after the first Nyaaaah! game.
c64:125988.title: Nyaaaah!: 15th Annversary Edition

c64:125992.description: Snodge the Biblet tracks down an evil Biblet mafia that captured his friends, in a lick-'em-up adventure.
c64:125992.title: Nyaaaah! 2003

c64:125993.description: Control a robot sealing radioactive leaks with stones, alone or with a second player as partner or rival; notable for experimenting with subliminal motivational messages.
c64:125993.title: O.B.Y. 1

c64:125994.description: Educational simulation of lake life: as one of several fish species, choose an action at each encounter to find food, avoid predators and survive.
c64:125994.title: Odell Lake

c64:125995.description: Ride a flying horse to rescue a princess kidnapped by a jealous sorcerer who wants her magic powers for himself.
c64:125995.title: Trojan Warrior

c64:125996.description: As an escaped sheep, munch Farmer Dave's crops to clear each field while avoiding other animals; three bumps end the game.
c64:125996.title: On The Farm

c64:125997.description: As Shep the border collie, herd a set number of sheep back to their pen in each of 20 levels before shearing time.
c64:125997.title: On the Farm: Part II

c64:125998.description: As a greedy St. Ives seagull, drive off the sheep by bombing them from above so you can claim Farmer Rich's crops, while Shep the sheepdog sometimes interferes.
c64:125998.title: On the Farm Part III

c64:126000.description: SEUCK lick-'em-up whose shots travel only one square, so you must get right next to enemies to destroy them. From Commodore Zone issue 4.
c64:126000.title: Nyaaaah! 03: A Licence to Lick the Biblets

c64:126003.description: Pac-Man variant where the dots are large turtles that shrink when eaten, so each maze must be cleared twice.
c64:126003.title: P. Man

c64:126009.description: Snodge the Biblet faces King Squit, a new ruler crueller than Evil Squatter, who turned Bibletsville's good Biblets evil and captured Snodge's friends.
c64:126009.title: Nyaaaah! 11

c64:126010.description: Model car racing head-to-head against a champion computer driver or a second player.
c64:126010.title: On-Track Computer Model Car Racing

c64:126011.description: Two-part platform arcade adventure about a disastrous episode of interstellar piracy.
c64:126011.title: Operation Anoria

c64:126012.description: Guide the explorer Orpheus through the underworld of Hades, gathering all the scattered treasure so he can leave, while avoiding creatures, obstacles and traps.
c64:126012.title: Orpheus in the Underworld

c64:126014.description: Two submarines face off, firing torpedoes or shooting mines to bounce them into the rival; five hits destroy a sub and give the other a point.
c64:126014.title: Sub Duel

c64:126016.description: Self-paced tutorial for grades 1 to 4 drilling addition that needs carrying and subtraction that may or may not need borrowing, stressing place value.
c64:126016.title: Success With Math: Addition and Subtraction

c64:126017.description: A self-paced algebra tutor that has you solve equations of the form ax+b=c step by step, choosing which axiom to apply, with explanations whenever you add, subtract, multiply or divide by the wrong term.
c64:126017.title: Success With Math: Linear Equations

c64:126018.description: Self-paced tutorial for grades 2 to 8 on multiplication and long division, with practice problems that also call for addition and subtraction.
c64:126018.title: Success With Math: Multiplication and Division

aliases: Success With Math: Multipling And Dividing Fractions
c64:126019.description: A tutorial in multiplying and dividing fractions: choose how many problems to do, cancel and reduce terms, convert answers to mixed numbers, and finish with an analysis that separates errors in procedure from errors in computation.
c64:126019.title: Success With Math: Fractions: Multiplication and Division

c64:126020.description: A souped-up take on Commando in which everything runs faster: more bullets fill the screen and enemies move so quickly there is barely time to react.
c64:126020.title: Super Commando

c64:126021.description: Two-player maze muncher by Richard Bayliss and Paul Kubiszyn, begun in 1995 and shelved after an unfinished demo appeared on a Commodore Format covertape; this deluxe edition came later.
c64:126021.title: Super Pac Twins

c64:126022.description: A take on Ludo: move four counters around a circular board and up into your home base. A six is needed to bring each counter into play, and any piece an opponent lands on goes back to the start.
c64:126022.title: Super Tact

c64:126023.description: Sideways shooter made as a sample for Shoot 'Em Up Destruction Set 2, leading a fleet of ships through deep space, an asteroid belt, an alien world and an alien city.
c64:126023.title: Super Tau Zeta

c64:126024.description: Sequel side-scrolling shooter with parallax scrolling and boss fights, leading a fleet of ships through space, asteroid belts, an alien world and a city.
c64:126024.title: Super Tau Zeta 2

c64:126025.description: Downhill racing against the clock on eight courses for up to eight players; beat the preview time to qualify for the next World Cup race and earn a life, while crashes or slow runs cost one.
c64:126025.title: Super-Ski: The Downhill Simulator

c64:126026.description: After your plane's engine fails on a treasure-hunting shortcut home and you crash-land unhurt in a meadow, find a way to stay alive.
c64:126026.title: Survive!

c64:126028.description: Stop aliens from conquering Earth by answering multiplication table questions correctly.
c64:126028.title: Table Invaders

c64:126029.description: Foosball on screen: take joystick control of each row of players to block, pass and shoot, with angled deflections and diving goalkeeper saves.
c64:126029.title: Table Football

c64:126030.description: Split-screen race for two or four players driving Moon Patrol buggies, waggling the joystick in Decathlon fashion to build speed; the faster the waggle, the faster the buggy.
c64:126030.title: Team Patrol

c64:126031.description: Single-player Pac-Man clone: clear a maze of dots while dodging four ghosts that emerge from the centre, eating corner power pellets to make them vulnerable for a while.
c64:126031.title: Pactron

c64:126032.description: Steer a painter around a house wall to give the whole facade a fresh coat, with three characters per game. Printed in the magazine Computronic in early 1985.
c64:126032.title: Painter

c64:126033.description: Guard a ship launching through a meteor storm with a single shield that can face fore, aft, port or starboard, scoring for each meteor blocked on the way to orbit.
c64:126033.title: Panic Run

c64:126034.description: Steer a falling plane down winding paths past an ever-growing number of obstacles. Entered in RGCD's 2014 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:126034.title: Paper Plane

c64:126035.description: Falling-block puzzle in the Tetris mould: fit differently shaped parts into a U-shaped pit as compactly as possible. Also released as Brainbox.
c64:126035.title: Pathal

c64:126036.description: Chess tutorial devised by Paul Whitehead, who took the Masters Division title at the American Chess Championship as a teenager; it also includes the Coffeehouse Chess Monster playing program.
c64:126036.title: Paul Whitehead Teaches Chess

c64:126037.description: Cribbage against the computer, choosing every action by pointing an arrow with the joystick; cut for the deal, count your own hand and crib, and optionally play Muggins, where either side can claim points the other misses.
c64:126037.title: Peg-Out

c64:126038.description: A miniature role-playing game in the spirit of the early Final Fantasy titles, first written in BASIC and later rebuilt for RGCD's 2014 16KB cartridge competition with new tile graphics by fx and music by Twoflower. The hero roams the map and battles monsters.
c64:126038.title: Penultimate Fantasy

c64:126039.description: Name a song from up to 25 notes, choosing among four possible answers.
c64:126039.title: Pick That Tune

c64:126042.description: One-button skating game: jump over obstacles across the terrain as the pace keeps rising. Entered in RGCD's 2014 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:126042.title: Pixel City Skater

c64:126043.description: Educational deduction puzzle: fire a laser into a maze from its edge, sized from 3x3 to 13x13, and work out where hidden mirrors, deflectors and absorbers lie from how the beam behaves.
c64:126043.title: Plato's Cave

c64:126044.description: Reach the treasure by solving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems; a wrong answer brings a step-by-step explanation from the professor.
c64:126044.title: Playful Professor: Math Tutor

c64:126045.description: Strategy game in which you run a nationwide campaign for the US presidency.
c64:126045.title: Presidential Campaign

c64:126046.description: Based on the TV game show: three contestants answer trivia questions to win spins, then use them on the Big Board.
c64:126046.title: Press Your Luck

c64:126047.description: Pipe Mania clone: lay pipe pieces outward from a starting station in the bottom right to build a working pipeline. From the September 1993 Magic Disk 64.
c64:126047.title: Pipe

c64:126049.description: Frogger variation with music and speech: a frog crosses a road of jousting knights, then a moat of snakes and alligators that may dive under, to reach the princess's castle.
c64:126049.title: Princess and the Frog

c64:126050.description: Four sub-games by Shaun Southern: a horizontal shooter, a platformer climbed with a yoyo, a scrolling run through a graveyard, and a target shooter borrowing Forbidden Forest's moon and aiming system.
c64:126050.title: Project X

c64:126051.description: Recover the Federation's prized ship Quann Tulla, stolen by its designer Erra Quann to sell its engine secrets to the Evil Empire, and kill the traitor, starting aboard your own damaged, airless ship.
c64:126051.title: Quann Tulla

c64:126052.description: Rescue Princess Zota, taken when the sorcerer Balzan's Zeldan guards razed the Boran city in the land of Sark, and save its scattered people.
c64:126052.title: The Quest of Kron

c64:126054.description: Joust-inspired single-screen game: ride an Osturkey armed with a Laser-Lance, knock foes off their flying mounts by striking from above, then shoot them on the ground.
c64:126054.title: Quak Attak

c64:126055.description: Vertically scrolling helicopter shooter in the style of 1943, unrelated to the Rambo films despite the title.
c64:126055.title: Rambo IV

c64:126056.description: Keystone Kapers-inspired chase: catch the thieves on each level within the time limit. Made for RGCD's 2012 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:126056.title: Rent-A-Cop

c64:126057.description: Floating mutant tomatoes that look edible but are lethal are terrorizing the countryside, towns and cities, swallowing up fleeing people.
c64:126057.title: Revenge of the Tomato

c64:126059.description: Based on the TV series Romper Room, teaching children aged 2 to 7 their letters, new words, concentration, cause and effect and word association, guided by the animated character Max.
c64:126059.title: Romper Room's I Love My Alphabet

c64:126061.description: Rotate jumbled numbers back into order at your own pace, with no time limit or lives.
c64:126061.title: Rotator

c64:126063.description: Flying platformer: gather items on each single screen to build up enough magic to destroy the Genie, marked by a skull on the map; arrive short of magic and the task is hopeless.
c64:126063.title: Rug Rider

c64:126064.description: Illustrated text adventure: as commander of a salvage ship, recover the Sequerra crystal from a disused convict shuttle left circling asteroid 4-Gamma-7 for 17 years.
c64:126064.title: Salvage

c64:126065.description: Lode Runner-like platformer: collect the required items while avoiding roaming enemies, digging holes that drop them to the platform below.
c64:126065.title: Samber

c64:126066.description: SEUCK side-scroller based on H. P. Lovecraft's tale: pilot an old-fashioned submarine against the sea creatures lurking off the coast of Innsmouth.
c64:126066.title: The Shadow over Innsmouth

c64:126067.description: As Bruise Lei, the Shaolin Master's young apprentice, fight evil henchmen, recover forty sacred idols and take revenge for your master to uncover the temple's hidden treasures and scrolls.
c64:126067.title: Shaolin

c64:126068.description: Sokoban-style puzzle: push coloured crates around a warehouse until all crates of each colour are grouped together; levels arrive in random order.
c64:126068.title: Sliding Skill

c64:126069.description: Guess whether the next random ball, numbered 1 to 99, will be higher or lower, in the manner of Play Your Cards Right, with a joker to play.
c64:126069.title: Smaller-Bigger

c64:126070.description: Hungarian SEUCK shooter: travel down a jungle river deep in Africa toward the guarded treasures of a legendary emerald castle.
c64:126070.title: Smaragd Var

c64:126071.description: Tron light-cycle style game for up to four players with a 4-player adapter, made for the Vision 2002 party and released in GO64! 2002/10.
c64:126071.title: Snacks 4 Snakes

c64:126074.description: Light-cycle game: outlast your opponent while weaving around the enclosure without running into a tail.
c64:126074.title: Snakes

c64:126075.description: Festive game: fly an airborne sleigh, pick up snowballs from the ground and fire them from a cannon at enemies who shoot back.
c64:126075.title: Snow'em Down

c64:126076.description: Run a games company, facing twists drawn from the real experiences of people who worked at Cult Games and D&H.
c64:126076.title: Software House

aliases: Sooty and Sweep's Fun With Numbers
c64:126077.description: Six short maths tests for children up to age seven, featuring Sooty the magic bear with Sweep and Soo.
c64:126077.title: Sooty's Fun With Numbers

c64:126078.description: As Commander Pork, duel the evil Baron von Oinkhofen, whose craft outpaces and outguns yours, relying on LARD missiles and quick reflexes.
c64:126078.title: Space Pig Duel

c64:126079.description: Hold off swarms of alien breeds threatening your space station with a satellite-mounted cannon that fires in your direction of movement, with only two lives to spare.
c64:126079.title: Space Station Hippy

c64:126080.description: Search the basement of a magic castle for the stolen Sparkk formula while its monster is away on a picnic; small monsters sap energy, but the clock is the real enemy.
c64:126080.title: Sparkk

c64:126081.description: Letter-guessing game in three formats: complete nursery rhymes, answer riddles, and fill in famous sayings.
c64:126081.title: Rhymes & Riddles

c64:126082.description: Illustrated interactive fiction: type simple commands, solve puzzles and work out which actions lead to the Serpent's Star.
c64:126082.title: The Serpent's Star

c64:126083.description: Guide Shauny the sheep and Rover the watchdog through the farmyard, rescuing sheep friends and feeding sausages to hungry foxes.
c64:126083.title: Sheep vs Fox

c64:126085.description: SEUCK shooter and winner of the SEUCK 2013 contest: fly a spacecraft in defence of Earth, lasering alien creatures.
c64:126085.title: Sheer Earth Attack

c64:126086.description: After nuclear war, supplies in the Silo 64 fallout shelter have run out, so leave with your robot companion to face the devastated world outside.
c64:126086.title: Silo 64

c64:126087.description: Race down a highway dodging police, roadblocks and potholes, choosing whether to spare or run down jaywalkers and grandmothers to earn angel or devil points.
c64:126087.title: Speed Racer

c64:126088.description: Christmas puzzle: deliver presents to every house, moving only to houses still waiting and crossing forests when needed. From Loadstar 76.
c64:126088.title: Speedy Delivery

c64:126089.description: A spelling program that lets you type in and save lists of up to 50 words, then practice them by seeing a word briefly and spelling it from memory at a chosen difficulty, taking a quiz, or playing hangman with nine wrong guesses allowed.
c64:126089.title: Spell Now

c64:126090.description: One of the earliest text adventures: a knight sets out from a campsite with a mule-like burdenbeast and a dart shooter to recover treasures hidden in the caverns of Spider Mountain. A fantasy rework of Lost Dutchman's Gold with its own odd vocabulary.
c64:126090.title: Spider Mountain Adventure

c64:126091.description: Time presses so a ball that bounces on its own moves forward over and under an endless line of spikes.
c64:126091.title: Spike C64 Dislike

c64:126092.description: Fly a Spitfire across the Channel to destroy grounded flying bombs and enemy planes, and shoot down bombs heading for your base before the fuel runs out.
c64:126092.title: Spitfire 40

c64:126093.description: Spy Hunter-style SEUCK shooter fought on land and sea; sixth in SEUCK Compo 2013, then included as a sample with the fourth Shoot 'Em Up Destruction Set.
c64:126093.title: Spy Rider

c64:126096.description: Logic puzzle: slide a square block to the exit within a move limit, knowing it only halts when it hits an obstacle. From Commodore Format 55.
c64:126096.title: Square Scape 2

c64:126097.description: Two-player space duel: steer your ship and shoot at your opponent, with ten selectable difficulty levels.
c64:126097.title: Starlab

c64:126098.description: One-button game: hold fire to swirl a star around and steer it through rings that pop up at random, without crashing into the walls.
c64:126098.title: Stars and Rings

c64:126099.description: Joust-style game in which Sir Lancelot, with a charmed lance, battles beasts terrorizing a mystical land; paired with Robin Hood on a Double-Ender release.
c64:126099.title: Sir Lancelot

c64:126100.description: Slalom racing: dodge trees and rocks and take the turns tightly for the fastest time.
c64:126100.title: Ski

c64:126101.description: Collect treasure, crosses and jewels in a maze while avoiding skulls; trapdoors and holes drop you to harder levels below, and your map gradually rolls itself up.
c64:126101.title: Skull

c64:126102.description: Slap Fight-inspired vertical space shooter, one of the sample games bundled with SEUCK.
c64:126102.title: Slap and Tickle

c64:126105.description: Smash TV-style arena shooter: as cartoon hero Squibbly Sqwob, win back the pens stolen by the evil ink blot so cartoons can be drawn again.
c64:126105.title: Squibbly Sqwob's Big Day Out

c64:126107.description: Hold fire to swing a star in a circle and let go to fling it off in a straight line, collecting the rings that appear around the play area.
c64:126107.title: Stars and Rings 2

aliases: Play Golf: Pineview Southern Golf Tradition
c64:126109.description: Golf on Pine View, a southern sandhills course drawn to scale hole by hole with bunkers, water, trees, rough and out-of-bounds areas.
c64:126109.title: Pine View: A Southern Golf Tradition

c64:126110.description: Teleport onto starships, find and charge a phaser, shoot the aliens aboard, then reach the console to beam back out.
c64:126110.title: Space Trip

c64:126111.description: Spelling and vocabulary for ages 6 to 9 with over 4,000 words plus your own lists; in Picture Spell, jump Stickybear around platforms to grab the letters of a pictured word.
c64:126111.title: Stickybear Spellgrabber

c64:126112.description: Creative writing program for grades 4 to 9 with a twist-a-plot feature that pushes young authors to branch their stories.
c64:126112.title: Story Tree

c64:126113.description: Two players share one control and must cooperate to hit a set number of targets in time, or both die; medals award extra lives.
c64:126113.title: Strike School

c64:126116.description: SEUCK shooter where cover and mobility are the keys to gunning down enemies before they get you, with music by Richard Bayliss.
c64:126116.title: Strike Team Delta

c64:126118.description: Overhead tank game across 8 battle zones, with rotate-and-thrust controls and narrow branching routes whose sturdy walls offer protection.
c64:126118.title: Super Tank

c64:126119.description: Held prisoner aboard the alien space station Synergy, you break out of your cell and steal a ship. Fly the vertically scrolling station destroying the cargo carriers and turning their rockets on the aliens as you search for a way out.
c64:126119.title: Synergy

c64:126120.description: Bounce a ball over squares that vanish beneath it, some needing several bounces, planning a path that always leaves a safe place to land.
c64:126120.title: Synopsis

c64:126122.title: Nyaaaah! 04: A Licking Experience for Snodge

c64:126123.description: Bowling viewed from behind the bowler: line up left or right, choose an angle and avoid fouling, with scores kept automatically.
c64:126123.title: Ten Pin Bowling

c64:126124.description: Two-player duel between a warrior and an evil doom lord: for five minutes, cast spells that hurl sabres while dodging your rival; the higher score wins.
c64:126124.title: The Temple Warriors!

c64:126126.description: Catch bricks dropping from a rolling bin in a small wheelbarrow; four misses end the game, and difficulty runs from 1 to 15.
c64:126126.title: Thud!

c64:126127.description: Beat 'em up: kick and punch through 24 screens to retrieve four mystic scrolls. Issued on cartridge by RGCD as a reward for the C64 in Pixels Kickstarter.
c64:126127.title: Tiger Claw

aliases: Being a Smart Thinker With the Tink Tonks
c64:126129.description: Tonk roams the floating islands of TinkTonk Land gathering Buddy-Bot parts while avoiding Gork's soldiers and black holes, either of which send him to Gork's Castle; a map helps with navigation in this children's thinking game.
c64:126129.title: Tink! Tonk! Tonk in the Land of Buddy-Bots

c64:126131.description: Slide tiles on a 6x6 grid so a rolling ball travels through every pipe piece exactly once and reaches the goal without hitting a dead end.
c64:126131.title: Tip Trick

c64:126132.description: Contract bridge: bid and play random deals or enter your own, with weak two-bids, rubber scoring, hints, two-person play and saved deals. Winner of the first computer bridge tournament.
c64:126132.title: Tom Throop's Bridge Baron

c64:126133.description: Platform puzzler: guide a duck around platforms and ladders, avoiding hungry enemies; any touch costs one of his three lives.
c64:126133.title: Top Duck

c64:126136.description: SEUCK game for one or two players: drive over the map picking up trash cans and shooting, to reach and destroy a gang's power plant that is polluting the river.
c64:126136.title: Trash Course

c64:126137.description: PET BASIC take on the mainframe Star Trek game, with torpedoes and phasers, stars that can be blown up, and random hazards like space storms that disable systems.
c64:126137.title: Super Trek

c64:126138.description: Loose take on Trivial Pursuit: dice are rolled for you and nearly 2000 mostly lighthearted questions come from six categories.
c64:126138.title: Trivia 64

c64:126139.description: The evil wizard Talis Vaultheart took the Torch of Truth and hid it among the sanctuaries and dungeons of Pastoria, a large island kingdom; a new hero must recover it and take the land back.
c64:126139.title: Torchbearer

c64:126140.description: Simon-style memory game: repeat the computer's ever-lengthening patterns using the joystick directions.
c64:126140.title: Tone-Loco

c64:126141.description: Typing tutor that uses games to teach the keyboard layout, build speed and accuracy, and compare results with other typists.
c64:126141.title: Type!

c64:126143.description: Enter Dracula's burial chamber at nightfall at the south entrance of level one, with the way back sealed and ghouls, zombies and other horrors waiting at every turn.
c64:126143.title: The Tomb of Dracula: Reloaded

c64:126145.description: A Pac-Man-style maze chase: gobble every pellet while four ghosts leave their pens and pursue you once you stray too close. Grabbing a corner power pellet drives them back home for a while, each cleared maze brings a harder one, and you start with five lives.
c64:126145.title: Turbo Maze Man

c64:126146.description: Shanghai variant: clear the board by removing pairs of matching tiles that line up with nothing blocking the path between them.
c64:126146.title: Turn It 2: Future Edition

c64:126147.description: Barbarian-style flick-screen platformer by Martin Piper, given away on Zzap!64's Megatape 35.
c64:126147.title: Tusari

c64:126148.description: Trivia game playable with or without the computer, mixing knowledge, solo or team strategy and some luck.
c64:126148.title: Trivia Fever

c64:126149.description: Jet flight simulator with dogfights versus a friend or the computer, plus training flights to learn the controls; mistakes make the screen border flash red as a warning.
c64:126149.title: Twin Tornado

c64:126150.description: Tetris clone for up to two players competing at the same time. Published in 64'er 1994/11.
c64:126150.title: Two-Tris

c64:126151.description: Pac-Man-style dot collecting across four mazes laid out in screen quadrants, chased by a single ghost in the early stages; the layout keeps changing until you press fire to begin.
c64:126151.title: Ultrex Quadro Maze

c64:126152.description: Educational journey across the USA: walk from state to state, working out when key events happened and which way leads to each state, with an inventory of helpful items.
c64:126152.title: U.S.Adventure

c64:126153.description: Cyberoid-style action game: break out of a space pirate base through more than 70 rooms, gunning down pirates and steering clear of indestructible missiles.
c64:126153.title: Vallation

c64:126154.description: As Adam the Vampire Hunter, armed with a crossbow, thwart the plot of the evil vampire Mozgorioth.
c64:126154.title: Vampire Hunter

c64:126155.description: Adam returns to stop Astaroth, brother of the slain vampire Mozgorioth, who has tipped a deadly poison into New York's sewers.
c64:126155.title: Vampire Hunter 2

c64:126156.description: As Verde of the Rosa Tribe, fly to the nest of the creatures who kidnapped your friends and destroy their giant egg. An entry in the Sideways SEUCK Compo 2010.
c64:126156.title: Verde

c64:126157.description: Three-stage horizontal shooter: down airborne enemies, wiping out whole groups to upgrade to twin shots, while every shot drains weapon energy.
c64:126157.title: V-Ga

c64:126158.description: Tetris clone for one or two players; in two-player mode, clearing two or more lines pushes extra rows onto your opponent.
c64:126158.title: Vioris

c64:126159.description: Shooter that took third place in RGCD's 2014 16KB cartridge competition: collect weapon upgrades and bombs from downed enemies, and bomb the steam engine three times to wreck a space station.
c64:126159.title: Voivod Attack

c64:126160.description: Mad Libs-style game: supply verbs, nouns, adjectives, adverbs and two famous buildings, and the computer weaves them into silly stories.
c64:126160.title: Wacky Stories

c64:126161.description: Guide a spaceman to collect a set number of stars and reach his rocket before time expires; if a playful alien touches him, he teleports away.
c64:126161.title: Walking on the Moon

c64:126162.description: Sequel text adventure: your first visit to the Weird kingdom landed you in a mental hospital, and now its doctors offer a red pill that sends you back.
c64:126162.title: Weird World II

c64:126163.description: As a pioneer around 1900 crossing the country by covered wagon, buy food, supplies and ammunition, hunt, and face attacks and settlements along each leg.
c64:126163.title: Westward Ho

c64:126164.description: Adaptation of the Wheel of Fortune TV show, where contestants spin the wheel and guess letters to solve puzzles; this re-release adds a thousand new ones.
c64:126164.title: Wheel of Fortune: Golden Edition

aliases: Wheel of Fortune: New Third Edition
c64:126165.description: Third Wheel of Fortune release, adapting the TV show with fresh puzzles: up to three contestants spin a wheel and guess the letters of hidden people, places, things and phrases.
c64:126165.title: Wheel of Fortune: New 3rd Edition

c64:126167.description: Sequel to Moebius blending role-playing with side-view real-time martial arts combat, as you train with Moebius and fight thieves, guards and assassins using cartwheels and flying kicks.
c64:126167.title: Windwalker

c64:126168.description: Fly 36 World War II fighters and bombers across four scenarios: intercepting V-1s, night fighting, intercepting bombers, and dogfighting.
c64:126168.title: Wings of War

c64:126171.description: Guide Woody the worm through a series of mazes to the exit, grabbing treasure for bonus points without touching the walls or the patrolling enemies.
c64:126171.title: Woody the Worm

c64:126172.description: Pairs Sheepoid DX, an updated Laser Zone-style shooter, with Woolly Jumper, a side-scrolling platformer with refreshed graphics and better jumping physics.
c64:126172.title: Sheepoid DX

c64:126173.description: Touch-typing tutor: save the planet from space invaders by typing correctly, across four difficulty levels.
c64:126173.title: Word Invaders

c64:126174.description: Quiz game for learning the world's countries, their capitals and other major cities.
c64:126174.title: World Capitals: Countries and Capitals

c64:126175.description: Falling-block puzzler framed by a legend: the ghosts of six sisters stay cursed until all rubble from their tower is cleared, so an engineer stacks rotating pieces into complete lines. Later levels start with blocks already in place, and a row of lights under the well marks the current piece's column.
c64:126175.title: Xetris

c64:126176.description: As an explorer in the Yucatan jungle, gather artifacts for a national museum while hostile natives and hungry critters try to stop you.
c64:126176.title: Yucatan

c64:126177.description: Tetris-like puzzle in the style of Hatris, where pairs of hats and other headwear drop in place of block shapes.
c64:126177.title: Zack

c64:126178.description: Fixed-screen Galaga-inspired shooter by Nick Pelling, ported from the BBC Micro by Pelling himself under the name Orlando M. Pilchard.
c64:126178.title: Zalaga

c64:126179.description: Vertically scrolling shooter: dodge or destroy intricate formations of incoming ships and meteors.
c64:126179.title: Zarcon

c64:126180.description: Crosshair shooter from the SEUCK 2013 competition: defend your city from zombies, but run out of energy and you join them.
c64:126180.title: Zombie Brain Eaters

c64:126181.description: Final chapter of the Zynax trilogy, built with the Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit: blast through a series of zones packed with alien forces, alone or with a second player, and destroy the boss waiting at the end of each one. Music by Richard Bayliss.
c64:126181.title: Zynax 3: The Last Episode

c64:126242.description: Smithers has stolen a diamond for Mr. Burns and snatched Maggie after she caught it; as members of the Simpson family, fight through Burns's henchmen across Springfield to get her back.
c64:126242.title: The Simpsons Arcade Game

c64:126280.description: Scrolling platformer: explore Pharaoh Manilo's tomb for riches, avoiding creatures, spikes, vanishing floors and long falls, with five lives.
c64:126280.title: Tom Thumb

c64:126959.description: Sequel to Thing on a Spring: Thing explores 11 levels of the Toy Goblin's factory, gathering a tape, a floppy disk, listing paper and a ROM chip to shut it down.
c64:126959.title: Coil Cop

c64:127507.description: First-person shooter in a twisting, constantly moving tunnel: shoot enough bats, frogs, rats and other creatures to clear each phase while keeping off the walls.
c64:127507.title: 3D Tunnel

c64:127515.description: First-person Pac-Man: roam a city laid out like a maze, eating blue blocks while avoiding Gloopers, with occasional red blocks that let you eat them; clear every block to escape.
c64:127515.title: 3-D Glooper

c64:127572.description: Turbo Girl, a lieutenant in the Korg army, takes on a suicide mission to destroy three cybernetic Elders who use a robot ship army to intercept a colony's supplies.
c64:127572.title: Turbo Girl

c64:127574.description: Super Sprint-style racing against up to three human or computer drivers, whose skill can be adjusted, across a series of tracks to win the championship.
c64:127574.title: 3D Stock Cars II

c64:127578.description: Ninja beat 'em up: recover stolen documents by fighting guards and big dogs with sword, kicks and forward rolls, picking up shields that match the colour of particle beams to pass them.
c64:127578.title: Kendo Warrior

c64:127579.description: In 2999, fly an armed helicopter through four mostly side-scrolling levels against Mr. Muddy's minions, each ending in a boss.
c64:127579.title: Mr. Heli

c64:127582.description: Compilation of seven pub games: darts, dominoes, bar billiards, table football, the card games pontoon and poker, and skittles.
c64:127582.title: Pub Games

c64:127583.description: Seek the emerald of Scarabaeus in a pharaoh's lost tomb, moving in first-person 90-degree steps with a map's help; on level one, touch nine ghosts to piece together a key.
c64:127583.title: Invaders of the Lost Tomb

c64:127586.description: Adventure licensed from the vampire film, presented in isometric Filmation style like The Great Escape, with monochrome graphics and detailed object interaction and physics.
c64:127586.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre

c64:128019.description: Fly a spaceship over side-scrolling terrain, turning either way and controlling speed, to blast giant mutant camels attacking your base; they change colour as they take damage.
c64:128019.title: Advance of the Mega Camels

c64:128172.description: Scrolling platform shooter: rescue falling fairies by catching them in midair, often above fiery pits you must not touch.
c64:128172.title: Deliverance: Stormlord II

c64:128186.description: Single-screen Dizzy action game: rescue four Yolkfolk from four lands including Cuckoo Land and Zak's Castle, gathering fruit in a maze of blocks.
c64:128186.title: Kwik Snax

c64:128275.description: Fixed-screen shooter seen from behind castle walls: as Gandalf, stop Lizardmen emerging from the woods before they reach your treasure.
c64:128275.title: Gandalf the Sorcerer

c64:128285.description: Action game: as Zorro, leap across buildings, survive huge falls and duel Colonel Garcia's henchmen to rescue a kidnapped senorita.
c64:128285.title: Zorro

c64:128286.description: Keep water flowing through a pipeline, sending a workman to fix the leaks caused by plugs falling onto it while avoiding deadly critters.
c64:128286.title: Pipeline

c64:128373.description: Drive along a road armed with weapons and a smoke screen against other cars, and shoot missiles at a helicopter that attacks from above.
c64:128373.title: 007 Car Chase

c64:128374.description: Fly a Boeing 747 at airports such as Newcastle, Gatwick and Amsterdam, starting with a practice flight toward the words DR SOFT.

c64:129300.description: Board game adaptation for up to four players racing to crack Victorian London mysteries as Holmes, Watson, Irene Adler or Lestrade, choosing from thirty cases.
c64:129300.title: 221 B Baker St.

c64:129303.description: Cartoon platformer by Ste and John Pickford in which every creature is named Zub; as the alien warrior Zub, recover the Green Eye of Zub for the emperor.
c64:129303.title: Zub

c64:129317.description: Pilot a zeppelin through the caves of Zarkifir to undermine the Timelords' base.
c64:129317.title: Zeppelin

c64:129323.description: Third-person action-puzzle game in which a patient on the operating table is trapped in his subconscious by a daemon called Emily and must find four orbs in surreal mini-games.
c64:129323.title: Weird Dreams

c64:129324.description: The Le Mans 24 Hours condensed: beat checkpoint times on a three-section lap that repeats as the race wears on.
c64:129324.title: WEC Le Mans

c64:129361.description: Qix variant: steer a pixel that draws lines, filling enclosed areas with colour; claim 75% of the field, with extra coverage earning bonus points.
c64:129361.title: Zolyx

c64:129461.description: Race six tracks in the Grand Circuit, earning money by finishing position and laps completed, while pitting to change worn tyres and refuel.
c64:129461.title: Pitstop

c64:131182.description: Fourth Freescape 3D game: as a prince or princess with a slingshot, explore a castle's four towers, mixing combat and puzzles, to rescue your beloved from the Magister.
c64:131182.title: Castle Master

c64:131417.description: Egrons disguised as the protected Starglider species have invaded Novenia; fight them off in wireframe 3D using an outdated Airborne Ground Attack Vehicle.
c64:131417.title: Starglider

c64:131418.description: Play the central computer Psytron, keeping the Betula 5 installation running by managing oxygen, food and duties and defending it against saboteurs and attacks.
c64:131418.title: Psytron

c64:131420.description: Explore a large jungle maze as an explorer hunting the four pieces of the ACG amulet.
c64:131420.title: Sabre Wulf

c64:131526.description: Commando-style vertical shooter: destroy the hideouts of the despot Fernandez, who has seized the Republic of El Diablo.
c64:131526.title: Fernandez Must Die

c64:131532.description: Fourth Wally Week arcade adventure: baby Herbert, lost in a big store, must reach his parents Wally and Wilma at the Lost and Found before closing time.
c64:131532.title: Herbert's Dummy Run

c64:131691.description: Geography game: travel by train between US cities planting crystals that multiply, then touch the FuzzBomb with 100 of them to stop it turning people into FuzzBodies.
c64:131691.title: Agent USA

c64:131692.description: Word-association game show: identify objects and categories from clues against the clock, versus the computer or up to three others.
c64:131692.title: The $100,000 Pyramid

c64:131695.description: Fly a stealth plane toward the Tower of Darkness 9999 meters away, destroying radar and bunkers, refuelling at yellow energy fields and avoiding red ones.
c64:131695.title: Stealth

c64:131696.title: The Transformers: Battle to Save the Earth: The Computer Game

c64:131697.description: Side-scrolling race over the ocean in a pedal-powered helicopter, passing rivals on the long way to the finish line.
c64:131697.title: Mancopter

c64:131700.description: As prospector Timothy O'Riley, dig endless mines for coal, oil, gold and gems, avoiding disturbed creatures, which speed up while the moon is out, and a rising underground river.
c64:131700.title: O'Riley's Mine

c64:131730.title: Jack and the Beanstalk (Thor Computer Software)

c64:131734.description: From a bunker outside Washington D.C., blast the flying saucers sent to destroy the capital's landmarks, seen from a first-person view.
c64:131734.title: Saucer Attack!

c64:131847.description: A Viking thawed from the ice in 1983 sets out to conquer Britain, searching 100 locations for the Crown Jewels and working out how to use objects to reach the throne.
c64:131847.title: Brian Bloodaxe

c64:131848.description: As Trogg the caveman, climb ladders and leap platforms collecting gems for points, light bulbs for extra time and every key, often in a set order, across scrolling levels.
c64:131848.title: FRAK!

c64:132293.description: Dizzy adventure: escape from underground and explore the castle to break the troll Rockwart's spell, which has put Daisy to sleep for 100 years.
c64:132293.title: Dizzy: Prince of the Yolkfolk

c64:132535.description: Role-playing game: lead a party of five into a Balrog-guarded stronghold in Zorg's forest to destroy the Evil Lord before his army takes the Fair Land.
c64:132535.title: Lord of the Balrogs

c64:132733.description: Maze game akin to Pac-Man: Dizzy gathers fast-moving food while dodging monsters across 30 levels that rise from very easy to extremely hard.
c64:132733.title: Fast Food (Codemasters)

c64:132823.description: As high school student Mikie, collect all the hearts in each room, from classrooms to the locker room, canteen, aerobics class and playground, to win a girl's affection.
c64:132823.title: Mikie

c64:132824.description: Charlie Fotheringham-Grunes investigates strange signals from the moon and must destroy the monolith responsible in this arcade adventure.
c64:132824.title: Nodes of Yesod

c64:132881.description: Stand guard over a Wild West bank during the gold rush, watching twelve doors where customers arrive to deposit cash while bandits burst in to rob it. Each door must take one deposit per day, and the outlaws grow tougher as the days go on.
c64:132881.title: West Bank

c64:132882.description: Play as Avenger in a fighting game licensed from a gamebook series in the Fighting Fantasy mold, battling through three separately loaded sections: unarmed combat, pole fighting and samurai sword duels.
c64:132882.title: The Way of the Tiger

c64:132883.title: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾

c64:133238.description: A supercomputer named TriComplex III has judged humanity a bug and set out to erase it. Wearing a power suit and backed by an orbiting space station, platform through city buildings, mountain ranges, caves and high-tech bases to stop it.
c64:133238.title: Main Frame

c64:133549.description: Text adventure set in 1888 London as the Ripper murders unfold. After a killing by accident leaves you under suspicion, clear your name before the police, hunting for anyone to blame, arrest you.
c64:133549.title: Jack the Ripper

c64:133550.description: Commando Joe Blade infiltrates Crax Bloodfinger's base to free six kidnapped leaders, viewed side-on across flick screens. Six bombs found along the way start a 20-minute countdown, and defusing each one means solving an ordering puzzle.
c64:133550.title: Joe Blade

c64:133848.description: Fantasy role-playing on the island of Gelnor, where the Black Knights extort sacrifices from town after town. Build a party of adventurers, explore and fight to overthrow the knights and their master Nikademus; one of the earliest RPGs with a bank for keeping gold.
c64:133848.title: Phantasie
