c64:133849.description: Graphic adventure driven by a keyboard verb menu: a detective heads to the Bates Motel one night to recover stolen jewels and the curator taken along with them, with Norman Bates as the prime suspect.
c64:133849.title: Psycho (Box Office Software)

c64:134183.description: The last chapter of the Sir Arthur Pendragon series. Starting on a small island crawling with minions, Pendragon searches for the sinister Skull of Souls, passing the graves of many who tried before him.
c64:134183.title: Dragon Skulle

c64:134184.description: Egypt under the pharaoh Zoser has been struck by a years-long famine, and his desperate subjects have gathered at his temple in Memphis demanding a solution.
c64:134184.title: Imhotep

c64:134185.description: Post-apocalyptic strategy in a 2000 where germ warfare has wrecked civilization and gangs fight over the highways. Lead a road gang in armed vehicles, recruit survivors, scavenge supplies and carry out an FBI mission to find the scientists who can produce a cure.
c64:134185.title: Roadwar 2000

c64:134186.description: First adventure of aristocrat Sir Arthur Pendragon, sent into a castle to search for the magical Staff of Karnath.
c64:134186.title: The Staff of Karnath

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Champions of Krynn
Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dragon Lance Vol. I: Champions of Krynn
c64:134508.description: After the War of the Lance, the party serves the Knights of Solamnia guarding outposts in northeastern Ansalon, and soon uncovers Draconians that were thought long gone. A Dragonlance RPG with tactical turn-based combat.
c64:134508.title: Champions of Krynn

c64:134807.description: Text adventure set in Cricklewood: leaving a prize night at The Liars Club, you find the red-haired Irishman who just won the Cup lying dead, apparently bitten and clawed, and set out to unravel what happened.
c64:134807.title: The Cup

c64:134845.description: Oscar's newly bought castle turns out to be home to the demon Grell and his minions, who are after his soul. Exploring flick-screen rooms, he gathers objects to drive them out while avoiding demons whose touch drains his soul energy.
c64:134845.title: Con-Quest

c64:134847.description: God game on a large scrolling map of forest or desert terrain: look down on your people as a divine figure and guide them to victory over a rival population.
c64:134847.title: Lords

c64:134944.description: Climb a haunted mansion's single-screen platforms to reach the power jewels that ghosts have hidden at the top, grabbing loose jewels on the way while avoiding the ghouls.
c64:134944.title: Ghouls

c64:135647.description: Sequel to Wizard's Crown: demons are pouring through a portal from another dimension, and a party of adventurers must find the Eternal Dagger, the only item that can seal it. Plays like its predecessor, with map exploration and detailed tactical combat.
c64:135647.title: The Eternal Dagger

c64:135685.description: Management sim about a new rock band. Name the group, pick a skill level and chase fame until you reach 1000 popularity points, a million pounds and three status symbols such as a yacht or a castle.
c64:135685.title: It's Only Rock 'n' Roll

c64:135696.description: Breakout variant with the bat placed at the side of the screen instead of the bottom, across 100 screens. Special bricks don't drop capsules; they flip over when struck to reveal what they give.
c64:135696.title: Krakout

c64:135697.description: Captured by brigands in Persia, an adventurer buys his life by agreeing to go into the Dragon's fortress and retrieve the Sword of Kadash. Top-down action-adventure through a labyrinth of chambers and passages.
c64:135697.title: Sword of Kadash

c64:135698.description: Based on the Car Wars board game, mixing role-playing, driving and vehicle combat in a future America ruled by gangs. Build and arm cars, take courier jobs and duel in arenas to earn money and reputation.
c64:135698.title: AutoDuel

c64:135867.description: The Red Warlock Zahgrim has turned the wizard Anakar to stone and seized the land of MariGold. As the hero, fight through the realm with magic and arms to defeat him and restore peace.
c64:135867.title: Black Magic

c64:135878.description: The Fire Mage who kept Stormhaven Bay's four elements in balance has been slain, and monsters now roam the land. Explore and fight to set things right in this action RPG.
c64:135878.title: Fire King

c64:135882.description: Puzzle game across 60 screens: rotate mirrors, each with 16 possible angles, to bend a laser beam around the board, destroying every cell to open the exit while keeping the beam from overloading.
c64:135882.title: Deflektor

c64:135883.description: Puzzle sequel where one or more light beams must be steered to a target by placing tiles: deflectors that turn the beam 90 degrees, solid blocks, and breakable blocks that slow it down.
c64:135883.title: Nova 2

c64:135884.description: A toy-store worker races to keep robot toys from overrunning the store, shutting off the valves that release them and jumping over or stopping escaped toys, all while dodging Hefty Hilda.
c64:135884.title: Toy Bizarre

c64:135918.description: Naval action-strategy set in the Pacific in 1944: command a small strike fleet with 96 hours to secure Leyte Gulf, knocking out shore guns and bunkers, then landing the right number of troops to take each island.
c64:135918.title: Power at Sea

c64:135922.description: Isometric shooter on Xenon, a human colony under alien attack. Fly the Panther aircraft, adjusting height while sweeping across the landscape to rescue the last stranded humans.
c64:135922.title: Panther

c64:135924.description: Sequel to Dimension X: fly a space jet in first person to clear Gorganitor squadrons from all 50 sectors around the planet Jaraloba, using radar and scanners while watching energy, shields and time, and rising through ranks from trainee to star sentinel.
c64:135924.title: Sentinel (Synapse Software)

c64:135976.description: Adaptation of the board game for two to four players building hotels along the Atlantic City boardwalk. Each turn involves rolling two numbered dice plus a color die, stacking markers that represent hotel floors.
c64:135976.title: Advance to Boardwalk

c64:136115.description: Space shooter set among sprawling fortresses lined with gun turrets and drifting asteroids; from Synapse, the makers of Shamus.
c64:136115.title: Survivor

c64:136401.description: Side-scrolling brawler in which the Master of Awesome hunts for a stolen toy robot across the ninja-infested city of Blapsville, from its Ninja Country Club to Lawyer Street.
c64:136401.title: 1,000 Kung-Fu Maniacs

c64:136404.description: Vertical shooter in the mold of 1942: fly a P-38 Lightning over the Pacific islands against Japanese aircraft, starting with a carrier take-off, collecting power-ups and pulling up to three evasive loops.
c64:136404.title: '43: One Year After

c64:136405.description: With Big Brother overthrown, humanity needs energy pods that he hid in caverns beneath four planets, and it falls to you to go and collect them.
c64:136405.title: 1985: The Day After

c64:136406.description: Text-based cycling management from ET Software: pick a country from the top twelve medal nations, choose riders from the era's well-known cyclists and follow home and away races against rival teams.
c64:136406.title: The 1991 World Cup Knockout

c64:136409.description: Olympic-themed foot race over 10,000 metres for exactly two players racing each other head to head.
c64:136409.title: 10000 Meters

c64:136414.description: Two-player Pong-style game dressed up as tennis, with the ball speed set by a difficulty level chosen at the start. A conversion of the German release Finaltag.
c64:136414.title: 2D Tennis Game

c64:136415.description: Vertical shooter where each wave of enemies must be wiped out before the screen scrolls on to the next; getting hit sends you back to the first wave. Given away with the December 1992 issue of 64'er.
c64:136415.title: 2K-Fighter

c64:136422.description: All-text American football strategy: use existing college or pro teams, draft from them or build a team from scratch, then call offensive and defensive plays and follow the play-by-play readout.
c64:136422.title: 3 in 1 College & Pro Football

c64:136438.description: Toolkit for building explorable 3D worlds with Incentive's Freescape engine, the technology behind Driller and Castle Master. Create and place objects with pull-down menus, link rooms, add animation, and script behavior in a simple BASIC-like language.
c64:136438.title: 3D Construction Kit

c64:136439.description: Type-in Q*Bert-style game from Your Computer magazine (March 1984): hop Cubert across a pyramid of 3D blocks, turning each one yellow to finish the level.
c64:136439.title: 3D Cubert 64

c64:136440.description: Math game for children eight and up: fly a spacecraft down a tunnel away from a black hole while solving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems at various difficulty levels.
c64:136440.title: 3D Hypermaths

c64:136443.description: Pac-Man seen from inside the maze: wander first-person 3D corridors eating pills while ghosts may wait around any corner, with an overhead map of the layout beside the view.
c64:136443.title: 3D-Man

c64:136444.description: Guide an ant through scorpion-patrolled tunnels to rescue the queen held in the eighth chamber, using keys and other objects found along the way to open the path forward.
c64:136444.title: Fire Ant

c64:136502.description: Pinball on a single table shown from a tilted angle for a 3D look. Rack up points by hitting targets, ramps, bumpers and bonus lights.
c64:136502.title: 3-D Pinball

c64:136505.description: Chess program from Italy that splits play across two screens, one for entering moves and one for studying the board, with options to rotate the board, change colors and set the difficulty.
c64:136505.title: 3D Scacchi Simulator

c64:136507.description: Scramble-style shooter seen from a 3D perspective: fly over a planet, shooting and bombing enemies, and keep the fuel gauge topped up by bombing fuel tanks on the ground.
c64:136507.title: 3-D Skramble

c64:136508.description: Race a computer opponent to overtake more cars before the laps run out; scraping the roadside or other cars eats into a limited supply of cars.
c64:136508.title: 3D Speed Duel

c64:136531.description: Single-screen platformer starring Thorak, an Eskimo known as Prince of Ice, gathering blocks from a multi-level cave to build a special igloo.
c64:136531.title: Ice Hunter

c64:136545.description: Side-scrolling helicopter shooter: giant bees are besieging the city, so blast or dodge them with the helicopter's Bug Blaster while searching each level for the Queen.
c64:136545.title: 3D Beee

c64:136546.description: Snake game set in outer space, where the growing trail must also contend with assorted enemies, all in psychedelic graphics reminiscent of Jeff Minter.
c64:136546.title: 3D-Roam

c64:136549.description: Lander-style rescue under the sea: steer a submarine down to pick up divers, taking care never to crash into the surrounding scenery. One of the games from Keypunch's Wild Kingdom pack.
c64:136549.title: 4 Fathoms

c64:136551.description: Four separate soccer games in one package: full 11-a-side, five-a-side indoor soccer with fewer rules, street soccer and a soccer skills challenge.
c64:136551.title: 4 Soccer Simulators

c64:136552.description: Solo hacky-sack in paddle form: keep a ball in play by striking it with four paddles in clockwise turn, while an object in the center deflects shots unpredictably. Published in 64'er, April 1992.
c64:136552.title: 4. Times Revlex

c64:136554.description: As pilot of the B-17 Impatient Virgin with the 306th Bomb Group, the player tries to survive 50 bombing missions over France and Germany, directing a ten-man crew. After each mission the crew is rated on difficulty and bombing accuracy.
c64:136554.title: 50 Mission Crush

c64:136557.description: Ten-pin-style bowling seen from just behind and above the bowler. Shift position along the lane, set the throwing angle with the plus and minus keys and choose left or right hand before each roll.
c64:136557.title: 5-Pin Bowling

c64:136560.description: Computer Mastermind: deduce a hidden row of four colors, drawn from six that may repeat, within ten guesses, using the feedback shown beside each attempt.
c64:136560.title: 64 Mastermind: A Game of Logic

c64:136571.description: Gomoku against the computer on a 23x23 grid, aiming for five in a row. A training mode allows taking back moves and asking the computer for the best next move.
c64:136571.title: 64Luff

c64:136572.description: Flight sim putting you in command of a 747 airliner, with a basic outside view of horizon and runway above a full instrument panel including altimeter, artificial horizon, compass, ILS, flaps and landing gear.
c64:136572.title: 747 Flight Simulator

c64:136580.description: Drive a Porsche 911 TS along the road, collecting passengers and dropping them at their homes; running onto the grass damages the car, and the brake lets you stop to turn around.
c64:136580.title: 911TS

c64:136583.description: Version of the arcade game Anteater: push a long snout down into the anthill to collect larvae, eat ants before they bite the snout, strike the queen to wipe out all the ants and creep up on worms from behind.
c64:136583.title: Aardvark

c64:136585.description: Alphabet and spelling practice for three to eight year olds across five games, steering a bright green caterpillar to eat letters in the right order.
c64:136585.title: ABC Caterpillar

c64:136587.description: Steer a craft through gaps in rows of bubbles advancing from left to right, with limited room to move in any direction.
c64:136587.title: Abhor

c64:136588.description: Pitfall-style platformer, borrowing some sprites such as the scorpion, about collecting gold bars past a long run of traps and hazards.
c64:136588.title: Abnormal Faction

c64:136589.description: Asteroids-style shooter: a pilot caught in a huge asteroid cloud blasts rocks with a photon cannon, clearing each round while an alien robot saucer fires across the screen.
c64:136589.title: A-Boulder 64

aliases: Accolade Comics: Steve Keene Private Spy
c64:136592.description: Interactive comic-book adventure about secret agent Steve Keene, told panel by panel as a boy reads it. Keene is sent either to Vienna to find a vanished professor or to investigate strange self-replicating fire hydrants that don't work.
c64:136592.title: Accolade's Comics featuring Steve Keene Thrillseeker

c64:136633.description: Harder, modified take on 720 degrees set in the huge park of Skate City: ollie off ramps, grind rails, weave around pedestrians, buy upgrades at skate shops and enter competitions for medals.
c64:136633.title: 720°: Part 2

c64:136640.description: Combat flight sim in which an invading force has landed on the US south coast, with tanks and gunships moving through Florida and Georgia and fighters heading for Washington. Take to the air in a fighter jet to repel them.
c64:136640.title: ACE: Air Combat Emulator

c64:136641.description: The ACE series moves into space: sent from the mothership Deliverance, recapture Federation planets taken over by enemy forces.
c64:136641.title: ACE 2088

c64:136647.description: Top-down puzzle action in the Crillion line: a vehicle keeps moving in its chosen direction until turned or blocked, and it can only destroy blocks that match its color; clear them all to reach the exit.
c64:136647.title: Acia

c64:136648.description: Lode Runner variant built on timing: use ladders and ropes to gather every item in a level and reach the exit doors before the clock runs out, avoiding the enemies on patrol.
c64:136648.title: Acid Runner

c64:136649.description: Pac-Man variant without power pills: the ghosts can never be eaten, so every green dot must be cleared purely by evading them. Published in a 64'er special issue.
c64:136649.title: Acidman

c64:136650.description: Mahjong solitaire from the 64'er magazine disk: clear the tile layout by taking away matching pairs of free tiles before the time limit runs out, with a hint option on hand and tile designs that are easy to tell apart.
c64:136650.title: Acinna

c64:136652.description: Breakout variant where the wall is made of tiny brick fragments instead of whole bricks; smash every piece to advance and lose a life whenever a ball gets past.
c64:136652.title: Acme Bricks

c64:136654.description: Adaptation of Avalon Hill's Acquire: invest in hotel chains, watch them grow and merge, and profit by buying shares cheap early and selling them high.
c64:136654.title: Computer Acquire

c64:136656.description: Ten aerobatic events for up to four players at four difficulty levels, flying a BD-5J microjet through tasks such as a pylon race, a figure-eight slalom and cutting ribbons.
c64:136656.title: AcroJet

c64:136658.description: COBRA has struck the island of Botsneda, where secret documents were left behind. Pilot an all-terrain AWE buggy across the island to recover them before COBRA does.
c64:136658.title: Action Force: International Heroes

c64:136659.description: Freeware cave flyer: navigate a ship through tunnels full of enemies, traps, lasers and moving doors to reach the landing pad before fuel runs dry.
c64:136659.title: Action on Protection

c64:136662.description: Updated Pong in which the ball bounces off the floor, for two players or against a tough computer opponent. Also released in Italy as Palla.
c64:136662.title: Action-Ball

c64:136664.description: Single-screen shooter spanning 256 waves of bomb-dropping aliens. Your weapon overheats if fired too long and fuel drains as you move, so you grab fireballs during asteroid storms and dock with the mothership for refuelling; up to four players take turns.
c64:136664.title: Ad Infinitum (Mr Chip Software)

c64:136667.description: Number puzzle from Game On magazine: push matching numbers together to remove them, clearing each board in as few moves as possible; some boards also require splitting numbers to reveal new ones.
c64:136667.title: Addgar

c64:136672.description: Math game for ages six to ten: draw walls around numbers on a grid of nine so that each enclosed group adds up to a target sum.
c64:136672.title: Addition Magician

c64:136673.description: Top-down soccer with 24 national teams in a World Cup-style championship with randomly drawn groups, using Kick Off-style dribbling and an optional second human-controlled team.
c64:136673.title: Adidas Championship Football

c64:136674.description: Top-down tennis where movement is automatic and the player chooses the shot near the ball: topspin, lobs and drop volleys via joystick direction. Supports up to 16 players.
c64:136674.title: Tie Break

c64:136675.description: Naval sim as captain of the German raider Admiral Graf Spee in World War II, patrolling the South Atlantic to disrupt Allied shipping. Enemy ships show up as blinking dots on the map.
c64:136675.title: Admiral Graf Spee

c64:136677.description: Fast-reaction action game set in 2042, after a war between China and Russia whose radiation has mutated birds into a hostile new generation.
c64:136677.title: Adrenalin

c64:136678.description: Five-card poker against four computer-controlled opponents, accompanied by intro and outro music.
c64:136678.title: Adult Poker

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dragon Lance: Heroes of the Lance
c64:136681.description: Dragonlance action game following Dragons of Autumn Twilight: the eight Heroes of the Lance descend into a ruined city for the Disks of Mishakal, fighting side-on one hero at a time and swapping between them.
c64:136681.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Heroes of the Lance

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dragon Lance: Dragons of Flame
Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dragons of Flame: A DragonLance Action Game
c64:136682.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dragons of Flame

c64:136685.description: Turn-based space strategy for one to four players: grow the largest empire while surviving rivals and native forces. A classic mode echoes Space Battle Deluxe; an advanced mode adds planetary management.
c64:136685.title: Advanced Space Battle

c64:136690.description: Toolkit for building tile-based role-playing adventures in the style of early Ultima, with custom tiles, maps and objects, starter kits in fantasy, sci-fi and spy settings, and ready-made adventures.
c64:136690.title: Adventure Construction Set

c64:136691.description: Cartridge for making simple dungeon adventures of rooms, hallways, treasure chests, monsters and traps, or generating them at random; saved adventures need the cartridge to play.
c64:136691.title: Adventure Creator

c64:136693.description: Tool for creating text adventures with some pictures, built around a two-word verb-noun parser; define rooms, objects and the logic connecting them.
c64:136693.title: Adventure Master

c64:136695.description: Joke text adventure passed off as an Activision release: you stand in one silent room, the parser understands little beyond LOOK and OPEN, and opening the right object (not the bed or the chair) wins the game and the title of Master Adventurer.
c64:136695.title: Adventure of the Year

c64:136696.description: Text adventure: enter the caves to win back stolen gold guarded by a dragon, then deliver it to the prince so he can raise an army against the evil king.
c64:136696.title: Adventure Without a Name

c64:136699.description: Text adventure in which Barsak the Dwarf hunts for the legendary Nine Treasures of the underworld, regularly finding food and water along the way to avoid dying.
c64:136699.title: Adventures of Barsak the Dwarf

c64:136700.description: Comedy adventure in a television studio: Basildon Bond has five hours to gather codes for his boss 'P', renamed 'B' to fool the KGB, by assembling jokes found around the rooms.
c64:136700.title: The Adventures of Bond... Basildon Bond

c64:136701.description: Adventure based on the 1984 film: play Dr. Buckaroo Banzai, neurosurgeon, physicist, rock guitarist and foe of the criminal mastermind Hanoi Xan.
c64:136701.title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai: Across the 8th Dimension!

c64:136702.description: Platformer starring Jim, a ball, chasing a demon that stole a magical skull across 15 worlds of three levels each.
c64:136702.title: The Adventures of Jim Slim in Dragonland

c64:136703.description: Sail among Aegean bays and islands hunting treasure, where touching rock costs a ship. At each island a clue helps decide whether to search; choose right to find treasure.
c64:136703.title: Aegean Voyage

c64:136704.description: Fitness program combining general workouts with routines aimed at particular body areas, so a routine can be tailored to individual needs.
c64:136704.title: Aerobics

c64:136707.description: Police investigation from Infogrames: as a detective sergeant in Saint-Etienne, examine the scene where Vera Cruz was found dead in her apartment and work the case to its solution.
c64:136707.title: Vera Cruz

c64:136710.description: Text adventure set in an aging Victorian-era hotel, opening with an ominous welcome from its management, who hope you will stay among Mr Robinson's many guests.
c64:136710.title: Africa Gardens

c64:136711.description: Two-word text adventure about searching for the missing Dr. Livingston deep in Africa, typed as verb-noun commands like GET BOOK.
c64:136711.title: African Adventure: In Search of Dr. Livingston

c64:136715.description: Text adventure that opens at an office birthday celebration: when talk turns to birthday kisses, you sneak off and end up hiding in a stall of the men's toilets, which is where your troubles begin.
c64:136715.title: After the Party

c64:136722.description: Dragonlance strategy for one or two players: lead armies, heroes and special forces against the Highlord Dragonarmies, send heroes questing for magic, win nations over with diplomats and hunt down enemy heroes.
c64:136722.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: War of the Lance

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Forgotten Realms: Hillsfar
c64:136723.description: Single-hero Forgotten Realms role-playing in the city of Hillsfar: join a local guild and take on its master's missions for gold and glory, with action sequences such as riding, lockpicking and arena fights.
c64:136723.title: Hillsfar

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Forgotten Realms Vol. III: Secret of the Silver Blades
c64:136724.description: Third Forgotten Realms Gold Box adventure: the heroes of the two earlier games return, pulled through a magic well into a frozen mining town under siege, without any of their gear, and must uncover the secret of the Silver Blades.
c64:136724.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Secret of the Silver Blades

c64:136725.description: Dragon-riding flight sim set in Dragonlance's War of the Lance. Across 20 missions, intercept enemy dragons, sink ships and defend the forces of good, earning rank, magic items, hit points and better dragons.
c64:136725.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: DragonStrike

c64:136726.description: Gold Box RPG in the Savage Frontier: after escorting a caravan from Adbar to Yartar, the party is drugged at a tavern and wakes to find nearly everything stolen, and must track down what happened.
c64:136726.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Gateway to the Savage Frontier

c64:136727.description: Budget pinball from Codemasters on a wizardry-themed table with extra flippers along both sides, where the best scores come from repeatedly battering banks of blocks.
c64:136727.title: Advanced Pinball Simulator

c64:136753.description: Deliberately punishing game in which you have just died and must earn a place in the Afterworld, the loveliest place in existence, against the wishes of its boss.
c64:136753.title: The Afterworld

c64:136756.description: An alien weed is draining the life from eight planets. Land a ship loaded with Agent Orange on each one and spread the herbicide while alien fighters try to stop you.
c64:136756.title: Agent Orange

c64:136757.description: Sequel to Agent X: the Mad Professor plots to give everyone acne and wreck the economy, and the agent must stop him across several distinct game sections.
c64:136757.title: Agent X II: The Mad Prof's Back!

c64:136758.description: Mad scientists from the constellation of the Cat have abducted Aghamix, sovereign of the planet Aghamix. Fight through each stage to free her.
c64:136758.title: Aghamix

c64:136760.description: Self-consciously absurd platformer: collect the underwear scattered around each level and avoid everything else to move on.
c64:136760.title: AGTMNS: A Game That Makes No Sense

c64:136762.description: Help Teddy escape the innermost of 99 nested toy boxes by stacking building blocks in the right order to form steps, and soothe the crying baby along the way.
c64:136762.title: Ah diddums

c64:136763.description: Xevious-inspired vertical shooter over six levels: gather power-ups strong enough to beat the bosses, with the distance to each level's end shown at the start and after every lost life. From Golden Disk 64.
c64:136763.title: Aidon: The Apocalypse

c64:136764.description: Fantasy action game: the gods sealed the Great Darkness into five stones, and as the Darkness returns, a warrior foretold by Aigina's prophecy sets out to find them and claim their power.
c64:136764.title: Aigina's Prophecy

c64:136768.description: Simple BASIC shooting gallery: pop a drifting balloon before it gets to the barn, usually with only two shots per crossing.
c64:136768.title: Air Defender

c64:136769.description: Machine-code remake of Chopper Rescue: fly a helicopter through a labyrinth to rescue people, now with mobile drones patrolling the entire maze instead of fixed sectors.
c64:136769.title: Air Rescue I

c64:136770.description: Early real-time strategy: command an army of robots from a helicopter that bombs enemy robots, ferries your own units around the map and issues them orders.
c64:136770.title: Air Support

c64:136773.description: Instrument-only flight sim written in BASIC: no cockpit view or action, just a full panel of airspeed, flaps, heading, altitude and climb rate to fly by.
c64:136773.title: Airliner

c64:136777.description: Side-scrolling shooter: a jet-pack fighter battles flying and bouncing creatures of the ancient world on the way to the Akropolis, collecting hidden statues to win. Its Italian release was titled Ancient World.
c64:136777.title: Akropolis

c64:136778.description: Workout program from The Big 100 collection: choose difficulty and session length, then follow an on-screen trainer through exercises and movements.
c64:136778.title: Aktiv

c64:136779.description: Preview of a horizontally scrolling shooter meant for Mastertronic in 1988: you guide a large flying figure with a short-range shot against waves of attackers, with the status bar placed out in the screen border. It was never released, and a cracking group leaked the build.
c64:136779.title: Ala

c64:136780.description: Escape from Alcatraz: a tunnel and a waiting boat are ready, but the guards have discovered the plan and try to stop the prisoner reaching the mainland.
c64:136780.title: Alcatraz

c64:136782.description: Strategy adventure: travel across a countryside of fortresses, gathering items along the way, then enter the fortress of Alcazar to find the crown. A strategy map gives an overview of the land.
c64:136782.title: Alcazar: The Forgotten Fortress

c64:136783.description: Tron-style light-cycle game for up to three players, with many selectable worlds and a built-in level editor; keep your line going without crashing.
c64:136783.title: Alderan

c64:136786.description: Children's maze game: lead blue ALF through the Color Caves, squeezing and wriggling through passages while avoiding the Wufflegumps, pairs of eyes that block the way.
c64:136786.title: Alf in the Color Caves

c64:136787.description: Based on the TV series: ALF has crash-landed on the Tanners' garage and must repair his spaceship and load it with cat provisions before he can fly home to Melmak.
c64:136787.title: ALF

c64:136789.description: Educational dungeon crawl that drills algebra: climb to the highest floor carrying two keys, keeping enough gold to avoid being eaten by a dragon and dodging spiders whose third bite kills.
c64:136789.title: The Algebra Dragons

c64:136790.description: Humanity's last forces strike back at the alien Aliants: an arcade landing at the hidden base Valley Forge and a laser simulator test lead into a strategy campaign commanding battle carriers on a 10x10 grid to liberate captured colonies.
c64:136790.title: Aliants: The Desperate Battle for Earth!

c64:136828.title: Alice in Videoland: The Further Adventures

c64:136833.description: Puzzle-focused platform adventure based on Lewis Carroll's two Alice books, built on the Below the Root engine, with inventory puzzles and riddles drawn from the stories.
c64:136833.title: Alice in Wonderland

c64:136835.description: Defend your territory from an alien ship that sweeps overhead with a power beam and drops swarms of Yeepods. Fire missiles until power runs low; while the base recharges, you are left defenseless.
c64:136835.title: Alien (Personal Computer News)

c64:136846.description: Based on the film: Ripley crash-lands on the prison planet Fiorina 161 and must fight through its corridors with flamethrower, grenades and pulse rifle, using a motion tracker to find and rescue prisoners from the aliens.
c64:136846.title: Alien 3

c64:136853.description: Scrolling shooter across nine levels: stop alien ships from planet HD3121 before they reach Earth.
c64:136853.title: Alien Bash 2

c64:136864.description: Platform game in which a special agent infiltrates terrorist headquarters to plant explosives and gather evidence, using lifts, shooting, jumping, ducking and magnetic cards that open force fields.
c64:136864.title: Agent UOP

c64:136865.description: Flying rally: fly a plane around courses of rally points, either built and saved yourself or generated by the computer, against the clock, while keeping an eye on RPM, altitude and other gauges.
c64:136865.title: Air Rallye

aliases: Quest for the Ancient Tome of Aliard
c64:136869.description: Years after the wizard Aliard rescued Malhek from the Demon Dungeons of Cail and lost his Tome of Magic Spells there, Malhek returns to the dungeons to recover the book.
c64:136869.title: Aliard's Tome

c64:137031.description: After a lost space battle, fly a rescue craft over enemy territory, collecting survivors' life capsules from the planet's surface and bringing them back to safety.
c64:137031.title: Alien Rescue

c64:137032.description: Shoot down aliens that try to land, though they cleverly dodge your shots; four successful landings ends the game.
c64:137032.title: Alien Sidestep

c64:137033.description: Beat 'em up and shooter based on the Sega arcade game: pick Karla, Gordon or Scooter of the Alien Busters, each armed differently and with a unique special move, to purge an alien invasion of Earth.
c64:137033.title: Alien Storm (U.S. Gold)

c64:137041.description: Side-scrolling shooter from the Gamma Strike pack, where the final boss stage switches to the bundled light phaser; hits nearer the bullseye do more damage.
c64:137041.title: The Alien Team

c64:137042.description: Kai's bride-to-be Medb is abducted by Slough Feg, who also turns Kai into an insect. Aided by the Druid Lords' magic, cross the Cave of Dreams to rescue her.
c64:137042.title: Alien World

c64:137043.description: Run and shoot through an underground maze in Subterrania while berserk aliens chase you wherever you go.
c64:137043.title: Aliens from Subterrania

c64:137044.description: Science-fiction platformer on the planet Alioth: after an experiment goes wrong, a robot armed with a gun of limited ammunition is sent in to wipe out the mutants, some of which have defenses against bullets.
c64:137044.title: Alioth

c64:137046.description: Basketball for one or two players, with an eight-team American tournament or exhibition games and options for skill level and game length.
c64:137046.title: All-American Basketball

c64:137047.description: Cricket licensed to Allan Border, with all the international sides and editable player names; Audiogenic's follow-up to Graham Gooch's Test Match.
c64:137047.title: Allan Border's Cricket

c64:137048.description: Inspired by Hunchback: Thomas the cat crosses the neighborhood screen by screen to reach his date, leaping walls and gates while dodging thrown boots and bottles.
c64:137048.title: Alley Cat

c64:137049.description: A shooter dressed up as bowling: move across eight wrapping lanes firing bowling balls at pins while dodging wine bottles, and catch falling strike and spare symbols to fill a scorecard, with ten symbols clearing the level.
c64:137049.title: Alley-Oops!: It Turns Bowling Upside Down

c64:137050.description: Unreleased shooter set in 2059, when humanity has split into two advanced species whose vast nations are at war.
c64:137050.title: Alliance

c64:137051.description: Sideways-scrolling shoot-'em-up with parallax backdrops for one or two players at once, running over eight stages that end in boss fights, with a choice of weapons such as a bouncing laser and music by Jeroen Tel. Starlight ran into money trouble before release, so the finished game was shelved.
c64:137051.title: Alloyrun

c64:137052.description: Arcade adventure across a 1700-screen African savannah: find the Almazz diamond within 40 days. Walking keeps the explorer's body temperature down, while running is faster but pushes the heat gauge toward its limit.
c64:137052.title: Almazz

c64:137092.description: Educational maze game for young children: race around a top-down maze collecting scattered letters, using two teleporters that drop you at random spots, with a picture of an object shown in the center of each maze.
c64:137092.title: Alphabet Zoo

c64:137093.description: Spy adventure: a priceless vase stolen in Peking and secret missile plans taken from a base in the Rocky Mountains both trace back to VODOC, a shadowy organization that manipulates world events for profit.
c64:137093.title: The Alpine Encounter

c64:137094.description: Logic game: deduce which of ten animals rides in each of a tram's four cars by placing four animals per turn and using the feedback on each guess.
c64:137094.title: Alpine Tram Ride

c64:137124.description: Comic text adventure full of puns and in-jokes: rescue Sally Software from the clutches of Sink. Typing HELP gives hints at some locations.
c64:137124.title: Al-Strad

c64:137125.description: After an asteroid storm cripples a Strato-Cruiser in deep space, the pilot must set down on the nearest world, Altair 4, a galactic prison planet.
c64:137125.title: Altair 4

c64:137126.description: Puzzle platformer where a hero is shadowed by a phantom alter ego mirroring every move from across the screen, horizontally or vertically. Swap places a limited number of times per level to slip past enemies and reach otherwise inaccessible spots.
c64:137126.title: Alter Ego

c64:137127.description: First-person role-playing: abducted from Earth by aliens, you are dropped into a strange yet familiar city in another dimension and must explore it for clues leading to your captors and the way home.
c64:137127.title: Alternate Reality: The City

c64:137128.description: Isometric action game: pilot the Arachnus 4 over the city of Amaurote with five million units of cash, destroying the invading insects, which include drones, scouts and deadly queens.
c64:137128.title: Amaurote

c64:137131.description: Answer science and nature questions correctly to find your way through a maze and out.
c64:137131.title: Amazer: Science

c64:137132.description: Race through a maze versus the computer, another player, or both together.
c64:137132.title: Amazing Maze

c64:137133.description: Dr. Doom plans to blow up New York with a stolen atomic bomb, so Spider-Man and Captain America head to Latveria together, fighting a string of Marvel villains in one-on-one combat. A comic book is bundled to tell the story.
c64:137133.title: The Amazing Spider-Man and Captain America in Dr. Doom's Revenge!

c64:137134.description: Platformer set on a film studio lot: Spider-Man rescues Mary Jane from Mysterio, stunning enemies with webbing and avoiding contact with them.
c64:137134.title: The Amazing Spider-Man

c64:137135.description: A lone warrior carrying a blowpipe and only so many darts faces seven trials in the Amazon rainforest, the first three in the jungle, killing creatures and overcoming obstacles.
c64:137135.title: Amazon Warrior

c64:137136.description: Single-screen space shooter: fly anywhere on screen, blasting enemies that enter from the top and travel downward at varied speeds, rebounding off the side walls.
c64:137136.title: Ambush

c64:137138.description: Side-scrolling run-and-gun with a marine of the Astro Marine Corps blasting through alien-infested levels, restoring energy with 'E' pickups and collecting other power-ups.
c64:137138.title: A.M.C.

c64:137139.description: Guide an anteater to eat ants and every dot while avoiding poisoned pieces.
c64:137139.title: Ameisenbär

c64:137140.description: Five geography mini-games for learning the names and locations of the US states, set on a US map and using a special keyboard overlay.
c64:137140.title: America: Coast to Coast

c64:137144.description: Pool and billiards for one or two players, with tournament play and matches that can pit player against player, player against computer, or computer against computer.
c64:137144.title: American 3D Pool

c64:137145.title: The American Challenge: A Sailing Simulation

c64:137146.description: Ride a Harley-Davidson across the United States, starting from Seattle toward Portland. Released on Magic Disk.
c64:137146.title: American Express

c64:137147.description: American football versus the computer or a second player, seen top-down over the whole field; after naming teams and a coin toss, plays are called by typing their first two letters.
c64:137147.title: American Football

c64:137148.description: Tag-team wrestling: each player picks two wrestlers and tags the fresh one in from the ring edge when the active partner weakens, letting the other recover.
c64:137148.title: American Tag-Team Wrestling

c64:137151.description: Puzzle game in which Morphe the blob wanders on his own, turning by a fixed order of preference, and you must lay special tiles in front of him to build a path past the obstacles, working within a limited supply of tiles and time to get him back to his mothership.
c64:137151.title: Amorphous

c64:137152.description: Text adventure: recover the seven shards of a shattered amulet scattered through time. Released by the Guild alongside The Scoop.
c64:137152.title: The Amulet

c64:137153.description: Drive an Ace Mk2 Interceptor tank through 16 top-down stages on the rebel-held planet Sentinel 4, destroying weapon caches that cannot be shot from point-blank range, so each approach needs planning.
c64:137153.title: Anarchy

c64:137154.description: Jeff Minter shooter starring a two-legged yak-like creature that fires bananas, with the ammunition changing on later screens. Jump and flip onto the ceiling to fight from upside down.
c64:137154.title: Ancipital

c64:137155.description: Maze shooter: destroy five Militoids within a time limit across three mazes, steering clear of shooting aliens, mines and twenty robots that can't be destroyed blocking the way.
c64:137155.title: Android 2

c64:137156.description: Galactic conquest for one to four players: found and defend colonies, spend each turn's resources before they expire and fight rivals for control of star systems.
c64:137156.title: Andromeda Conquest

c64:137157.description: Text adventure commanding the starship Andromeda III and twenty crew members, sent from Earth to uncover the secret left by the Dawn People, space travelers who visited at the dawn of time.
c64:137157.title: Andromeda III

c64:137158.description: Hungarian text adventure that begins at the cold gate of the underworld, with the river Styx and Charon the ferryman to the south and a grinning skull to the north.
c64:137158.title: Angel of the Hell

c64:137159.description: Tile puzzle about matching tiles in threes along angled lines. Published in Game On, March 1992.
c64:137159.title: Angle

c64:137180.description: Lay out the house you have always wanted, choosing everything from wall colours and sinks to the roof and appliances such as dishwashers and dryers, then walk through and test it. Styles include a colonial farmhouse, and every home gets a living room, kitchen, bathroom and two bedrooms.
c64:137180.title: Dream House

c64:137194.description: Turn-based wargame of the Vietnam War with six scenarios of 15 to 25 turns, each turn split into eleven phases, scored by victory points for units destroyed.
c64:137194.title: NAM

c64:137195.description: Anteater-style maze game: extend a robotic drilling arm through the ground to pump oil, retracting it fast enough to keep underground creatures from biting the pipe.
c64:137195.title: Oil's Well

c64:137196.description: Illustrated text adventure in Kerovnia, a land where strangeness is routine and King Erik is unpopular for banishing the whisky-brewing Roobikyoub dwarves. The goal is to find a way out.
c64:137196.title: The Pawn

c64:137224.description: Children's memory game: briefly see which animals occupy three or six hotel rooms, for one to five seconds, then recall who is in a room picked at random.
c64:137224.title: Animal Hotel

c64:137225.description: Five-card stud against a computer opponent, with an animated card character announcing each stage of the game.
c64:137225.title: Animated Strip Poker

c64:137226.description: Number puzzle: click squares to raise their values until the grid matches the target pattern shown alongside.
c64:137226.title: Aniso

c64:137228.description: Flick-screen arcade adventure: steer a Mindprobe through the 64 rooms of the 'Metareal' world of Ankh, shooting back at roaming attackers and working through doors to reach what waits in the last room.
c64:137228.title: Ankh

c64:137230.description: Very hard platform shooter in forest ruins: a hunter with bow and arrows fights strange monsters, and turns into a faster but more fragile snake to travel underground.
c64:137230.title: Annaconda

c64:137232.description: Grand strategy from 273 BC: as a Roman senator, direct generals and armies to expand Rome across the known world and hold it against Carthaginians, Parthians, Persians, Vandals and others.
c64:137232.title: Annals of Rome

c64:137233.description: Sequel to Annihilator: fly a scrolling side-view shooter over planets of the Messier 31 galaxy, crossing three stages per planet and capturing its inhabitants.
c64:137233.title: Annihilator 2

c64:137234.description: In 2016, earthquakes have wrecked nuclear plants around San Francisco and survivors hide underground. Their only escape is a set of new matter transporters, which need special crystals from the contaminated surface to run.
c64:137234.title: Another World

c64:137235.description: Isometric action in the walled city of Antescher, overrun by giant ants: play as a boy or girl, explore the city freely in three dimensions and rescue a partner trapped there.
c64:137235.title: Ant Attack

c64:137236.description: Pete's vegetable garden is swarming with ants. Use a backpack-fed high-pressure hose to drown them over several levels, while keeping the plants watered in the heat.
c64:137236.title: Anter-Planter

c64:137237.description: Missile Command-style defense with four ships dropping tiny-radius charges that must land precisely in the path of falling bombs to stop them.
c64:137237.title: Anti

c64:137240.description: Shooter that turns scoring upside down: the farther you advance, the fewer points you earn, with a wide arsenal of weapons. Published on a Commodore Format cover tape in 1995.
c64:137240.title: Antifriction

c64:137242.description: Single-screen gallery shooter: from a homestead window, aim a crosshair at mounted attackers riding past to protect yourself and a party of six.
c64:137242.title: Indian Attack

c64:137243.description: In 1997, fly an AH-64 Apache through the skyscraper canyons of an enemy city to hunt down and destroy the Strategic Defense Computer, fighting off helicopters and tanks on the way.
c64:137243.title: Apache Strike

c64:137244.description: Officer Bob must book a daily quota of offenders such as litterbugs and speeders by chasing them down and hitting the siren, sometimes ramming them off the road; making a hardened criminal confess wraps up the day.
c64:137244.title: APB

c64:137245.description: Donkey Kong-style platformer without ladders: hop between platforms using raised sections, grab bonus items and dodge the bombs flung by a crazed ape.
c64:137245.title: Ape Craze

c64:137246.description: Simulation of a fictional Apollo moon mission in the early 1980s, continuing after Apollo 17, with crackly digitized mission-control speech and telemetry screens that must be set correctly at each stage.
c64:137246.title: Apollo 18

c64:137247.description: Horizontal shooter: slip past the inner defenses, drop photon missiles to cripple the enemy and destroy the hostile boss creature. Published in Game On, August 1991.
c64:137247.title: Apoxoly

c64:137249.description: Climb up a cider factory's apple conveyor as a spider, jumping obstacles and scaling thick threads past rolling apples, crushing presses and other creatures.
c64:137249.title: Apple Cider Spider

c64:137250.description: Speedboat racing over 20 courses: beat a qualifying time, then beat the race time to move on, while staying between the course posts.
c64:137250.title: Aqua Racer

c64:137253.description: The global sect Arachne kidnaps people with psychic gifts, drains their energy and leaves them to die as it works to awaken supernatural powers and seize the world. Stop the cult. Also published as Oberator.
c64:137253.title: Arachne

c64:137254.description: Based on the film: deadly South American spiders have invaded American towns, and an exterminator clears infested farms, houses and public buildings with Toxi-Max pesticide, aided by an arachno-detector.
c64:137254.title: Arachnophobia

c64:137261.description: Sequel to Nodes of Yesod: Charlie travels to the planet Ariat to keep its makers, the Ariatans, from accessing vital Earth data carried there by the moon monolith.
c64:137261.title: The Arc of Yesod

c64:137268.description: Top-down racer in black, white and grey styled after Atari's 1970s Sprint arcade games. Published in 64'er magazine.
c64:137268.title: Arcade Classic

c64:137270.description: Compilation of four unofficial arcade clones: Asteroids (as Rocks in Space), Snakes (as Worm Warz), Space Invaders (as Invaders) and Space Wars.
c64:137270.title: Arcade Classics

c64:137272.description: Arcade flying across three eras: a World War I biplane over Germany, a World War II plane over Pearl Harbor and a World War III jet. Shoot down all enemy planes, return to base for a bomb, then fly back to drop it on the target.
c64:137272.title: Arcade Flight Simulator

c64:137273.description: Educational football game where progress depends on answering math questions, such as simplifying fractions to make a first down or working out percentages.
c64:137273.title: Arcade Football

aliases: Arcade Fruit Machine: Cash and Grab
c64:137274.description: Fruit machine simulation with a Cash 'n' Grab feature: collect numbers during play to light up all the letters, then pick one of three bonuses such as Pick a Win, Fruit Step or Win Spins.
c64:137274.title: Arcade Fruit Machine

c64:137276.description: Quiz for up to three players with four rounds of questions in six categories, from art and literature to sport, history and geography, chosen from icons arranged in a pyramid.
c64:137276.title: Arcade Trivia Quiz

c64:137277.description: Educational shooter: move a cannon along the bottom and blast descending rows of five alien ships, each carrying an addition problem.
c64:137277.title: Alien Addition

c64:137278.description: Math drill: an alligator with a number on its belly must snap up only the equations racing in from the right that equal that number, and let the wrong ones pass.
c64:137278.title: Alligator Mix

c64:137279.description: Educational action game: tanks bearing division problems advance on your bunkers; correct answers aim your anti-tank guns, wrong ones make the shots miss.
c64:137279.title: Demolition Division

c64:137280.description: Arithmetic drill with a dragon to protect: answer multiplication and division problems quickly enough to halt the rockets raining down on it, moving up through the game as your number skills improve.
c64:137280.title: Arcademic Skillbuilder: Dragon Mix

c64:137283.description: Math shooter: a rotating space station fires in eight directions at incoming meteors carrying multiplication problems; hitting the wrong one speeds it up, and a single impact ends the game.
c64:137283.title: Meteor Multiplication

c64:137284.description: Subtraction practice: green slime blobs with problems ooze down toward the player's laser cannon, which must zap them with the right answers.
c64:137284.title: Minus Mission

c64:137285.description: Word search themed on video games: within ten minutes, find twenty words hidden in a grid of 374 letters, ten across and ten down.
c64:137285.title: ArcadeSearch

c64:137297.description: Aliens head for Earth in twenty huge cylinders packed with cities, farmland, factories, power plants, army bases and even shoe shops. A lone pilot is sent to destroy them.
c64:137297.title: W.A.R

c64:137319.description: Scrooge McDuck races his rival Flintheart Glomgold to amass the greatest fortune, flying to expeditions around the world in search of treasure.
c64:137319.title: DuckTales: The Quest for Gold

c64:137320.description: Navy F/A-18 combat flight sim across four missions with carrier take-offs and landings, bombing runs, strafing and dogfights, completing objectives in order.
c64:137320.title: F-18 Hornet

c64:137321.description: Illustrated text adventure in inter-dimensional espionage: a veteran agent who can warp into any living creature, in any dimension, is called off vacation and finds himself in the body of a goldfish.
c64:137321.title: Fish!

c64:137326.description: Computer version of the Cluedo board game: deduce who killed Mr. Boddy in his mansion, with which weapon and in which room, from a shuffled deck of 30 cards.
c64:137326.title: Clue: Master Detective

c64:137381.description: With two and a half hours of Twilight left before Shedding Moon Eve, steal the Dark Clavicle, a book of black magic, from the castle Arcana of the evil northern king Valarequil.
c64:137381.title: Arcana

c64:137382.description: Two-player treasure race: grab the gold and escape the maze ahead of your rival archaeologist does.
c64:137382.title: Archeologist Duel

c64:137384.description: Vertically scrolling sword-and-sorcery shooter by Alf Yngve for one or two players at once: as a knife-throwing hero you march up through a fantasy realm, the Otherworld, felling hordes of creatures and freeing hostages on a quest to restore harmony between Tara and Uisnech.
c64:137384.title: Archetype

c64:137385.description: Text adventure: the sole survivor of the airship Hesperus washes ashore on a remote Pacific island and finds a cave passage leading down into an undersea tunnel network.
c64:137385.title: Archipelago

c64:137401.description: Sequel to Archon with a more complex board: two Adepts, of Order and Chaos, cast spells and summon elementals and demons, and fight it out in real-time combat when pieces meet.
c64:137401.title: Archon II: Adept

c64:137402.description: Shipwreck survivors cling to an unstable ice floe in the Arctic. As a mammoth, shift your weight to keep the floe from tipping over in the wind and spilling them into the sea.
c64:137402.title: Arctic Shipwreck

c64:137409.description: The American release of Asterix and the Magic Cauldron with the hero redrawn as a barbarian: search fifty screens of village, Roman camp and forest for pieces of a smashed cauldron, trading punches and kicks with boars and soldiers.
c64:137409.title: Ardok the Barbarian

c64:137412.description: Wizard duels: the High Mage holds a deadly sorcery contest in the arena to choose his successor, and you must eliminate every rival wizard.
c64:137412.title: Arena (Cult Games)

c64:137415.description: Top-down shooter set in a futuristic Galactic Arena in 3000: survive endless waves of killer robots that get faster each level, with optional twin-joystick controls for moving and shooting separately.
c64:137415.title: Arena 3000

c64:137417.description: Conquer at least 90% of enemy territory while avoiding three kinds of alien ship to advance to harder levels.
c64:137417.title: Arex

c64:137419.description: In 2152, Captain Cord of the Space Fleet hunts the space bandit Valdira, who framed him using a hologram of Cord, to clear his name.
c64:137419.title: The Argon Factor

c64:137420.description: Players team up to explore deep space, hunting relics of an ancient alien civilization, whose recovered secrets once sent human progress soaring. Built by Children's Television Workshop around teamwork, it makes every voyage a different expedition.
c64:137420.title: The Argos Expedition

c64:137421.description: A pirate imprisoned on a remote island is offered freedom if he wipes out an evil High Priest and his cult. Find the sacred scroll and fight cult members with weapons collected along the way.
c64:137421.title: Ark Pandora

c64:137423.description: Polish action game: Emil the penguin hops across floating ice floes from the bottom-left of the screen to his igloo at the top-right, bringing fish home to his family.
c64:137423.title: Arktyczne Polowanie

c64:137426.description: Horizontal shooter across eight sectors of the Delta region, blasting through what remains of a long-forgotten war's technology; marketed as a sequel to Delta.
c64:137426.title: Armalyte: Competition Edition

c64:137427.description: Invaders from the Milky Way descend on Mobanti, a planet that has lived for centuries in peaceful isolation and has no means of defending itself, and its leader must find a way to fight back.
c64:137427.title: Armourdillo

c64:137428.description: A three-day stint of army training as a single-screen shooting gallery. Day one is target practice on the range, scored on hits against misses; day two swaps rifles for darts while birds fly through the line of fire; the last day tests everything learned. Made for a light gun, with joystick control as well.
c64:137428.title: Army Days

c64:137535.description: Dodge objects falling from the ceiling, which turn into collectible goodies once they land; later levels add rolling balls to jump over.
c64:137535.title: Arrivo

c64:137536.description: Free alien party guests from their spacecraft and guide them safely down to the landing pad at TND HQ; letting one hit the ground ends the game.
c64:137536.title: Arrow Busters

c64:137537.description: Kniffel, the German Yahtzee-style dice game, for up to six players, with the computer rolling dice and keeping scores and a high-score list across rounds.
c64:137537.title: Arscet

c64:137538.description: Fly a small ship down a long space tunnel as enemies arrive in convoys. Wiping out an entire convoy adds another laser to your guns, though dodging a wave is often wiser than fighting it; avoid the explosion clouds, slip through laser barriers when they open and watch for attacks from behind.
c64:137538.title: Artax

c64:137539.description: Two-player artillery duel across mountains: take turns setting barrel angle and powder charge within a time limit to land a shell on the opposing gun. From Golden Disk 64.
c64:137539.title: Artillery '90

c64:137540.description: Tetris with standard rules where each completed line uncovers part of a hidden picture; revealing the whole image advances the level. Released on Magic Disk 64.
c64:137540.title: Artris

c64:137541.description: Side-scrolling platformer loosely drawing on Arthurian myth: Artura, son of Pendragon, wields an axe against spiders, bats and traps to rescue Merdyn's apprentice Nimue from his wicked half-sister Morgause.
c64:137541.title: Artura

c64:137542.description: Text adventure, converted from the Plus/4: search a manor for its long-hidden family secret while staying away from a murderous house cat.
c64:137542.title: Ashby Manor

c64:137543.description: Single-player puzzle about sorting assorted symbols before time expires, with the number of symbols and time allowed varying. Part of the Triada game pack.
c64:137543.title: Ashido

c64:137545.description: The planet Targon is building an Assault Machine to conquer other worlds. Armed with four droids and three planes for atmospheric flight, the Galactic Police must stop it.
c64:137545.title: Assault Machine

c64:137546.description: Strategy game on the 1812 Battle of Borodino near Moscow, letting either Napoleon or the Russian army rewrite how the clash turned out.
c64:137546.title: Napoleon in Russia: Borodino 1812

c64:137547.description: Work on a Mercedes production line racing to keep schedule for a holiday in Cairo: run to the parts bin, grab a part and fit it to the wheel passing on the conveyor, letting no more than five go by untouched.
c64:137547.title: Assembly Line

c64:137548.description: A hundred levels of pattern matching: make the grid of pictures on the left match the model on the right, bearing in mind that changing one picture also alters its neighbours, all while the clock runs down.
c64:137548.title: Astatin

c64:137551.description: Asteroids variant: break up the drifting rocks with a photon cannon to clear each round, while an alien robot saucer sprays shots across the screen.
c64:137551.title: Asteroids 64

c64:137552.description: Gauntlet-like top-down shooter: Mr. Weems hunts the She Vampires through their six-level mansion, finding keys for locked doors, using teleporters and secret passages, and fighting bats and monsters that respawn from coffins.
c64:137552.title: The Astonishing Adventures of Mr. Weems and the She Vampires

c64:137553.description: First-person gallery shooter: guide a crosshair to shoot down formations of XENO aliens before they destroy the six energy generators along the bottom of the screen.
c64:137553.title: Starbase Defense

c64:137609.description: With Earth's forces wiped out by the Vengrian Empire, man two neutronium cannons from a first-person view, panning in all directions to shoot down enemy fighters and cruisers.
c64:137609.title: Astral Zone

c64:137610.description: Defend Earth from eight mega mines closing in on the planet, destroying them with lasers while flying saucers chase your ship around the planet.
c64:137610.title: Astro Chase

c64:137614.description: Pilot a fast rocket plane over a planet, gunning down Spinners, Seekers, Saucers and radar dishes on the surface and in the air while dodging enemy fire.
c64:137614.title: Astroblitz

c64:137615.description: Single-screen platformer from CBI: jump between platforms collecting every coin while avoiding aliens and laser barriers.
c64:137615.title: Astrobot

c64:137617.description: Sequel to Astrobot with new graphics: collect all the hearts on each single screen, where even the lightest brush with the alien sends you back to the start.
c64:137617.title: Astrobot II

c64:137622.description: A garden is slowly flooding, and you must dig up its flowers one by one and carry them to safety before the water swallows them, all to a rendition of Flight of the Bumblebee. Finished for Firebird in 1989 but shelved when the label was sold, it finally appeared on a Commodore Zone cover disk.
c64:137622.title: ATG: All Terrain Gardener

c64:137623.description: Athena, Goddess of Wisdom, leaves her castle for a fantasy world full of hostile creatures, picking up weapons like a ball and chain, bow and sword, and gaining wings to fly.
c64:137623.title: Athena

c64:137624.description: A Qix-style game viewed in pseudo 3D: color in the playfield without being caught by the crawling Krabblers, and steer Atock over a marked square to briefly gain the power to knock enemies out for bonus points; extra lives come at 50,000 points and every 100,000 after.
c64:137624.title: Atock

c64:137625.description: Hanna-Barbera cartoon tie-in: Atom Ant must save the city after 'Mad Dog' Jackson demands a ransom from the mayor and threatens to blow everything up.
c64:137625.title: Atom Ant

c64:137626.description: A logic puzzle in the Black Box mold: choose how many atoms hide in an 8 by 8 grid, fire probes in from the edges and note whether each is absorbed, reflected or emerges elsewhere, then mark where you think the atoms are, with wrong guesses adding to your score.
c64:137626.title: Atom Box

c64:137627.description: Molecule-building puzzle: slide atoms around a top-down board, each moving until it hits an obstacle, to recreate the structure shown in the preview.
c64:137627.title: Atomix

c64:137631.description: Futuristic handball in 2040, played with a moon ball deflected by an electron paddle, scoring by destroying subatomic particles.
c64:137631.title: Atomic Handball

c64:137635.description: Side-view fighting game: avenge your murdered master by defeating an army of shadowy assassins with high and low kicks and punches, scoring for each hit.
c64:137635.title: The Attack of the Phantom Karate Devils

c64:137636.description: Shooter combined with a text adventure: an alien sonic transmitter is driving Windscale's reactor core toward meltdown; kill the aliens and find and destroy the device in time.
c64:137636.title: Attack on Windscale

c64:137637.description: Destroy a Gestapo headquarters by bombing the dam above it to flood the building, past a bunker with a machine gun and a tank patrolling the gorge. From the Cassette 50 collection.
c64:137637.title: Attacker

c64:137638.description: Hunt unidentified submarines that ambush a peacetime naval exercise, learning their evasive tactics to sink them and uncover the treasures they guard.
c64:137638.title: Attack of Atlanteans

c64:137641.description: Side-view ATV racing with a split-screen two-player option: clear each course within 30 seconds, running to the vehicle at the start and climbing back on after every spill.
c64:137641.title: ATV: All Terrain Vehicle Simulator

c64:137642.description: Based on the first series of the British TV comedy, set on a building site in Dusseldorf where a crew of English builders works abroad.
c64:137642.title: Auf Wiedersehen Pet

c64:137645.description: Hanna-Barbera tie-in: as Augie Doggie, rid the home of pests during Doggie Daddy's nap, across four side-scrolling levels from the basement to upstairs.
c64:137645.title: Augie Doggie and Doggie Daddy

c64:137646.description: A rookie in an Auriga-class fighter has to come through sixteen alien waves to win a place in Earth's new Space Fighter Squadron, firing upward from the base of a fixed screen.
c64:137646.title: Auriga

c64:137648.description: Dutch text adventure with graphics, shelved in 1987 and translated into English in 2014: find the treasure holding Giganticus, the world's largest diamond, without coming to a grisly end.
c64:137648.title: Aurum

c64:137649.description: Adventure in World War II: an expert commando infiltrates a Japanese camp in New Guinea to kill the enemy leader Ho Shin and escape alive.
c64:137649.title: Aussie Assault

c64:137650.description: Quiz for one or two players covering Australia's cities, landmarks and natural resources.
c64:137650.title: Aussie Trip

c64:137651.description: Australian rules football over four three-minute quarters, with six points for a goal through the middle posts and one for a behind.
c64:137651.title: Australian Rules Football

c64:137652.description: Scrolling platformer about a caveman crossing the landscape to reunite with his brothers Org and Gnom while avoiding being snatched by a pterosaur, using his club to pick up items needed elsewhere.
c64:137652.title: Australopiticus Robustus

c64:137653.description: Based on the TV series: the holographic crimefighter Automan, whose glowing cursor conjures cars and helicopters, faces an evil copy built by a crime syndicate from the same program.
c64:137653.title: Automan

c64:137655.description: Top-down driving on scrolling autotest courses: choose one of four cars with different handling and beat qualifying times to earn money and points in the National Championship.
c64:137655.title: Autotest Simulator

c64:137658.description: Space Invaders variant: defend Earth against endless rows of descending aliens, shooting passing flying saucers for bonus points.
c64:137658.title: Avenger (Commodore Business Machines)

aliases: Avenger: The Way of the Tiger
c64:137659.title: The Way of the Tiger: Avenger

c64:137660.description: Domino's Pizza tie-in: deliver a pizza to the top floor of Doom Industries within 30 minutes while the Noid tries to stop you; arrive late and the customer gets a discount and you lose your job.
c64:137660.title: Avoid the Noid

c64:137664.description: Galaxian-style shooter: blast the alien formation from the bottom of the screen as some break away to dive and zigzag; each cleared wave returns faster and more aggressive.
c64:137664.title: Axiens

c64:137665.description: Tempest meets Asteroids: fly across a series of grids battling the Master Arachnid and his forces, avoiding the webs they leave, with lasers and one screen-clearing Pulse Bomb per level.
c64:137665.title: Axis Assassin

c64:137666.description: Indiana Jones-style action adventure: with a pistol and three sticks of dynamite, retrieve a jade idol from a maze-like temple full of traps, snakes, panthers and natives, and get out alive.
c64:137666.title: Aztec

c64:137710.description: Two-on-two basketball against the computer or a friend over four three-minute quarters, with overtime on a tie and a practice mode for learning moves.
c64:137710.title: Slam-Dunk

aliases: The American Challenge: A Sailing Simulation
c64:137721.title: The Official America's Cup Sailing Simulation

c64:137722.description: Strategy game as Supreme Commander of a future Earth divided into 16 nuclear-armed nations, working through point-and-click controls to keep the planet from destroying itself.
c64:137722.title: Global Commander

c64:137726.description: Fly a B-24 Liberator with the 460th Bomb Group on World War II raids against the Ploesti oil fields in Romania, filling the roles of pilot, co-pilot, navigator, flight engineer and bombardier as each mission unfolds.
c64:137726.title: B-24

c64:137729.description: A Bomb Jack-inspired action game: fly around single-screen stages grabbing every gem while dodging their guardians, with a bonus for clearing a screen quickly. Stages are more open, with fewer ledges, than in Bomb Jack.
c64:137729.title: Baby Jack

c64:137734.description: Hop a kangaroo across screen after screen of obstacles and enemies. A single hit is fatal, so precise jump timing matters as the difficulty climbs.
c64:137734.title: The Baby of Can Guru

c64:137736.description: A multi-directional scrolling shooter in which you collect flashing squares while avoiding enemy fire. It was originally released on the November 1988 issue of Game On.
c64:137736.title: Babylon Four

c64:137737.description: A set of four children's activities, Music Machine, Drawing Board, an alphabet game and a memory game, meant to build creativity and recall.
c64:137737.title: Babysitter Vol. 1

c64:137740.description: Feed a hungry frog by flicking its tongue at passing bugs, using the number keys 1-9 to set how far it reaches; longer reaches burn more energy. Ten skill levels speed up the bugs and raise energy costs.
c64:137740.title: Back to Nature

c64:137741.description: An astronaut in a spacesuit and jetpack must find the way out of a maze of rooms deep inside a planet. Touching a monster or firing the jetpack drains fuel.
c64:137741.title: Back to Reality

aliases: Attack of the Mutant Camels (North America)
c64:137744.title: Gridrunner II: Attack of the Mutant Camels

c64:137793.description: A multi-part text adventure: repair a time distorter, escape a German prison camp in World War II and get back to your time machine before the currents of time carry you onward.
c64:137793.title: Back to the Present

c64:137796.description: In a post-nuclear wasteland, pure-blooded humans hold the cities while mutants hunt monsters from small villages on the plains. When the human leader Lord Dominix plans a war to wipe out the mutants, your village chief sends you on a mission.
c64:137796.title: Bad Blood

c64:137797.description: One-on-one fighter in the mould of Street Fighter II, written by Italian teenager Luca Balducci and showcased in the Italian edition of Zzap!. It was left incomplete but is fully playable by one or two players, with an intro and an ending sequence.
c64:137797.title: Bad Enemies

c64:137802.description: A learning game where children steer a dinosaur to the right answer for tasks shown along the screen's bottom edge, such as picking up an animal with a tail; correct answers earn a little dance.
c64:137802.title: Bagasaurus

c64:137804.description: Modelled on the arcade game Bagman: a robber gathers money bags across three mine scenes and tips them into a wheelbarrow, dodging miners and runaway railcars. A pickaxe knocks miners out for a few seconds.
c64:137804.title: Bagitman

c64:137805.description: Alien barbarians have infiltrated Earth's defenses and seized government residences across several provinces, and you fly a heavily armed reconnaissance shuttle to strike back.
c64:137805.title: Balakon Raider

c64:137806.description: A Breakout variant: slide a paddle along the bottom of the screen to keep the ball in play and smash every destructible block on each field.
c64:137806.title: Ball-Blasta

c64:137807.description: A short horizontally scrolling shooter in which a ship with only a basic gun faces wave after wave of craft and odd foes. Music by Per Fredrik Kvarme and Arjan van der Werf.
c64:137807.title: Ballerup

c64:137808.description: A bat-and-ball game against a wall with extra hazards, such as a second ball bobbing vertically through the centre of the screen that the main ball must not touch.
c64:137808.title: Ball

c64:137810.description: Guide a springy little ball that can launch itself high from a standstill through level after level, dodging slimy snails and hopping monsters. Each stage has two layers, so when the way above ground is blocked you can try burrowing a route underneath.
c64:137810.title: Ballfever

c64:137812.description: Logic puzzle modelled on Toyballs: reproduce the pattern shown in the right-hand window by dropping balls onto the grid, where each placement makes the neighbouring balls swell, so every move has to be planned ahead.
c64:137812.title: Ball-Job

c64:137821.description: Bounce Erik the ball around ledges, turning each one to the target colour on contact while avoiding randomly moving Chasers. Each of the eight levels has to be completed four times.
c64:137821.title: Ballcrazy

c64:138009.description: An adventure based on Johann David Wyss's novel: as Fritz, eldest son of a Swiss family shipwrecked in the East Indies, get off the wrecked ship and make a new life on a deserted island.
c64:138009.title: Swiss Family Robinson

c64:138017.description: A dodging game: steer a ball across a sector of space while balls fly straight at it, and avoid every one. Released in Italy as Recrudew.
c64:138017.title: Ballmania

c64:138018.description: A type-in game modelled on Kickman: catch falling balloons and balance them on your head. It ran in COMPUTE! issue 67 (December 1985) and was sold as Wonderland by Caesar Software.
c64:138018.title: Balloon Crazy (1985)

c64:138019.description: Pilot a hot-air balloon around a single-screen cavern, collecting eight numbered fuel canisters in order before the clock runs out, using thrust to fight the pull of gravity.
c64:138019.title: Balloon Rescue

c64:138020.description: Inspired by the arcade Crazy Balloon: touch a switch to open each exit, then float your fragile balloon there before time expires, avoiding flickering force fields and moving enemies.
c64:138020.title: Balloonacy!

c64:138021.description: Sequel to Balloonacy: steer a balloon through 16 hazard-filled caverns, grabbing the key, unlocking the door and escaping through the exit. Published on GO64! in November 2005.
c64:138021.title: Balloonacy 2

c64:138022.description: An educational simulation for ages 12 to 16 that teaches safe hot-air ballooning over a changing landscape using an instrument panel, with several balloon types and three game modes including a Flying School.
c64:138022.title: Ballooning

c64:138028.description: Mixing Tetris and Galaxian ideas, this game has you fire a ball at descending circles to knock them back up before they reach the bottom, holding out for a set time to reach the next level.
c64:138028.title: Ballz I

c64:138029.title: Baltic 1985: When Superpowers Collide: Corridor to Berlin

c64:138030.description: Steer Splidge around an arena gathering bananas while keeping clear of boulders that would flatten him. Published on GO64! in August 2004.
c64:138030.title: Banana Dash

c64:138031.description: As newly installed president of the small state of Ananaba after a coup, stay in office and alive for as long as possible by choosing among policy options that keep everyone content.
c64:138031.title: Banana Drama

c64:138032.description: Manage a young banger racing driver's career from Division 3 to the Division 1 championship, sending him to training, keeping his car roadworthy and earning money along the way.
c64:138032.title: Banger Racer

c64:138033.description: Platformer based on the British children's TV cartoon: as Bangers you gather three kinds of fruit for your mum's pie, shooting or avoiding creatures and steering clear of dangerous flowers across several levels.
c64:138033.title: Bangers & Mash

aliases: Jonny and the Jimpys: Part I
c64:138034.title: Jonny and the Jimpys: Parts I & II

c64:138038.description: An educational capture-the-flag game for two players working together against Max and his robot team: reach Max's zone, seize his flag and return with it before he takes yours.
c64:138038.title: Bannercatch

c64:138039.description: Captured by banshees, find and free a princess hidden somewhere in the castle and escape, avoiding banshee attacks and wandering jesters; a roving monk can restore health.
c64:138039.title: Banshee Castle

c64:138040.description: Ken phones Barbie to invite her out, whether to the prom, dinner, the pool, tennis, the gym or a picnic, and you help her get ready for the date.
c64:138040.title: Barbie

c64:138041.description: Frank the Foreman grabs pound notes as they fall so he can pay his workers and get a house built, dodging his rival Evil Eric and his darts; balloons give a quick ride up the platforms.
c64:138041.title: Barmy Builders

c64:138042.description: A text adventure in which you help a friend in MI5 by carrying a secret file to Chicago.
c64:138042.title: Barney Brown and the Chicago Connection

c64:138043.description: An educational language game with exercises such as unscrambling words, filling in a missing word and adding the right articles so sentences become grammatical.
c64:138043.title: Barney the Elf

c64:138044.description: Turn-based speculation in the American property market: each turn is a month in which you study trends, investigate properties and buy or sell them in pursuit of a fortune.
c64:138044.title: Baron: The Real Estate Simulation

c64:138045.description: From the Cassette 50 compilation: as Brewery Bill, ride a moving barrel across, climb ladders to the flashing barrel and carry it back to the delivery lorry.
c64:138045.title: Barrel Jump

c64:138048.description: Two-player joystick baseball: the pitcher picks from five pitches such as a sinker or a high fastball, the batter times a swing for when the ball reaches home plate, runners can steal, fielders run and jump for fly balls, and tiring pitchers can be swapped from the bullpen between innings.
c64:138048.title: Baseball

c64:138083.description: One-on-one basketball from Dinamic, dedicated to Fernando Martín, the first Spaniard to play in the NBA, with the emphasis on straightforward head-to-head action.
c64:138083.title: Basket Master

c64:138084.description: Sequel to The Basket Manager: coach a pro basketball team on a $34,000,000 budget, buying eight players and picking a starting five, then play the matches yourself, either as a tournament or as single games.
c64:138084.title: Basket Play-Off

c64:138086.description: A strategy simulation in which you coach NBA teams from different eras, setting up dream matchups such as the 1985 Celtics of Larry Bird versus the 1972 Lakers.
c64:138086.title: Basketball: The Pro Game

c64:138087.description: Jeff Minter's package of six mini-games: progress in each earns pieces of completion icons, and the game is won once five icons are assembled before an overall time bar runs out.
c64:138087.title: Batalyx

c64:138088.description: Real-time tactical simulation of modern armored warfare: command a U.S., Soviet or Chinese battalion as a lieutenant colonel across five scenarios and 40 maps with rivers, hills and minefields.
c64:138088.title: Battalion Commander
