c64:138091.description: A Space War clone for two players only, included in several Supernova game packs.
c64:138091.title: Battle 2000

c64:138093.description: A brutally hard tank game: break into a heavily fortified enemy city and wreck the nuclear plant that powers it.
c64:138093.title: Battle Bound Project

c64:138107.title: Jonny and the Jimpys: Part II

c64:138156.description: Two figures at opposite ends of a single screen fight over a bathtub, one player against the computer or two against each other, trying to hold the water at the right level or to fill or drain it so a swan escapes or a fish perishes.
c64:138156.title: Bath Time

c64:138158.description: A clone of Irem's Moon Patrol arcade game, included in Keypunch's compilation packs Arcade Games and War Games.
c64:138158.title: Battle Buggy

c64:138163.description: To power a resource-starved Earth, link the 37 hexagons of the Cosmic Interlace Grid with an unbroken line across from one edge to the opposite edge, freeing hexagons with a trio of ZMX general-purpose robots within one hour of real time.
c64:138163.title: BattleDroidz

c64:138169.description: Companion to Kampfgruppe covering platoon-level Western Front combat between 1943 and 1945, with nearly all the ground weapons fielded by Britain, the US and Germany; games end automatically after 30 turns.
c64:138169.title: BattleGroup

c64:138171.description: A commando armed with an M16 and smart grenades recovers the eight pieces of a Bailey bridge to reach a Neutron Beam weapons base and destroy it, fighting through alien troops, tanks and laser emplacements.
c64:138171.title: Battle Island

c64:138172.description: Grand tactical simulation of the Civil War's bloodiest day around Sharpsburg, Maryland, along Antietam Creek, played in 11 hour-long turns scored on casualties and territorial objectives.
c64:138172.title: Battle of Antietam

c64:138173.description: Based on the cartoon series: fly a G-Force Phoenix ship to defend the planets Pete, Xenath, Elias, Horaf and Olixal from Zoltar's attacks, destroying enough of his craft at each.
c64:138173.title: Battle of the Planets

c64:138174.description: Moon Patrol-style action in which 26th-century scientists drive an all-terrain vehicle through the time void, battling across eras with threats ranging from dinosaurs to nuclear hazards.
c64:138174.title: Battle Through Time

c64:138182.description: Two players face off in futuristic tanks on a top-down single screen, each needing four hits on the other to win; four arenas with different wall layouts can be chosen.
c64:138182.title: Battle-Field

aliases: Battlefront: Corps Level Command in World War II
c64:138183.description: Corps-level World War II command of Axis or Allied forces: give orders to as many as a dozen regiments toward preset objectives and timetables, deciding the role each plays in the battle.
c64:138183.title: Battlefront

c64:138184.description: A wargame covering four Napoleonic battles, Waterloo, Quatre Bras, Borodino and Auerstadt, playable from either side, plus a construction set for designing maps, troop types, weapon ranges and damage.
c64:138184.title: Battles of Napoleon: A Construction Set

c64:138198.description: Follow-up to SSI's Warship covering surface naval battles of World War I between Britain and Germany and of World War II between Germany/Italy and Britain/France, with 79 ship classes.
c64:138198.title: Battle Cruiser

c64:138199.description: Command RAF Fighter Command in 1940, either for one day of light or heavy raids, or across a 30-day campaign starting on 20 August, on a map of southern Britain.
c64:138199.title: Battle of Britain

c64:138211.description: A 100-meter swim for one player, racing for the fastest possible time.
c64:138211.title: Baywatch

c64:138212.description: A follow-up to the swimming-event Baywatch game in which you battle ghostly spirits to save the world, though defeat, and the end of the world with it, is all but certain.
c64:138212.title: Baywatch Nights

c64:138213.description: A single-screen platform game for one or two players set in the realm of the wizard Aroon, with ten levels plus a bonus stage; collect coins and smash stones with a steel helmet. Published on Golden Disk 64 #12.
c64:138213.title: B-Bobs

c64:138214.description: Hungarian top-down rally racer starring Bburago's miniature toy rally cars. Finishing the original release gave players a code to mail in for a chance at one of fifty real Bburago models; it only came out in Hungary, though crackers later produced an English version.
c64:138214.title: Bburago Rally

c64:138221.description: Beach volleyball in which each serve is aimed with the joystick, using an on-screen direction indicator to pick straight, left or right before the server throws.
c64:138221.title: Beach Blanket Volleyball

c64:138222.description: Race a beach buggy through the eight rounds of the Dune Trials, beating each time limit while jumping rocks, shooting down helicopters that would cause crashes, and picking up fuel to keep going.
c64:138222.title: Beach Buggy Simulator

c64:138224.description: As Beaky, an Andromedan Armed Condor nesting on the hostile planet Crackit, protect your eggs from the native Eggsnatchers who are out to destroy them.
c64:138224.title: Beaky and the Egg Snatchers

c64:138225.description: Ted the Bear needs batteries for his new Sinclair electric truck, so he climbs a patrolled building site to fetch them, dropping bombs on the guards. A Baby Bear mode allows practice.
c64:138225.title: Bear Bovver

c64:138226.description: Steer a black ball to pick up bombs and use them to destroy the other balls. Released on Game On in September 1991.
c64:138226.title: Beat Ball

c64:138227.description: A text adventure made with The Quill and built on Beatles lyrics: in 2953 a keeper of the archives researching ancient Earth comes across 'The Four Kings of EMI'.
c64:138227.title: Beatle Quest

c64:138228.description: A text adventure about a simple trip to buy milk that goes wrong at every turn, with obstacles such as obstructive bank staff, transport troubles and a greedy tramp.
c64:138228.title: Because of a Cat

c64:138263.description: A vertically scrolling space shooter over 16 short levels: blast swirling alien formations and fixed cannons, grab extras and fight boss ships, alone or with a second player.
c64:138263.title: Bedlam

c64:138264.description: As bee number 52, gather enough honey from backyard flowers each day to meet your quota, avoiding spiders, grasshoppers, other bugs and lawn sprinklers.
c64:138264.title: Bee 52

c64:138265.description: Zombies have overrun Burt's beer factory; bounce Burt between platforms through 32 rooms in each of the Shipping, Production and Control departments to wipe them out.
c64:138265.title: Beer Belly Burt's Brew Biz

c64:138266.description: Othello against the computer on an 8 by 8 board: type a row number and column letter to place pieces that outflank and flip the computer's, choose your color and who moves first, and ask the computer to play its best or go easy.
c64:138266.title: Bel Osero

c64:138267.description: Written as a 4KB entry for the 2003 MiniGame Compo: work through four castle sections by lowering the thick brick walls between them, ringing four of eight bells in the correct order.
c64:138267.title: Bellringer

c64:138268.description: Climb ladders through four castle towers collecting bags of gold worth 750 points each; to move on from each tower, ring five of its eight bells in the right order to raise the final ladder.
c64:138268.title: Bellringer II

c64:138269.description: A box-pushing logic puzzle in the Sokoban mould: a little man must shove crates onto marked spots and can never pull them. Released on Game On in March 1989.
c64:138269.title: Ben

c64:138270.description: As Benji, rescue scientists held by robot drones across the solar system and fly them home to Earth, picking destinations from the engine room and adjusting warp and jump settings.
c64:138270.title: Benji: Space Rescue

c64:138271.description: Play a whale dodging fishermen's mines, harpoons and torpedoes while eating plankton and surfacing to breathe; when the plankton runs out, the next tide begins.
c64:138271.title: Bering

c64:138272.description: Two princes of the Empire of Man, trapped with their fleets in the Tyriarus Nebula, must fight off a Berserker wolf pack together, and then whoever survives may turn on the other.
c64:138272.title: Berserker Raids

c64:138273.description: Bert the Bug searches a garden for twenty of a wizard's scrolls, shooting at the killer toy mice, kettles, umbrellas and fire extinguishers roaming everywhere.
c64:138273.title: Bert the Bug Bites Back

c64:138275.description: Spelling drills from the Besieged series covering notoriously awkward English words like asthma, ancillary and miscellaneous; correct answers help a crusading knight advance.
c64:138275.title: Spellbound: Besieged

c64:138276.description: A chess teaching program that replays Bobby Fischer's games and asks you to guess each move.
c64:138276.title: Best of Chess: Volume I: American Triumph

c64:138278.description: Based on the Eddie Murphy film: Axel Foley tackles four distinct sub-games, including a Green Beret-style shootout in a warehouse.
c64:138278.title: Beverly Hills Cop

c64:138279.description: Steer an orb with the paddles to investigate the fate of Vern Grenington, who vanished along with his whole vehicle service station at Vicinity NAW-911, a region known to hold a black hole.
c64:138279.title: Beyond the Black Hole

c64:138326.description: Kicked out by his mother for rudeness, Biff the chimp tries to earn his way back home by doing a series of jobs around the jungle in a flick-screen arcade adventure.
c64:138326.title: Biff

c64:138327.description: Trapped in a space complex by the wizard Jem, Giz must collect 30 gold coins to open the tunnel to Big Ben's bell and ring it to escape, in a multi-directional scrolling platformer.
c64:138327.title: Big Ben

c64:138329.description: A fishing holiday in the south seas, hunting big game fish while the locals try to make money off you; land enough catches or the vacation ends after a single day.
c64:138329.title: Big Game Fishing

c64:138330.description: Box your way past eight opponents, including Heap Big Nose and Cheap N' Nasty, to win the title; name your fighter and fight in a side-on view of the whole ring.
c64:138330.title: The Big KO!

aliases: Big Mac: The Mad Maintenance Man
c64:138331.description: Mac must deactivate 18 single-screen vaults, climbing ladders and surviving any fall onto smooth ground, while hitting switches in the right order to remove walls, make floors and freeze obstacles.
c64:138331.title: More Adventures of Big Mac: The Mad Maintenance Man

c64:138332.description: Big Nose the Caveman, whisked through time to modern New York, sets out to free the animals caged in a zoo in a multi-directional scrolling platformer.
c64:138332.title: Big Nose's American Adventure

c64:138333.description: A comic text adventure spoofing 1930s detective fiction: dim private eye Sam Spillade takes a case to find his client's missing father.
c64:138333.title: The Big Sleaze

c64:138334.description: Footsy the Bigfoot must fix two breaks in a cable so he can blast open with TNT the cage where a madman holds his girlfriend, travelling through a series of environments.
c64:138334.title: Bigfoot

c64:138335.description: Based on the 1980s film: Jim journeys into the past to warn the World War I pilot Biggles about a devastating German weapon. The game comes in two separate parts.
c64:138335.title: Biggles

c64:138336.description: As Barney the clown, perform four increasingly hard circus acts viewed side-on, with options for lives, difficulty and the extra-life score threshold.
c64:138336.title: Bigtop Barney

c64:138359.description: An educational memory game: ride a bike through the park noticing things like bins, rabbits, frogs, deer and flowers, then recall which items you saw.
c64:138359.title: Bike Hike

c64:138360.description: Pat Splatt, Groove-Town's best poster paster, must fix the posters his rival Nasty Norville has wrecked before time runs out; the starting level can be picked beforehand.
c64:138360.title: Paste-Man Pat

c64:138363.description: Drive a postal land yacht, keeping bird droppings off the shiny paintwork and shooting planes, trains, helicopters and cars that block the way. Also released in Italy as Giacomo Il Postino and Falco.
c64:138363.title: Billy the Postman

c64:138364.description: Computer bingo for anywhere from four to a hundred players, with four cards on screen at once. Each card is a five-by-five grid of numbers from 1 to 99, the centre square showing the latest call, and the first player to complete a card collects the money.
c64:138364.title: Bingo (Tynesoft Computer Software)

c64:138365.description: Home-safety quiz on a 5x5 bingo grid: pick a square and answer its multiple-choice question to claim it for a point, or get it wrong and lose that square. Five in a row earns five bonus points and a little dance from Bingo Bugglebee.
c64:138365.title: Bingo Bugglebee Presents: Home Alone

c64:138366.description: Computer bingo for up to 99 players: numbers drawn from a bingo machine are checked off on 5x5 cards to complete a pattern, with text or graphics modes and printing of custom-designed cards.
c64:138366.title: Bingo (Milton Bradley)

c64:138368.description: A Bionic Granny waits outside the school at 4 o'clock and moves along the bottom of the screen, whacking the departing children with her walking stick.
c64:138368.title: Bionic Granny

c64:138369.description: Aliens will overrun Icarus Earth Defense Base within ninety minutes, so an android trained in Eastern martial arts is sent to fight through five levels and destroy them all.
c64:138369.title: Bionic Ninja

c64:138370.description: A three-part game about raising a family: build a nest and lay three eggs, feed the chicks when they hatch, then help them learn to fly, avoiding obstacles that cost lives.
c64:138370.title: Bird Mother: Life's a Struggle

c64:138371.description: A simple shooter in which a great bird flies over a coral reef, using a short-range blast against other birds, dragons and leaping sea creatures.
c64:138371.title: The Birds

c64:138372.description: A one-player version of the pen-and-paper ship-hunting game: you and the computer each hide a submarine, PT boat, battleship, destroyer and carrier on a 10x10 grid. Part of the 30 Games pack.
c64:138372.title: Bismark

c64:138444.description: Ghosts have moved into your computer's circuit boards; drive a small vehicle with an anti-ectoplasm beam along the circuits to destroy them and repair damaged chips, with more ghosts on each level.
c64:138444.title: Bit Exorcist

c64:138445.description: A bundle of three text adventures; in the title story, a student newspaper reporter investigates the Eta Beta Pi sorority, whose members may be behind a friend's disappearance.
c64:138445.title: Bite of the Sorority Vampires

c64:138446.description: A single-screen shooter set inside a data bus on the way to the computer's central core: blast the Bits, then the pods they leave behind, across successive waves.
c64:138446.title: Bitmania

c64:138447.description: Teddy, lost in a forest on the way to the teddy bears' picnic, raids a giant beehive for its honey across 16 single-screen platform levels.
c64:138447.title: Bizy BeeZZzz

c64:138448.description: A tile-laying board game: players take turns filling squares with tiles in one of three pathway designs, after which a heart-shaped marker travels along the paths until it reaches an empty square.
c64:138448.title: Black

c64:138449.description: A computer version of Abalone: push black and white marbles around a hexagonal board, aiming to shove six of the opponent's off the edge. Released on Magic Disk 64 in March 1994.
c64:138449.title: Black & White

c64:138450.description: A taekwondo sparring simulation built to supplement real training: two-minute bouts against a friend or six increasingly tough computer opponents, scored by landing or blocking blows under the sport's actual rules and penalties, with fighters stepping between three planes of the mat.
c64:138450.title: Black Belt

c64:138451.description: The wizard Tobias has used the Black Crystal to bring down the kingdom of Beroth after the Brotherhood of Wizards turned him away; travel its realms to recover the seven Rings.
c64:138451.title: Black Crystal

c64:138453.description: Fly the Black Hawk over a chain of island bases, wrecking tanks, missile launchers and planes to raise the enemy's Strategic Loss Factor; both sections scroll vertically, the first guiding a missile camera.
c64:138453.title: Black Hawk: The World's Deadliest Mission

c64:138456.description: Roll a ball across the field's stones to change their colour step by step in a set order of priority until each one vanishes; the goal is to clear them all.
c64:138456.title: Black It!

c64:138459.description: The Black Knight has ravaged the valley, killing and capturing its people; gather objects and weapons from the surrounding lands, storm his castle past the guards and slay him.
c64:138459.title: Black Knight Adventure

c64:138513.description: One-on-one martial arts fighting in the style of Way of the Exploding Fist, with moves ranging from basic punches and kicks to rolls, back-flips and roundhouse kicks, performed through eight joystick directions and short or long button presses. Released on Game On in February 1992.
c64:138513.title: Black Panther

c64:138515.description: A text adventure with small pictures: in 1912 the hunter Forrester Kilbride seeks the fabled Black Pearl and is left alone when his bearers refuse to enter the uncharted Land of the Kalmad.
c64:138515.title: The Black Pearl

c64:138517.description: Blackjack for one to five players using Las Vegas, Downtown Vegas, Reno or Atlantic City rules, or custom ones, with adjustable bet limits and deck counts and a hint mode suggesting the best play.
c64:138517.title: BlackJack Academy

c64:138520.description: Text adventure in which you play a seven-year-old trying to help a poorly mother. Before Blackpool Tower can be reached you have to find a way out of the house, taking care near the fire and when crossing the road.
c64:138520.title: Blackpool Tower

c64:138521.description: Inspired by the film: as a police hunter, track down and eliminate six grades of increasingly intelligent replidroids on Earth, mostly from inside your skimmer.
c64:138521.title: Blade Runner

c64:138523.description: Slippery Sid, spy and son of Blagger, gathers the keys scattered over each level, jumping the robots that guard them before leaving through a doorway.
c64:138523.title: Son of Blagger

c64:138524.description: Blagger tours the film sets of director Steven Speilbum, aiming to steal his latest film while dodging characters like Superman, Batman, Tarzan, Jaws, James Bond, Robin Hood and the Hulk.
c64:138524.title: Blagger Goes to Hollywood

c64:138525.description: Roll a ball to collect key fragments in numerical order, then find the hidden exit. Released on Game On in October 1989.
c64:138525.title: Blakhole

c64:138528.description: A duel for two players only: shoot your opponent, and the first to 10 points wins.
c64:138528.title: Blast Fest

c64:138531.description: A space cadet's final test: fly through the heavily defended Blaze Zone of the Andromeda System, moving a ship along the bottom of the screen and shooting aliens and defenses.
c64:138531.title: Blaze

c64:138532.description: Hired by the Sahiban to steal the Mazeli superweapon ship Blazer, you fly a vertically scrolling overhead shoot-'em-up armed only with a forward cannon and no power-ups, facing enemies from above and the sides and shooting ground bases.
c64:138532.title: Blazer

c64:138533.description: A plane crosses the screen, dropping lower after each pass; bomb the skyscrapers below with the space bar to flatten them before it hits one.
c64:138533.title: Blitz (Courbois Software)

c64:138534.description: A flying saucer low on fuel crosses a city, descending with each pass; bomb all the skyscrapers flat so it can land on level ground.
c64:138534.title: Blitz 2000

c64:138615.description: Official sequel to Blitz 2000, a horizontally scrolling shooter against an alien attack on Earth, released with Commodore Zone issue 12.
c64:138615.title: Blitz 3000

c64:138616.description: A real-time strategy wargame in which you command German forces trying to conquer Western Europe and England between 1 May and 30 September, against computer-controlled Allies.
c64:138616.title: Blitzkrieg

c64:138617.description: A text adventure that opens outside a castle in a blizzard: get inside quickly, since every move lowers your body temperature, then defeat an evil wizard.
c64:138617.title: Blizzard Pass

c64:138620.description: A tough Bubble Bobble-style platformer: collect a set number of items to finish each level unless a key appears to open the exit, while enemies respawn in unexpected places.
c64:138620.title: Blobber

c64:138623.description: Falling-block puzzle in three dimensions: rotate pieces on every axis to drop them into a pit seen from above and complete layers. The pit size and piece sets can be changed.
c64:138623.title: Block Out

c64:138624.description: A Pac-Man clone: steer Blob around his maze home, avoiding the deadly Wibblies, and use four hidden potions to turn the tables for a while. Released with Commodore Format issue 2.
c64:138624.title: The Blob

c64:138625.description: Rather than blasting blocks away, shoot pieces into place to destroy the alien buildings that threaten your planet.
c64:138625.title: Block Shock

c64:138626.description: A reversed space shooter: you are the saucer at the screen's top, firing down on ships and aliens rising toward you.
c64:138626.title: Blockade 64

c64:138687.description: A country-house murder mystery. A body turns up at Rambling Hall, home of a senior Cabinet minister, and Scotland Yard's Chief Inspector Pincher must question the guests one by one, weighing their stories until the killer among them can be named.
c64:138687.title: Murder

c64:138831.description: A 3D shooter: escort four merchant freighters carrying vital supplies to Earth through an asteroid belt, dodging rocks, destroying robot mines and alien ships, and managing fuel and shields.
c64:138831.title: Blockade Runner

c64:138834.description: Recreates the Gold Run bonus round of the TV quiz Blockbusters on its 5x4 grid of hexagon questions; correct answers claim cells for you, wrong ones turn them black for the opposition.
c64:138834.title: Blockbusters: Gold Run

c64:138835.description: An early Q*bert clone for one or two players.
c64:138835.title: Block Hopper

c64:139006.description: Trap every bubble without ever touching one. Published in 64'er Sonderheft issues 17 and 26 and the 64'er Spielesammlung #3.
c64:139006.title: Block'n'Bubble

c64:139007.description: Sequel to Block'n'Bubble with the same aim of trapping every bubble while never touching one; published in 64'er Sonderheft 30.
c64:139007.title: Block'n'Bubble II

c64:139010.description: A version of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle, included in The Big 100 compilation.
c64:139010.title: Blocktower

c64:139011.description: A 5x7 board starts with one kind of tile per column, then gets shuffled; slide rows and columns with the keyboard to restore the original layout.
c64:139011.title: Blok Copy

c64:139012.description: Early, simple sideways-scrolling shoot-'em-up by Paul Kessels with Maniacs of Noise music that CP Verlag planned to publish around 1991; it never came out, and only this preview build survives.
c64:139012.title: Blond Blubber

c64:139015.description: Hark and Kren, whose parents were killed when their village on Sylonia was burned, ride homemade Skywalk jet bikes to the planet Scorpia to wipe out the space convicts known as the Scorpions.
c64:139015.title: Blood Brothers

c64:139016.description: A head-to-head shooter for two players only: whoever has the most kills when the timer expires wins.
c64:139016.title: Blood Hand

c64:139017.description: Loosely based on two 1986 fantasy gamebooks: play the Quarry, a barbarian, priest or thief slave released once a year into the valley of Gad to be hunted down by the Archveult, the valley's cruel ruler.
c64:139017.title: Blood Valley: Duel Master

c64:139018.description: An Othello-style thinking game for one or two players, published in 64'er in September 1997.
c64:139018.title: Blox

c64:139019.description: Memory pairs game for one or two players with three picture sets: uncover the 56 tiles two at a time, earn points for each match, chain consecutive matches to reach a bonus board, and lose half your score for sitting idle too long.
c64:139019.title: Blubria

c64:139020.description: A flight simulator of the F/A-18 built around air shows, recreating the U.S. Navy's Blue Angels demonstration squadron with tight formation flying that requires coordinating with the other jets.
c64:139020.title: Blue Angels: Formation Flight Simulation

c64:139021.description: As the Blue Baron in 1918, fly 12 bombing missions in a side-scrolling shooter: take off from the airfield, fight past enemy aircraft, bomb the target and return home.
c64:139021.title: Blue Baron

aliases: Blue Max 2001: Der Neffe von Blue Max
c64:139044.description: Sequel to Blue Max set in 2001: pilot a flying saucer bombing enemy targets while avoiding enemy saucers and ground cannon, with the screen border flashing to warn of low altitude.
c64:139044.title: Blue Max 2001

c64:139045.description: Pilot an intergalactic spacecraft through five stages on a hostile planet to rescue a stranded sister ship and its crew and bring them back to the Blue Moon; touching creatures or obstacles costs a life.
c64:139045.title: Blue Moon

c64:139046.description: An American Civil War strategy game in semi-real time for one player against the computer or two players, with historical or invented missions from the Confederate or Union side.
c64:139046.title: Blue Powder Grey Smoke

c64:139047.description: A side-scrolling shooter tied to the TV series: fly a jetcopter across a sea of islands bristling with defenses to reach and disable the enemy stronghold after an alien assault.
c64:139047.title: Blue Thunder

c64:139048.description: Two players take a BMX through six freestyle events, each with a qualifying standard to beat; clearing all six repeats them with tougher targets.
c64:139048.title: BMX Freestyle

c64:139049.description: Having taken treasure from a hidden jungle valley, flee the angry natives on a BMX bike across flick screens, avoiding obstacles, traps and creatures.
c64:139049.title: BMX Jungle Bike

c64:139050.description: An arithmetic game for ages six to ten: ride a BMX around a maze to find and jump over the answer to addition, subtraction or multiplication questions.
c64:139050.title: BMX Number Jump

c64:139051.description: Ride a BMX up an endless vertically scrolling road for as long as possible, dodging cars, other riders, oil patches and more.
c64:139051.title: BMX Racers

c64:139053.description: Sequel to BMX Simulator with four riders instead of two and two terrains: the familiar Dirt tracks and expert-level Quarry races, where tyre thickness can be chosen.
c64:139053.title: BMX Simulator 2

c64:139054.description: One or two players tackle six BMX challenges: a 200m race, longest wheelie, ramp jump, slalom, bunny hops over bars and a jump over a VW Beetle.
c64:139054.title: BMX Trials

c64:139056.description: As Bob Morane, retake a space station overrun by enemy soldiers, hunting down and destroying every one of them in a multi-directional scrolling shooter played much like Prohibition.
c64:139056.title: Bob Moran: Science Fiction

c64:139057.description: Bob Winner seeks a lost desert civilisation and must win three keys by defeating bosses in Paris, then London, then New York, two boxers and a gun-slinging cowboy, using items found on earlier screens.
c64:139057.title: Bob Winner

c64:139058.description: A Bubble Bobble-style platformer with trampolines, spread over 70 to 80 levels and finished off with a proper ending.
c64:139058.title: Bobby Bounce Back

c64:139059.description: Apprentice magician Bobix of the island Texul learns that his teacher, the magician Bennof, is an impostor who poisoned the queen. Released on Game On in June 1994.
c64:139059.title: Bobix

c64:139063.description: In the 1930s, private eye Sam Harlow escapes two hired killers and searches the town for clues and informants to solve the kidnapping of Rita Sweeney, his former wife.
c64:139063.title: Borrowed Time

c64:139064.description: Baseball on a split screen, with a field overview beside a batter view that disappears once the ball is hit; draft your squad by each player's skill ratings before play.
c64:139064.title: Championship Baseball

c64:139065.description: As King Kayus of Agamen, ride a dragon out to destroy the tyrant Zambaquous across six levels of horizontally scrolling shooting with some vertical movement.
c64:139065.title: Dragon Breed

c64:139066.description: A conversion of the arcade football game with big sprites on a small pitch, where winning possession and dribbling forward matter more than passing.
c64:139066.title: Fighting Soccer

c64:139067.description: Two-on-two basketball: draft teammates from ten players modelled on pro stars and play with or against the computer or a friend, with practice games such as Horse and Around the World.
c64:139067.title: GBA Championship Basketball: Two-on-Two

c64:139086.description: As Quack Fu master Howard the Duck, punch and kick through maze-like landscapes on Volcano Island to rescue Phil and Beverly from a dark overlord's volcano.
c64:139086.title: Howard the Duck: Adventure on Volcano Island

aliases: The Great American Cross Country Road Race
c64:139087.description: Race a high-performance car between U.S. cities, planning your own route through fog, snow, road works and day-night cycles.
c64:139087.title: The Great American Cross-Country Road Race

c64:139088.description: American football from a first-person view: you see what your player sees, with control passing from quarterback to receiver on a pass or from kicker to returner on kicks.
c64:139088.title: GFL Championship Football

c64:139089.description: Air racing in 250mph planes through southern USA valleys in the pioneering era, across 16 marked courses.
c64:139089.title: Gee Bee Air Rally

c64:139090.description: Command the Ocean Ranger, a frigate-sized foilborne missile ship, hunting surface, underwater and airborne targets on missions ranging from the easier Bering Sea to the toughest, the Persian Gulf, via Southeast Asia and Central America.
c64:139090.title: Ocean Ranger

c64:139091.description: Waking in a hut on a deserted beach with no memory and a pounding head, piece together who you are as words and phrases trigger memories of the past.
c64:139091.title: Mindshadow

c64:139092.description: A techno-scavenger in 2049 explores the Koronis Rift, where the Ancients left ships and artifacts behind; send a droid to retrieve modules and work out what each piece of ancient technology does.
c64:139092.title: Koronis Rift

c64:139093.description: Hunt down each level's boss and defeat it to win the key to the exit, using a jet-pack to get around and shooting the planet's inhabitants.
c64:139093.title: Quartet

c64:139094.description: Back from a century-long voyage, an astronaut finds Earth deserted and logs into Worldnet, the global database of human activity, to learn what happened, in a computer novel told through its records.
c64:139094.title: Portal (Activision)

c64:139095.description: In 8878, a Pastfinder explores radioactive planets in a vertically scrolling game, retrieving artifacts and time capsules and delivering them safely to base, choosing destinations from a map.
c64:139095.title: Pastfinder

c64:139096.description: Asteroids-like shooting in a lethal stretch of space filled with killer rocks, rogue satellites and boomerangs, with warp holes on each level.
c64:139096.title: Zone Ranger

c64:139097.description: An Infocom text adventure: a postal clerk in the fishing village of Festeron delivers an envelope to Ye Olde Magick Shoppe and finds the town mysteriously transformed.
c64:139097.title: Wishbringer

c64:139098.description: A musical take on evolution in eight levels of three phases each; in the first, freeze organisms into energy clusters by reaching web intersections ahead of them.
c64:139098.title: Web Dimension

c64:139099.description: An illustrated text adventure in which an interplanetary secret agent roams the galaxy in a fuel-hungry ship, with touches of dry humour.
c64:139099.title: The Tracer Sanction

c64:139100.description: Pick a fighter from various alien races, including humans, with their own abilities and styles, buy weapons and gadgets, bet on bouts and fight through opponents to face the Fatman.
c64:139100.title: Mondu's Fight Palace

c64:139101.description: Gramps has invented a device that makes his dreams real; when the dream creature Franklin Snarl kidnaps him into the bizarre world of Tonetown, you follow to rescue him.
c64:139101.title: Tass Times in Tonetown

c64:139102.description: Pilot the shuttle Discovery from launch to orbit, open the cargo bay to recover and repair a satellite, then land, while burning as little fuel as you can.
c64:139102.title: Space Shuttle: A Journey into Space

c64:139103.description: Tile-matching solitaire with 144 mahjong tiles stacked in a layout; remove them in matching pairs until the board is clear.
c64:139103.title: Shanghai

c64:139104.description: Control a defense satellite to stop waves of bombs aimed at the United States, with movement and aiming handled independently.
c64:139104.title: SDI: Now the Odds are Even

c64:139106.description: Manage a football club from below the top division toward league and European glory, with a squad of up to 15 renamable players, transfers and bank loans.
c64:139106.title: Soccer Boss

c64:139107.description: American football management with 16 teams, players rated for skill, energy and form, and a soccer-style transfer market with mid-season trades for cash.
c64:139107.title: Grid Iron 2

c64:139108.description: Freddy Hardest, a hard-partying galactic playboy and heir to a fortune, takes his spaceship out while drunk and lands himself in serious trouble in this side-scrolling action game.
c64:139108.title: Freddy Hardest

c64:139110.description: As the Doctor from Doctor Who, stop the Daleks' invasion of Earth with your companions, starting with a hover-platform ride through London's sewers blasting monsters before later fighting on foot.
c64:139110.title: Dalek Attack

c64:139111.description: A real-time illustrated text adventure based on Michael Moorcock's trilogy: British officer Oswald Bastable is in command of HMS Shards, an airship, in a steampunk future.
c64:139111.title: The Nomad of Time

c64:139112.description: Pinball for up to four players on a single table, with rotatable ABC lights at the top worth 10,000 points and bonus multipliers.
c64:139112.title: Micro Ball

c64:139113.description: Eleven joystick-waggling track and field events, including five running races from 100 meters up to a gruelling 1500 meters.
c64:139113.title: Micro Olympics

c64:139114.description: Space thief Philip Sunset, hunted by the Drowhar army after stealing its secret Sprocket System, flies for the Terra-1 forces in this horizontally scrolling shooter, grabbing extra weapons, speed and lives against fast swarms of erratic enemies.
c64:139114.title: Meganova: The Weapon

c64:139115.description: Drive Pat's van through a busy working day: collect letters and parcels from Mrs Goggins at the post office, deliver them, and help with chores like herding Peter Fogg's sheep.
c64:139115.title: Postman Pat

c64:139116.description: An illustrated text adventure spoofing Star Trek: as James T. Cake, captain of the starship Paralysed, deliver a Rigellian Slime beast and a Trell to the planet Dandrox for experiments.
c64:139116.title: Star Wreck

c64:139117.description: The first game starring the British children's TV puppets: left in charge of the house by Matthew, Sooty must deal with the old bones Sweep has scattered everywhere in this platformer.
c64:139117.title: Sooty & Sweep

c64:139118.description: After a cheese sandwich supper, Fred Bear dreams of driving through Toyland, steering clear of fluffy snakes, wooden ducks, spacemen, toy trucks and other dangerous toys.
c64:139118.title: Tread Bear

aliases: Strangest Mobile Army Surgical Hospital East of Detroit
c64:139119.description: A text adventure with occasional pictures spoofing M*A*S*H: newly qualified surgeon Pigseye Peers joins a mobile army hospital in Korea, where the first job is to recover a still.
c64:139119.title: S*M*A*S*H*E*D: Strangest Mobile Army Surgical Hospital East of Detroit

c64:139121.description: Train two middle-distance runners, one for 400m and one for 800m and 1500m, through local races before earning a place in four major championship finals including Crystal Palace.
c64:139121.title: Run for Gold

c64:139122.description: On war-ravaged Nu-Earth, the lone survivor of the Genetic Infantrymen betrayed in the Quartz Zone Massacre sets out to find the traitor responsible.
c64:139122.title: Rogue Trooper

c64:139123.description: Fly with the RAF's Red Arrows display team, performing loops, rolls and flypasts at over 300mph a few feet from your teammates, following in-flight height and heading instructions.
c64:139123.title: Red Arrows

c64:139124.description: A rally simulation with educational aims: plan routes on a full map where each road has its own traits, such as higher speeds or a tendency to flood in rain.
c64:139124.title: Rally Driver

c64:139168.description: An Earthman crash-lands into an ancient war and pilots a giant blue battle-robot against the red Zoids, fighting from inside the cockpit.
c64:139168.title: Zoids (Electric Dreams Software)

c64:139169.description: Yogi crosses 198 sideways-scrolling screens of Jellystone Park to rescue the kidnapped Boo-Boo, collecting six toffee apples that form a code for freeing him quietly.
c64:139169.title: Yogi Bear

c64:139170.description: An illustrated text adventure starring Ralph, a wizard fond of a drink, whose drunken prank of transforming a man during a night out sets the story in motion.
c64:139170.title: Wiz Biz

c64:139172.description: A Popeye-style single-screen platformer: Bongo the rat collects gems while avoiding a pursuer, and can teleport by standing on the letters of his name and pressing fire.
c64:139172.title: Bongo

c64:139173.description: A jet airliner simulator: take off, clear the surrounding mountains and land on a valley runway with fuel for only one try. Six skill levels raise the peaks, shorten the runway and add engine fires, crosswinds and the need for reverse thrust.
c64:139173.title: Flight Path 737

c64:139176.description: Top-down football expanded from Kick Off with full tournament modes, fictional players and four pitch types, including a plastic surface with unpredictable bounce.
c64:139176.title: Kick Off 2

aliases: Franco Baresi World Cup Kick Off
c64:139177.title: Kick Off

c64:139178.description: Escape the house room by room: from a reception hall of ten doors, numbered one to nine plus X, clear each room before room X and the final way out open up.
c64:139178.title: House of Usher

c64:139179.description: A jump jet simulation written by a real jump jet pilot, with ranks from Flight Lieutenant to Group Captain plus a practice mode, and guided missiles for combat.
c64:139179.title: Jump Jet

c64:139202.description: Play poker against two computer opponents, starting with $100 and betting from $5 up to $25 a hand.
c64:139202.title: Strip Poker II (Byte Back)

c64:139203.description: Sequel to Space-Pilot, the Time Pilot clone: fly a rotating craft across varied environments, downing planes for points, with some departures from the original's features.
c64:139203.title: Space Pilot 2

c64:139205.description: Zaxxon-like isometric action underground: fly a helicopter through tunnels to the life-support power plant on Zaga 1 and fix its critical fault.
c64:139205.title: Zaga Mission

c64:139207.description: Isometric tennis seen from the sideline, with eight-direction movement and shot power set by angle and fire-button pressure; matches are best of three sets under standard rules.
c64:139207.title: Tiebreaker

c64:139208.description: A power-station rod controller's annual assessment on a simulator: on a split screen against the computer, keep two Dynamic Rods level.
c64:139208.title: Dynamix

c64:139209.description: Formula racing converted from the arcade: start in Brazil among 100 cars needing a top-80 finish to qualify, with the field shrinking across eight races.
c64:139209.title: Continental Circus

c64:139210.description: Follows the second Adrian Mole book through 18 months of Adrian's life, presented as sections of challenges where you pick among three options.
c64:139210.title: The Growing Pains of Adrian Mole

c64:139211.description: Officially licensed by the English FA: guide a club side toward FA Cup glory with up to eight players, choosing formation and an attacking, balanced or defensive strategy.
c64:139211.title: F.A. Cup Football

c64:139212.description: Hostile Hadean craft are using Earth's refinery planet Erebus to brew nerve gas. Fly a scrolling overhead shooter, passing over every section of a level to open its dimension duct, then survive a 30-second bonus wave by dodging up and down.
c64:139212.title: Erebus

c64:139213.description: Full-court two-on-two basketball with a horizontally scrolling court, a referee calling rough fouls, and teams that start at a salary level to work up from.
c64:139213.title: Magic Johnson's Basketball

c64:139214.description: Four trucks race over off-road tracks built by mirroring and reversing a core set of layouts; losing to a computer truck costs one of your three credits, while wins bring rewards.
c64:139214.title: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road

c64:139215.description: One of the last four great sorcerers must rescue the other three from the Necromancer before time runs out, flying across 17 screens of wasteland, river and woods, gathering items and keys and avoiding ghosts and sorcerers.
c64:139215.title: Sorcery

c64:139216.description: THX2240 flees slave-like labour in an agridustrial compound aboard a stolen Crowd Control vehicle, fighting an escape through all 10 levels.
c64:139216.title: Rebel

c64:139217.description: Pop bouncing balloons, which split into smaller ones, with upward-shooting hooks across 50 levels; one or two players share the screen, and a second can join at any time.
c64:139217.title: Pang

c64:139219.description: A bounty hunter roams the desert to find a bank, cemetery, saloon, Indian village, mine and fort, shooting cowboys who get in the way and keeping his limited ammunition topped up.
c64:139219.title: A Fi$tful of Buck$

c64:139220.description: Train in the gym with weights, squats and sit-ups, waggling the joystick to fill a bottle of Lucozade, before Daley Thompson takes on the decathlon events.
c64:139220.title: Daley Thompson's Olympic Challenge

c64:139221.description: Based on the film: as Frank Harris, stop Holli Would from crossing into the real world by shooting doodles and gathering coins across four cartoon worlds of four levels each.
c64:139221.title: Cool World

c64:139222.description: In 2631, Red Falcon terrorists seize the Galuga archipelago off New Zealand ahead of an alien invasion, and Contra commandos Bill Rizer and Lance Bean are sent to stop them.
c64:139222.title: Contra

c64:139223.description: Keep a bakery's production line running while scaring off raccoons that eat the bread and switch off the machines, so the delivery truck fills up and drives away.
c64:139223.title: Comic Bakery

c64:139224.description: A knight races the clock through six dungeons collecting scattered door pieces, then defeats the black wizard to rescue a princess held in the castle.
c64:139224.title: Cavelon

c64:139238.description: A Bagman-style flick-screen platformer: gather all the gold bags across three mine screens using ladders and lifts while dodging two outlaws.
c64:139238.title: Gilligan's Gold

c64:139243.description: Platformer based on the 1991 film: cat burglar Eddie 'Hudson Hawk' Hawkins, just out after ten years in prison, is dragged back into thieving despite plans to go straight.
c64:139243.title: Hudson Hawk

c64:139245.description: Based on Spielberg's 1991 film: Peter Pan sets out to save his kids from Captain Hook.
c64:139245.title: Hook

c64:139247.description: Fly a laser-armed helicopter over a sea of small islands, finding stranded people before they starve or drown, dropping a ladder to lift them aboard and ferrying them to a safe platform.
c64:139247.title: Helikopter-Jagd

c64:139248.description: Choose Roger Murtaugh or Martin Riggs for each of four missions and a final bonus one, running, jumping, swimming, kicking and shooting to stop crime in Los Angeles.
c64:139248.title: Lethal Weapon

c64:139249.description: Slide blocks left or right with a cursor so they drop and touch matching blocks, aiming to clear every block on each level.
c64:139249.title: Puzznic

c64:139250.description: Ryu brawls through Las Vegas, the Grand Canyon, Brooklyn and other American stages in this arcade beat-'em-up, using flying neck throws, back flips and hanging kicks, smashing phone booths and oil drums for power-ups and swords, with two-player co-op.
c64:139250.title: Shadow Warriors

c64:139251.description: A QIX variant: draw lines with a space scriber to wall off at least 75% of the playfield and trap the ball, losing a life if it touches you or your unfinished trail.
c64:139251.title: RollerBall

c64:139253.description: Wheelie off ramps to leap between platforms on nine single-screen obstacle courses, collecting flags before the fuel gauge, which doubles as a timer, runs dry.
c64:139253.title: Stunt Bike

c64:139254.description: Based on the film: newly self-aware robot Number 5 must escape the laboratory, finding hardware and software upgrades that let him jump and fire a laser while evading security.
c64:139254.title: Short Circuit

c64:139255.description: Jungle man Toki, turned into an ape by the wizard Dr. Stark, battles through jungle, underwater and volcanic stages to reach Stark's palace, rescue Wanda and regain human form.
c64:139255.title: Toki

c64:139256.description: Fly a Tornado at low level over built-up areas in a pseudo-3D top-down view, dropping altitude to shoot out six target discs while avoiding trees and buildings.
c64:139256.title: TLL

c64:139284.description: The alien scientist Erra Quann has hijacked the Federation flagship Quann Tulla and taken it to an Empire outpost to sell its engine secrets, and you are sent to stop him.
c64:139284.title: Federation

c64:139285.description: Count Vladimir has stolen King Arnid's Crown Jewels, scattered them across the island of Ognid and kept a sceptre inside his castle; recover them to restore the land of Ix.
c64:139285.title: The Causes of Chaos

c64:139286.description: An illustrated text adventure in which Bugsy, a giant rabbit, climbs Chicago's criminal ladder through theft, extortion, bribery and worse, aiming to replace Al Capone as Public Enemy No. 1.
c64:139286.title: Bugsy

c64:139287.description: Delta 4's comic text adventure parody of The Hobbit, in three parts and full of jokes such as an Old Ford location next to a New Ford.
c64:139287.title: The Boggit: Bored Too

c64:139288.description: A Mandroid agent hunts on the planet Cove 4 for Chris Auker, who has stolen the Mandroid files to pass them to the crime lord Max, exploring on foot or with a remote vehicle.
c64:139288.title: Mandroid

c64:139290.description: As a novice oceanographer, build a reputation exploring more than 75 lost wrecks, then plan, fund, crew and equip an expedition to find the Titanic, charting courses and diving against the elements.
c64:139290.title: Search for the Titanic

c64:139292.description: A low-gravity 3D Pong invented by the Galcorp corporation: hit the ball so the other player can't return it, scoring when it reaches their back wall.
c64:139292.title: Room Ten

aliases: Richard O'Brien's: The Rocky Horror Show
c64:139293.description: As Brad or Janet, search the castle for parts of the De-Medusa machine, carrying one piece at a time, to unfreeze your partner and escape before the castle blasts off.
c64:139293.title: The Rocky Horror Show

c64:139294.description: Sent by a distrustful command to the heavily defended alien world Loughton 2 instead of a deserted colony, pilot a Plasmatron fighter and blast the oncoming waves.
c64:139294.title: Plasmatron

c64:139296.description: A text adventure: with the Silvian invading Meridan once more, seek the legendary eternal Guardian said to dwell deep inside a mountain.
c64:139296.title: Pilgrim

c64:139297.description: A three-part text adventure about a werewolf's curse, each part seen through a different character, starting with a man who wakes up covered in blood.
c64:139297.title: Wolfman

c64:139300.description: Fire-breathing dragon DJ Puff collects discs hidden in hard-to-reach spots or dropped by certain monsters, burning enemies and jumping through the levels.
c64:139300.title: DJ Puff

c64:139301.description: Sequel to CJ's Elephant Antics: the young elephant crosses the USA to rescue brothers and sisters trapped by The Hunter, firing peanuts and collected bombs in a platform game.
c64:139301.title: CJ in the USA

c64:139302.description: A retired superhero recovers diamonds stolen by insane genius Austen van Flyswatter across 12 platform levels riddled with traps.
c64:139302.title: Captain Dynamo

c64:139351.description: Four styles of arcade shooting across 32 levels, including a vertically scrolling Salamander-style stage with wall flames and a Centipede-style stage.
c64:139351.title: Lazer Force

c64:139352.description: An overhead Super Sprint-style racer for one or two players, with circuits full of underpasses and tight bends.
c64:139352.title: Grand Prix Simulator

c64:139528.description: Seven years after World War III, drive the specially equipped Last V8 out of your shelter across a hostile surface, following the orders of a digitised voice.
c64:139528.title: The Last V8

c64:139535.description: Following Soldier One, you wake in a strange building with a note telling you to collect the pieces of an exit code; explore its flick screens of platforms to escape.
c64:139535.title: Captured

c64:139537.description: A first-person adventure in and around a dark castle: cross a moat full of sharks and battle evil to free your choice of the Prince or Princess.
c64:139537.title: Castle Master II: The Crypt

c64:139538.description: A role-playing game in the vein of Sword of Fargol, built around the legend of a deformed child of Kraizar abandoned in the woods and taken in by the old wizard Ibonek Nawibo.
c64:139538.title: The Castle of Kraizar

c64:139540.description: A branching multiple-choice game adapted from Edward Packard's first Choose Your Own Adventure book, in which a kid wanders into a cave that leads to different times.
c64:139540.title: The Cave of Time

c64:139544.description: A Pac-Man-inspired maze game set on Disneyland's Tom Sawyer's Island: gather berries while Aunt Polly, Injun Joe and later a bear give chase, escaping via a water wheel, teeter-totter or raft.
c64:139544.title: The Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island

c64:139545.description: Based on the Fighting Fantasy gamebook: infiltrate the Black Tower atop Craggen Rock with spells, sword and wits to defeat the warlock Balthus Dire and save the Vale of Willow.
c64:139545.title: The Citadel of Chaos

c64:139552.description: Zen the Mole turns a network of sticks blue by walking over them while yellow, turning red for a few seconds to build bridges out to the network.
c64:139552.title: Collapse

c64:139562.description: Tag-team wrestling with four teams, the Mad Soldiers, Orient Express, Great Maskmen and Crush Brothers, each wrestler having special moves such as knee butts, body slams and flying head butts.
c64:139562.title: Body Slam

c64:139603.description: Use a magic wand to create and destroy blocks, arranging them to reach each level's key and unlock the exit.
c64:139603.title: Solomon's Key

aliases: Jonny Quest in Doctor Zin's Underworld
c64:139631.description: As Jonny, explore Dr. Zin's complex in a side-on flick-screen adventure to rescue your father, who has been kidnapped and forced to build a world-conquering laser.
c64:139631.title: Jonny Quest

c64:139643.description: Six Wild West contests, including arm wrestling timed to your arm's strong phases and shooting beer glass targets faster than a rival.
c64:139643.title: Western Games

c64:139645.description: Defend New York from invading aliens on a single screen of skyscrapers with a subway tunnel beneath, launching from pads at either edge; one or two players.
c64:139645.title: Save New York

c64:139647.description: A text adventure in one of the valleys around Lake Watersmeet: seek your fortune by finding treasure or robbing locals, whose characters move about in real time.
c64:139647.title: Twin Kingdom Valley

c64:139649.description: Moe, Larry and Curly scramble to raise $5000 to save an orphanage from an evil banker, through scenes based on their TV and film routines, including dodging flying pies.
c64:139649.title: The Three Stooges

c64:139756.description: Based on Bob Monkhouse's TV quiz: up to four players answer general knowledge questions on a bingo-style board, completing lines for prizes and clearing the whole card to win.
c64:139756.title: Bob's Full House

c64:139757.description: Steer an Olympic bobsled down a mountain, avoiding boulders and obstacles, and above all the chalet, as speed builds toward the finish.
c64:139757.title: Bobsled

c64:139758.description: Run a bobsleigh team, handling training, equipment purchases and finances, then race the runs yourself; bankruptcy ends the game.
c64:139758.title: Bobsleigh

c64:139759.description: Lawn bowls: roll the jack, then send heavier bowls toward it, scoring for each bowl nearer the jack than the opponent's best.
c64:139759.title: Bowls

c64:139761.description: With help from his friend Dr. Who and the TARDIS, Bod the Alien travels to an Egyptian pyramid, a medieval castle and a Victorian haunted house to rescue his kidnapped children in a flick-screen platformer.
c64:139761.title: Bod Squad

c64:139763.description: Educational activities about different parts of the human body, followed by a quiz of more than 200 questions.
c64:139763.title: The Body in Focus

c64:139764.description: Arriving late to work, the BOFH finds insane activists have taken the servers and workstations hostage and planted bombs in the network closets, and goes to war to take the building back.
c64:139764.title: BOFH: Servers Under Siege

c64:139765.description: Delta 4's parody text adventure of Lord of the Rings: Fordo the Boggit must take the Great Ring to Mount Doom, joined by Spam, Pimply and Murky and meeting Bumbadil, Hashberry, Legoland and Giblet.
c64:139765.title: Bored of the Rings

aliases: Zork Quest I: Assault on Egreth Castle
c64:139771.description: An illustrated story set in the Zork world: a caravan of adventurers heads into Egreth Castle, once home of King Duncanthrax and now overrun by trolls, hobgoblins and night gaunts under a mad wizard.
c64:139771.title: ZorkQuest: Assault on Egreth Castle

aliases: Zork Quest II: The Crystal of Doom
c64:139772.description: The second ZorkQuest story: the magician Frobwit, Acia, the merchant Gurthark and the scout Ryker travel together toward Accardi-By-The-Sea.
c64:139772.title: ZorkQuest: The Crystal of Doom

c64:139776.description: From Cassette 50: choose between Master Logic, a Mastermind clone with nine difficulty levels, and Letter Jumble.
c64:139776.title: Boggles: The Mind Boggler

c64:139777.description: The meter has run out and the lights are off, letting Bogymen roam; climb ladders from the meter at the bottom right toward the top of a single-screen platform layout.
c64:139777.title: Bogy Men

c64:139781.description: Bounce around collecting every item in the correct order, or lose a life. Released with Commodore Zone issue 13.
c64:139781.title: Boing!

c64:139782.description: Bojo the Clown bounces on circus trampolines to reach balloons; each balloon collected reappears elsewhere, so a different trampoline is needed.
c64:139782.title: Bojo

c64:139783.description: A head-to-head shooter for two players only, with each side getting its own half of a split screen. Programmed by Mathew Cox, music from Kent Patfield.
c64:139783.title: Bolo

c64:139784.description: A tiny 4K minigame-competition entry where falling bombs have to be caught before they go off.
c64:139784.title: Bomb Catch

c64:139785.description: Steer Smudge around enclosed arenas gathering 20 bombs per stage while dodging roaming monsters and shifting walls.
c64:139785.title: Bomb Chase

c64:139787.description: Bombs are ticking inside the Sellerscale nuclear plant, and a lone hero must defuse them across a series of single-screen platform levels before the north of the globe is wiped out.
c64:139787.title: Bomb Fusion

c64:139788.description: A lightly reworked follow-up to Bomb Chase in which Smudge again clears each arena of bombs while avoiding enemies, with a cuter look but the same rough edges.
c64:139788.title: Bomb Chase: Revival

c64:139789.description: Bomb Jack's caped hero returns in a scrolling platform sequel, grabbing bombs for points and avoiding monsters that pop out of crates.
c64:139789.title: Mighty Bombjack

c64:139793.description: A plain Bomb Jack-style game of leaping between platforms to gather bombs, which cycles back to its first screen after a while. Appeared in Happy Computer and a 64'er game collection.
c64:139793.title: Bomb Runner

c64:139794.description: Feuding twin brothers Bang and Boom are thrown into the Bomb Squad Pit to settle their quarrel with dropped bombs over three rounds, in a Bomberman-like duel.
c64:139794.title: Bomb Squad

c64:139795.description: Locked in a terrorist hideout, break out of the cell and race into town to stop a bomb set to detonate at 4 p.m. in this text adventure from Mogul's Great Adventure Pack.
c64:139795.title: Bomb Threat

c64:139799.description: Fly a bomber leftward over enemy territory, moving only up and down, and land 25 bombs on targets without striking any hospital while flak and fighters attack.
c64:139799.title: Bomber Attack

c64:139801.description: A plane sweeps back and forth over a city, dropping bombs to level the buildings so it can land, refuel and start the next mission.
c64:139801.title: Bomber Run

c64:139802.description: Fight across 36 fiery Bomberman-style arenas in a solo campaign, or face two to five friends in deathmatch; passwords unlock cooperative play and computer opponents.
c64:139802.title: Bomberland

c64:139803.description: Hop from platform to platform collecting the objects scattered over each screen without tumbling off. Also known as Bomb Jack Junior, and issued in Italy under the names Labirinto and Vampir.
c64:139803.title: Strobuster

c64:139804.description: A Polish Bomberman-style duel for two players or one against the computer, blasting through destructible walls in a half-indestructible maze to eliminate the rival. Part of the Triada pack.
c64:139804.title: Bombi

c64:139806.description: Jump around each screen picking up tokens while avoiding moving foes; collecting them in their flashing order earns a bonus, and a falling power-up gives a temporary edge. Three lives are all you get.
c64:139806.title: Bombo

c64:139808.description: A Minesweeper clone coded entirely in assembly, with genuine mouse support and a high-score table that can be saved.
c64:139808.title: Bombsweeper 64

c64:139809.description: A multi-screen platformer in a Mario-like vein where the goal is to jump up and grab flowers, with the option of leaving a level and coming back to it later.
c64:139809.title: Bond

c64:139810.description: Bono the dragon makes soap from skeletons, and to restock he digs through 22 scrolling castle levels in this Boulder Dash-style puzzle game.
c64:139810.title: Bone Cruncher

c64:139811.description: Move a little workman up and down ladders between layered floors; the layout of ladders and boxes is rearranged every game.
c64:139811.title: Bonzo

c64:139812.description: Kteth, a falcon-headed godling of Egypt, is cast out of the Other World with the rest of Set's kin after Set murders Osiris and is defeated by Horus.
c64:139812.title: Book of the Dead

c64:139817.description: Run illegal Scotch down the highways in an armed, armoured car while police try to stop the delivery, in a side-scrolling driving and shooting game.
c64:139817.title: Bootleg Bandits

c64:139820.description: An educational platformer where Boppie, a bouncing ball, gathers letters one at a time in the right order to spell words.
c64:139820.title: Boppie's Great Word Chase

c64:139824.description: An Infocom text adventure set during the Cold War on the border between fictional Frobnia and neutral Litzenburg, around a plot involving the arriving US ambassador, told from several viewpoints.
c64:139824.title: Border Zone

c64:139830.description: After crash-landing on a swampy planet, Borzak must cross five side-scrolling levels to reach his wrecked ship, jumping the many gaps along the way.
c64:139830.title: Borzak

c64:139838.description: Worlie the worm finds a hole into a garden of tasty roses, unaware they belong to the king, in this adventure published in 64'er magazine.
c64:139838.title: The Worm

c64:139841.description: Two-on-two ice hockey in which each side fields a skater and a goalkeeper, trying to score the most goals in a two-minute match.
c64:139841.title: Hat Trick

c64:139842.description: A motorcycle drag-racing game: pick a Honda Hurricane, Suzuki Katana, Kawasaki Ninja or Yamaha FZR and race the clock or the championship record.
c64:139842.title: Pocket Rockets

c64:139861.description: Port of Capcom's horizontally scrolling arcade shooter where Lieutenant Henry, with a second player as Sergeant Sanders, flies against the Bozon invaders threatening Earth.
c64:139861.title: Hyper Dyne Side Arms

c64:139862.description: Fantasy football played by monsters on a field of landmines, where brutal tackles are allowed and the aim is still to score touchdowns.
c64:139862.title: Grave Yardage

c64:139916.description: Budget conversion of Namco's Bosconian: a top-down space shooter where each wave has enemy space stations to destroy among rocks and alien fighters, with a scanner to locate them.
c64:139916.title: Bosconian '87

c64:139917.description: Guide a basketball through screen-sized platform stages to the hoop at the end, avoiding hazards like glass bottles and laser beams before time runs out; extra balls give points and lives.
c64:139917.title: Bounce It

c64:139919.description: A futuristic one-on-one ball sport for two players or one against the computer, played over two 90-second halves with two different ways to score points.
c64:139919.title: Bounces

c64:139920.description: Bounce a head around a top-down floating maze, collecting enough lips to finish each level and avoiding the creatures that roam it.
c64:139920.title: Bouncing Heads

c64:139921.description: A watermelon farmer with a pitchfork plants melons and protects them from bouncing Kamungas during a thunderstorm, defeating the creatures by standing beneath them.
c64:139921.title: The Bouncing Kamungas

c64:139922.description: A Norwegian dodging game: keep clear of colourful bouncing enemies to reach the next level, with only three lives to spare.
c64:139922.title: Bouncy

c64:139923.description: Up to three players jump on one another to drain energy and bounce ever higher, winning a level by knocking all rivals off the screen. Released on a Commodore Zone cover tape.
c64:139923.title: Bouncy Balls

c64:139925.description: Single-player bat-and-ball game in the Arkanoid style, with animated hi-res characters scrolling behind the bricks and sampled sound; players single out its sluggish, laggy bat and steep difficulty.
c64:139925.title: Bound

c64:139931.description: A human races around a spiral building seen from above, climbing ladders between floors to collect every item while faster reptiles hunt him down.
c64:139931.title: Bounzy

c64:139945.description: A ten-pin bowling simulation for up to three players, released in the Commodore Pro-Pak collection.
c64:139945.title: Bowling Night

c64:140013.description: Graphical updates of three Dunjonquest role-playing games, Temple of Apshai, Upper Reaches of Apshai and Curse of Ra, exploring dungeons room by room with only the nearby area visible.
c64:140013.title: Temple of Apshai Trilogy

c64:140017.description: Manage a stable of boxers whose skills grow with training and fight experience.
c64:140017.title: The Boxer

c64:140018.description: Hired by Mr. Box, head of a firm that makes oversized freight boxes, the player has to tidy away the crates the factory keeps churning out.
c64:140018.title: Boxes

c64:140021.description: Pick from dozens of boxers rated in power, defence and punishment and fight a single bout or a whole championship, with large fighter sprites and an announcer introducing each match.
c64:140021.title: 3D World Boxing

c64:140022.description: Steer young heavyweights toward a world title through a text-based management interface.
c64:140022.title: Boxing Manager

c64:140023.description: Help Bozo stagger home from the pub by the left route, the right route or across the park; each safe arrival earns more pints, and walking straight gets harder as he drinks.
c64:140023.title: Bozo's Night Out

c64:140024.description: In 1912 Hamburg, a detective and his partner Wilhelm investigate a mummy's supposed curse, and must present evidence and the right answers when the superintendent arrives a week later.
c64:140024.title: Bozuma: The Mystery of the Mummy

c64:140026.description: Sequel to Brain Disease by Bela Erdei: instead of pushing blocks together, arrange balls to meet each level's goal and move on.
c64:140026.title: Brain Disease II: The Return

c64:140027.description: Tiles bearing sixteen different symbols keep appearing around the edge of the board; select one and flick it in a direction, and it slides until it hits a wall, a diamond or another tile. Bring matching symbols together to clear them, using the shifting diamonds as bumpers, before the border fills up as the pace quickens.
c64:140027.title: Brain Spasm

c64:140028.description: A take-away numbers duel for one or two players, inspired by Coined: players alternate removing a chosen amount from a shared pot of credits, trying to force the opponent into a losing position.
c64:140028.title: Brain Strain

c64:140029.description: Draw lines inside a field of coloured shapes to deflect a bouncing ball into the red ones, aiming to beat the previous screen's score before the timer hits zero.
c64:140029.title: Brainstorm

c64:140030.description: An overhead racer on a constantly upward-scrolling road: weave left and right past other cars, switching between low and high gear, with points only earned in high gear.
c64:140030.title: Brands

c64:140031.description: Stranded on an alien world after a crash, recover two ship parts from each of four bases in this multi-screen sci-fi platformer, managing scarce ammunition against mutants.
c64:140031.title: Brave

c64:140066.description: An illustrated text adventure in which an African huntress sets out to rid the jungle of savage monsters.
c64:140066.title: The Brave African Huntress

c64:140068.description: Perform breakdance moves on joystick command in front of two judges, after choosing the colours of everyone's outfits.
c64:140068.title: Break Fever

c64:140069.description: An Arkanoid-style bat-and-ball game where some smashed blocks release capsules granting extra balls, lasers or a bigger or smaller paddle.
c64:140069.title: Breaker

c64:140070.description: An interactive fiction story where the hero meets the Breakers, an old race awaiting a messiah, on the very day their prophecy names, and must persuade them that he is the one.
c64:140070.title: Breakers

c64:140075.description: An Arkanoid-style brick breaker bundled with an editor for building or altering levels to make new games. Published on Magic Disk 64 and Game On.
c64:140075.title: Breakout Construction Kit

c64:140076.description: A first-person, racquetball-like spin on Breakout: from one end of a rectangular room, return the ball with a square paddle so it chips bricks off the far wall.
c64:140076.title: BreakThru (Avalon Hill)

c64:140077.description: Drive, leap and shoot through five side-scrolling stages, from mountains and a bridge to plains, a city and finally an airfield, to recover a stolen jet fighter.
c64:140077.title: BreakThru

c64:140078.description: A two-player goalkeeper duel in the style of Pong, where the winner is whoever keeps their own goal area clearest.
c64:140078.title: Breathalyzer

aliases: Brektwon: The Curse of the Keys
c64:140079.description: The aged wizard Mijkar went mad and turned his palace into a network of chambers sealed by locked doors, which must now be explored.
c64:140079.title: Brektwon

c64:140080.description: An illustrated English text adventure: the king has fallen ill and the chosen hero must find his cure, though a weak parser makes several puzzles very hard.
c64:140080.title: The Brew

c64:140081.description: A football management board game where between two and five players each run a club through a season, strengthening the squad against human and computer rivals.
c64:140081.title: Brian Clough's Football Fortunes

c64:140082.description: Take on judo Olympian Brian Jacks across eight events, among them running, archery, cycling, football and swimming, in a contest modelled on the BBC show Superstars.
c64:140082.title: Brian Jacks Superstar Challenge

c64:140086.description: Play the bride, wandering Castle Frankenstein and its grounds to gather the lungs, hearts, kidneys and brains her monstrous partner needs, finding keys to open locked doors.
c64:140086.title: Bride of Frankenstein

c64:140087.description: A contract bridge program that adds the Blackwood convention and lets you enter specific deals or play random ones, bidding and playing with a computer partner against two computer opponents.
c64:140087.title: Bridge 3.0

c64:140088.description: Text-only contract bridge: you and a computer partner take on two computer opponents, first bidding for the contract and then playing out the hand while the program keeps score and rejects illegal bids or plays. Each deal is generated from a seed number, so a memorable hand can be dealt again later.
c64:140088.title: Bridge 4.0

c64:140089.description: Single-player contract bridge with cards drawn on screen, bidding based on five-card Stayman and Blackwood, a bidding review, automatic scoring and warnings for illegal moves.
c64:140089.title: Bridge 5.0

c64:140090.description: Electronic contract bridge against the computer, with 99 levels that steadily increase in difficulty.
c64:140090.title: Bridge 64

c64:140093.description: Two players captain sailing brigs and try to sink each other, firing a broadside cannon that cannot aim over the bow or stern while the wind keeps changing.
c64:140093.title: Brig Battle

c64:140094.description: Seek a fortune on the roulette wheel or by driving an ice cream van around Brighton, steering clear of sunbathers and runaway elephants.
c64:140094.title: Brighton Beach

c64:140095.description: A real-time text adventure in which Sir Gawain, trapped in a dream of the underworld Ulro, must learn five magic words to escape; the story is narrated in the third person.
c64:140095.title: Brimstone

c64:140096.description: Sneak past a guard to grab cash and valuables on the top floor before the alarm sounds, then get back down to the getaway driver; each heist the guard grows sharper. Also published as Joe Fox.
c64:140096.title: Brinx Jinx

c64:140098.description: Tactical combat between Napoleonic-era sailing ships, playable in a fast arcade mode where you steer and fire directly or a more detailed simulation mode.
c64:140098.title: Broadsides

c64:140100.description: A multi-event sports contest that swaps the Olympics for the streets of the Bronx.
c64:140100.title: Bronx Medal

c64:140102.description: Roll a bubble across a grid over five levels, collecting red stones worth four points and blue stones worth two.
c64:140102.title: Bubble

c64:140103.description: An early-learning game for ages 4 to 8 where children help Soapie the Sea Serpent steer soap bubbles to catch Zeboingers, building prediction skills.
c64:140103.title: Bubble Burst

c64:140104.description: A ghost blows a fragile bubble through the rooms of a castle; where he puffs on it decides its path, and candles, fans and other hazards can pop it.
c64:140104.title: Bubble Ghost

c64:140105.description: Collect every disk icon on the level while leaving the skull and crossbones alone, and stun pursuers with bubbles that float them to the top of the screen.
c64:140105.title: Bubble It

c64:140106.description: A puzzle-minded platformer about a little imp determined to gather every gem in the land.
c64:140106.title: Bubble Mania

c64:140107.description: In the city of Irkon, enslaved by the wizard Vadra, a revived blob uses magic corks from Kintor to seal the giant bottles spewing bubbles that spawn mutant guards.
c64:140107.title: Bubbler

c64:140108.description: Weave through a strange dimension, dodging waves of bubbles heading your way.
c64:140108.title: Bubbles

c64:140131.description: Lava is flowing toward a village, and only a wizard who can reverse it can help; first the bewitched local witch needs a magic powder to restore her so she can fetch him.
c64:140131.title: WitchSwitch

c64:140133.description: Explore a multi-directionally scrolling platform maze across three zones in search of the exit, jumping gaps, riding lifts and climbing ladders while collecting coins.
c64:140133.title: Buddy Bubble

c64:140134.description: Buffalo Bill hosts six humorous Wild West events, starting with knife throwing at a spinning board with a woman strapped to it; any event can be retried after a failure.
c64:140134.title: Buffalo Bill's Rodeo Games

c64:140135.description: Ride a horse around a single screen herding buffalo through a gate, keeping them from escaping through gaps into the desert.
c64:140135.title: Buffalo Round Up

c64:140137.description: A one-player Centipede clone by Eric R. Smith, published in an FHD Software Twin Pack; not the Antony Crowther game of the same year.
c64:140137.title: Bug Blast

c64:140147.description: Man a ground gun and shoot down helicopters, bombers and the paratroopers they drop; let enough soldiers land and they form a tank that destroys the gun.
c64:140147.title: Paratroopers

aliases: Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip
c64:140150.description: A Defender-style shooter based on the Gobots cartoon: as Leader-1, invade the planet Moebius to stop Dr. Braxis and rescue captured Gobots and their human allies.
c64:140150.title: Challenge of the Gobots

c64:140154.description: Guide a squadron of three ships escorting relief convoys between the planets of the Coman system in this sideways-scrolling shooter.
c64:140154.title: Cosmic Convoy

c64:140190.description: Antony Crowther's take on Centipede, shooting a segmented centipede as it zigzags down the screen toward a ship at the bottom.
c64:140190.title: Bug Blaster

c64:140191.description: Pilot a ship down dangerous tunnels into caverns beneath a planet to wipe out nests of mutant bugs, then fly back up to the surface.
c64:140191.title: Bug Blitz

c64:140192.description: Ram bugs with your ship to destroy them while red saucers attack whenever you leave the blue safe zones; holding fire grants brief invulnerability at the cost of fuel.
c64:140192.title: Bug Crusher

c64:140193.description: As a bug, dive repeatedly from the surface to the seabed to fetch eggs, avoiding fish that swim across the screen.
c64:140193.title: Bug Diver

c64:140194.description: A Centipede-like shooter starring Zappo, a garden-spraying gadget that moves along the bottom of the screen to blast a centipede creature.
c64:140194.title: Bug Squad

c64:140195.description: Clear bugs from a computer's maze-like circuits using bombs, mines, blockades and bug-hunting hatchlings, in a Dynablaster-inspired game with several ways to kill enemies.
c64:140195.title: Bugbomber

c64:140196.description: A two-player cooperative shooter in which one player defends the top of the screen against bugs while the other fires at those crawling up from below.
c64:140196.title: Bugs

c64:140197.description: Bugs Bunny burrows through an abandoned mine hunting clues and carrots, digging past spiders, birds and other critters.
c64:140197.title: Bugs Bunny: Private Eye

c64:140198.description: Joey the builder won the lottery and insists on building his dream house himself, in a tile-matching puzzle game made of single-screen levels.
c64:140198.title: Build It: Das Bauhaus

c64:140199.description: Ben has four houses to build: first he scales a brick wall to fetch his three tools from the top, dodging a weight and a bug, then gets on with the construction while avoiding hazards.
c64:140199.title: Builder Ben

c64:140201.description: Fly a small ship up a vertically scrolling course packed with Polon gun emplacements and blocking walls, fighting through to destroy their mother ship.
c64:140201.title: Bulldog

c64:140202.description: Two snow-clearing bulldozers leave trails Tron-style over six rounds with varied layouts; force the rival into a trail or wall, while a head-on crash counts as a draw.
c64:140202.title: Bulldoze! Schneeräumer im Kampf

c64:140205.description: Based on the darts quiz show for two players: throw at category segments to earn questions, compete on a standard board for the right to answer, then try the red-and-black bonus board without hitting the same red twice.
c64:140205.title: Bullseye

c64:140206.description: A darts game with seven ways to score, including Golf, Cricket and standard 501, aiming each throw with joystick or keyboard.
c64:140206.title: Bully's Sporting Darts

c64:140233.description: Two-a-side volleyball on indoor or beach courts, played solo against the computer, head-to-head, or with a friend teaming up against the computer.
c64:140233.title: Bump Set Spike!: Doubles Volleyball

c64:140234.description: Drive through all four seasons in a Bump 'n' Jump-style race, earning extra points by shoving other cars off the road and leaping over water once past 100 mph.
c64:140234.title: Bumping Buggys

c64:140236.description: Run a club in one of the top three German football divisions, with the genuine teams and players of the time, handling transfers, training and finances.
c64:140236.title: Bundesliga Manager

c64:140238.description: Collect cosmic creatures around a single-screen maze while bunnies breed from a warren, holding them off with a bunny-zapping laser.
c64:140238.title: Bunny Zap
