c64:140239.description: A BurgerTime-inspired platformer where a chef climbs ladders and walks over ingredients to drop them down layer by layer, assembling four burgers over four levels.
c64:140239.title: Burger Chase

c64:140240.description: Deliver as many men as possible through the bush while avoiding obstacles and an alligator that grows more aggressive as play goes on.
c64:140240.title: Bush Patrol

c64:140241.description: A collector hunts the eight rarest butterfly species across several levels in the one place they are said to live.
c64:140241.title: Butterfly

c64:140242.description: Bertie the Bee cannot resist sweet fruit, even when it hangs in a big spider's web; fly him across the screen gathering pieces of it.
c64:140242.title: Buzz Off!

c64:140243.description: A boxing game that allows dirty tactics like kicks and low blows if the referee is looking the other way; bouts run 15 rounds, and a knockdown only ends the round.
c64:140243.title: By Fair Means or Foul

c64:140244.description: A budget spoof of Sir Clive Sinclair's ill-fated C5 electric car, with Clive driving it through a series of screens alternating between two styles of play.
c64:140244.title: C5 Clive

c64:140247.description: Before the CADCAM unit debuts at a trade show, a failed memory bank deep in its circuitry must be repaired against the clock.
c64:140247.title: Cad Cam Warrior

c64:140248.description: Explore a dungeon, battle monsters and save gold to buy better weapons and armour from a trader in this 2D role-playing adventure.
c64:140248.title: Caer Shiraz

c64:140249.description: Thrown out after smashing crockery chasing mice, Caesar the Cat looks for a new home in a choice-based story game for children aged three to nine.
c64:140249.title: Caesar's Travels

c64:140250.description: A trench-coated detective must make contact in Cairo, recover a microfilm and bring it back to the Chief, preferably after finding a missing revolver.
c64:140250.title: The Cairo Connection

c64:140258.description: Into-the-screen road racer patched together from the Out Run Deluxe preview demo. The car largely drives itself, and steering off the tarmac has no consequence, so there is little to do beyond watching the road go by.
c64:140258.title: California Driver

c64:140259.description: Play two 18-hole courses with Leader Board-style swing controls, choosing from 14 clubs and accounting for wind, with a 3D view and an overhead map.
c64:140259.title: California Pro Golf

aliases: The California Raisins and the Cereal Factory
c64:140260.description: As Tiny Goodbite, climb and jump through the floors of a cereal factory to free the other California Raisins, grabbing each level's key.
c64:140260.title: The California Raisins

c64:140261.description: Battle droid Psycho must find seven Doomsday Devices before Professor Hans de Jaberwocky turns humanity into gunge unless paid a ransom of money, BMX bikes and shiny pebbles.
c64:140261.title: Call Me Psycho

c64:140262.description: Calvin clears caverns of green dinosaurs and flying robotic hats, starting defenceless in a basic suit and stepping on pads to change into different suits.
c64:140262.title: Calvin

c64:140264.description: Four rally-raid events: drop a package from a plane onto a target, drive a van clear of rocks, refuel it by waggling against the clock, and cross rocky ground without going too fast.
c64:140264.title: Camel Trophy

c64:140265.description: Race through an abandoned castle as quickly as possible, avoiding the traps laid in its rooms. Also known as Castelli Magici and Castelli Incantati.
c64:140265.title: Camelot

c64:140266.description: A knight travels through Camelot to recover four strange 20th-century objects that have appeared in the medieval world, in a sword-swinging platform game from Opera Soft.
c64:140266.title: Camelot Warriors

c64:140270.description: Wipe out enemy waves in each zone using cannons positioned along the bottom and left edges, collecting power-ups; playable alone but designed for two players together.
c64:140270.title: Cannon Craze

c64:140271.description: A tennis-like duel between two gunners firing a cannonball back and forth; the first to 15 points wins. From the Cassette 50 collection.
c64:140271.title: Cannonball

c64:140272.description: Paddle a canoe around a course for the best time, using forward, reverse, rotation and a fire-button throttle, while keeping off the banks.
c64:140272.title: Canoeing

c64:140273.description: Ride a cannonball through a side-view maze, Baron Munchausen style, searching for the way out.
c64:140273.title: Canonrider

aliases: Ordeal in the Canyons of Zelaz
c64:140275.title: Canyons of Zelaz

aliases: Captain America and the Doom Tube
c64:140276.description: Captain America infiltrates Dr. Megalomann's Doom Tube, three nested cylinders of decks and rooms linked by the Orbivator lift, some of them contaminated by a deadly virus.
c64:140276.title: Captain America in: The Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann

c64:140277.description: Pilot a helicopter through a horizontally scrolling cave in the style of Scramble, shooting everything and never touching the floor or ceiling.
c64:140277.title: Captain Cactus

c64:140278.description: One or two players climb 20 stacked levels of the invaded planet Icarus, unlocking doors and reaching each lift in a Gauntlet-style shooter with a split screen.
c64:140278.title: Captain Fizz Meets the Blaster-Trons

c64:140279.description: Space courier Captain Kelly is trapped aboard the Obsidian 2 after its security system ignores the shutdown code.
c64:140279.title: Captain Kelly

c64:140281.description: A space shooter based on the 1987 TV series, set in 2147 on a devastated Earth ruled by Lord Dread and his machines.
c64:140281.title: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future

c64:140282.description: A box-pushing Sokoban variant with 255 levels and a number of extra features.
c64:140282.title: Captain Stark: The Mission

c64:140283.description: Steer a spaceman through 13 tunnels to reach the green asteroid. Later given an unofficial English translation.
c64:140283.title: Captain Starlight

c64:140284.description: Trapped in the Glen of Coloured Corpses, roam an island town searching for colour-coded keys to the locked doors in order to escape.
c64:140284.title: The Captive

c64:140285.description: A kidnap victim of Buck and Jack, still held after the $20,000 ransom demand, must find the money and escape in this text adventure.
c64:140285.title: Captive

c64:140286.description: A Check Man-inspired puzzle game where Capt'n Kidd moves around a 15x12 grid seen from above, reaching and defusing bombs before their timers run out.
c64:140286.title: Capt'n Kidd

c64:140290.description: Players take turns capturing pieces until a set limit is reached, and the higher score wins; play against the computer or a second player.
c64:140290.title: Capture 2

c64:140292.description: Run a haulage firm: choose contracts, trucks and routes for the best profit while handling hazards and avoiding speed traps on the motorway.
c64:140292.title: Car Journey

c64:140294.description: A card-matching memory game, with a ping pong game included as a bonus. Published on a Commodore Scene disk.
c64:140294.title: Card Land

c64:140327.description: Puzzler that Stavros Fasoulas and Simon Nicol reportedly coded in one night: you move around an Amidar-like grid set over a star field, colouring in the map Painter-style, with touches borrowed from Quedex and Delta. Meant for Firebird's budget label, it went unreleased.
c64:140327.title: Cargo

c64:140328.description: A top-down racer where all cars share the same speed and only a win unlocks the next of 18 tracks; prize money buys nitro, mines and other upgrades between races.
c64:140328.title: Carnage

c64:140330.description: A Dutch-language racer where you weave around other cars while shifting up through the gears for more speed.
c64:140330.title: Car-Race

c64:140331.description: Command carrier task forces in the Pacific War as either the United States or Japan, across six scenarios including Pearl Harbor, Coral Sea and Midway.
c64:140331.title: Carriers at War 1941-1945: Fleet Carrier Operations in the Pacific

c64:140332.description: Mr Livewire tidies the classrooms of St. Hexidecimals, a school for crazed coders, turning every large X into a tick while dodging people, creatures and objects.
c64:140332.title: Carry on Laughing

c64:140334.description: Pop groups of two or more same-coloured bubbles, scoring more for bigger groups and earning a 500-point bonus for clearing the board.
c64:140334.title: Cascade

c64:140336.title: The Case of the Missing Adventure

c64:140339.description: Includes a slot-machine take on five-card draw poker: start with 20 points and gain or lose according to each final hand, with the payout threshold rising after 15 hands.
c64:140339.title: Casino Poker

c64:140344.description: Sent by Lady Artemis into the magical Castle Blackstar, an adventurer seeks a precious orb in this text adventure, keeping any other treasure found and scoring points along the way.
c64:140344.title: Castle Blackstar

c64:140345.description: A master's demon-summoning experiment has overrun his castle and he has vanished, leaving his young helper to tackle the platform-filled halls.
c64:140345.title: Castle Boy

c64:140349.description: Slip into a castle and find its treasure while avoiding guards, bats and the Baron himself.
c64:140349.title: Castle Adventure

c64:140350.description: Find Count Dracula's castle, search it for useful items and finally drive a stake through the Count, while dealing with ghouls and zombies, one of which steals whatever you carry.
c64:140350.title: Castle Dracula

c64:140351.description: Steer a small ghost around a haunted mansion seen from above, gathering treasures and shooting in four directions. Released in Europe as Mystic Mansion.
c64:140351.title: Castle Hassle

c64:140356.description: Lead Simon through ten levels of a nightmarish castle, finding each room's key to open the way onward, toward a chest holding a rough diamond and his freedom.
c64:140356.title: Castle Nightmare

c64:140358.description: A text adventure that starts at 6 PM before Dracula's castle: using two-word commands, find the items you need, get past trolls, a guard who demands four gold coins and treacherous water, and kill the count before midnight or before he bites you.
c64:140358.title: Castle of Dracula

c64:140359.description: Recover Klingsar's casket from his castle before he takes it back, solving six educational mini-games that test logic, perception, letters and numbers to earn keys to blocked passages.
c64:140359.title: Castle of Dreams

c64:140362.description: An evil wizard has seized Mydor's sacred Crown; descend below the castle dungeons to his cave, defeat him and bring the Crown back to the throne room.
c64:140362.title: Castle of Mydor

c64:140365.description: Throw rocks down on raiders storming the castle walls, earning a shield per stage, with a princess waiting after the seventh. An early example of speech on the machine.
c64:140365.title: Castle Raid!

c64:140366.description: A text adventure about defeating a warlock and escaping his stronghold, hampered by a picky parser and a misspelling in its own instructions.
c64:140366.title: Castle Warlock

c64:140367.description: Infiltrate Nazi headquarters in disguise, retrieve a hidden bomb and plant it at Hitler's bunker, relying on stealth and bribes, since open gunfire quickly brings the alarm.
c64:140367.title: Beyond Castle Wolfenstein

c64:140369.description: A Dungeons and Dragons style role-playing game: roll a character by type, race and alignment, then explore a castle level by level with an unseen guide who opens doors, carries gear and draws the map, fighting tougher creatures deeper down for experience and treasure.
c64:140369.title: Castles and Creatures

c64:140371.description: Command the only laser outpost defending the lunar city of Erriam from Jovian saucers, holding out as long as possible.
c64:140371.title: Cataclysm

c64:140374.description: Venture into the catacombs under Count Damion's castle in a fantasy role-playing game where hearts, speed, strength and morale must all stay above zero.
c64:140374.title: Catacombs of Gold

c64:140375.description: Fly against the alien CLIO civilisation through five large horizontally scrolling levels, from a moon base and alien forest to dark caves and an ancient city, with mid-level and end bosses.
c64:140375.title: Catalypse

c64:140376.description: Ferry bricks by helicopter, one per trip, from a barge to an island to raise a hotel as tall as possible over six days.
c64:140376.title: Catastrophe

c64:140377.description: Aliens, planets, spaceships and monoliths rain from the sky at different speeds and angles, and all must be caught; missing three means starting over.
c64:140377.title: Catch II

c64:140378.description: A two-player arena duel set in the future: grab flying objects before your opponent does while fending off satellites and enemy fire.
c64:140378.title: Catch It

c64:140383.description: Search underground crystal caverns for seven treasures and bring them back up to the surface in this text adventure.
c64:140383.title: Cave Explorer

c64:140384.description: Escape caves against the clock in a side-scrolling platformer where jump height and distance depend on how long the fire button is held.
c64:140384.title: Cave Fighter

c64:140385.description: An educational adventure set in the New Stone Age: left behind with her pet rabbit when her tribe moves to its summer cave, Clair must survive until they return.
c64:140385.title: Cave Girl Clair

c64:140387.description: In this Dig Dug-like game, tunnel through dirt to reach and eliminate burrowing creatures before they collapse the Earth's crust.
c64:140387.title: Cave Kooks

c64:140393.description: Sequel to Cavelon: gather the door pieces in each dungeon against the clock, now also harassed by a Black Wizard who unleashes birds and archers.
c64:140393.title: Cavelon II

c64:140395.description: Guide a balloon through the perilous caves of Morgor.
c64:140395.title: Cavelon 64

c64:140396.description: Ug the caveman wants a change from Brontosaurus steaks and travels nine islands to carry three pterodactyl eggs from the mountains home, one at a time, without breaking any.
c64:140396.title: Cavemania

c64:140398.description: A Scramble-like horizontally scrolling shooter: carrying bombs and anti-aircraft missiles, push deep into enemy territory, causing damage and collecting treasure.
c64:140398.title: Cavern Construction Kit

c64:140399.description: Steer a falling craft left and right through a continuously scrolling cavern, avoiding the walls and picking up fuel capsules to stay airborne.
c64:140399.title: Cavern Run 64

c64:140402.description: Pilot a null-gravity scout ship through the caverns of Jupiter to a base station, dodging yellow space mines and collecting flashing green beacons, using a small laser mining tool to cut through walls or blast mines, but not so often that it overheats.
c64:140402.title: Caverns of Jupiter

c64:140405.description: Play both sides between the Torms and invading Humans: rescue the farming robots the Torms took and blow up their power plant in the caverns below.
c64:140405.title: Caverns of Sillahc

c64:140406.description: Jetpack through six levels collecting treasure, avoiding traps and keeping an eye on the fuel gauge.
c64:140406.title: The Caves

c64:140407.description: Fly a craft through the computer's own innards, past BASIC and Kernal ROM, toward the CPU in a horizontally scrolling shooter full of lasers and narrow walls.
c64:140407.title: Caves of 64

c64:140408.description: Pilot a saucer through a vast cave system on Uranus's moon Oberon, uncovering the knowledge left behind by an extinct civilisation.
c64:140408.title: The Caves of Oberon

c64:140449.description: A text adventure that starts at a brush-covered cave entrance where Long John Silver's silver is said to be hidden.
c64:140449.title: Caves of Silver

c64:140451.description: A deadly dungeon crawl packed with monsters such as Mind Flayers and Intellect Devourers, with the demon Asmodeus waiting for any survivor.
c64:140451.title: Cells & Serpents

c64:140453.description: Michael Cranford, creator of The Bard's Tale, designed this sci-fi role-playing game in which a party drawn from six alien races, armed with weapons and psychic powers, explores space.
c64:140453.title: Centauri Alliance

c64:140457.description: A vertical, two-player Pong-style tennis game using a metal ball that emerges from a planet-like sphere in the middle of the court in a random direction.
c64:140457.title: Centron

c64:140458.description: Exiles from the planet Rydthar, whose Absolute Control Stations have run amok, settle on its third moon Xydrahpur, only to find new trouble in its caverns.
c64:140458.title: Caverns of Xydrahpur

c64:140464.description: A Centipede-style shooter: move a craft along the bottom of the screen, with a little room to advance, and blast the Centropod as it weaves down from the top.
c64:140464.title: Centropods

c64:140466.description: The three Centurions suit up in exo-frames to stop Doc Terror's minions from stealing Tyron Dichromate, a fusion chemical, from the Weapons Development Centre.
c64:140466.title: Centurions: Power X Treme

c64:140477.description: A karate fighting game for one or two players, built around enrolling in a martial arts school to learn self-defence techniques.
c64:140477.title: Super Black Belt Karate

c64:140490.description: Richard Bayliss's first machine-code game, written in an Action Replay monitor: jump moving objects with the space bar to rack up points.
c64:140490.title: Cetimiex

c64:140494.description: A strategy game against the computer or a friend: add bombs to squares until they reach critical mass and burst into neighbouring squares, setting off chain reactions to wipe out the opponent's pieces.
c64:140494.title: Chain-Reaction

c64:140496.description: Holding half of a sacred medallion, travel to the land of the bear to recover the other half and a blue sapphire in this Jack Lockerby text adventure.
c64:140496.title: The Challenge

c64:140500.description: Alien savages have overrun ten cities on a distant planet; bomb them flat from a spacecraft so they can be cleansed and rebuilt.
c64:140500.title: Challenger

c64:140509.description: A deliberately absurd text adventure where every object is useless and any wrong move ends the game, though a solution does exist.
c64:140509.title: Crazy Adventure

c64:140510.description: Adaptation of the TV game show: match pairs among 30 numbered panels to reveal parts of a hidden rebus picture puzzle and solve it.
c64:140510.title: Classic Concentration

c64:140514.description: Rise from alleyway scraps to title fights, training with a heavy bag, sparring partners and a skipping rope under a manager, with 11 moves including high and low punches and blocks.
c64:140514.title: The Champ

c64:140515.description: Snooker with six reds instead of fifteen for up to eight players; the solo mode challenges clearing the table with a shot allowance that shrinks with each miss or foul.
c64:140515.title: Championship 3D Snooker

c64:140517.description: Draft a team based on player attributes and play baseball on a split screen that shows the whole field on one side and the batter on the other.
c64:140517.title: Star League Baseball

c64:140545.description: Play one-on-one basketball as Julius Erving or Larry Bird at a single hoop, to a target score or time limit, with spin moves, outside shots and slam dunks.
c64:140545.title: One-on-One

aliases: Voyage au centre de la terre
c64:140546.description: Based on Jules Verne's novel: a scientist sets out to prove Arne Saknussemm's scroll is true, mixing exploration with action sequences on the way to the Earth's core.
c64:140546.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

c64:140603.description: A crosshair shooter in which squadrons of aliens swoop and bounce toward you, starting at 40 enemies to destroy.
c64:140603.title: Chaos

c64:140614.description: A spelling tutor that uses the SAM speech synthesizer to say a word, use it in a sentence and repeat it, then read each letter aloud as it is typed.
c64:140614.title: Chatterbee

c64:140615.description: Skate through isometric, constantly scrolling streets completing the Street Hawks gang's tests to win membership as the new kid in town.
c64:140615.title: Cheap Skate

c64:140619.description: Checkers in both colour and monochrome versions, with a computer-versus-computer mode for watching and learning strategy.
c64:140619.title: Checkers (ComputerEasy)

c64:140620.description: The Jams of planet Xnyl live on air and love, but their air is running out, so Pin and Ball build an atmosphere machine to save them.
c64:140620.title: Cheeky Twins

c64:140621.description: A Bomberman-style sequel: with their ship repaired, Pin and Ball head home to rescue the Jams of their planet, facing trickier levels.
c64:140621.title: Cheeky Twins II

c64:140622.description: A virtual chemistry lab with 50 experiments and thousands of reactions that can fizz, boil over or blow up unexpectedly.
c64:140622.title: Chem Lab

c64:140623.description: Pick up atoms with a crosshair and arrange them into the molecule shape shown, with passwords to resume at later levels.
c64:140623.title: Chemical

c64:140625.description: Run a nuclear power station through menus, readouts and typed commands such as shutting down generators; the Chernobyl name has no effect on the simulation.
c64:140625.title: Chernobyl: Nuclear Power Plant Simulation

c64:140626.description: Dash across a bridge gathering cherries while boulders crash down from above.
c64:140626.title: Cherry Dash

c64:140629.description: A chess board for two human players with no computer opponent: each move is typed as the coordinates of the piece to move, such as a2, followed by the square it goes to.
c64:140629.title: Chess for Two

c64:140630.description: A chess fan dozes off over his board and finds himself in a nightmare beside an enormous chess board, a jeering crowd on either side and a task to complete on its squares.
c64:140630.title: The Chess Game

c64:140631.description: After General Guemon conquers Guldred and kidnaps Princess Karen, the knight Gazem, left for dead on Chesterfield Island, sets out to rescue her.
c64:140631.title: Chester Field: Challenge to Dark Gor

c64:140632.description: A Pitfall-like adventure over a larger world, built on precise jumps over cactus plants and ending with a leap into darkness.
c64:140632.title: Chevalier

c64:140633.description: Race one of two vintage Chevrolets against the clock through four multi-section levels in an Out Run-style view, shifting between two gears to pass traffic.
c64:140633.title: Chevy Chase

c64:140634.description: A Pac-Man clone in PETSCII graphics: eat every cross and the dollar sign while avoiding the monster to move on.
c64:140634.title: Chewing Charlie

c64:140635.description: Two trucks gather steel girders to build up crunch power before smashing head-on in a game of chicken.
c64:140635.title: Chicken

c64:140639.description: His car out of fuel, a man walks through a forest, cinema, ghetto and graveyard full of ghouls, zombies, ghosts and bats to reach the haunted mansion where his girlfriend is held.
c64:140639.title: Chiller

c64:140640.description: A text adventure about lasting until morning in a haunted house while tracking down a lost amulet.
c64:140640.title: Chillervilla

c64:140641.description: Board an alien ship orbiting Earth, disable its weapons, trigger self-destruct and escape, exploring its empty isometric rooms.
c64:140641.title: Chimera

c64:140646.description: Wally knows where the Pong Dynasty's jade mines are; across 30 single-screen platform levels he collects set items and then a key to advance.
c64:140646.title: China Miner

c64:140652.description: Program little robots with visual instructions so they navigate environments, teaching the basics of computer programming.
c64:140652.title: ChipWits

c64:140653.description: Stranded by a time warp in a warehouse of white blocks, Charlie must push the four purple blocks together to escape.
c64:140653.title: Choc A Bloc Charlie

c64:140654.description: Survivors of a nuclear war are sealed under the city of Cholo by a malfunctioning computer, and robot droids must be sent to the surface to deal with it.
c64:140654.title: Cholo

c64:140655.description: A goldfish eats smaller sea creatures and then other fish to grow, moving from bowl to aquarium to river while avoiding piranhas and nets.
c64:140655.title: Chomp!

c64:140656.description: A Pac-Man-style maze game: eat all the dots while avoiding Bullies, using a limited speed burst and four ghost repellents.
c64:140656.title: Chomper Man

c64:140658.description: Fly a helicopter through a constantly scrolling battlefield in three sections, dodging and shooting helicopters and balloons before attacking a base, with six skill levels.
c64:140658.title: Aircop 2000

c64:140659.description: The last helicopter pilot of a doomed squad fights the Evil Empire's tanks to liberate three Free Continents in a side-scrolling shooter.
c64:140659.title: Chopper Commander

c64:140660.description: A helicopter shooter on a screen that never stops scrolling. Across three sections and six skill levels, gun down or dodge enemy helicopters and barrage balloons on the approach, then press on to bomb the enemy base at the end of the run.
c64:140660.title: Chopper (Creative Sparks)

c64:140662.description: A reworking of Buried Bucks: a helicopter bombs holes in the ground to dig out a different treasure each level, such as oil barrels, money bags and nuclear material.
c64:140662.title: Chopper Hunt

c64:140665.description: A ladder-climbing platform game made with the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, where the heroes collect bonus items while mostly avoiding enemies.
c64:140665.title: Chrome Bros

c64:140667.description: Car park attendant Chubby Gristle eats burgers, chocolate and other treats across flick-screen platform levels in this Monty Mole-inspired game.
c64:140667.title: Chubby Gristle

c64:140668.description: As Chuck Norris, walk the path to a monastery where a leader is held hostage, fighting enemies in close-up martial arts battles along the way.
c64:140668.title: Chuck Norris Superkicks

c64:140669.description: Test-fly 14 aircraft, including the Bell X-1 and SR-71, each with its own handling, using ten camera views and zoom up to 256x.
c64:140669.title: Chuck Yeager's Advanced Flight Trainer

c64:140671.description: A reworked Frexel: fly through the strange Frexel-Kejland region, shooting aliens, grabbing flashing pods for firepower and jump energy, and destroying laser locks to open each exit.
c64:140671.title: Chute Pursuit

c64:140672.description: The board game for one to four players: spin for a number from 1 to 6 and race from square 1 to 100, climbing ladders and sliding down chutes.
c64:140672.title: Chutes and Ladders

c64:140673.description: Princess Cecil of the land of Oms falls ill, and Romek sets out to find the magic cure, carrying at most two items at a time and working out where each one is needed.
c64:140673.title: Chwat

c64:140674.description: Defend Earth from the lunar surface in a first-person shooter, aiming a gun sight at alien attackers that shoot back across several stages.
c64:140674.title: Ciphoid 9

c64:140675.description: A ring-shaped world built around a sun by a vanished alien race is falling toward its star, and its leftover technology and creatures stand between you and saving it.
c64:140675.title: Circle World

c64:140680.description: Perform five acts of Circus Morelli: trampoline, tightrope, juggling, knife throwing and leaping clowns, practising each before the full evening show.
c64:140680.title: Circus Attractions

c64:140682.description: Sid Chip is stuck inside a nightmare dreamed by The Great Allonso, made of 20 scrolling circus rings, and must find each ring's exit across odd-shaped platforms, avoiding the creatures.
c64:140682.title: Circus Circus

c64:140688.title: Ringling Brothers and Barnum & Bailey: Circus Games

c64:140747.description: A text adventure that opens on a hill south of a looming Citadel, with walls to circle, a raised drawbridge and a moat to inspect.
c64:140747.title: Citadel of Corruption

c64:140748.description: Shipwrecked when the island Yah-Mon surfaces beneath your boat, find the island's citadel, defeat the sorcerer inside and get away in this Quill-made text adventure.
c64:140748.title: The Citadel of Yah-Mon

c64:140749.description: Slide a cannon left and right to shoot down waves of aliens bombing their way toward London's underground nuclear reactor.
c64:140749.title: City Fighter

c64:140751.description: A cancelled street-life game where a down-and-out tries to work his way up and make serious money, similar in spirit to Rags to Riches.
c64:140751.title: City Survivor

c64:140752.description: Defend a major city against three types of alien assault over 14 levels, flying a craft in a side-scrolling shooter.
c64:140752.title: Cityattak

c64:140757.description: Jimbo the big-eared elephant crosses five scrolling platform levels full of enemies and traps to rescue his kidnapped cousin, using his trunk to help.
c64:140757.title: Jimbo

c64:140759.description: A version of Crowther and Woods' Colossal Cave Adventure, first released by Abersoft as Adventure 1 before Melbourne House renamed it.
c64:140759.title: Classic Adventure

c64:140760.description: More rebus puzzles from the TV game show Concentration, for two players or one against the computer, matching panels to uncover the hidden puzzle.
c64:140760.title: Classic Concentration: 2nd Edition

c64:140761.description: Bet on horse racing over a meeting of 1 to 50 races; one player aims to reach a million pounds, while two players try to outdo each other.
c64:140761.title: Classic Punter

c64:140762.description: Own five racehorses and campaign them through 20-week seasons, starting with £5000 and aiming to win the Derby at each season's end.
c64:140762.title: Classic Trainer

c64:140767.description: Cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban must tidy a new hotel littered with paper by vandals before guests arrive, floor by floor over eight platform levels.
c64:140767.title: It's Clean-Up Time

c64:140768.description: Otto and Bobban return to clean the Addle Hotel; alone or with a friend, run through large levels clearing up while avoiding mutant rubbish.
c64:140768.title: Clean Up Service

c64:140770.description: A text adventure in which Clemens asks you to kill Salvius, the man who wrecked his shop.
c64:140770.title: Clemen's Revenge

c64:140772.description: Six party-themed activities for young children, such as blowing out cake candles, singing nursery rhymes and drawing, teaching letters and numbers with adjustable difficulty.
c64:140772.title: Clever Clogs: Party Time

c64:140773.description: Six educational games teaching letters and numbers to children from age three, with selectable difficulty.
c64:140773.title: Clever Clogs: Whizz Quiz

c64:140781.description: Galactic strategy set in the year 3714, when rival governors fight for sole rule of the clone sector. Build fighters, cruisers, dreadnoughts, freighters and troop ships, set taxes, keep morale and the economy up, raise tech levels and put down guerrillas while defending your resources.
c64:140781.title: The Clone Wars

c64:140782.title: Close Encounters of the Fourth Kind

c64:140783.description: Terry travels through 32 top-down kingdoms to recover the crystals Baron von Bansai scattered, collecting keys and hopping over enemy balls and bugs.
c64:140783.title: Cloud Kingdoms

c64:140785.description: Bounce clowns on a seesaw up into rows of balloons; each landing flings the other clown skyward, in a Breakout-like twist.
c64:140785.title: Clowns

c64:140786.description: Backgammon for two players or against three levels of computer opponent, with a mode for watching the computer play itself.
c64:140786.title: Club Backgammon

c64:140787.description: Six table and arcade games for one or two players: foosball, 3-D pinball, Skee-Ball, billiards, crazy pool and a shooting gallery.
c64:140787.title: Clubhouse Sports

c64:140789.description: A walking cyborg must gather eight machine parts in order within 15 minutes, each one unlocking a new teleporter destination.
c64:140789.title: Clystron

c64:140790.description: A two-player cooperative platformer set in 1639 around the magic sword Excalibur, with both characters working together to clear each level fast.
c64:140790.title: Co & Co

c64:140795.description: Fly a helicopter in a side-scrolling shooter, knocking out missile defences so a B2 Stealth Bomber can destroy the invading enemy's bases.
c64:140795.title: Cobra Force

c64:140796.description: Sideways-scrolling helicopter shooter in the vein of Scramble: fly over hostile terrain picking up stranded civilians while shooting or dodging missiles, aircraft and ground vehicles, and never clip the scenery.
c64:140796.title: Cobra Mission

c64:140802.description: Four musical modes, among them fishing notes from a pool to build a melody the band then plays, and racing a clam to catch notes.
c64:140802.title: Coco Notes

c64:140803.description: Two monkeys sit in coconut trees hurling coconuts at each other to knock the rival out, while dodging birds and incoming fruit.
c64:140803.title: Coconuts

c64:140805.description: Guide an intruder droid through the computer network of an alien battleship, bombing guards on 16 levels to send codes back to Earth.
c64:140805.title: C.O.D.E Hunter

c64:140807.description: Free a city from evil magic by recolouring its houses, crashing a train of colours and digits so the parts swap until the needed code is formed.
c64:140807.title: Codebreaker

c64:140809.description: Sequel to Codename MAT: Mat pilots Centurion II against the Myons in the war over Vesta, a planet rich in the precious Karillium.
c64:140809.title: Viper Patrol

c64:140811.description: Illustrated text adventure set in 2550: aliens have raided the lunar base Lunar IV and stolen documents able to wipe out whole planetary systems. Disguised as one of them, agent 12-34P follows their trail by star cruiser. A two-word parser drives play, with full-screen pictures for many locations.
c64:140811.title: Codeword Arguseye

c64:140812.description: Start as a mail room trainee in your uncle's company, delivering mail around his towers in hopes of promotion to his other buildings.
c64:140812.title: Cohen's Towers

c64:140814.description: Minesweeper with colourful graphics and a mine count adjustable from 10 to 50.
c64:140814.title: Coldiarus

c64:140815.description: A memory game of uncovering matching picture pairs against a time limit, with a move counter.
c64:140815.title: Colee

c64:140837.description: American football with voice synthesis, on-the-fly receiver switching and blitz plays, presented in the style of ABC's Monday Night broadcasts.
c64:140837.title: ABC Monday Night Football

c64:140862.description: An experimental audio-visual piece by Mel Croucher following a life in a future where a central computer gradually takes control of all records and state functions.
c64:140862.title: Deus Ex Machina

aliases: The World's Greatest Baseball Game: Enhanced Version
c64:140875.description: Baseball mixing management and play: choose from 25 famous teams drawn from World Series and All-Star history and set lineups by batting average, fielding or ERA.
c64:140875.title: The World's Greatest Baseball Game

aliases: Close Encounters of the Worst Kind
c64:140888.description: One or two players move ships along the bottom of the screen, shooting upward at alien attackers.
c64:140888.title: Close Encounters

c64:140916.description: A mechanoid explores over a hundred castle locations, outside, inside and in the dungeons, to find 13 bottles of ingredients for a magic spice, carrying up to three items.
c64:140916.title: Castle

c64:141070.description: A single-screen shooter where endless enemies drop in from the top; any that reach the fire at the bottom come back enraged, recolored and much faster.
c64:141070.title: Super Bread Box

c64:141071.description: A Tron-style lightcycle duel: steer a cycle that leaves a solid trail behind it and avoid crashing into walls or trails.
c64:141071.title: Collision

c64:141072.description: Elite-style space trading with an inheritance to spend: start out from Antares station in a worn all-purpose glider, buying and selling cargo between colonies, carrying passengers met in station bars and upgrading your ship. Space flight is a top-down Asteroids-style view with hyperspace jumps plotted on a star map, and pirates lie in wait.
c64:141072.title: Colonial Trader

c64:141073.description: As a service droid on a distant colony, guard the food crops from ants, ladybirds and other pests that chew through the perimeter fence, while planning buildings and resources to maximise output.
c64:141073.title: Colony

c64:141083.description: Grand strategy around 1900: lead Britain, France, Germany, the U.S., Russia or Japan and use diplomacy, espionage, armies and fleets to seize over 120 minor nations and rival empires.
c64:141083.title: Colonial Conquest

c64:141084.description: Push colored crates together into single-color stacks and move them onto the exit to advance; careless pushes can leave a level unsolvable.
c64:141084.title: Color Buster

c64:141085.description: A Mastermind-style codebreaker: deduce a hidden combination of five tokens in ten guesses from feedback on correct positions and misplaced pieces.
c64:141085.title: Color Mania

c64:141087.description: Crack a hidden code by deduction in this computer take on Mastermind, issued with an Italian magazine's games supplement.
c64:141087.title: Color Mind

c64:141089.title: Colora: The Revenge of the Stones

c64:141090.title: Colorado Smith and the Castle of Doom

c64:141092.title: Colorado Smith and the Lost Pyramid

c64:141096.description: Level 9's compilation of revised versions of its Middle-earth trilogy text adventures (Colossal Adventure, Adventure Quest, Dungeon Adventure), now with still pictures.
c64:141096.title: Jewels of Darkness

c64:141097.description: A BASIC adaptation of Crowther and Woods' original text adventure: explore the cave and collect treasure to reach the highest score.
c64:141097.title: Colossal Cave Adventure

c64:141098.description: Single-player contract bridge with the computer handling the other three hands, using Acol bidding with Blackwood, Stayman and Baron conventions; supports hand entry, save/load, replay and card recommendations.
c64:141098.title: Colossus Bridge 4

c64:141099.description: A strong chess program with adjustable settings, move history and a display of the computer's look-ahead; it can even deliver the difficult king, bishop and knight mate.
c64:141099.title: Colossus Chess 4

c64:141100.description: Mahjong under official British rules: 144 tiles, 14 dealt to each player, and discards that other players may claim when the tile completes a set.
c64:141100.title: Colossus Mah Jong

c64:141101.description: A Terry Pratchett Discworld text adventure, illustrated in places, on the flat world carried by four elephants standing on the turtle Great A'Tuin, where the usual compass directions do not apply.
c64:141101.title: The Colour of Magic

c64:141102.description: Spot where the block shown at the bottom left fits within the main grid, then move the white marker there and press fire; each round asks for ten matches.
c64:141102.title: Colouration

c64:141104.description: A Western shoot-out: advance up the main street gunning down desperadoes.
c64:141104.title: Coltfire

c64:141105.description: Dodge head-seeking missiles drawn to your engine energy; cut the engines without crashing and trick the missiles into colliding with each other.
c64:141105.title: Combat Approach

c64:141107.description: As the last soldier standing, fight through a tropical rainforest, an underground labyrinth and Warbringer's fortress to kill the enemy leader.
c64:141107.title: Combat Crazy

c64:141109.description: Fly a Lynx helicopter in a behind-view battle game, protecting allied bases from air and ground attack and ferrying soldiers between them, armed with mines and heat-seeking missiles and helped by a map of enemy forces.
c64:141109.title: Combat Lynx

c64:141119.description: Clear the field of colorful moving pieces by pushing matching stones together so they vanish.
c64:141119.title: Combination

c64:141120.description: Command customizable armored war machines in futuristic combat, with around 300 weapon combinations plus adjustable size, armor and placement of control centers.
c64:141120.title: Combots

c64:141122.description: Halley's Comet is carrying bacteria that threaten all life on Earth; pilot a spaceship to intercept it and wipe out the organisms.
c64:141122.title: The Comet Game

c64:141123.description: A single-screen platformer starring Donald Duck, also released in the Netherlands as The Duck Game.
c64:141123.title: The Comic Game

c64:141125.description: An official computer-only sequel to Commando that plays more like Gauntlet than the arcade original.
c64:141125.title: Commando 86

c64:141128.description: Run a large company as its chief executive, choosing which projects to pursue and growing the business.
c64:141128.title: Company Director 64

c64:141129.description: Match pairs of tiles; removing or shifting tiles makes those above fall, so plan moves to clear every one.
c64:141129.title: Combination Deluxe

c64:141132.description: A logic puzzle: reproduce the number pattern on the right by clicking squares on the left; each click places a 1 and raises neighboring numbers by one.
c64:141132.title: Compare

c64:141133.description: Sequel with new levels: recreate the target number grid by placing ones that also increment adjacent numbers, best tackling the large values first.
c64:141133.title: Compare II: The New Levels

c64:141135.description: From the Gamma Strike light gun pack, mostly a scoreboard that records hits made on the external target.
c64:141135.title: Competition Shoot Out

c64:141139.description: Solitaire card patience drawn entirely in PETSCII characters.
c64:141139.title: Comp-u-taire

c64:141142.description: Squad-level World War II tactics in France: as a sergeant, command ten American or German infantrymen, each with a name, dossier and individual combat skill ratings.
c64:141142.title: Computer Ambush

c64:141146.description: Adaptation of Avalon Hill's Statis Pro Baseball board game: manage a team, set lineups and call plays based on season statistics of major league players.
c64:141146.title: Computer Statis Pro Baseball

c64:141149.description: Word searches on a 22 by 20 letter grid in normal or Wordsnake form, with themed or mixed lists of 6 to 24 words, solved against a timer.
c64:141149.title: Computer-Wordsearch

c64:141150.description: Crossword puzzles on screen, solvable alone or by groups of up to four players.
c64:141150.title: CompuZzler

c64:141152.description: Parker Brothers' James Bond game. Drive a multi-purpose vehicle over land and sea, jumping hazards and firing at enemies through scrolling missions loosely based on four Bond films, from Diamonds Are Forever to For Your Eyes Only.
c64:141152.title: James Bond 007

aliases: Fall Gelb: The Fall of France
c64:141155.description: Corps-level wargame of Germany's 1940 invasion of France for one or two players, commanding Axis or Allied land forces against a human or computer opponent.
c64:141155.title: Fall Gelb: The France Campaign 1940

c64:141156.description: As Conan, storm a castle to defeat Volta, carrying ten boomerang swords and crossing seven levels of lava pits, geysers and spikes with help from gems, keys and a bird ally.
c64:141156.title: Conan

c64:141157.description: First-person maze action in smoothly scrolling pseudo-3D: thirty timed labyrinths each set a task, such as finding a key past a walrus, chasing roaming musical notes or rounding up a zoo's animals, before you head for the exit. A plasma gun, power-up question marks, one-way passages, teleporters, an overview map and level codes complete it.
c64:141157.title: Complex

c64:141160.description: Guide Freezy from his North Pole ice cream stand through the water to the ice cream islands to fill customers' cone orders, in an educational action game from the Early Learning Friends pack.
c64:141160.title: Coney Island

c64:141161.description: Two-player modern war game mixing military forces such as armies, warships and missiles with finance including the stock market, oil and piracy.
c64:141161.title: Conflict

c64:141162.description: Strategic space warfare in the year 2500: drive off an invading fleet of planet pulverizers ravaging your sector of the galaxy.
c64:141162.title: Conflict 2500

c64:141163.description: Third in MicroProse's Command series, recreating five Vietnam battles starting with the French defeat in 1954, using an accelerated real-time system.
c64:141163.title: Conflict in Vietnam

c64:141164.description: Episodic mini-games with Creatures-like characters: bomb giant monsters from a balloon, then dodge traps and gather potions to fire a cannon.
c64:141164.title: Confusing Quest

c64:141167.description: Slide fuse tiles around a single gap so a traveling spark reaches and detonates every bomb on the level.
c64:141167.title: Confuzion

c64:141170.description: A magazine type-in of Connect Four: drop discs to line up four in any direction.
c64:141170.title: Connect Four (Sunshine Publications)

c64:141173.description: Join the two blue stones while gravity pulls pieces down, aided by green stones and helpful bubbles.
c64:141173.title: Connection: Gravity

c64:141174.description: Lead an expedition of climbers, sherpas and porters, moving supplies and equipment from Camp 0 up to Camp 6 over a number of days before a final attempt on the summit of Everest.
c64:141174.title: Conquering Everest

c64:141177.description: Turn-based conquest for up to eight players: build a continent of at least ten hexagonal provinces, then recruit soldiers at a gold piece each, raise towers and new villages for taxes, and invade rivals. The old king's troops can be set as allies or enemies, and his crusading brother may return to aid them.
c64:141177.title: Conquest for the Crown

c64:141187.description: Captain a battleship patrolling an inland sea in wartime, tracking aircraft, ships and submarines on three radars and destroying them, along with missiles, in action mini-games.
c64:141187.title: Convoy Raider

c64:141188.description: A three-way dueling game included as a bonus on the original disk of The Galleon.
c64:141188.title: Conway Fighter

c64:141190.description: A Pac-Man-style maze chase published in a 64'er special issue.
c64:141190.title: Cookie-Eaters

c64:141191.description: Fly a light aircraft over the bombing sites marked on the map to score points, then bring it down for a clean landing back on the runway before the fuel runs out, steering with keys that tilt the nose and bank left or right.
c64:141191.title: Coplin Flight Simulator

aliases: Cops III: Cops, Robbers and Dinosaurs
c64:141192.description: Christmas in snowed-in Euro-City: with most police off duty, bank robbers, neo-Nazis, fanatics and terrorists run riot, and a pair of officers must restore order.
c64:141192.title: Cops 3

c64:141195.description: Play a robber raiding the Acme Diamond Co. and an old mine for jewels, hauling them back to the getaway vehicle while evading clever cops, low-flying choppers and deadly ghosts.
c64:141195.title: Cops'n'Robbers

aliases: Super Sleuth Series: The Case of the Mad Mummy
The Case of the Mad Mummy
c64:141200.description: As detective Basil Byron, look into the odd behavior of Lord Munroe, an adventurer who withdrew from public life after bringing crates and chests home from an Egyptian expedition two years earlier.
c64:141200.title: Mystery of Munroe Manor

c64:141280.description: A platformer inside a deadly nightmare: survive until the alarm rings at 8:12, with each room entered advancing the clock six minutes, while also raising your dream state.
c64:141280.title: Frightmare

aliases: WWTBAM,Who Wants to be a Millionaire?

c64:141390.description: Play one of six giant monsters, among them Godzilla, a tarantula and a robot, rampaging through cities such as New York, London, Moscow, Paris or San Francisco in scenarios like escaping, rescuing or flattening a landmark, while humans resist with tanks and jets.
c64:141390.title: The Movie Monster Game

c64:141409.description: Simulates flying the Piper Archer II (PA-28-181) light aircraft, modeling the variables of real flight including the avionics.
c64:141409.title: Flight Simulator II

c64:141791.description: Drive-and-shoot action: as British agents chasing terrorists who stole a stockpile from a U.N. camp, race a red sports car down a narrow road blasting other cars.
c64:141791.title: Turbo Charge

c64:141830.description: One- or two-player soccer played on city streets rather than a stadium, with preset teams or squads assembled from a cast of characters.
c64:141830.title: Street Sports Soccer

c64:141877.description: Stuntman Dennis must recover the pieces of his Oscar, stolen by his cousin and hidden around a film studio's storerooms. Using only accelerate, brake and jump, he rides a motorbike over hazards, collects the parcels holding the pieces and can draw on porridge power for brief invincibility.
c64:141877.title: Daredevil Dennis

c64:141878.description: A Gauntlet-like dungeon crawl: as Sheba or Thor, alone or with two players at once, explore 15 top-down dungeons gathering all the treasure.
c64:141878.title: Dandy

c64:141997.description: Inspired by Q*Bert: bounce a spring from block to block to turn every block the target color, while magnets, clouds, raindrops and monsters drift around the screen.
c64:141997.title: Slinky

c64:142723.description: As the dragon-like Frognum, use fire breath and magical artifacts found along the way to battle through a dark world and destroy the Tyrant Beast.
c64:142723.title: Draconus

c64:142732.description: In 2096, fly an AGX Hypersonic Fighter in a constantly scrolling vertical shooter, bombing flak batteries and defenses to reach and destroy the rogue CPU known as Computer Control.
c64:142732.title: Flak: The Ultimate Flight Experience

c64:142738.description: As Slimey the frog, stranded in an asteroid field, find mine entrances and explore the caverns inside to recover the scattered parts of your ship, seen from above.
c64:142738.title: Slimey's Mine

c64:142837.description: Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill: aliens descend on Christon 3, a planet of weapons laboratories, and a passing pilot is the only defence. A Defender-style shooter that scrolls in both directions as you sweep the landscape clear of attackers.
c64:142837.title: R.I.S.K.

c64:142869.description: The Avatar, who once restored Lord British to Britannia's throne, is seized by demon-like creatures in the role-playing finale of the Age of Enlightenment trilogy.
c64:142869.title: Ultima VI: The False Prophet

aliases: Dr. Who and the Mines of Terror
c64:143900.description: Side-scrolling platformer with the sixth Doctor, sent to the second moon of Rijar where the Master has seized a heatonite mining base to build a Time Instant Reply Unit.
c64:143900.title: Doctor Who and the Mines of Terror

c64:143951.description: Puzzle platformer: archaeologist Joe Gunn explores a newly found Egyptian pyramid, possibly the Crocodile King's tomb, solving its secrets screen by screen and trying to escape alive.
c64:143951.title: Joe Gunn: Gold Edition

c64:143969.description: Warehouse puzzle: shove crates one at a time onto marked squares; two crates in a row cannot be moved, and the level ends when every crate is in place.
c64:143969.title: Soko-Ban

c64:144001.description: Federation agent Andrew Angello investigates alien attacks on colonised asteroids, starting with EROC 1, where a faint signal is still transmitting.
c64:144001.title: CORE

c64:144008.description: Jumpman-inspired single-screen platformer: cat burglar Corman uses his long-jumping power to grab every diamond across ten screens linked by ladders and lifts.
c64:144008.title: Corman

c64:144010.description: Detective adventure on the Cornish coast: uncover Aylesbury's secret, find a way home and, if possible, recover the lost goblet.
c64:144010.title: The Cornwall Enigma

c64:144011.description: As the knight Corom, travel to Peloria to rescue Princess Diana from the sorcerer Targoth, whose freed powers could banish him for good, while facing monsters that come in two strengths.
c64:144011.title: Corom

c64:144013.description: A top-down Zodiac clone in the vein of Shamus and Berzerk: shooting only works while moving, and touching walls or demons is fatal.
c64:144013.title: Correpasadizos

c64:144014.description: Magnetic Scrolls text adventure: a fast-rising stockbroker survives attempts on his life amid talk of insider dealing and must clear his name of a crime he did not commit.
c64:144014.title: Corruption

c64:144016.description: Two-player Tron-style race with cars instead of cycles: each vehicle leaves a lethal trail, and the winner is whoever boxes in the other.
c64:144016.title: Corx: Rebel Racers

c64:144017.description: Text-only adventure: the warrior-sage Corya sets out to destroy the dragon that razed the village of Ermahal.
c64:144017.title: Corya the Warrior-Sage

c64:144018.description: Design starships within limited equipment space, trading off weapons, shields and propulsion, then send them into combat against the computer.
c64:144018.title: The Cosmic Balance

c64:144020.description: Pilot the Plasmobile defending an energy source from the Doovries with a plasma cannon whose indestructible ball keeps destroying everything until you catch it again.
c64:144020.title: Cosmic Bounce

c64:144021.description: Flick-screen maze game: pick the Knight, Queen or King fairy, each with different abilities, and rescue four forest princesses from the Underground-dwelling Dark Wizard.
c64:144021.title: Fairy Well

c64:144022.description: A simple take on Moon Patrol.
c64:144022.title: Cosmic Brewers

c64:144025.description: Text adventure starting in an English village with no stated goal; explore with computer companion Bugsy, discover spacecraft and eventually travel into space.
c64:144025.title: Cosmic Capers

c64:144069.description: Top-view single-screen shooter: a shuttle pilot takes on the demon wizard Shroud and his army, hidden in the tail of Halley's Comet to invade Earth.
c64:144069.title: Cosmic Clash

c64:144073.description: Steer a crosshair over an elevated single-screen view, shooting aliens that emerge from the back and wander down; hit enough to advance, as escapees reappear at the top.
c64:144073.title: Cosmic Commando

c64:144074.description: Fly an outdated Cosmic Cruiser to rescue the hostage crew of an Earth space station seized by the invading Rallom Empire.
c64:144074.title: Cosmic Cruiser

c64:144077.description: Timed Sokoban-style puzzles aboard a crashed spacecraft: collect all vials of an Earth-saving substance in each cabin and push spare wires into place to fix the electrics and open the next door.
c64:144077.title: Cosmic Hero

c64:144078.description: One or two players compete in real time on Conway's Game of Life, flying ships that seed digi-bugs which breed by Life rules, while storms briefly freeze the ships.
c64:144078.title: Cosmic Life

c64:144079.description: Multi-directional shooter: as a criminal working for the pirate organization The Council, take on increasingly dangerous missions to hijack space trucks.
c64:144079.title: Cosmic Pirate

c64:144082.description: Choose an adventurer from one of five nations (the U.S., England, France, Germany or Japan) to track down Professor Renegade, who foresaw a catastrophic asteroid heading for Earth, in a multi-level action adventure.
c64:144082.title: Cosmic Relief: Prof. Renegade to the Rescue

c64:144085.description: Across six levels in each of four oceans, eat a quota of fish while dodging eels, sharks, piranhas and falling anchors, with a supply of ink for defense.
c64:144085.title: Mollusk Redux

c64:144087.description: Light gun shooter from the Magnum Light Phaser pack: defend the planet from aliens sweeping in sine-wave patterns, with accuracy graded as you play.
c64:144087.title: Cosmic Storm

c64:144088.description: On the planet Cybor two giant robots fight; as the worker droid Cosmonut, roam inside the head of your side's sabotaged robot hunting enemy infiltrators.
c64:144088.title: Cosmonut

c64:144126.description: Hop between towers Q*Bert-style, stamping them down; four towers of equal height forming a square sink into the ground.
c64:144126.title: Cosmox

c64:144128.description: Platformer with adventure elements based on the cartoon: Count Duckula, Igor and Nanny move their castle to ancient Egypt in search of the Sax, a magical ancient saxophone.
c64:144128.title: Count Duckula in No Sax Please: We're Egyptian

c64:144129.description: Stranded on Planet Cute, Count Duckula must get back to Transylvania, dodging teddies and fluffy bunnies with a ketchup gun of limited ammo as he crosses each screen from left to right.
c64:144129.title: Count Duckula 2 featuring Tremendous Terence

c64:144130.description: Recreates the Channel 4 words-and-numbers quiz in its original format of six letters games, two numbers games and a conundrum; with no computer opponent, two players are required.
c64:144130.title: Countdown

c64:144141.description: A Connect 4-style game for two: take turns dropping counters into seven columns of an upright grid, with an option to set how many in a line are needed.
c64:144141.title: Counter Attack

c64:144143.description: Guide an airship through a treacherous cave system, with beginner, normal and suicidal difficulty levels.
c64:144143.title: Counterblast

c64:144145.description: Counting practice for ages 3 to 6: pick the requested number of jungle and circus animals from a field of creatures and watch them parade across the screen.
c64:144145.title: Counting Parade

c64:144148.description: Climb from humble beginnings in a rural town to become the star programmer at a Sydney software company.
c64:144148.title: Country Capers

c64:144149.description: On a week's holiday in a Herefordshire farm cottage, sightsee and chat with locals while hunting for the fortune the late previous owner is said to have buried around the area.
c64:144149.title: Country Quest

c64:144151.description: Run an English county cricket team for several seasons, chasing the title and cups in limited-overs matches set between 40 and 60 overs.
c64:144151.title: County Cricket

c64:144152.description: An overhead racer in a rocket-fuelled car that explodes at the slightest touch of the roadside: the faster you drive the more points you earn, with a bonus at each level's end, but breaking the posted speed limits gets you disqualified, and you have three cars.
c64:144152.title: County Racer

c64:144157.description: Poker for up to three people facing one of eight opponents shown in digitized photographs.
c64:144157.title: Cover Girl Poker

c64:144168.description: Single-screen platformer: guide a hungry pig across platforms catching the food that scrolls past, since failing to eat enough means starving.
c64:144168.title: Quod Init Exit

c64:144169.description: A cowboy dueling shooter where aim matters more than a quick draw.
c64:144169.title: Cowboy

c64:144170.description: Western quick-draw duel in the spirit of Midway's Gun Fight: two gunslingers face off across the screen, or one player takes on Bad Bob, a sharp-shooting computer opponent. It offers tournament play, many settings, varied arenas including a nod to the Atari VCS, and hats that fly off when hit.
c64:144170.title: Cowboy Duel: Live Your Dream!

c64:144171.description: New edition of Cowboy Duel that keeps the original showdown and adds three gentler versions of the computer gunslinger Bad Bob, giving less practised players a real chance of winning a gunfight.
c64:144171.title: Cowboy Duel Junior: Live Your Dream ...Again!

c64:144173.description: Fend off aliens by hurling cowpats at them.
c64:144173.title: Cowpat Frisbee

c64:144185.description: Ben and Andy, top special forces officers, infiltrate Atlantis, an industrial city seized by the mad scientist Mr. K and his army of artificial soldiers, to stop his bid for world conquest.
c64:144185.title: Crack Down

c64:144186.description: The Mastermind codebreaking board game on screen, from a German disk magazine.
c64:144186.title: Crack It!

c64:144187.description: Alone or cooperatively with a friend, collect all the crack rocks scattered across the floor in a Pac-Man-like game.
c64:144187.title: Crack Mainia

c64:144188.description: Text adventure as Sam Gamgee, starting outside the gates of Cirith Ungol and crossing the ash wastes of Gorgoroth beneath the smoke of Mount Doom.
c64:144188.title: The Crack of Doom

aliases: Lord of the Rings: Game One
The Fellowship of the Ring: A Software Adventure
c64:144189.description: Illustrated text adventure following the first volume of The Lord of the Rings, as hobbits Frodo, Pippin and Sam carry the Ring toward Mount Doom; the game comes in two parts.
c64:144189.title: The Fellowship of the Ring

aliases: Shadows of Mordor: Game Two of Lord of the Rings
c64:144190.description: Illustrated text adventure following The Two Towers as either Frodo or Sam, closely tracking the book's plot.
c64:144190.title: The Shadows of Mordor

c64:144201.description: To destroy the Dark Lord, gather items including the True Ring and cast them into the Crack of Fire in the heights of the Mountains of Moldak, aided by your companion Garston.
c64:144201.title: Cracks of Fire

c64:144203.description: Breakout clone: bounce the ball off your bat to clear every brick, with falling icons that help or hinder, such as a level skip, ball catch and double balls.
c64:144203.title: Crack-Up

c64:144204.description: Logic puzzle from the Game On disk magazine: lay the connecting pieces in the right order to close the circuit before the timer runs out.
c64:144204.title: Craft

c64:144208.description: Short of money in a small-town hotel opposite the Cranmore building, plot to steal the famous Cranmore Diamond on exhibit there.
c64:144208.title: The Cranmore Diamond Caper

c64:144215.description: A Head On-style driving game: speed around collecting dots while avoiding collisions.
c64:144215.title: Crash

c64:144216.description: Futuristic top-down racer on a straight track that narrows and widens, with potholes, gaps and islands to swerve around or jump, and rival cars that try to ram you off; adapted from Burnin' Rubber but never published.
c64:144216.title: Crash and Crush

c64:144254.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter mixing traditional aliens with oddball foes like strawberries and floppy disks.
c64:144254.title: Crazay

c64:144255.description: Steer a balloon toward the way out of a cave without touching the spiked walls and ceiling.
c64:144255.title: Crazy Ballon

c64:144256.description: As balloon pilot Nathan Wigglesworth with co-pilot T.C. Barton, float through 26 side-view single-screen levels to the exit without touching walls or objects that would burst the balloon.
c64:144256.title: Crazy Balloon

c64:144264.description: As a clown, stop a mad bomber from blowing up a fairground rollercoaster, running along its top in flick-screen side view with a scanner showing you, the bomber and the bomb.
c64:144264.title: Wild Ride

c64:144265.description: Mad Planets-inspired single-screen shooter: from a ship seen from behind, blast celestial bodies hurtling on erratic paths across successive levels to restore order to the universe.
c64:144265.title: Crazy Comets

c64:144266.description: Drive a turbocharged Ferrari F40 capable of over 300 mph across America to expose corrupt police running a stolen car racket, choosing routes at forks in the road.
c64:144266.title: F40 Pursuit Simulator

c64:144294.description: Platform shooter: collect every box on the level while avoiding the alien, with limited ammo that the boxes can replenish.
c64:144294.title: Crazy Conveyors

c64:144300.description: Jog along a beach, jumping and ducking past wildlife to reach the distance marker at each level's end, with bonus stages between levels.
c64:144300.title: Crazy Jogger

c64:144417.description: As Howard the Robot, fix the mess left by Zigmund across four scrolling maze levels, laying paving stones where needed and dodging creatures.
c64:144417.title: Crazy Paving

c64:144419.description: Platformer: collect all the hearts on each screen to move on, past roaming monsters and falling hazards.
c64:144419.title: Crazy Runner

c64:144420.description: Unarmed Sue, lost in a magical, dark forest, searches for the way out while evading its cunning inhabitants.
c64:144420.title: Crazy Sue

c64:144421.description: Updated version of the scrolling platformer in which weaponless Sue seeks the exit of a dark, magical forest full of hostile creatures.
c64:144421.title: Crazy Sue Plus

c64:144422.title: Crazy the Mine Chaser: Mistakes Twice

c64:144935.description: Command an interceptor-class ship sent to the Caldorre system, whose three planets' merchants are being raided by agile space marauders that giant battleships could not catch.
c64:144935.title: Sentinel Worlds I: Future Magic

c64:144937.description: Educational program: build creatures from heads, bodies, arms and legs, learn programming basics by making them dance, and practice pattern matching, including duets with a computer-made twin.
c64:144937.title: Creature Creator

c64:144939.description: Made with the TSB bank: as Cred, rescue Interrestials from prisons across four single-screen top-view maze levels.
c64:144939.title: Cred Breaks Out

c64:144945.description: A demanding Space Invaders clone with a title intro and music, included in several Keypunch compilations.
c64:144945.title: Creeps

c64:144947.description: Fly a space shuttle over an alien planet while the computer steers; release bombs to destroy the enemy cities on your route.
c64:144947.title: Rebel Bomber

c64:144950.description: Cribbage against a computer that deals, pegs and counts every hand itself: cut for the crib, discard two cards into it, play out the pegging, and try to avoid being skunked.
c64:144950.title: Cribbage

c64:144964.description: Limited-overs cricket pitting England against the West Indies, with editable player names and a choice of who bats first, viewed from above at an angle.
c64:144964.title: Cricket 64

c64:144968.description: Sixty-over cricket against the computer or a friend, using a custom side or one of the two preset teams, England and a World XI, with a toss deciding the batting order and a selectable skill level.
c64:144968.title: Tim Love's Cricket

c64:144981.description: Cricket management against the computer as one of the top seven international sides, in single matches or series of three or five one-day games lasting 40 to 60 overs.
c64:144981.title: Robin Smith's International Cricket

c64:144983.description: The manager of an English cricket team bound for the Caribbean island of St. Malcolm, secretly sent to win rights to its guano, survives a hijacking and a plane crash on the way.
c64:144983.title: Cricket Crazy

c64:144984.description: Breakout without a paddle: steer the constantly bouncing ball sideways to dissolve blocks of its own color, using asterisk blocks to change that color.
c64:144984.title: Crillion

c64:144985.description: Act as a judge passing sentence on defendants already found guilty, in cases ranging from perjury and theft to murder, earning up to ten gavels for matching the sentence a real judge chose.
c64:144985.title: Crime and Punishment

c64:144986.description: Mystery adventure controlled by clicking words beneath the pictures: two hitchhiking friends stop to shelter from a downpour and stumble into a mystery.
c64:144986.title: Crime Time

c64:144990.description: Verb-noun adventure with optional graphics: answer King John the Good's call to find Princess Sabrina, missing for two weeks, in Transylvania's dark forests.
c64:144990.title: Transylvania

c64:144993.description: Fly a hovering craft mostly eastward to destroy alien anti-matter machines before they push the solar colonies' power sources to critical mass.
c64:144993.title: Power

c64:144995.description: A shooter with platform elements built with the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit and clearly modeled on Thalamus' Creatures.
c64:144995.title: Critters

c64:144998.description: Question all the suspects after a bank robbery; crack the case to keep your job.
c64:144998.title: The Crooked Canyon Caper

c64:145004.description: Your unarmed friends cross dangerous landscapes toward the Evil Master's castle to recover stolen treasure, and you protect them with a crossbow, shooting enemies and obstacles in their way.
c64:145004.title: Crossbow

c64:145005.description: Crossword-meets-Scrabble trivia game for 1 to 4 players: roll a die numbered 1 to 9 to earn either a trivia question or the right to place a tile directly.
c64:145005.title: Crosscheck: A Strategy Crossword Game

c64:145073.description: Build crossword-style words from letters the computer deals out, holding up to four in reserve and discarding unusable ones, aiming for a high score.
c64:145073.title: Crossword Twister

c64:145075.description: Pilot a copter drone shooting down alien devices before they hit the cities.
c64:145075.title: Croussaider

c64:145119.description: Side-scrolling shoot-em-up with Wally Beben music: spy sensors reveal that an evil scientist in an alien base on the moon of Evans has deployed mind control generators.
c64:145119.title: Crunch Point

c64:145135.description: Pac-Man clone: eat dots in a maze while avoiding the ghosts Zippy, Stilty, Gippy and Chris, turning on them with power pellets and grabbing fruit for bonus points.
c64:145135.title: Sprite Man

c64:145173.description: First in MicroProse's Command Series, designed by Sid Meier and Ed Bever, a heavily researched World War II wargame of the campaign in Europe.
c64:145173.title: Crusade in Europe

c64:145174.description: Second Command Series wargame, covering World War II's North African theater across five scenarios with the same system as Crusade in Europe.
c64:145174.title: Decision in the Desert

c64:145176.description: A Boulder Dash-like game without deadly falling boulders or a time limit.
c64:145176.title: Crush'em Up!

c64:145212.description: Search an ancient castle's uncharted depths in the land of Perlain for the crystal orb of the wizard Mylor the Cruel.
c64:145212.title: The Crystal Orb

c64:145350.description: A three-dimensional brainteaser: assemble a 3x3x3 cube from six oddly shaped pieces made of smaller cubes, across three increasingly hard puzzles, with the option of designing new ones by altering the program.
c64:145350.title: The Cube

c64:145352.description: A tile-matching puzzle based on Rubik's Cube, with selectable music for each game and level passwords.
c64:145352.title: Cube Magik

c64:145358.description: Rubik's Cube reimagined from above with all faces visible, letting the player choose from 4 to 25 sides and many starting positions grouped by difficulty.
c64:145358.title: Cubulus

c64:145359.description: Q*Bert-inspired isometric game: hop on the cubes of a pyramid to change their color, with later levels needing several jumps per cube.
c64:145359.title: Cuddly Cuburt

c64:145361.description: Top-down 8-ball pool for one or two players, with a choice of 1 to 9 frames, table color and computer opponent.
c64:145361.title: Cue Boy

c64:145363.description: Educational map-reading program for ages 7 to 13, accompanying the Moving Into Maps pre-atlas book.
c64:145363.title: Cunning Running

c64:145365.description: A head-to-head sailing race against friends or family.
c64:145365.title: Cup Challenge

c64:145367.description: Football management: pick one of 40 European teams and steer it through a group stage of five-team groups into the knockout rounds and the cup final.
c64:145367.title: Cup Football

c64:145369.description: Text adventure: peering into a fairground fortune teller's crystal ball transports you to ancient Egypt, and you must find a way back.
c64:145369.title: The Curse

c64:145370.description: Monsters wiped out the people of Babylon, leaving it sealed off; play the lone adventurer who ventures in to destroy the evil ruling it.
c64:145370.title: Curse of Babylon

c64:145371.description: Sneak past the evil forces of Borgan Castle to find and rescue a princess, using special items to overcome obstacles; converted from 1984 BBC Micro programs.
c64:145371.title: The Curse of Borgan Castle

c64:145373.description: The evil Cult of Sagalia grips Sherwood Forest despite Robin Hood's resistance, and Friar Tuck arranges an exorcism with the Bishop of Derby.
c64:145373.title: The Curse of Sherwood

c64:145386.description: Graphic text adventure made with the Graphic Adventure Creator. As Oswald, son of a druid king, you must track down three scattered magic objects and carry them to the island of Rotena to break the wicked wizard Volcan's hold over it.
c64:145386.title: The Curse of Volcan

c64:145387.description: Gothic text adventure as Ashar, who wakes strapped to a rack in a dank dungeon and must escape before the torturer blinds him.
c64:145387.title: Cursed be the City

c64:145388.description: Locked inside the Mad Scientist's haunted house, solve puzzles to find the cursed key in an adventure inspired by Mikro-Gen's games.
c64:145388.title: The Cursed Key

c64:145389.description: A computer version of the mancala board game Kalaha.
c64:145389.title: Custer

c64:145390.description: Walk Cuthbert around all four sides of each grid cell to color it, filling the whole grid while avoiding the nasties that patrol it.
c64:145390.title: Cuthbert Goes Walkabout

c64:145391.description: Joust-like levels in two stages; the first has Cuthbert flying a small shuttle between platforms, collecting fuel pellets one at a time and bringing each back.
c64:145391.title: Cuthbert in Space

c64:145392.description: Side-scrolling space flight through a vast industrial complex of halls, tanks and containers. Your craft drifts with convincing inertia, so steering takes practice; packs of bubble-like enemies and any brush with the scenery drain your 99 energy cells, and your gun fires slowly.
c64:145392.title: Cut-In

c64:145393.description: Infocom text adventure: a professional scuba diver on the sleepy seaport island of Hardscrabble gets a chance to salvage treasure from one of four wrecks.
c64:145393.title: Cutthroats

c64:145397.description: Futuristic American football played in 2022 by two seven-robot teams with a 350-pound bomb in place of a ball, after bionic cheating forced the rules to change.
c64:145397.title: Cyberball (Domark)

c64:145398.description: Randomly falling Tetris-like pieces, with arrows marking where each drops and a window previewing the next shape, must be arranged within a marked region of the field.
c64:145398.title: CyberBlocks

c64:145399.description: Chess teaching tool: set up a real board and follow four games between grandmasters, guessing each move from multiple-choice options.
c64:145399.title: Cyberchess

c64:145401.description: Follow-up to Bonka: in a flick-screen top-view maze aboard a cosmic space station, gather Platignum while dodging or shooting its Cybermen guards and slipping through open doors.
c64:145401.title: Cybermen

c64:145429.description: The board game Othello on a standard 8x8 grid.
c64:145429.title: Cybertrap

c64:145430.description: Top-down maze of rooms: collect randomly placed items and touch the safe to finish the level, with eight-way movement and firing, electrified walls and enemies appearing as rooms are entered.
c64:145430.title: Cybertron Mission

c64:145432.description: Blast through the Cybership's base to hit the man inside, scoring for fighters and scanner ships while dodging the ship's laser.
c64:145432.title: Cyberzone

c64:145433.description: A colorful Armalyte-style horizontally scrolling shooter.
c64:145433.title: Cybex: The Cosmic-War

c64:145434.description: Assigned to escort a mothership leaving Earth, a fighter pilot turns instead to defend the planet from an arriving invasion fleet across three parts.
c64:145434.title: Cyber 1

c64:145437.description: As a cyborg hunter, climb huge structures such as space stations, trees and pipes to destroy flying robots, in a game made with the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit.
c64:145437.title: Cyborg Hunter 2025

c64:145438.description: A Robotron-style single-screen shooter: blast every Tron, Brain and Enforcer droid hunting the last humans and pick up wandering people for bonus points, with an option to aim the laser using a second joystick.
c64:145438.title: Cybotron

c64:145439.description: Ride an armed, jump-capable motorcycle through several lands in isometric view to rescue the Queen and kidnapped villagers, with five skill levels.
c64:145439.title: Cycle Knight

c64:145441.description: Grand Prix motorcycle racing against nine computer rivals in 125, 250 and 500cc classes, on a season of 8 to 15 international circuits.
c64:145441.title: The Cycles: International Grand Prix Racing

c64:145445.description: Based on the film: as He-Man, recover the eight chords of the Cosmic Key, which fell to Earth, before Skeletor does, fighting his minions first in the streets.
c64:145445.title: Masters of the Universe: The Movie

c64:145455.description: A Space Invaders-style game with a finely detailed cannon sliding along the ground.
c64:145455.title: Cyclon Zap: Space Bomb

c64:145467.description: Roll a ball through cave levels collecting ten magic pots, then reach the exit before time runs out.
c64:145467.title: Cygnus

c64:145468.description: Puzzle of skill: reproduce the arrangement shown in the right pane on your own side, placing pieces in the correct order or starting over.
c64:145468.title: Cylogic

c64:145469.description: Isometric puzzle exploration: to earn leadership of the Ostan race, recover 24 objects hidden in a virtual world and bring them back to base, carrying at most five at once.
c64:145469.title: Cylu

c64:145471.description: Chess program and sequel to Cyrus, switchable between top-down and 3D isometric boards, with twelve skill levels.
c64:145471.title: Cyrus II

c64:145474.description: Vertically scrolling shooter from a Commodore Format covertape, built in SEUCK as the worked example for the author's tutorial on designing fun SEUCK games: destroy everything in sight, but touching the walls or spikes wrecks your craft.
c64:145474.title: Daedalus

c64:145477.description: Horse racing betting for 1 to 4 players, wagering virtual money on win, place and show or two-horse bets such as exacta, quinella and daily double.
c64:145477.title: Daily Double Horse Racing

c64:145478.description: A two-sided wargame of the North African campaign from March 1941, with battalion-to-brigade units of the real forces, turns split into supply, movement, combat and reinforcement phases, Fort Bardia and the Malta invasion among its features, and a variable order of battle for exploring how history might have gone differently.
c64:145478.title: DAK: Deutsches Afrika Korps
