c64:158903.description: Sid Meier's first wargame: command NATO's Western European armies against a Warsaw Pact invasion of central Europe in a hypothetical Third World War, a design that later underpinned MicroProse's Command Series.
c64:158903.title: Nato Commander

c64:158912.description: A Defender-like shooter flying over an alien landscape in four directions, progressing from beginner levels 1 to 4 up to Ace levels from 13 on.
c64:158912.title: Neoclyps

aliases: Nonterraqueous: Not of the Earth or Sea
c64:158980.description: Guide a robot seeker drone across the planet Nonterraqueous to destroy its master computer, swapping forms at swap stations to resist acid drops at the cost of weapons and recharging at psyche stations.
c64:158980.title: Nonterraqueous

c64:158981.description: With Earth's fossil fuels exhausted and its Uranium 235 used up, the planet's power now hinges on vast deposits of the mineral found on Saturn's moons and an agreement struck to obtain them.
c64:158981.title: Nuclear Embargo

c64:159045.description: An educational platformer over twelve levels: a builder climbs around a building site collecting sums that add to or subtract from his starting number to hit a target.
c64:159045.title: Number Builder

c64:159054.description: Four noughts-and-crosses-based maths games for two players or one against the computer: Magic Square, Addition, Subtraction, and a mixed Adds & Subs.
c64:159054.title: Number Puzzler

aliases: Olli  & Lissa: The Ghost of Shilmoore Castle
c64:159067.description: Shilmore Castle has been sold to Eugene Portcullis III Jnr, who plans to ship it stone by stone to America; ghost Sir Humphrey has lost his scaring powers and needs Olli and Lissa's help to drive the buyer off.
c64:159067.title: Olli and Lissa

c64:159088.description: Play 8-ball pool or snooker on a full-table overhead view against a friend or a computer opponent of chosen skill, with the rules of both games closely observed.
c64:159088.title: On Cue

c64:159090.description: American football against the computer or a friend from an elevated third-person view, with options for 5 or 15 minute games and a demo mode.
c64:159090.title: On-Field Football

c64:159092.description: A tennis game that positions your player automatically, leaving timing and shot placement to you, so angled volleys, lobs and drop shots decide the match.
c64:159092.title: On-Court Tennis

c64:159096.description: Steer a Quadroid around maze-like platforms across 32 single screens, picking up eight gravity pods per screen while avoiding roaming nasties.
c64:159096.title: Oops!

c64:159097.description: Oswald the Orange tries to escape from his packing case in a Spanish fruit processing factory before he becomes juice, climbing platforms and sliding down ropes to reach each screen's flag.
c64:159097.title: Orange Squash

c64:159098.description: As the last fighter pilot defending the planet Hyperion, move around the screen shooting or dodging waves of alien invaders.
c64:159098.title: Orbitron

aliases: Orc Attack: You Against the Hordes
c64:159099.description: Defend your castle by sliding along the top of its wall, fighting your own momentum to stop in the right place, while hordes of orcs climb up from below.
c64:159099.title: Orc Attack

c64:159101.description: Modelled on Pooyan: Boss Roo rides a pulley-driven lift up and down the right side of the screen to save nine joeys from swagmen, needing to kill 32 swagmen to advance across three levels.
c64:159101.title: Outback

c64:159102.description: Learning games starring Paddington Bear, with a storybook in which Jonathan and Judy give him a glow-in-the-dark bedside clock that has lines instead of numbers.
c64:159102.title: Paddington's Early Visit

c64:159103.description: Aimed at five to eight year olds, this flick-screen maze game sends Paddington Bear around the countryside during a week's holiday catching butterflies.
c64:159103.title: Paddington's Garden Game

c64:159104.description: Stop the world's evils escaping Pandora's box by having Pandora blow on each creepy creature as it reaches the lid, timing the gust for when it is at its largest.
c64:159104.title: Pandora's Box

c64:159105.description: A Space Panic-style platformer: clear each screen of invading monsters by digging holes on the five ladder-linked floors and waiting for the creatures to fall in.
c64:159105.title: Panic Planet

c64:159106.description: Train like a paratrooper on four assault courses, racing for the best time solo or against a friend in competition or practice mode, with three difficulty levels and course previews.
c64:159106.title: Para Assault Course

c64:159107.description: Four single-screen games for children aged five to eight starring a rabbit, Mr Grub, a frog and a kangaroo, including a carrot-collecting rabbit maze and a 10 by 7 picnic maze.
c64:159107.title: Pathfinder

c64:159109.description: Pedro's famous Mexican flower beds are under siege by hungry animals, and he must build barriers and blockades across their paths to the flowers.
c64:159109.title: Pedro

c64:159114.description: A computer version of the funfair horse race stall, where landing a ball in a hole moves your horse forward, with farther holes moving it farther.
c64:159114.title: Kentucky Racing

c64:159115.description: A book and software set where children build sentences from the book's words and watch Kermit, Miss Piggy, Gonzo and other Muppets act them out as an animated story.
c64:159115.title: Kermit's Electronic Storymaker

c64:159117.description: Fly a kettle through 30 side-scrolling underground levels, searching the bowls scattered around each for the one hiding a tin opener that unlocks the exit.
c64:159117.title: Kettle

c64:159120.description: Gardener and globetrotter Nebraska Joe falls into a vast underground labyrinth and must find his way out through four levels spread over 128 screens. He jumps, climbs ladders and collects keys and gear while robots, bouncing eyes, bats and spiders roam, and lasers and high-voltage traps kill instantly.
c64:159120.title: Key Finders

c64:159121.description: Touch-typing course with a science-fiction framing, using 3-D graphics and animated hands that demonstrate the correct finger reaches. Lessons take learners from beginner to advanced level.
c64:159121.title: Keyboard Cadet

c64:159125.description: Gather treasures until a key appears, then make for the door to the next level while avoiding tunnel trolls; includes a maze editor. Written by Randy Ubillos and David Dixon for the Arcade Action pack.
c64:159125.title: Key-Quest 64

c64:159126.description: A comic horizontally scrolling spy caper. KGB man Ilya Ilyavanovic is sent by his chief, Colonel Farenov, after the yuppie Alexander Sharamski, who has run off with millions of roubles' worth of Eastern Bloc weapons and means to sell them to the villain Mad Martinov.
c64:159126.title: KGB Agent

c64:159127.description: One or two players race to reach the ceiling first on a crowded playfield, with steadily rising difficulty, a cheat mode and customisable sets. Published in 64'er Sonderheft 85.
c64:159127.title: Kick and Kill

c64:159128.description: Fly five missions to smuggle defecting scientists out of East Germany, where the authorities want them kept for a weapons project; the first four each require ferrying six scientists to a safe house.
c64:159128.title: KGB Superspy

c64:159129.description: Masters at the Siandown Temple, convinced no Westerner can master kickboxing, invite you to face their four best fighters.
c64:159129.title: Kick Box Vigilante

c64:159131.description: Ride a unicycle as a clown, catching falling balloons on your head to pop them, and later stacking them into ever-taller columns that leave less time to react.
c64:159131.title: Kickman

c64:159132.description: Claim squares on a grid by tracing their edges to clear each level, using agility and a stun gun that briefly freezes the four pursuers trying to trap you.
c64:159132.title: Kid Grid

aliases: Kid Grid II: Kid vs. Kid
c64:159133.title: Kid vs. Kid in Kid Grid 2

c64:159136.description: Three reading and typing drills for young children, each with four speed levels, beginning with falling letters that must be typed before they reach the bottom.
c64:159136.title: Kids on Keys

c64:159137.description: Art Linkletter puts questions to children and weaves their answers into humorous stories.
c64:159137.title: Kids Say the Darndest Things... to Computers

c64:159138.description: Children design colourful scenes from 99 characters and objects in settings ranging from a farm or theatre to outer space, then write a story to go with them, with music.
c64:159138.title: KidWriter

c64:159139.description: A peg solitaire puzzle based on an old Japanese game: jump pegs over one another to remove them, aiming to finish with one peg in the centre, over multiple levels.
c64:159139.title: Kikugi

c64:159174.description: Caterpillars are devouring your orchard; spray them before the trees are bare, while their eggs hatch into deadlier pests.
c64:159174.title: Killer Piller

c64:159175.description: Pilot a craft through side-scrolling underground tunnels, shooting 12 bulbs to reach the next level and fending off creatures that drain your shield.
c64:159175.title: Killer Watt

c64:159176.description: Shoot everything that moves, then blast the spaceman's heart for bonus points if you reach him, with difficulty climbing each game.
c64:159176.title: Killer Ring

c64:159177.description: A number-grid duel for two players, or one against the computer: player one moves along rows and player two along columns, each taking a number from the line where the opponent last picked. Rack up points while spoiling your rival's chances, and be quick, as time is limited.
c64:159177.title: Killing Fields

c64:159178.description: Forced down onto a planet thought dead since the giant brain that ruled its life died out, the survivor of a space battle finds something is still alive and hostile on the surface.
c64:159178.title: Killing Machine

c64:159184.description: George the bear must stock up on food and get safely back to his cave to hibernate, dodging poisonous apples, careless skiers and bear-eating spiders across three stages.
c64:159184.title: Perils of.... Bear George

c64:159192.description: Six early learning games for children aged 3 to 8, practising reading, counting and the keyboard: Letters, Names, Match, Sequence, Draw and Scribble.
c64:159192.title: KinderComp

c64:159193.description: A side-on football game licensed by Peter Beardsley, built around the European Championship, with 8 teams picked from 26 European nations and a two-player option.
c64:159193.title: Peter Beardsley's International Football

c64:159195.description: Pick up, rotate and place blocks to recreate a hidden image across 16 grid levels called MicroKinema; peeking at the target speeds up the clock.
c64:159195.title: Kinetic Connection

c64:159197.description: Blast through four stages of alien fleets, each with its own backdrop and respawning enemies, destroying a target number to advance; the first three scroll vertically.
c64:159197.title: Phase 4

aliases: PHM Pegasus: Patrol Hydrofoil Missile Craft Simulation
c64:159198.description: Command Pegasus-class hydrofoil missile boats in eight missions, also directing helicopters and convoys to patrol, survey and clear areas of hostile ships.
c64:159198.title: PHM Pegasus

c64:159200.description: Fly a 30-seat Leander Class 454 prop plane by night from Norwich Airport, setting wind speed and fuel load before takeoff.
c64:159200.title: Pilot 64

c64:159201.description: Lay down pipe sections offered in random order to build a route for the flowing flooz, routing it through as many pieces as possible before it spills.
c64:159201.title: Pipe Dream

c64:159204.description: Guide a round spaceship through more than 44 screens under realistic gravity and inertia, collecting the letters P, A, X in sequence and avoiding or shooting foes that drain energy or steal items.
c64:159204.title: Kinetik

c64:159205.description: An illustrated text adventure starting at a deserted trading post, where trade with the locals may get you over a ravine on the way to the fabled mines.
c64:159205.title: King Solomon's Mines

c64:159208.description: Play as a sorceress, barbarian, paladin or knight, raising an army of creatures to defeat villains and locate the Sceptre of Order in turn-based play with a time limit set by difficulty.
c64:159208.title: King's Bounty

c64:159209.description: A two-player SEUCK shooter themed on early Hollywood comedies, with heroes called Charlie and Harold; by Carsten Manshusen for Game On, February 1989.
c64:159209.title: Kings of Comedy

c64:159211.description: A Tron-style light cycle duel on an enlarged arena, whose computer opponent learns from its errors so it avoids repeating them. Published in Magic Disk 64 in November 1994.
c64:159211.title: Kitron: The Challenge

c64:159212.description: Klemens searches a 256-room labyrinth to free eight twin brothers from cages that only dynamite can open, and since he holds one item at a time he must remember routes back.
c64:159212.title: Klemens

c64:159213.description: An Arkanoid variant with familiar cartoon pictures hidden behind the bricks, adding indestructible and regenerating blocks, erratically flying birds and assorted bonuses; it has no sound.
c64:159213.title: Klepkomania

c64:159214.description: A simple Croatian platform game in the mould of Manic Miner with monochrome graphics; its title means The Key, and a fan English translation appeared in 2008.
c64:159214.title: Kljuc

c64:159218.description: As the knight Sir Legless, equip yourself at the armoury and then fight in all directions to free King Eric and fellow knights held by the wizard Anthrax.
c64:159218.title: Knightmare (Romik Software)

c64:159221.description: George the Plumber must lay a pipeline from a valve to a hot-water tank before the pressure bursts it, choosing from six pipe shapes, removing mistakes with a spanner, blasting boulders with dynamite and dodging the ghost of his old boss.
c64:159221.title: Plumb Crazy!

c64:159222.description: Despite the title, you play a hunted gorilla escaping captors on a grid of uneven rectangles before taking on the fearsome Teddy Twins.
c64:159222.title: Potty Painter in the Jungle

c64:159238.description: Earth's pyramids were built and sold by the planet T-Pyge, each needing one transporter for the structure and another for its power supply until a cheaper scheme was devised.
c64:159238.title: Power Pyramids

c64:159253.description: An operational simulation of Rommel's North African campaign from March 1941 to February 1943 in 12 two-month turns, with each side trying to push the other back along the coast and seize key towns.
c64:159253.title: Knights of the Desert: The North African Campaign of 1941-43

c64:159254.description: Two to four players move mythological creatures on an isometric 8 by 8 board, each starting with four pieces in a corner, aiming to wipe out every opposing piece.
c64:159254.title: Powerplay: The Game of the Gods

c64:159255.description: Hunt for keys across the castle's screens to raise portcullises and reach the tiny princess in her cell, picking up weapons and food while avoiding items that slow you down.
c64:159255.title: Prince Clumsy

c64:159256.description: A side-view boxing game: win three bouts for the European title, then three more for the world crown, with adjustable stamina, a two-player fight and an opponent editor; one knockdown, when the head-hit gauge fills, decides each bout.
c64:159256.title: KnockOut!

c64:159258.description: A game version of the 1962 book by psychologist Hans Eysenck, letting players measure their own IQ and personality.
c64:159258.title: Know Your Own IQ & Personality

c64:159259.description: Skate through seven levels from Codemasters, each pairing an isometric skate park, where every flag must be grabbed against a strict clock without straying off the tarmac, with a top-down cross-country run.
c64:159259.title: Pro Skateboard Simulator

c64:159261.description: Downhill skiing from an isometric overhead view, racing a friend or the computer through every checkpoint within a time limit on ever harder slopes, with the screen following the leader.
c64:159261.title: Professional Ski Simulator

c64:159264.description: An illustrated adventure in which you undergo the Kobyashi Naru trial for immortality, gathering the required objects in its knowledge, wisdom and understanding sections.
c64:159264.title: Kobyashi Naru

c64:159265.description: Koko trades blue skies for a musty underground cave on his hunt for a wish-granting Magic Ball, in this platform game from Aackosoft.
c64:159265.title: Koko

c64:159268.description: A super kangaroo with a jet pack and gun hops across a right-to-left scrolling landscape, leaping obstacles, dodging enemies and grabbing bonuses on the way back to his spaceship.
c64:159268.title: Kosmic Kanga

c64:159269.description: Fly a MantaRay fighter from the cockpit through the Kromazone, the Terran Space Fleet Academy's elite proving ground for pilots who will face the Maranzar.
c64:159269.title: Kromazone

c64:159270.description: On a 6 by 6 grid, move every coloured ball exactly once, each colour travelling a set number of squares, after which the ball turns into a fixed stone.
c64:159270.title: Krymini

aliases: Kulfon in the Bad Demons Land
c64:159273.description: A Polish platform adventure: Kulfon's fiancée is locked in a castle, and he must rescue her using objects found around it, inside and underground, carrying up to two items and talking to characters.
c64:159273.title: Kulfon W Krainie Zlego Demona

c64:159276.description: The Redhawk sequel: newly promoted to reporter at The Daily Trumpet, Kevin Oliver is sent to investigate Dr Lee's strange mansion, ready to turn into the superhero Redhawk.
c64:159276.title: Kwah!

c64:159279.description: Get through three labyrinth levels as slowly as possible, since the slowest time is the one recorded. Published by Polsoft in 1997.
c64:159279.title: Labe Me

c64:159281.description: Grab flags while dodging fast enemies and a rival player, laying mines to trap the opponent but risking your own. From 64'er Software Extra Nr. 20.
c64:159281.title: Labiraton

c64:159282.description: Slide a flashing orange square over coloured keys to open matching doors, not all of which yield, and collect the numbers 1 to 5 in order through the labyrinth.
c64:159282.title: Labman

c64:159284.description: Two players go head to head solving mazes, with a built-in editor for designing new ones.
c64:159284.title: Labyrint

c64:159297.description: Rearrange tiles with the joystick to recreate the picture shown at the start of each of ten levels, with a password given for every level.
c64:159297.title: Laced Tiles

c64:159298.description: Maze collect-em-up modelled on the arcade game Lady Bug, played out over a long run of levels with rotating doors that change the routes through each maze. The 2011 release added a level editor.
c64:159298.title: Lady Kakerlak

c64:159302.description: Joust astride an ostrich against rival knights; each one beaten leaves an egg that must be smashed before it hatches into a new foe.
c64:159302.title: Lancer Lords

c64:159303.description: A lone mercenary rescues eight space kids stranded in hidden silos by escorting each to a building on the planet's right side, shooting the hostile inhabitants.
c64:159303.title: Land of Neverwhere

c64:159304.description: A text adventure retelling Jack and the Beanstalk, in which you must rescue two children taken by a giant.
c64:159304.title: Land of the Giants

c64:159310.description: One of Infocom's InfoComics: in 2029 the Blubbermen invade Earth and only Lane Mastodon can stop them, told in the style of 1950s science fiction.
c64:159310.title: Lane Mastodon vs. the Blubbermen

c64:159313.description: Take $250 into a Las Vegas casino and play blackjack, baccarat, roulette and craps under their usual rules, betting whatever you can afford.
c64:159313.title: Las Vegas Casino

c64:159322.description: The Psycastria keep their energy pods in four installations, on land, aboard a giant carrier at sea, on the Moon and in deep space, and you are given command gifted with the cunning of the famous Boggles.
c64:159322.title: Psycastria

c64:159323.description: A cute Gauntlet-like overhead maze game over 20 levels, steering either the strong Puffy or the faster Puffyn through an alien world of traps.
c64:159323.title: Puffy's Saga

c64:159324.description: A Breakout and Arkanoid-style game: bounce a Laserpulse with an Energy Mirror across levels to raise a planet's evolution grade.
c64:159324.title: Pulsoids

c64:159325.description: Cross a river five times on a bridge of four bobbing purple turtles, fetching fruit from a tree on the far bank before the timer expires.
c64:159325.title: Purple Turtles

c64:159326.description: Help Santa on Christmas Eve, starting with a flip-screen hunt around his home for the parts of his sleigh; the player's name appears in a personal letter to Santa.
c64:159326.title: The Official Father Christmas

c64:159328.description: Robot Liberation Front rebels storm Titan, a robot-run geothermal power plant built under the Atlantic on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, and take over its robots.
c64:159328.title: Quake Minus One

c64:159329.description: A droid collects mushrooms in eight dangerous caves, planning routes past rocks and poisonous shrubs that can box it in while enemy droids and Quango birds pursue it.
c64:159329.title: Quango

c64:159339.description: Defend the eight circular sectors of the Hyperspace Causeway from aliens planting bombs, firing from a ship at each ring's centre.
c64:159339.title: Lazer Wheel

c64:159340.description: Martial artist Aarzak punches and kicks through the side-scrolling forces of the evil Duke, finally facing the three generals who kidnapped his girlfriend.
c64:159340.title: Last Battle

c64:159342.description: The Galden Tribe has seized the planet Bacula and invaded peaceful Mu, abducting Queen Sheets, and Mu sends its best fighters to win her back.
c64:159342.title: Last Duel

c64:159350.description: Two arithmetic games in one package. In Sum Vaders you type the sum or difference of the numbers on a passing spaceship and its falling alien robot before it lands; Robot Tables drills multiplication through a machine that builds robots.
c64:159350.title: Quick Thinking!

c64:159351.description: Pilot a craft over a grid of dots, firing in eight directions at mutants advancing up from the bottom before any reach the top.
c64:159351.title: Quintic Warrior

c64:159353.description: Overhead rallycross for one or two players across five tracks, earning points from each race to spend on car upgrades.
c64:159353.title: Rallycross Simulator

c64:159356.description: Guide a snake that never stops moving at right angles, eating eggs that show up singly until enough are eaten to escape through a gap in the top wall.
c64:159356.title: Rattler

c64:159357.description: A target-shooting challenge of six events testing the strength, reflexes, stamina and nerve of a new soldier, all of which must be passed to qualify.
c64:159357.title: Raw Recruit

c64:159358.description: The second part of Level 9's Time and Magik trilogy: recover the stolen Red Moon Crystal to save Baskalos from ruin.
c64:159358.title: Red Moon

c64:159360.description: Explore a maze collecting 500 units of treasure through randomly assigned tasks to enter the Sphinx's tomb, then answer its riddle for the Treasure of the Sphinx.
c64:159360.title: Riddle of the Sphinx

c64:159361.description: Investigative journalists Harper and Elliot join the Alterian Corps and are sent to Rigel V, where one region holds out against Federation invaders.
c64:159361.title: Rigel's Revenge

c64:159362.description: Elite insectoid warriors riding runner creatures keep planetary forcefields charged before invading arachnoid aliens can break through.
c64:159362.title: Rimrunner

c64:159369.description: An Armalyte-style horizontal shooter: condemned for past misdeeds, you are loaded into a spaceship and cast down into the depths of hell. From Magic Disk 64, February 1995.
c64:159369.title: Latent Fusion

c64:159370.description: Carry Later, trapped by Kropop in an underground maze, from one side of each chamber to the other without touching walls, traps or monsters, at one of three speeds.
c64:159370.title: Later

c64:159371.description: A vertically scrolling Wild West shooter made with SEUCK, playable co-operatively by two.
c64:159371.title: Law Man

c64:159372.description: Five-set tennis against a friend or the computer on an isometric full-screen court, with accurate scoring and five skill levels; originally Lawn Tennis.
c64:159372.title: Grand Prix Tennis

c64:159373.description: Fly rescue missions to stranded spaceships, shooting meteorites, aliens and flying eyes while avoiding collisions and cannon fire.
c64:159373.title: Lazarian

c64:159374.description: A tank duel with puzzle elements against a second player or an AI opponent, where shots must be lined up to rebound off walls to hit the enemy.
c64:159374.title: Lazer Duel

c64:159377.description: Based on the infrared tag sport, carrying its non-violent idea of tagging opponents rather than hurting them into a science fiction setting.
c64:159377.title: Lazer Tag

c64:159442.description: Fill a 96-square board with 76 symbol stones before time runs out, placing each next to stones that share its shape or colour. A question mark occasionally appears and must be reached within three seconds or it blocks a square or wipes out surrounding stones.
c64:159442.title: Le Parc

c64:159468.description: Take over one of 64 renameable clubs at the bottom of four divisions with only 11 players, signing up to 15 and building them into a winning side.
c64:159468.title: League Challenge

c64:159469.description: Steer a boat down a river flowing across the screen, avoiding islands, crocodiles and logs while picking up explorers stranded in the jungle.
c64:159469.title: River Rescue: Racing Against Time

c64:159470.description: Football management in which a club starts in Division 4 and aims for the Division 1 championship plus cup glory, handled through team and formation picks, coaching and transfers.
c64:159470.title: League Football

c64:159473.description: Play as Road Runner, staying a step ahead of Wile E. Coyote and his traps across two stages that recur four times, in an action game modeled on the Looney Tunes cartoons.
c64:159473.title: Road Runner and Wile E. Coyote

c64:159474.description: Text adventure adapted from Isaac Asimov's novel: as Earth detective Elijah Baley, travel to the Spacer planet Aurora and solve the killing of roboticist Han Fastolfe, maker of humanlike robots.
c64:159474.title: Robots of Dawn

c64:159483.description: A music program for composing tunes at home: record pieces, edit them and play them back.
c64:159483.title: Rock 'N' Rhythm

c64:159485.description: Children aged 3 to 7 choose a digit between 1 and 9, then solve a problem about it by steering an animal to the group with the right count of balloons, building up a rainbow as they go.
c64:159485.title: Learn to Add

c64:159486.description: A spelling game for kids: as a dolphin, hunt the ocean for lost letters that complete the words on a submarine so it can sink down to the sea floor.
c64:159486.title: Learn to Spell

c64:159487.description: A bridge tutor drawing on columnist Charles Goren's teachings, using quizzes to train hand evaluation, bidding and competitive play.
c64:159487.title: Charles Goren: Learning Bridge Made Easy

c64:159489.description: Educational spin-off of Sierra's Lunar Leeper: steer a Leeper onto one of four icons to choose among its four learning games.
c64:159489.title: Learning With Leeper

c64:159490.title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos: Solid Gold Edition

c64:159492.description: Arcade conversion set in 2011: race along elevated skyways that wind up a vertically scrolling screen, using a jump device to leap obstacles and hostile traffic.
c64:159492.title: LED Storm

c64:159502.description: Roll and hop a ball around a grid of tiles, touching exactly the required number of each target tile type shown at the top while jumping gaps and dodging enemies.
c64:159502.title: Rollaround

aliases: The Legend of the Amazon Women
c64:159516.description: As Lady Wilde, the only survivor of a plane crash deep in the Amazon jungle, fight through the legendary tribe of Amazon warriors believed to have taken your baby daughter Penelope.
c64:159516.title: Legend of the Amazon Women

c64:159526.description: First-person rail shooter set aboard a roller coaster, designed for Tynesoft by the Subway Software team of Bill Kunkel, Joyce Worley and Arnie Katz.
c64:159526.title: Roller Coaster Rumbler

c64:159527.description: A maze chase in the spirit of Pac-Man: a tuba gathers musical notes along staves while guitars, cymbals, triangles and pianos give pursuit, and cymbombs scatter extra notes.
c64:159527.title: Rootin' Tootin'

c64:159531.description: Officially licensed tie-in to the 1991 Rugby World Cup, following the real tournament format with all 16 nations and streamlined rules such as simplified scrums for faster play.
c64:159531.title: Rugby: The World Cup

aliases: Rupert y la Fiesta del Juguetero
c64:159532.description: Platform game starring Rupert Bear, the cartoon character created by Mary Tourtel, who must reach the Toymaker's castle to join his friends at a party.
c64:159532.title: Rupert and the Toymaker's Party

c64:159533.description: Climb a yachting league by challenging boats up to two places above you, adjusting your vessel's design, such as its overall length, to suit the rival and the weather forecast before each race.
c64:159533.title: Sailing

c64:159537.description: Lightgun compilation of five games: RoboCop, Rambo III, Hyper Sports, Combat School and Platoon, the last cut down to its Bunker and Tunnel Network stages.
c64:159537.title: Blaze Out

c64:159564.description: Play a complete round on one golf course alone or against as many as three friends, with Novice, Amateur and Professional settings that change how hard the wind blows.
c64:159564.title: Golf Master

c64:159566.description: Commander of the three mineral planets Glaciax, Solarix and Terrax, you must clear the radiation pods that alien starships have planted on their surfaces, along with the creatures guarding them.
c64:159566.title: Neutralizor

c64:159598.description: Multidirectional scrolling shooter in which a far-future ox breeder flies the ship Badjak to stop aliens carrying off the herd, armed with a laser and a rear-firing boomerang.
c64:159598.title: Oh No!

c64:159600.description: Tie-in to the British comic Oink!: editor Uncle Pigg is short of pages near deadline, so three mini-games are played to fill the issue, with the earned comic pages readable afterwards.
c64:159600.title: Oink!

c64:159601.description: Three skiing events, slalom, ski jump and downhill, are tackled in turn for a total score and a final rating; failing one event still lets you continue to the next.
c64:159601.title: Olympic Skier

c64:159602.description: Fly through horizontally scrolling caverns in a Scramble-style shooter, steering clear of the jagged walls while dodging radar installations and homing missiles.
c64:159602.title: Penetrator

c64:159603.description: Pilot a submarine through a side-scrolling sea in 2007 to reach an undersea British nuclear base whose malfunctioning Vax 3000 computer is about to launch missiles worldwide, and shut it down.
c64:159603.title: Periscope Up

c64:159605.description: Popeye returns to Sweethaven to save Olive Oyl and beat Bluto across four levels, while also minding Swee'Pea, feeding Wimpy and watching over Jeep.
c64:159605.title: Popeye 2

c64:159606.description: Guide Solo the Synthelman as he protects the baby Nejo on an escape from Wardlock's mechanical world, crossing the Ice, Vegie, Tech and Fire Zones connected by teleports.
c64:159606.title: Prodigy

c64:159608.description: Overhead snooker with spin, adjustable shot power and color nomination after legal pots, plus a practice mode where balls can be set up anywhere on the table.
c64:159608.title: Professional Snooker Simulator

c64:159609.description: Horizontal shooter with constant left-to-right scrolling: alien invaders threaten Earth, and the only defense is to switch on the Galactic Shield by fighting through their levels.
c64:159609.title: Protium

c64:159612.description: Fly the Northall Q15, a helicopter-jet hybrid with heavy weaponry and a zoomable radar, against the attacking Peradusins at Ursa Minor Delta-V.
c64:159612.title: Prowler

c64:159614.description: Martial arts fighting game in which you weight your samurai's training toward skill, speed, stamina or strength, choose a training regime and attack tactics, then duel to win.
c64:159614.title: Samurai Trilogy

c64:159615.description: Military shooter following an SAS soldier through four jungle, desert and swamp levels, each split into two phases that begin with a Commando-style overhead section.
c64:159615.title: SAS Combat Simulator

c64:159616.description: First-person slot car racing modeled on Scalextric model car sets, later sold in Europe under the name Gran Prix.
c64:159616.title: Slot Car Racer

c64:159617.description: Unofficial take on Scramble: fly a plane over mountainous scrolling terrain to reach and destroy an enemy base, dropping bombs that fall horizontally rather than at an angle.
c64:159617.title: Scramble 64

c64:159619.description: As a pearl diver, dodge sharks, squid and jellyfish on the sea bed, waiting for clams to open so their pearls can be snatched along with other sunken treasure.
c64:159619.title: Scuba Dive

c64:159620.description: Illustrated adventure in which the warrior Se-Kaa attempts to breach the fortress of the Dark Hordes, spanning over 170 pictured locations with a full-sentence parser.
c64:159620.title: Se-Kaa of Assiah

c64:159629.description: Quill-made illustrated text adventure continuing Subsunk: Ed Lions is still aboard his sunken submarine after calling base for help.
c64:159629.title: Seabase Delta

c64:159630.description: Jeff Minter shooter in which a flying sheep defends a planet from aliens charging a planet-buster gun, using gravity fields at both the top and the bottom of the screen, much like Ancipital.
c64:159630.title: Sheep in Space

c64:159631.description: Illustrated mystery adventure: as Sherlock Holmes, investigate a double murder in Leatherhead alongside Dr. Watson while Inspector Lestrade pursues the case too.
c64:159631.title: Sherlock

c64:159633.description: A 17th-century naval captain seeks wealth and renown, choosing on meeting each enemy ship whether to fire on it, board it with crew or flee, and tracking losses in men after every battle.
c64:159633.title: Ship of the Line

c64:159635.description: Paddle a canoe through gates on a vertically scrolling river against the clock, working the joystick left and right to stroke while currents of varying speed push the boat around.
c64:159635.title: Shoot the Rapids

c64:159636.title: The Quest for the Golden Egg Cup

aliases: SEUCK: The Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit
c64:159638.description: Sensible Software's game maker for building scrolling shooters: draw the sprites and backdrops, edit how enemies attack, and start from four bundled sample games.
c64:159638.title: Shoot 'em-up Construction Kit

c64:159639.description: As Rik, roadie for the band Alternative Rock, drive their gear to the venue through oncoming traffic, haul it inside and adjust the sound before the show begins.
c64:159639.title: Rik the Roadie

c64:159640.description: Side-scrolling skateboard game in the vein of Kickstart: ride through each level over obstacles, losing one of three boards with every crash.
c64:159640.title: Rollerboard

c64:159641.description: Sequel to Superkid: having lost his powers, Tom Essex rides a skateboard and fires a catapult to rid six levels of New York streets of thugs in a flick-screen platformer.
c64:159641.title: Skatin' USA

c64:159642.description: Spike the Viking washes up in Transilvania after crossing the North Sea and must break out of captivity, then free his shipmates held below the village castle.
c64:159642.title: Spike In Transilvania

c64:159644.description: Roller skating in a multidirectionally scrolling car park arena: kick cans and gather litter while avoiding cones, ramps, sand, bouncing balls, frisbees, tyre mazes, rocks and rival skaters.
c64:159644.title: Skate Crazy

c64:159645.description: In the 24th century a dictatorship pacifies people with the drug SKY; ride with the rebel underground on the planet Moloc to wreck the harvesting machines, fighting sky bikers and defense towers.
c64:159645.title: Sky Runner

c64:159646.description: A word game for several players: letters appear in a central pool and players form words from them, while rivals may grab an existing word by extending it with more pool letters.
c64:159646.title: Snaffle

c64:159647.description: Pinball oddity in which the Slamball family of ball bearings lives on a table that the Americana monster has swallowed, so the game plays out inside its stomach.
c64:159647.title: Slamball

c64:159648.description: Snooker simulation also known as Snooker '83, where players alternate shots under standard rules, setting strength and spin with the space bar and cursor keys.
c64:159648.title: Snooker

c64:159656.description: Skate through city streets in a Paperboy-like scroller, grabbing flags before time expires and dodging pedestrians, cars and obstacles over 10 levels to earn a place among the Slime Rat Skaters.
c64:159656.title: Arcade SkateRock

c64:159657.description: Futuristic sport blending ice skating and football on a three-screen pitch whose middle section holds obstacles, with digitized player faces shown at the bottom.
c64:159657.title: Skateball

c64:159666.description: Board-game styled football management for up to three human or computer players, taking one of 32 teams from Division 4 to the Division 1 title at five difficulty levels.
c64:159666.title: Soccer Rivals

aliases: SOS: The Game with no Name
c64:159668.description: Biomech 1, a droid nicknamed Sydney, is stranded somewhere strange thanks to his forgetful creator Foley and must find his way home in one piece, or Foley's boss takes it out on Foley.
c64:159668.title: S.O.S.

c64:159698.description: Spores have escaped in a lab and will soon spread outside; travel through its fixed-screen levels using up every canister of antidote stored inside to stop the outbreak.
c64:159698.title: Spore

c64:159699.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter set in 2150: a lone deep-penetration fighter goes behind enemy lines, needing to shoot down a set number of alien convoy craft in each level.
c64:159699.title: StarLifter

c64:159700.description: As the robot BLOB, explore a 512-screen unstable planet, gathering a combination of parts that changes every game and bringing them to the core to prevent its explosion.
c64:159700.title: Starquake

c64:159701.description: Tank combat against the Arcturan Empire of Gir Draxon, whose warplinks let it shift troops instantly, fought as the Terran force sent to Arcturus.
c64:159701.title: Stellar 7

c64:159702.description: To save Joe Lebrinski's East Side gym from developers demanding $50,000, its members train in two exercises and then box the yuppies' West Side thugs in the street.
c64:159702.title: Street Cred Boxing

c64:159717.description: Steer a fast spacecraft through seven space tunnels in a row to reach the promised land beyond.
c64:159717.title: Space Tunnel

c64:159727.description: Santa flies his sleigh through a horizontally scrolling sky, catching presents from his helpers and avoiding the Red Devil's gifts, clouds and mountains, then lands on houses to deliver in person once he has enough.
c64:159727.title: Special Delivery: Santa's Christmas Chaos

c64:159734.description: For one to four players: a spider spins a short web trail as it moves, enclosing flies to catch them, and loses its web on hitting a fly or crossing its own trail.
c64:159734.title: Spider & Fly

aliases: Spirates: Battle on the High Seas
c64:159735.title: Spirates

c64:159743.description: A treasure hunter must find all 40 diamonds on an island overrun by the undead, moving across an island map and entering 21 buildings that each play as a platform level.
c64:159743.title: Spirit of the Stones

c64:159744.description: Fly a Spitfire over the English Channel to bomb flying-bomb launch sites and down enemy aircraft, while also intercepting flying bombs headed for your home base, all before the fuel runs out.
c64:159744.title: Spitfire

c64:159747.description: Up to four players manage horse racing stables, entering horses in races and hiring jockeys based on form and conditions, then watch the races play out from the side.
c64:159747.title: Omni-Play Horse Racing

c64:159753.description: On a pyramid of platforms, hop on each one to change it to the target color while enemies close in from the sides and from above, across 15 rounds that grow harder.
c64:159753.title: Mr. Cool

c64:159786.description: Fight through Chicago's streets, a cemetery and the docks to reach the warehouse lair of a crime boss, beating his trained thugs and collecting the cash they drop.
c64:159786.title: Street Warriors

c64:159788.description: Command the four-man Strike Force Cobra on a mission to stop a mad scientist known only as The Enemy, who has built a nuclear bomb powerful enough to wipe out humanity.
c64:159788.title: Strike Force: Cobra

c64:159790.description: Stuntman Chad Adams must complete five dangerous motorbike stunts to prove himself, such as riding under a hang-glider to catch him as he drops while avoiding road obstacles.
c64:159790.title: Stunt Bike Simulator

c64:159791.description: Pilot the T-Bird, a craft capable of 1346 mph, blasting swarms of flying saucers, space jellyfish and other aliens with a standard zapper and smart missiles while dodging their fire.
c64:159791.title: T-Bird

c64:159838.description: Earth faces a final devastating attack, and the Mission A.D. plan unites the world's defenses against it; one country has refused to join.
c64:159838.title: Mission A.D.

c64:159839.description: Terrorists have planted a bomb in a skyscraper hotel housing an FBI unit; climb through it in eight-floor sections, finding the porter who holds the key to each next segment, and defuse the bomb.
c64:159839.title: Mission Elevator

c64:159840.description: Illustrated text adventure in which the knight Sir Tappin sets out to find the Holy Grail.
c64:159840.title: The Quest for the Holy Grail

c64:159841.description: Second M.A.S.K. game, based on the 1980s toy and cartoon line: a side-scrolling shooter in which Matt Trakker's agents again battle the villains of V.E.N.O.M.
c64:159841.title: MASK Two Two

c64:159843.description: As billboard paster Bill Stickers, climb a ladder and line up rolls of paper on hoardings around town; pieces placed correctly stay put, while badly aligned ones fall off.
c64:159843.title: Poster Paster

c64:159847.description: Conversion of the Games Workshop and Milton Bradley board game: up to three players each lead a commander and four marines on missions aboard alien starships, with the commander rising from sergeant through the ranks.
c64:159847.title: Space Crusade

c64:159878.description: Woken from cryosleep when Bogloid aliens attack the ship, grab a proton beam that both kills the invaders and seals the hull breaches they leave, draining its power with each repair.
c64:159878.title: Space Doubt

c64:159882.description: Race seven computer cars over three laps of a long street circuit, with the first lap in daylight, the second at night and the third in snow, after choosing your car's color.
c64:159882.title: Street Machine

c64:159885.description: One or two fighters punch their way rightward along corridors as enemies come from both sides, facing a large boss near the end of each level, with a gun available as a pickup.
c64:159885.title: Thunderforce

c64:159900.description: First-person space combat sequel: the Zylons strike the Celos IV system, and the Liberty Star warps between endangered planets to fight Fly Fighters and Destroyers, refueling at friendly space stations.
c64:159900.title: Star Raiders II: The Great Galactic Adventure Continues

c64:159902.description: The last merchant in an eight-planet system plagued by pirates buys goods from wine merchants, jewellers and sawmills, sells them elsewhere and arms his ship. Shops keep hours, you must eat, drink and rest, and flights between planets are shown from the cockpit.
c64:159902.title: Star Trader

c64:159905.description: Wearing a jet pack and carrying a laser, fend off waves of strange aliens, splitting cluster missiles and meteors, returning to dock with the mother ship for fuel.
c64:159905.title: Star Trooper

c64:159906.description: In 2746 the Space Thugs threaten the Rubicon, an anti-matter buffer zone created by eight allied planets; defend it from the cockpit of a Starfox fighter with lasers and side and rear mirrors.
c64:159906.title: The Rubicon Alliance

c64:159907.description: Aliens with a time machine have altered key events in Earth's past; rookie pilot Starion patrols 243 sectors, one per year, destroying enemies and solving historical puzzles to restore them.
c64:159907.title: Starion

c64:159959.description: Up to nine players take turns racing for points on Loonies Loop or Devils Deathtrack, picking manual or automatic gears and a race length of one to nine laps.
c64:159959.title: Turbo 64

c64:159960.description: Pilot a powerboat out of enemy territory in a side-scrolling game, steering up and down and speeding either way while gathering the map pieces allied planes drop on the water.
c64:159960.title: Turbo Boat Simulator

c64:159961.description: Mr Megafat pedals his home-built Velocipede S.T.A. to the beach half a mile away, riding a screen that scrolls constantly to the right.
c64:159961.title: Velocipede

c64:159962.description: Mr Megafat returns on the Velocipede II, a unicycle that fires, crossing four timed, sideways-scrolling levels where you set the speed and jump hazards but cannot steer up or down.
c64:159962.title: Velocipede II

c64:159963.description: Vertically scrolling space shooter inspired by Star Force: a laser starfighter heads into an asteroid belt against starbases and fighter waves, avoiding mines and meteor showers that wear down its shields while picking up power-ups.
c64:159963.title: War Hawk

c64:159965.description: Soccer management sim where you run a club's finances and results, taking a third division team in a league of Europe's best toward the top, mostly through menus.
c64:159965.title: World Soccer

c64:159980.description: Overhead racing for one or two players on circuits that grow more complex, with hazards from traffic cones to tornadoes and wrenches to collect for car upgrades.
c64:159980.title: Super Sprint

c64:159981.description: Pursue Alana across the galaxy aboard the starship Andromeda to recover the crystal, seizing star bases to hem her in and searching planets for the Lance and the elements that power it.
c64:159981.title: Starship Andromeda

c64:159982.description: A shuttle pilot ferries goods from supply planets to the orbiting starcruiser, weaving through dangerous asteroid belts and landing and docking with care.
c64:159982.title: Stellar Dodger

c64:159983.description: Snooker or pool against yourself or another person, with no computer opponent; choose a short ten-red game or a full frame, controlled by joystick or keyboard.
c64:159983.title: Steve Davis Snooker

c64:159984.description: Bertie Bee defends his hive and queen from invading swarms of rival bees.
c64:159984.title: Sting 64

c64:159985.description: Top-down stock car racing on six selectable tracks, where one or two players in red cars race yellow computer cars, with optional oil slicks and adjustable skid levels.
c64:159985.title: Stock Car

c64:159986.description: Young readers build their own picture stories, which the program animates with color graphics and music, in scenes such as a dog chasing a cat or a frog named Freddy on a see-saw.
c64:159986.title: Story House

c64:159987.description: Five-card draw poker against two digitized photo opponents, Suzi and Melissa, with more opponents sold on expansion disks.
c64:159987.title: Strip Poker: A Sizzling Game of Chance

c64:159988.description: As Johnny Alpha, the mutant bounty hunter from 2000 AD, you crash-land on the Planet of Renegades after an ambush by the Stix Brothers while heading to meet friends Wulf and Gronk.
c64:159988.title: Strontium Dog and the Death Gauntlet

c64:159989.description: In 2492, race a craft through the Sub-Terranean Underground Network at over 900 mph against the clock, shooting or avoiding cycles, armored drones and birdlike flyers.
c64:159989.title: S.T.U.N. Runner

c64:159990.description: Side-scrolling aerial shooter with missions to destroy an enemy headquarters, where speed and maneuvers burn fuel and enemy planes, SAMs and gunships attack from every direction.
c64:159990.title: Suicide Strike

c64:159991.description: One-button bomber game like Air Attack: a light plane low on fuel descends over a city and must level the buildings to land, with bonuses for landing and for hitting King Kong on a skyscraper.
c64:159991.title: Super Blitz

c64:159992.description: Two-player-only World War I aerial duel seen from above, with clouds forming the arena, similar to Atari's Air Combat games.
c64:159992.title: Super Dogfight

c64:159993.description: Move a head along the lines of an 8 x 8 grid to paint them, filling each box once it is enclosed, while avoiding scorpions that cost one of three lives.
c64:159993.title: Gridder

c64:159994.description: Motorbike trials against the clock, one rider at a time, with a side-scrolling view of the rider above a smaller overhead map of the obstacle course.
c64:159994.title: Super Scramble Simulator

c64:159995.description: Taito's update of Space Invaders with tougher alien formations, boss fights, power-ups for extra weapons and varied backdrops.
c64:159995.title: Taito's Super Space Invaders

c64:159996.description: Turn-based American football strategy using teams and player statistics drawn from the real league, choosing plays against the computer or a human opponent.
c64:159996.title: Super Bowl Sunday

c64:159998.description: Tom Essex drinks his uncle's formula and becomes Superkid, able to fly and throw a super punch, then cleans up the crime-ridden streets of future New York for its mayor.
c64:159998.title: SuperKid

c64:160004.description: As Prince Imrahil, journey to Baghdad over eight levels of guards and hazards to rescue his sister from Sultan Saladin, who has his brides killed after their wedding night.
c64:160004.title: Tales of the Arabian Nights

c64:160014.description: Warhawk sequel: called out of boredom on the planet Sloar, fly the Quariad stealth fighter over the surface of Tanium to destroy the alien force that has taken it.
c64:160014.title: Tanium

c64:160018.description: Battlezone-like tank combat: a lone tank holds off homing missiles, robot attackers and hard-to-hit saucers on the horizon.
c64:160018.title: Tank Atak

c64:160082.description: Turned into a monkey by a witch doctor, Tarzan gathers six ingredients, a necklace, mask, plant, crossbones, bottle and gem, for the cauldron, throwing stones at snakes, birds, lizards and cannibals.
c64:160082.title: Tarzan Goes Ape

c64:160083.description: Football management where a club climbs from the English Fourth Division to the First Division title and cups, choosing from 40 teams split into divisions of 10.
c64:160083.title: The Match

c64:160085.description: Adventure driven by one-letter keyboard commands, each shown as a side-view animation, as an adventurer trapped at the cave entrance works through the Oracle's cave complex to escape.
c64:160085.title: The Oracle's Cave

c64:160088.description: Adapted from James Herbert's novel, this mix of strategy and text adventure has several characters fighting a rat swarm overrunning London, starting with Foskins and a map of the city; the game ends if the rats spread beyond it.
c64:160088.title: James Herbert's The Rats

c64:160089.description: James Sydney has been shot in the head by a sniper in the building opposite who had watched him all day; lead a team gathering clues at the crime scene to track down the killer.
c64:160089.title: The Sydney Affair

c64:160090.description: Wargame covering the first 30 days of a feared Cold War conflict in Europe, commanding NATO or Warsaw Pact air and ground forces with the option of nuclear and chemical strikes.
c64:160090.title: Theatre Europe

c64:160091.description: As The Boss, plan a robbery: hire criminals skilled in explosives, driving and more who want money up front and a cut of the take, and buy information and plans on the target.
c64:160091.title: They $tole a Million

c64:160092.description: Spelling practice for young children featuring Thomas the Tank Engine, with six games using three or four letter words in lower, upper or mixed case.
c64:160092.title: Thomas The Tank Engine's Fun With Words

c64:160094.description: Malmor, Demonlord of Darkness, once banished to Limbo by a council of wizards, has found the Ring of Skulls and again threatens the land of Aelandor from the Tower of Despair.
c64:160094.title: Tower of Despair

c64:160095.description: International football management: lead a national team through qualifying and into the European Championship and World Cup, picking a 22-man squad from 100 eligible players with no transfer market.
c64:160095.title: Track Suit Manager

c64:160096.description: Inspired by Richard Branson's 1987 balloon crossing: race a friend or the computer across the Atlantic, controlling an eagle rather than the balloon itself.
c64:160096.title: Trans-Atlantic Balloon Challenge: The Game

c64:160097.description: Based on the 1980s British TV show, decode cryptic clues to send a presenter and camera crew by helicopter from location to location, with a printed booklet of over 60 pages.
c64:160097.title: Treasure Hunt

c64:160098.description: Football management with four divisions of 20 teams and a pool of 1,500 invented players, each with attributes, covering selection, training, transfers, injuries and the chase for trophies.
c64:160098.title: Treble Champions

c64:160099.description: Ekim, a giant ant trained by pirates in 1647, hops across the backs of turtles between islands to gather treasure.
c64:160099.title: Turtle Jump

c64:160100.description: Sabreman's second adventure after Sabre Wulf: lost in caverns spanning nearly 600 side-view screens, escape by one of three exits, each with a guardian beaten by a specific weapon.
c64:160100.title: Underwurlde

c64:160101.description: Star Trek-like strategy: command the ship Andromeda for the Federation against the warlike Vagan race across a galaxy of 4096 sectors in 64 quadrants, managing crew and combat.
c64:160101.title: Vagan Attack

c64:160102.description: Starting at the bottom of the social order in the Norse gods' Valhalla, undertake six quests for named magic items such as Ofnir and Grimnir, finding or buying weapons and armor along the way.
c64:160102.title: Valhalla

c64:160103.description: A message on an answering machine revives the Valkyrie 17 case from 40 years ago; after the leads run dry, the investigation picks up at The Glitz hotel, the last remaining clue.
c64:160103.title: Valkyrie 17

c64:160104.description: Second Phantomas game: work through 95 rooms of Count Dracula's castle to destroy him, evading his servants and collecting as much food as possible.
c64:160104.title: Vampire

c64:160106.description: Fruit machine simulation with one pay line, using holds and nudges when offered to line up winning combinations.
c64:160106.title: Vegas Jackpot

c64:160107.description: Take on the Tangent Empire's invasion fleet by destroying 14 space stations, each with three sub-levels playable in any order, driving a tank through multidirectionally scrolling levels.
c64:160107.title: Vindicators

c64:160111.description: Six-a-side volleyball under standard rules in single matches against the computer or another player, with a tactics menu for setting defensive and offensive plans.
c64:160111.title: Volleyball Simulator

c64:160112.description: Galaga-flavored shooter where space vultures leave their nest above your ship one at a time to attack, bouncing back and forth across the screen instead of wrapping around.
c64:160112.title: Vultures

c64:160113.description: Cursed into a werewolf, hunt down every relative of the family responsible to lift the curse, while each kill raises police pressure and arrests can be escaped with the right gear.
c64:160113.title: Werewolves of London

c64:160116.description: New York, 1998: with half the city in ruins and ruled by gangs and the other half home to drug barons, fight through the wrecked streets.
c64:160116.title: Wild Streets

c64:160117.description: An outlaw named Big Nose Bill and his men have seized Fort Snake; stranded in the desert with nothing, search the surrounding lands to reach him and retake the fort.
c64:160117.title: Wild West

c64:160118.description: Seymour, an aspiring film producer, recovers the equipment that the mysterious El Bandeeto scattered around his studio after tearing up the script for his western movie.
c64:160118.title: Wild West Seymour

c64:160119.description: Jet fighter flight sim defending an island home and its nuclear plant from enemy aircraft, with Novice, Pilot and Ace skill levels and takeoffs from the runway.
c64:160119.title: Wing Commander

c64:160121.description: Platform action in which Wizard Willy gathers ten magic eyes over four levels and defeats demonic guardians to reach the dark fortress where an evil emperor holds Princess Fifi.
c64:160121.title: Wizard Willy

c64:160122.description: Spelling game for children 8 and up: move around a grid avoiding word-wobbling aliens while spelling 1500 words split into five difficulty levels.
c64:160122.title: Word Wobbler

c64:160123.description: Football management in a 16-team super league, picking the side and substitutes for each match while handling injuries and suspensions; also released as Premier II and Premier League.
c64:160123.title: World Champions

c64:160127.description: Pick one of 24 national teams for a World Championship that copies the 1990 World Cup format, choosing which players take the field to balance the side.
c64:160127.title: World Championship Soccer

c64:160128.description: First-person flight shooter: fly into enemy territory and knock out the 10 beacons that cloak the enemy base, making it visible so it can be destroyed, using radar to navigate.
c64:160128.title: X-29 Fighter Mission

c64:160129.description: Atari arcade conversion: one or two players, on a split screen, explore Gauntlet-like underground mazes in third-person pseudo-3D, shooting robots and grabbing bonuses from flying saucers.
c64:160129.title: Xybots

c64:160130.description: First-person shooter protecting Defense Sphere 7 from enemy attack ships, turning a solar-powered positron accelerator through 360 degrees to find and destroy them.
c64:160130.title: Zeta-7

c64:160146.description: A pared-down two-player version of Cult's British Super League, a text and statistics based football manager tracking finances, skills and league position, with matches reported in text.
c64:160146.title: 2 Player Super League

c64:160147.description: Motorbike racing viewed from behind the rider over 12 world circuits, alone or against a friend on a vertically split screen, with a nine-lap championship against six riders and a two-lap training mode.
c64:160147.title: 500cc Grand Prix

c64:160152.description: Updated Pong for one player against the computer or two head to head, with six variants that include tennis, football and two forms of squash.
c64:160152.title: Video Classics

c64:160164.description: Vertically scrolling shooter along roads full of gaps, blasting aliens and recurring mini-bosses that break apart as they take hits; released on a 1994 Commodore Format cover tape.
c64:160164.title: Alien Smash

c64:160165.description: Scrabble played by the official rules at eight difficulty levels, improving on Computer Scrabble with better graphics, a bigger dictionary and a timer.
c64:160165.title: Computer Scrabble De Luxe

c64:160197.title: Temple of Apshai: Curse of Ra

c64:160216.description: Command a wartime submarine hunting eight destroyers and four transports carrying munitions within 18 hours, using torpedoes, steerable guided missiles and long-range radar.
c64:160216.title: Ocean Conqueror

c64:160222.description: Educational game made with the RSPB and set at Loch Garten in Scotland: as head of the project, assign wardens so the ospreys can nest, raise chicks and survive the dangers they face.
c64:160222.title: Osprey!

c64:160226.description: Lief the Viking gathers money to purchase the black key to the throne room of Castle Osk in Narvay, where he must kill the usurping ogre Smoth, past his two goblin guards, and free the jailed Queen Dana.
c64:160226.title: Viking Raider

c64:160247.description: Dizzy searches the islands for the pieces of a stolen magic crystal treasure, facing pirates and dangerous island creatures, with his friends on hand to help.
c64:160247.title: Crystal Kingdom Dizzy

c64:160251.description: Platform game across more than 200 screens, fighting trolls that menace humanity with a gun and energy bolts; a construction kit is included.
c64:160251.title: Down at the Trolls

c64:160295.description: Stop seven riot leaders within 15 minutes by tracking them down and hurling them off the prison roof, first solving word scrambles to disarm their booby traps, in a flick-screen fighter like Joe Blade.
c64:160295.title: Prison Riot

aliases: Fun School II: For the Over 8's
c64:160309.title: Fun School 2: For the Over-8's

aliases: Fun School II: For the Under 6's
c64:160310.title: Fun School 2: For the Under 6's

aliases: Great Courts: The Ultimate Tennis Simulation
c64:160337.description: Tennis endorsed by Jimmy Connors, with tournaments and single matches on several court surfaces, using a crosshair to aim each shot across the net.
c64:160337.title: Pro Tennis Tour

c64:160341.description: Paradroid with metallic Morpheus-style graphics: take over robots with the 001 Influence Device, aiming to clear ships entirely and to transfer into the unstable 999 droid, in a fleet that never runs out.
c64:160341.title: Paradroid: Metal Edition

c64:160346.description: As Captain Clutch of the S.S. Slipshod, which has hit an iceberg, lead passengers to the lifeboats in a side-scrolling platformer.
c64:160346.title: Waterline

c64:160379.description: Real-time strategy in which Caesar leads up to 10 legions plus cavalry against larger barbarian armies in increasingly big battles to conquer Gaul.
c64:160379.title: Legionnaire

c64:160382.description: Star Trek parody aboard the starship Enterpr1se on its five-year mission, exploring space and shooting aliens with charged particle weapons.
c64:160382.title: Space: The Ultimate Frontier

c64:160383.description: Joust clone published by COMPUTE!'s Gazette: a hero on a winged horse flaps to rise and fall, beating flying foes by striking them from above.
c64:160383.title: Pegasis

c64:160400.description: Role-playing adventure set in the world of The Magic Candle: choose one of several adventurers with differing strengths, take a job from the mayor and save the town of Maramon.
c64:160400.title: The Keys to Maramon

c64:160442.description: Board the generation ship Pandora, which is set to infect Earth with deadly flowering spores, and stop it with help from the surviving crew, obtaining ID at the entrance to avoid a ceiling laser.
c64:160442.title: Pandora

c64:160443.description: After bailing out of a crashing Star Hopper near the spaceport of the unstable planet Stank, finish the journey on foot through its hazards.
c64:160443.title: Lethal

c64:160444.description: Framed for murder, Jake Stalin is exiled for life to the planet Souzel to process rubbish from a dozen nearby worlds into raw materials, and tries to escape.
c64:160444.title: Life-Term

c64:160445.description: Early space shuttle simulation of a satellite recovery mission, played in five stages beginning with an automatic launch, a rendezvous and an approach to the dead satellite.
c64:160445.title: Shuttle Simulator

c64:160446.description: Two robots, Limes and Napoleon, compete in skill tests; the winner is sent to hunt precious metals on far planets and the loser is scrapped, starting with flicking a flashing Glidstar in the center.
c64:160446.title: Limes + Napoleon

c64:160447.description: Operation Wolf-style shooter that starts behind enemy lines: escape with the captured Rapier machine gun through eight varied levels with vehicles, pursued by its makers.
c64:160447.title: Line of Fire

c64:160448.description: The ruler of a race of little green aliens has escaped his captors but is stranded on a strange world, and must cross a scrolling platform landscape to rejoin his spaceship.
c64:160448.title: Little Green Man

c64:160449.description: Puff the little dragon is lost outside Dragonland; guide him through levels of puzzles and traps to find the four parts of the pass that gets him back home.
c64:160449.title: Little Puff in Dragonland

c64:160450.description: Liverpool FC football game with an overhead Kick Off-like view, offering cup and full season modes, adjustable match lengths and basic statistics for each player.
c64:160450.title: Liverpool: The Computer Game

c64:160452.description: Three separate puzzle games of 120 levels each, all against the clock, with a password every five levels. One has the player rebuild a pattern of numbered stones whose values rise when neighbours are placed, and two others are about clearing preset stone layouts.
c64:160452.title: Logo

c64:160453.description: As a Royal Engineers lance corporal in wartime London, locate and defuse unexploded German bombs before their delayed fuses go off.
c64:160453.title: London Blitz

c64:160454.description: Non-canon Lone Wolf adventure: the Kai Master climbs the flick-screen interior of Gorazh's tower, which widens toward the top like an upturned pyramid, to claim a Lorestone of Nyxator at its summit.
c64:160454.title: Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death

c64:160455.description: Puzzle game where randomly shaped pipe pieces, such as straights, corners and S bends, are rotated and placed anywhere on a grid to form closed loops.
c64:160455.title: Loopz

c64:160456.description: Mouse-controlled adventure role-playing game across 101 locations, where four characters must destroy a supreme vampire, werewolf, zombie and mummy.
c64:160456.title: Lords of Doom

c64:160467.description: Early British baseball game for one or two players over three, six or nine innings at three computer skill levels, played in an arcade style without team statistics.
c64:160467.title: The Slugger

c64:160471.description: First-person space combat in which a starfighter flies missions ranging from finding lost artifacts to wiping out enemy forces.
c64:160471.title: Skyfox II: The Cygnus Conflict

c64:160481.description: Robots aboard the space station Sigma 7 have gone haywire; reach the central controls by beating three stages with different gameplay, starting with a diagonally scrolling shooter.
c64:160481.title: Sigma 7

c64:160486.description: Pinball with a single table for up to four players with five balls each, plus an editor for reshaping the table and arranging its parts; the default table has several bottom flippers.
c64:160486.title: Macadam Bumper

c64:160487.description: Turn-based Korean War simulation as Douglas MacArthur leading UN forces or as the Chinese command, with the option to keep the conflict limited or widen it into an Asian or global war.
c64:160487.title: MacArthur's War: Battles for Korea

c64:160488.description: In 1936 a murder takes place aboard the airship Zinderneuf; as the sole investigator aboard, explore its decks from above and collect evidence to accuse the killer before landing.
c64:160488.title: Murder on the Zinderneuf

c64:160489.description: Dust Brain wants to lead the Madballs who run planet Orb's parliament, and wins over the other Madballs by bumping them off multidirectionally scrolling platforms.
c64:160489.title: Madballs

c64:160490.description: Cockpit-view shooter escorting an airliner: after an automatic takeoff, the Flyer Fox shoots down enemy fighters to protect the jumbo, using radar, compass and artificial horizon.
c64:160490.title: Flyer Fox

c64:160491.description: Aliens have devastated civilization's worlds; the last hope is Mag Max, a weapon left unfinished by scientists who hid its parts underground, which must be found to complete it.
c64:160491.title: Mag Max

c64:160492.description: Fixed-screen shooter against enemy formations massed overhead, with a fuel tank acting as a time limit that refills after clearing several waves.
c64:160492.title: Threshold

c64:160494.description: Centipede-inspired shooter: a small blue creature along the lower edge moves sideways and a little forward and back, firing up at a big maggot descending level by level.
c64:160494.title: Maggotmania

c64:160495.description: A witch recovers four magic scrolls stolen from Neverland by the sorcerer Colo and his henchmen, using a cape, cross, wand and hourglass that each work differently against his creatures.
c64:160495.title: Magic Madness

c64:160496.description: Sequel to Reckless Rufus: evil witches have taken Antwicky, so Rufus dons a cape and learns spells, freeing prisoners across platforms and ladders while battling witches, demons and Vikings.
c64:160496.title: Magic Rufus

c64:160497.description: Illustrated text adventure scored with Mike Oldfield's Tubular Bells: the magician Caro must kill an evil wizard to lift the spell that turned a little girl to stone.
c64:160497.title: The Magician's Ball

c64:160499.description: Shield three llamas from invading aliens by steering a killdroid over the attackers while holding fire; any llama can die, but the game ends when Mama is lost.
c64:160499.title: Mama Llama

c64:160500.description: Qix variant: draw lines with a dot to enclose and color areas while avoiding enemies confined to colored or uncolored zones, aiming to fill 75% of the screen.
c64:160500.title: Maniax

c64:160501.description: Captain C T Cobra drives a Battlecar up the vertically scrolling planet Mergatron to recover the captured jewels of Ozymandias, destroying turrets and enemy cars along the way.
c64:160501.title: Marauder

c64:160503.description: Commodities trading simulation for one to eight players, where each turn opens with a market analysis hinting at which goods may rise in value.
c64:160503.title: Market Forces

c64:160505.description: Early Westwood turn-based RPG on Mars: a stranded space jockey assembles a team to search for a lost city, building characters with attributes and 21 improvable skills.
c64:160505.title: Mars Saga

c64:160509.description: Educational math race for one or two players, where runners advance by solving problems, with four skill levels from Walker to Olympian and a choice of operations such as multiplication and division.
c64:160509.title: Marathon

c64:160514.description: Chess under the standard rules on a 2D board, moving pieces by placing a pointer on the starting square, pressing space, and repeating on the destination.
c64:160514.title: Master Chess

c64:160515.description: Football against the computer or a friend, or a cup for up to eight players, with half lengths of 5, 15 or 45 minutes, three computer levels and editable team names.
c64:160515.title: Match Day

c64:160516.description: Football management licensed from the BBC highlights show, covering training, transfers and tactics through an unusual interface where a diary on a desk is dragged around to pick options.
c64:160516.title: Match of the Day

c64:160517.description: Based on the Max Headroom TV movie and series, set in a cyberpunk near future ruled by ratings-hungry corporations, with Network 23 reporter Edison Carter attempting a rescue.
c64:160517.title: Max Headroom

c64:160518.description: Ride six timed stages of a motorcycle circuit, choosing one of seven riders with different bike traits and switching between low and high gear with the fire button.
c64:160518.title: Max Torque

c64:160519.description: Professor Arabesque, sent by the Psychical Society, jumps and shoots his way through Maxwell Manor in overhead and side-on sections, gathering treasures to break the hold of the Skull of Doom.
c64:160519.title: Maxwell Manor

c64:160521.description: Hewson maze game starring Flippo, who must turn every tile of a maze to the target colour by walking over it. Some tiles flip back or only change from certain directions, and enemies, holes and power-ups complicate each level.
c64:160521.title: Maze Mania

c64:160522.description: Memory and word guessing combined: two players, human or computer, flip boxes on a 36-box grid to match animated figures of the same type and color.
c64:160522.title: Matchboxes

c64:160523.description: Terrorists of the Red Legion hold the Lutheran embassy and threaten to blow it up, while the ambassador's daughter hides inside; three Mayday Squad commandos go in to rescue her.
c64:160523.title: Mayday Squad Heroes

c64:160524.description: As Mick or Mac, chase down the Hamburglar to recover Ronald's stolen bag of magic tricks, collecting Ronald's cards in platform levels such as Ronald's Clubhouse and Birdie's Treehouse.
c64:160524.title: McDonaldland

c64:160525.description: After nuclear war, mutants roam the wastelands outside the cities; as the mutant Sante, break into a city to free your father Hante.
c64:160525.title: Mean City

c64:160526.description: Overhead vertically scrolling racing: overtake rival cars and finish each lap within the time limit to reach the next race, watching for drivers coming up behind.
c64:160526.title: Mean Machine

c64:160527.description: Rebels bored with matter transporters race on the Battletrack, an abandoned orbital road; ride the armed Mean Streak motorcycle along its isometric, Mad Max-like course.
c64:160527.title: Mean Streak

c64:160528.description: Platoon-level wargame of a hypothetical NATO versus Soviet armored battle for two players, human or computer, with four historical scenarios and a scenario builder.
c64:160528.title: Mech Brigade

c64:160529.description: A doomsday machine orbiting the satellites Xylos and Pholos was set long ago to stop nuclear war between galactic empires, triggering if nuclear activity climbs too high; eight smooth-scrolling scenarios follow.
c64:160529.title: Mediator

c64:160530.description: Medieval politics and war strategy beginning in 1028 AD and lasting up to five centuries or 100 turns, for up to 10 players with as many as six run by the computer, with optional limits on actions per turn.
c64:160530.title: Medieval Lords: Soldier Kings of Europe

c64:160531.description: Logic game where a sphere rides around rotating cogs, switching between them where they touch, to gather the parts of a formula in order while avoiding enemies on some cogs.
c64:160531.title: Pi. R Squared

c64:160535.description: Into-the-screen 3D shooter viewed from behind the Mega Hawk as it seeks a new universe, through stages in a tunnel, in deep space and over a planet's surface.
c64:160535.title: Megahawk

c64:160536.description: On Midsummer Night, Mr Megafat, melon grower and TV personality, runs along a side-scrolling landscape protecting his ripe melon patches from Melonmonsters.
c64:160536.title: Melonmania

c64:160546.description: Ikari Warriors-style shooter in which an anti-terrorist soldier frees an ex-President held by African revolutionaries across eight mostly horizontal levels, sometimes shooting trees and scenery to advance.
c64:160546.title: Mercs

c64:160547.description: Myrtle, a heavyset mermaid who has finally found her dream man, the diver Gordon, must rescue him through an underwater maze after he flees and gets stuck beneath a ship.
c64:160547.title: Mermaid Madness

c64:160548.description: Expansion for Mercenary with the same controls, sending the player back to Planet Targ for a new adventure in the Second City.
c64:160548.title: Mercenary: Escape from Targ: The Second City

c64:160549.description: Inside an asteroid complex lives Garth, a two-headed alien bent on destroying Earth; fill flasks with acid and use them to blow up the four power units that sustain him.
c64:160549.title: Metaplex

c64:160550.description: Single-screen platformer where a spaceman with a jet pack walks over fuel pods to color them in, collecting all of them to move to the next screen.
c64:160550.title: Metranaut

c64:160551.description: Defend a city at the bottom of the screen from waves of aliens that fly in from the edges and crash into it, losing once the Metro-Blitz lettering under the city is wiped out.
c64:160551.title: Metro Blitz

c64:160552.description: Add-on for MicroLeague Baseball, which featured licensed MLB teams and real players, letting users trade between teams or build their own.
c64:160552.title: MicroLeague Baseball: General Managers Owners Disk

c64:160553.description: Steer a small robot through a vertically scrolling, overhead circuit maze inside a supercomputer, repairing its broken circuits instead of trained engineers.
c64:160553.title: Micro Mouse

c64:160560.description: Text adventure set in Egypt: a desert wanderer finds the lost city of Xeiops and explores its tomb, said to hold over 100 rooms, carrying the treasures out.
c64:160560.title: Tombs of Xeiops

c64:160590.description: As the maintenance engineer of the stricken freighter Nimbus, walk or jet-pack around single screens, carrying seeds singly from the upper edge to save the priceless Terran Plant cargo.
c64:160590.title: Microcosm

c64:160591.description: Interactive fiction built on the SWAN system and adapted from an Anna Popkess novel, set after an apocalypse where guards rule mutant mobs with frequent executions, following a boy named Robin.
c64:160591.title: Mindfighter

c64:160592.description: A Wild West multi-event game: cross the desert, win gunfights, compete at beer drinking and arm wrestling in the saloon, and milk a cow.
c64:160592.title: Pacos Pete: The High Plains Drifter

c64:160593.description: Robot aliens have invaded; Minit Man flies a helicopter to carry materials and rebuild the bridge needed to move missiles to the silos, then loads and fires three warheads.
c64:160593.title: Minit Man

c64:160595.description: After the Bad Star Empire ravages the planet CRYS-CIT, fly a star fighter over the empire's world wrecking fighters and installations to blunt any future attack.
c64:160595.title: Mission Genocide

c64:160596.description: A mysterious alien craft codenamed Omega carries deadly missiles; board it and shut down its four reactors within an hour so it can be studied without firing or falling to the enemy.
c64:160596.title: Mission Omega

c64:160599.description: Science fiction action by the creator of Maxwell Manor, in two parts, The Final Appeal and Operation Tempest, striking the hated Eternals' underground power base on the planet Thunderhead.
