c64:164028.description: Design and fight turn-based battles from any era, ancient, 1800s, modern or future, setting each unit's firepower, movement, strength and aggressiveness. For one or two players, with eight ready-made scenarios.
c64:164028.title: Wargame Construction Set

c64:164031.description: A point-and-click horror adventure in the style of Déjà Vu and Shadowgate: after a figure on a dark road causes a car crash, wake to find your brother gone and search the eerie mansion he must have entered.
c64:164031.title: Uninvited.

c64:164032.description: As Van Helsing, rid 160 side-view screens of vampires before time runs out, bouncing a beam of light off mirrors to destroy them and keeping it under control.
c64:164032.title: Vampire's Empire

c64:164033.description: A casino collection of four games, Keno, Blackjack, Draw Poker and Lucky 7 Slots, playable alone or with friends.
c64:164033.title: Video Vegas

c64:164034.description: Casino craps with a mouse-driven interface: pick up chips, place bets on the table and click the dice to roll, starting with $1000 and playing on until the money runs out.
c64:164034.title: Vegas Craps

c64:164035.description: Aliens have raided a research center, and a driver races across the land to save abducted scientists and retrieve stolen weapons, computers and microfilm, getting out on foot to grab each one while dodging aliens.
c64:164035.title: Warp!

c64:164036.description: Drive back a great evil by purging the twelve signs of the zodiac, three levels each, where portals release good and evil spores and the good ones must spread far enough to destroy every evil portal.
c64:164036.title: Wicked

c64:164037.description: One or two players race craft through 3D tunnels seen from behind to grab an orb and bring it back to the finish, firing lasers at each other and at hostile craft. Includes a track editor.
c64:164037.title: Tunnel Vision

c64:164038.description: Cinemaware's American football presented like a TV broadcast, with a TV-style intro before each game and cut scenes for dramatic moments, mostly action play with plays chosen beforehand.
c64:164038.title: TV Sports Football

c64:164039.description: A creative program for young children, guided by a friendly turtle, where they use the joystick to paint pictures and play with color, music and animals, saving their artwork for later.
c64:164039.title: Turtle Toyland Jr.

c64:164040.description: Follow-up to Panzer Strike, simulating small-unit World War II combat: Americans versus Japanese in the Pacific, British versus Japanese in Asia, and Americans versus Germans in Europe.
c64:164040.title: Typhoon of Steel

c64:164041.description: From Ajax HQ, remotely pilot a drone that switches between a jet fighter seen from behind and a top-down helicopter gunship, battling through eight levels to destroy the alien fortress.
c64:164041.title: Typhoon

c64:164042.description: An interactive audiovisual piece rather than a game: Mike Oldfield's Tubular Bells rearranged for the SID chip and paired with on-screen visuals.
c64:164042.title: Tubular Bells

c64:164043.description: Landing ten minutes ahead of a mind-probe at the Triaxos maximum security prison, locate the one prisoner able to activate the galaxy's most powerful weapon and bring him to your ship inside 30 minutes, blasting robot guards.
c64:164043.title: Triaxos

c64:164044.description: An illustrated take on Colossal Cave: wander a forest and caves gathering treasures and handling odd creatures, using one- or two-word typed commands, with plenty of jokes in the responses.
c64:164044.title: The Very Big Cave Adventure

c64:164050.description: Texas billionaire Arthur J. Hackensack kidnaps scientist Frobisher Goonhilly and uses his matter transformation weapon to turn the Isle of Wight into a custard slice and New York into a sponge, and Blinky the ghost steps in.
c64:164050.title: Titanic Blinky

c64:164051.description: A quiz for one to four players on a fruit machine theme, with an optional answer timer of up to 995 seconds and a choice of short or long games.
c64:164051.title: Trivial Fruit

c64:164053.description: A side-scrolling shooter where the ship flies in either direction and must shoot down a quota of enemies per stage, using a radar to track them and matching their speed without colliding.
c64:164053.title: Tangent

c64:164054.description: Guide a cat through the dangers of everyday feline life, first crossing roads and pavements to fetch an important item while avoiding cars, foxes, people, light bulbs and potted plants.
c64:164054.title: Tales of the Cat

c64:164055.description: Set in the age of steam, this business game puts the player in charge of a train, loading raw materials at supply stations and delivering them to industries that need them, with faster deliveries earning more.
c64:164055.title: Trains (Spinnaker)

c64:164056.description: A spelling and grammar learning game with three levels, created by Mercer Mayer, following Tink as he wakes early in Tink Tonk land for a day of learning.
c64:164056.title: Tink! Tonk! Tink's Adventure

c64:164057.description: Destroy enemy starships by planting bombs found on their hulls next to the nuclear reactors. Each placement requires cracking three locks by pressing fire while LOG ON is lit; a mistake gets you destroyed.
c64:164057.title: Unitrax

c64:164058.description: A Pac-Man-style maze game with the fish Supercuda in the lead, chased by a new set of deep-sea predators on every screen and powered up by electric eels in place of power pills.
c64:164058.title: Supercuda

c64:164059.description: Recreates Super Bowl XX, where Chicago beat New England 46-10, mixing play calling with action. Kick power and accuracy are set by timing the fire button, and the C64 version includes a computer opponent.
c64:164059.title: Super Bowl

c64:164061.description: Ride an eagle through the vast tomb of King Tut, past chambers of spears, enchanted saws and boulders, and then a hall full of the Devil's minions.
c64:164061.title: Treasure of the Phoenix

c64:164086.description: Heading home after five years patrolling Province 4, a damaged ship is pulled into a black hole and the pilot must find a way back out.
c64:164086.title: The Tube

c64:164089.description: A multiple-choice trivia quiz across five categories, sports, music, science, TV and general knowledge, with an option to type in answers instead of picking them.
c64:164089.title: The Trivia Arcade

c64:164090.description: Following Thundercross, Flight Commander McCoy is sent by Space Control 25 against 32 giant spacecraft in the stratosphere, flying alongside each one in his Advanced Flight Capsule and blasting everything on its hull.
c64:164090.title: Trigger Happy

c64:164097.description: One or two players search seven sectors for Tarkus and Eugene's kidnapped friends, choosing any sector, where higher sectors hold more Wheelies to free and more enemies to shoot or dodge.
c64:164097.title: Wheelies

c64:164099.description: A Donkey Kong-style platform game across four single screens: climb ladders and leap rolling barrels to rescue a girlfriend held at the top by a giant ape.
c64:164099.title: Crazy Kong (Supersoft)

c64:164102.description: Would-be agents pick their training missions from a set of corridors, tackling four arcade-style tests that include a sabotage job; pass all four to move up a level.
c64:164102.title: Spy School

c64:164103.description: Space shoot-out aboard the starship Interceptor: blast a meteor shower that knocks out shields and controls, spend repair units earned from destroyed meteors, then fight off attacking alien craft.
c64:164103.title: Star Command

c64:164104.title: Trivial Pursuit: The Computer Game: Baby Boomer Edition

c64:164105.description: The first expansion of questions for Trivial Pursuit, aimed at children and teenagers, adding 3,000 questions split into ages 7 to 12 and 12 and up, with categories such as People and Places.
c64:164105.title: Trivial Pursuit: The Computer Game: Young Players Edition

c64:164107.description: A space-faring take on Trivial Pursuit: each player pilots a ship around the galaxy, answering questions to win over Genus's Elders to their people's plan to colonize the planet.
c64:164107.title: Trivial Pursuit: A New Beginning

c64:164109.description: A Moon Patrol variant on the surface of Zon: drive a patrol wagon over obstacles and mines while fending off LasaSlamma tanks and missile-firing HeliChargers for as long as possible.
c64:164109.title: Troopa Truck

c64:164145.description: Go-kart racing against a friend or the computer on an overhead split screen, with limited turbo boosts and track icons that repair damage and refill turbo.
c64:164145.title: Turbo Kart Racer

c64:164146.description: With Earth's silicon reserves running out, the mercenary Sillo travels to a distant part of the galaxy to harvest a new, highly explosive source.
c64:164146.title: 3D Silicon Fish

c64:164216.description: A Mahjongg variant where matching tiles can be removed only when they line up with no other tile between them, clearing a set number of each symbol to empty the board.
c64:164216.title: Turn It

c64:164223.description: A Polish platform game: clear radioactive items from a fortress by carrying them to a special container, using precise jumps and accurate shooting against mutated creatures and collecting extra lives and ammo.
c64:164223.title: Twierdza

aliases: U.S.S. John Young: A Naval Warship Simulation
c64:164249.description: A naval simulation with action sequences set in 1995 as the Persian Gulf boils over between Iran, Iraq and the US: captain the US destroyer John Young and secure the region.
c64:164249.title: Battle Stations

c64:164250.description: Inmates Warmonger and Mandroid, the second player, try to break out of a maximum security prison orbiting Earth, fighting through waves of guards with a gun and a laser.
c64:164250.title: UCM: Ultimate Combat Mission

c64:164257.description: A Snake variant in scrolling maze levels of narrow passages: Lenni the snake eats every fruit, growing longer with each one and turning by himself when he hits a wall.
c64:164257.title: Magic Serpent

c64:164261.description: A single-screen shooter in which the Cyclonic Megawarz Uniship Mk1 rotates and thrusts, drifting to a stop, as it warps from planet to planet on the way to Earth, starting at Pluto.
c64:164261.title: Megawarz

c64:164262.description: An updated Phoenix: move left and right at the bottom of a single screen shooting several waves of attackers, with a short-lived shield that must recharge between uses.
c64:164262.title: Mega Phoenix

c64:164265.description: Three card games in arcade form, played with a set number of credits: Poker Royal, a five-card draw where cards are held or discarded, Twenty One, and High Low.
c64:164265.title: Video Card Arcade

c64:164266.description: Erik the Viking must rescue his warrior queen from Death Island and loot its Main Fortress, starting on Stoney Island where he gathers gear and finds a way off while dealing with the unwelcoming locals.
c64:164266.title: The Vikings

c64:164269.description: Wee Willie washes windows at an apartment block and has only so much water in his bucket and needs to remember which tenants want their windows cleaned and which do not.
c64:164269.title: Memory Manor

c64:164292.description: A curse called Shades has struck the island of Arulan, making people vanish and reappear elsewhere and bringing monsters and traps. A hero sets out to lift it and restore the island.
c64:164292.title: Shades

c64:164298.title: Banana Jones and the Temple of Goons

c64:164302.description: Break into five buildings of increasing size and security, from a jewelry store, museum and bank to a research facility and an embassy, to find the loot while getting past security.
c64:164302.title: Security Alert

aliases: Pictionary: Das Spiel mit dem schnellen Strich
Pictionary: Un Mot en un Coup de Crayon
c64:164310.description: Adaptation of the board game in which players guess a word or phrase from a sketch. Clues come from five categories, including a hard puzzle set and an All Play round; the guessing time is adjustable, and drawings are made with a simplified paint program that can be practised separately.
c64:164310.title: Pictionary: The Game of Quick Draw

c64:164316.description: Electronic Arts' unusual take on Dots and Boxes. Up to four worms crawl over a grid of diagonal dots, leaving coloured trails to claim territory; each worm can be steered, trained to repeat a pattern, or left to the computer.
c64:164316.title: Worms?

c64:164349.description: Run an 8-bit era computer and software distribution business: buy machines and games, then deliver them to shops at a profit. Getting there means crossing platforms and traps, and stock dropped from rival trucks can be picked up along the way.
c64:164349.title: Wibstars

c64:164372.description: A Lemmings-like puzzle where walkers stroll along paths between doorways. A single movable bridge must cover the gaps for several walkers heading in different directions at different speeds across multiple paths.
c64:164372.title: Walkerz

aliases: Börsenfieber: Spielend spekulieren mit Geld und Aktien
c64:164373.description: A stock market trading simulation for up to four players. A share-trading quiz at the start sets each player's opening capital, after which shares and funds are bought and sold while market news shifts prices.
c64:164373.title: Wall$treet

c64:164418.description: Sequel to Psi Warrior. Sent by RadCom Corps into an old storehouse out in the nuclear wasteland, the warrior goes down ramp after ramp toward a Biocomputer believed dead that now gives off intense psychic activity.
c64:164418.title: Warrior II

c64:164433.description: The official Mexico '86 football tie-in: run a World Cup from the quarter-finals with human or computer teams, playing 90-minute matches on a scrolling three-screen pitch where you steer the player nearest the ball, shoot with fire and dive with the keeper.
c64:164433.title: World Cup Carnival

c64:164434.description: An illustrated text adventure loosely inspired by The Frog King. Turned into a toad by the witch Hazel and trapped on her island, the hero must gather ingredients and brew them in her cauldron to regain human form.
c64:164434.title: The Witch's Cauldron

c64:164435.description: A naval wargame of the age of sail, in which frigates and ships of the line maneuver and exchange broadsides in battles involving the Spanish and British empires.
c64:164435.title: Wooden Ships & Iron Men

c64:164436.description: Based on the TV puppets: the young Wombles head out onto the common to collect litter, with Great Uncle Bulgaria asking them to keep an eye out for a discarded copy of The Times.
c64:164436.title: The Wombles

c64:164437.description: Sent by Global Weapons Inc to fix a generator fault, a troubleshooter finds the plant in meltdown, all 30 generators failing and its automated machines running wild. They must be switched off remotely, since going inside is too dangerous.
c64:164437.title: Web

c64:164440.description: Follow-up to Lode Runner with unchanged gameplay and 50 very hard levels aimed at experts. There is no level editor and stages must be cleared in sequence; progress can be saved, but each restore costs a life.
c64:164440.title: Championship Lode Runner

c64:164454.description: A side-scrolling game in which Wallie floats above his wheel and both travel together across the ground, eating dots and three flashing dots for points on the way to the end of each level.
c64:164454.title: Wheelin' Wallie

c64:164455.description: The third Carmen Sandiego game: chase Carmen and her gang of thieves across 34 European countries, using the bundled Rand McNally Concise Atlas of Europe to follow the clues.
c64:164455.title: Where in Europe is Carmen Sandiego?

c64:164467.description: Escort a clumsy, scatter-brained brother, newly hired as a research scientist, past hazards by whistling to direct him; the hero is a former student who spent university learning to whirl like a dervish.
c64:164467.title: Whistler's Brother

c64:164473.description: Defend 22nd-century Earth from the beings of Cirrus Major across 108 zones. Instead of conventional weapons, the defence relies on the energy beamed down by the giant solar platforms that power the planet.
c64:164473.title: Pulse Warrior

c64:164474.description: A no-frills tennis game for one or two players seen from behind the court with a slight 3D effect. Choose from three computer skill levels and matches of one, three or five sets; the shot played depends on the ball's height when struck, and full service rules apply.
c64:164474.title: Pro Tennis Simulator

c64:164486.description: A single-screen shooter: steer a ship along the bottom of the screen and blast waves of aliens arriving from the top in changing formations as the levels progress.
c64:164486.title: Quasar Zone

c64:164487.description: Fly over the planet Osmium in a constantly left-to-right scrolling shooter, destroying the Rexillian Blitztroopers or dodging them while steering clear of terrain obstacles across several levels.
c64:164487.title: Osmium

c64:164488.description: Lead a small strike force into Campuchia, where Lee Ho Fook enslaves the population in his Jade Mines, and destroy the super-tank he is building with parts smuggled in as oil refinery equipment.
c64:164488.title: Operation Hanoi

c64:164489.description: Based on the TV game show: a teammate sketches a common expression drawn literally, such as a light bulb over a head for 'bright idea', and the team has to work out what the picture means.
c64:164489.title: Win, Lose or Draw

aliases: Metamorphosis IV: Labyrinth of the Creator
c64:164521.description: Follow-up to Creator's Revenge. Roam a guarded fortress screen by screen from a top-down view, hunting for three keys that open the room holding a power source needed to reach the Creator's sealed chamber.
c64:164521.title: Labyrinth of the Creator

c64:164526.description: Collect treasures on each screen while dodging monsters, then find the key that both opens the exit and grants spells such as fireballs and teleportation. Puzzle-solving and arcade action are mixed throughout.
c64:164526.title: Wizard

c64:164561.description: Known as Wizardry in Europe. A student magician, Drinn, faces his guild's final exam: recover the First Element from a perilous castle. Isometric action with puzzle elements, with rooms scrolling until a door is passed.
c64:164561.title: Spell of Destruction

c64:164566.description: A Scramble-style side-scrolling shooter; it is really Cave of Death from 1989, hacked and renamed by Eaglewing Software's Dennis van Marstricht and Richard de Groot.
c64:164566.title: COC: Construction of Confusion

c64:164575.description: A typing tutor in game form: letters drift down on parachutes, and typing each one stops it before it lands.
c64:164575.title: Type-Snyper

c64:164671.description: A single-player cricket management game. Pick one of seven national sides and take on the others in short, medium or long tours at home and abroad, covering one-day, three-day and full Test matches, all run through icon menus.
c64:164671.title: World Cricket

c64:164673.description: A football management game: choose a squad, qualify and try to win the World Cup against 40 national teams, scheduling friendlies, coping with injuries and bringing young players through.
c64:164673.title: World Cup

c64:164674.description: A football management game with 240 club sides from 15 countries. The manager's career can move between clubs around the world while chasing league and cup success.
c64:164674.title: World of Soccer

c64:164707.description: Shoot advancing robots while dodging the bombs they leave behind and collecting rubies. The robots never fire, but touching one still costs a life, and levels grow harder as they go.
c64:164707.title: Robots

c64:164710.description: A Polish adventure about escaping an island by applying items at the proper spots or handing them to the right characters. Inventory is unlimited and items cannot be misused; the screen splits into a location view and an information panel.
c64:164710.title: Wyspa

c64:164712.description: A fast arcade shooter from the Arcade Games II pack, fending off attacking Centripods while Dactoes fall and Caruths hop across the screen.
c64:164712.title: Centripod

c64:164714.description: A Qix-style game: draw force fields to box in Kwixx, an energy creature bouncing destructively around the screen, and claim at least 75% of the area by joining lines to the edge or to existing fields.
c64:164714.title: Kwixx

c64:164729.description: A computerised Scrabble board where the host, Monty, joins in as an extra computer player. Players draw letter tiles, form words from a rack of seven and can pass a turn when no word fits.
c64:164729.title: Monty Plays Scrabble

c64:164730.title: The Computer Edition of Scrabble Brand Crossword Game

c64:164741.description: Pong in three dimensions: move a bat both horizontally and vertically to return a ball flying toward it, with a split-screen display giving two different views of the court.
c64:164741.title: Zero Gravity

c64:16476.description: Tom-Tom, now called Wonder Boy, returns to a Wonder Land overrun by monsters. A side-scrolling action game with role-playing touches, where gold from defeated enemies buys weapons, armour and magic in shops.
c64:16476.title: Super Wonder Boy in Monsterland

c64:164765.description: Fly over the five worlds of Alpha Centauri shooting waves of aliens. Giant letters on the ground can be shot to release power-ups such as extra speed, smart bombs and extra lives.
c64:164765.title: ZIP

c64:164767.description: Steer Zoomer, a Pac-Man-like figure with arms and legs, around a grid tracing the edges of squares to light them up. Completing a square scores points, and a level ends once every square is lit.
c64:164767.title: Zoom!

c64:164810.description: A speeded-up Paradroid with improved scrolling code, released only in a double pack with Uridium Plus.
c64:164810.title: Paradroid: Competition Edition

c64:164880.description: A public domain clone of Son of Blagger: software companies have caught all the crackers, and rescuing them means finding six keys while avoiding flowers and mines. Each key collected awards a bonus.
c64:164880.title: Crackers Revenge

c64:165016.description: A homebrew port of Super Mario Bros., made over almost seven years. Run and jump through the Mushroom Kingdom to free the Princess from the Koopa turtles.
c64:165016.title: Super Mario Bros.

c64:165108.description: A text adventure set after a war in which the Orcs' Dark Lord was killed and his armies scattered. One roaming Orc band raided a monastery and carried off religious treasures, the legendary Golden Chalice among them.
c64:165108.title: The Dark Tower

c64:165202.description: A mutant human able to fire energy bolts in eight directions battles the Robotrons, humanity's own creation, room by room. Movement and shooting are controlled separately, also in eight directions.
c64:165202.title: Robotron: 2084

c64:165230.description: Air hockey for two players only: each controls a paddle on their side of the table, knocking the puck toward the opponent's goal. A toss-up decides who starts each game.
c64:165230.title: Retro Ball

c64:165237.description: Build a party of three Warriors or Wizards, buy equipment, then explore a 3D wireframe labyrinth, fighting monsters and gaining experience on the way to a final showdown with the Balrog.
c64:165237.title: Maze Master

c64:165253.description: A warrior king who wanted peace is betrayed by his generals and cursed by their wizard, his body twisted into a beast and his soul stolen, then sealed in a tomb from which he must escape.
c64:165253.title: Soulless

aliases: Mit Jeans & Hellebarde: Vor dem Sturm
c64:165495.title: Mit Jeans und Hellebarde

c64:165557.description: A Sierra graphic adventure starring Ulysses, ordered by the king to find the Golden Fleece. Starting in a small town, he sails to distant lands guarded by the gods and meets figures from Greek mythology.
c64:165557.title: Ulysses and the Golden Fleece

c64:165608.description: Protect the power rail on which the home planet depends from alien invaders, flying a ship left and right at varying speeds in a horizontally scrolling shooter with a crosshair sight.
c64:165608.title: Raskel

c64:165668.title: Count and Add With the Tink Tonks

c64:165670.description: A puzzle quiz for one or two players: each round shows eight names, places or objects with a common link, and the two to six items that don't belong must be removed before time runs out.
c64:165670.title: Quink

c64:165681.description: Play a tadpole in a realistically depicted pond, trying to grow a frog colony while surviving its many natural hazards.
c64:165681.title: Savage Pond

c64:165754.description: Home from a long sea voyage, Ninja Hamster finds his village terrorised by a gang under Sinister Rat and the reptilian Lizard of Death. A one-on-one fighting game against six gang members and then the two bosses.
c64:165754.title: Ninja Hamster

c64:165773.description: An expanded 64K remake of the 2014 P0 Snake, with 30 levels and one-button control: the snake turns clockwise by default and holding fire turns it the other way.
c64:165773.title: P0 Snake

aliases: Hi-Res Adventure #2: The Wizard and the Princess
c64:165774.description: A Sierra graphic adventure set in Serenia, where a wandering traveller hears the town crier read the King's proclamation and takes on the quest to rescue his daughter from a wizard.
c64:165774.title: Wizard and the Princess

c64:166022.description: Fly F-15 missions over Southeast Asia, Europe and the Mideast, dogfighting enemy aircraft and bombing ground targets with modern electronic warfare equipment.
c64:166022.title: F-15 Strike Eagle: International Edition

aliases: Mr. Chip Presents: Pontoon, Roulette & Aces High
c64:166089.description: A set of three gambling games, among them Pontoon, the British relative of blackjack that uses twist, stick and buy instead of hit, stand and double.
c64:166089.title: 3 Games of Chance

c64:166107.description: A graphical roguelike: create a hero by entering a name and picking one of five classes, then explore the Valley, fighting monsters in semi-real-time combat and collecting treasure.
c64:166107.title: The Valley

c64:166109.description: Three-a-side street football with teams picked from neighbourhood kids, each with his own skill. The offence gets four downs to gain ten yards by passing or running, with a quarterback and two receivers.
c64:166109.title: Street Sports Football

c64:166114.description: Earth is under attack by the Terrilon, and one ship stands against them in this side-on shooter. The landscape scrolls steadily as you blast waves of aliens across a series of stages; any collision costs a life.
c64:166114.title: TimeZone: The Challenge Remains

c64:166117.description: Help Micro Mouse defend his programs inside a computer: collect letters from cages in the four corners to fill gaps in a BASIC listing at the screen's centre while dodging software bugs.
c64:166117.title: Micro Mouse Goes De-Bugging

c64:166118.description: Pilot a hot air balloon between bases in a horizontally scrolling game, avoiding clouds, trees, kites, birds and rock-throwing people. Climbing burns fuel, and both fuel and sandbags are scarcer at higher difficulty levels (0-5).
c64:166118.title: Up Up and Away...

c64:166174.description: As Oscar, enter the clifftop research station of The Brotherhood, who have raised The Master and his minions, and put an end to the vampire and his blood-drinking servants.
c64:166174.title: One Bite Too Deep

c64:166227.description: Drive a speedboat towing a waterskier around a buoyed course for six laps, avoiding mines and ramps with the boat and keeping both boat and skier inside the markers.
c64:166227.title: Waterski 3D

c64:166228.description: Aliens have overrun the Regulus system and taken hostages. A vertically scrolling shooter in five levels: break through the outer defences, then fight across jungle, ice and desert planets toward the alien stronghold.
c64:166228.title: Light Force

c64:166247.description: A party-based fantasy role-playing game in a medieval land where a mysterious addictive drug is spreading. The heroes trace it to a single source run by an enigmatic stranger and set out to stop him.
c64:166247.title: Spirit of Adventure

c64:166250.description: A short adventure from Adventure Pack 1: a meteor is hurtling toward the moon base, and unless it is destroyed every lunar colony will be wiped out.
c64:166250.title: Moon Base Alpha

aliases: Le mille e una ora di Asterix
c64:166324.title: Asterix and the Magic Carpet

c64:166373.description: Sammy Lightfoot leaps over obstacles, bounces on trampolines and swings on ropes to climb to the top of each screen without falling into gaps. After three levels the cycle repeats at a higher difficulty.
c64:166373.title: Sammy Lightfoot

c64:166374.description: Zenos, a woman starpilot passed over for the Ace Starpilot post of Zigmundia, steals the retired ace's Tesscan starfighter to show the federation its supposedly unbeatable defence system can be broken.
c64:166374.title: Zenos

c64:166399.title: Can you find... The Real You?

c64:166401.description: Ship-versus-ship space combat between the Alliance of Free Stars and the Ur-Quan Hierarchy, where each side fields its own warship types, every vessel with distinct weapons and abilities.
c64:166401.title: Star Control

c64:166402.description: Released as Sun Star in Europe. Fly a solar energy collector around 16 grids in space from a first-person view with a radar below, gathering ten energy crystals on each grid.
c64:166402.title: Solar Star

c64:166419.description: An Infocom murder mystery: as a reporter framed for a killing at a costume party, find evidence of innocence before the police close in, while the real killer watches.
c64:166419.title: Suspect

c64:166420.description: An Infocom detective story set near Los Angeles on a stormy February night in 1938. A wealthy, frightened man asks for police protection, a death follows anyway, and the detective has only twelve hours to crack the case and make an arrest.
c64:166420.title: The Witness

c64:166423.description: A homebrew remake of Mine Storm from the Vectrex, which was itself modelled on Atari's Asteroids: pilot a ship and shoot drifting space mines.
c64:166423.title: MineStorm

c64:166432.description: Infocom's sequel to Planetfall. The hero, promoted to Lieutenant First Class in the Stellar Patrol and buried in paperwork, is sent on a routine errand to a space station that turns out to be strangely deserted.
c64:166432.title: Stationfall

c64:166449.description: Find hidden words in a grid of letters against the clock, with several difficulty levels and over forty themes. Part of The Complete Home Entertainment Centre.
c64:166449.title: Wordsearch

c64:166489.description: A diary program for 1989 that shows the date and time along with facts about each day, plus extras such as weather, a horoscope and a daily snack recipe.
c64:166489.title: Computer Maniacs 1989 Diary

c64:166540.description: The Creator has raised an army of robots and insects and is bombing the world's great cities. Drive a tank against his forces and stop each bomb before it lands; followed by Labyrinth of the Creator.
c64:166540.title: Creators Revenge

c64:166558.description: Isometric single-screen puzzle in which Dexter, Merlin's assistant, hops over a set of cubes. Pressing fire flips the colour of the cube he stands on and its neighbours, and every red cube must be made yellow.
c64:166558.title: Merlin's Puzzle

c64:166562.description: Ski downhill past odd hazards such as rabbits and snowmobiles that cut across the slope; after a crash, a dog comes to the rescue. Included in the Cymbal Software compilation 3 Arcade Games - Book 2.
c64:166562.title: Ski-Devil

c64:166611.description: A Snake variant by Shaun Southern with extra obstacles, including animated mechanical devices such as robots. Released on the Triple Decker 8 compilation from Alternative Software.
c64:166611.title: Super Snake Simulator

c64:166707.description: Waddingtons' version of Monopoly with the full board game rules and the London street names. Up to six human or computer players buy property, build houses and hotels and try to bankrupt each other.
c64:166707.title: Deluxe Monopoly

c64:166825.title: Die Erben des Throns: Krieg um die Krone II

aliases: Die Kristallgrotte: This is E.F. IGES
This is E.F. IGES: Interactive Game Editor System
c64:166846.description: Two programs in one: a multi-directional scrolling shooter, and a game creator that uses the shooter as a base for making new games. The game is in English, while the creator is in German.
c64:166846.title: This is E.F. IGES

c64:166852.description: From the author of Space Taxi, a three-part ambulance rescue game. First drive through a maze of city houses to a burning building without hitting houses or other vehicles, racing a timer that counts down from 1000.
c64:166852.title: Rescue Squad

c64:166923.description: Licensed from the kids' TV show Round the Bend, set in a comic factory. Doc Croc has destroyed the press, so Lou Brush has to travel the sewers to recover all eight missing pages.
c64:166923.title: Doc Croc's Outrageous Adventures!: Round the Bend!

c64:166945.description: A tiny early text adventure from On-Line Systems: an astronaut must launch a rocket to destroy an asteroid heading for Earth, but first needs to obtain the flight plan. Commands are one or two words.
c64:166945.title: Mission Asteroid

c64:167014.description: A memory card game with an editable deck: besides the supplied cards you can load other sets, or paint your own in Amica Paint by editing the card picture, whose right-hand card sets the pattern on the backs.
c64:167014.title: Mindbreaker

c64:167048.description: Rescue Maid Marian from the Sheriff of Nottingham's castle, crossing several screens with different objectives, starting with a trek through Sherwood Forest full of henchmen, and take gold for the poor along the way.
c64:167048.title: Robin Hood

c64:167053.description: A variant of Go on a hexagonal board of 21 lines forming triangles, with 55 points for stones. Up to four players take turns placing stones and try to capture each other's.
c64:167053.title: TrianGO

c64:167235.title: The Duel: Test Drive II Car Disk: The Muscle Cars

c64:167236.title: The Duel: Test Drive II Car Disk: The Supercars

aliases: Eis und Feuer Teil 1: Der Magier
c64:167256.title: Eis und Feuer: Der Magier

c64:167366.description: Fly a small, advanced fighter escorting a massive bomber on its way to wipe out the hostile navy in the Persian Gulf. The fighter can create false radar images to stay hidden and keep the bomber unharmed.
c64:167366.title: Silent Shadow

c64:167471.description: Bounce laser beams off mirrors and deflectors to hit target points, an idea that predates Deflektor by four years. Part of Commodore's Fantasy Five collection.
c64:167471.title: Photon Reflection

c64:167474.description: A simulation of English billiards for two players, using two cue balls, one for each player, and a single object ball.
c64:167474.title: Spatial Billiards

c64:167489.description: A hacked version of Krakout by Met with tougher levels and faster play.
c64:167489.title: Aargh Krakout

c64:167497.description: An educational game for children: plan the cheapest, shortest pipe network to connect a neighbourhood's houses to the water supply, choosing pipe types and placement on a tight budget. The number of houses is selectable.
c64:167497.title: Pipes

c64:167538.description: Geologists at a research base are being abducted by aliens. A single-screen shooter: slide a craft along the bottom of the screen, firing upward at waves of aliens while trying to save the scientists.
c64:167538.title: Fiends

c64:167556.description: An educational package based on the cartoon The Shoe People, with a simple paint program and five mini-games such as Trampy Visits His Friends, where objects he trips over must be named by typing.
c64:167556.title: First Class with the Shoe People

c64:167588.description: The space pirate Torsul threatens to plunder the minerals of the peaceful planet Quarx unless its people prove their worth at his computer puzzle game. As their chosen champion you must reach his points target, since missing it by a single point means enslavement.
c64:167588.title: Quarx

c64:167594.description: Guide a mouse around platforms, clouds, moving ledges and ladders collecting cheese, cakes and balloons, jumping flowers and dodging bouncing balls and dinosaurs, any of which costs a life on contact.
c64:167594.title: Mouse Quest

c64:167611.title: Fun School 3: for 5 to 7 Year Olds

c64:167621.title: Fun School 4: For 5 to 7 Year Olds

c64:167622.title: Fun School 4: for 7 to 11 Year Olds

c64:167689.description: A graphic adventure based on the 1980s TV series. As Super Gran, track down Scunner Campbell, who has stolen valuables from Chisleton's museum and Town Hall, and recover them.
c64:167689.title: Super Gran: The Adventure

aliases: Heroes & Cowards: Das Pentagramm der Macht
c64:167749.title: Heroes & Cowards: The Pentagram of Power

c64:167816.description: A Boulder Dash clone squeezed into 1024 bytes: collect enough diamonds to open the exit while avoiding falling boulders and fireflies. The author says it contains 1024 levels.
c64:167816.title: 1k-Mini-Bdash

c64:167863.description: A phrase-guessing game modelled on Wheel of Fortune: spin a carnival wheel to set the cash prize and solve Hangman-like word puzzles. Part of Keypunch's Club Casino pack.
c64:167863.title: Spin to Win

c64:168010.description: Collects all three Ket adventures: Mountains of Ket, then Temple of Vran, then The Final Mission. Interactive fiction with role-playing elements where prowess, energy and luck develop, items are bought from merchants or found, and combat occurs.
c64:168010.title: The Ket Trilogy

c64:168087.description: A collection of new Kikstart motorbike courses built with the Kikstart Construction Set by Nitro and The Illusion.
c64:168087.title: Kikstart III

c64:168089.description: A conversion of the C16 Kikstart, the motorbike stunt game: steer the rider quickly and carefully over obstacle courses, alone against the clock.
c64:168089.title: Kikstart C16

c64:168116.description: A platformer set inside the mountain of the spiders: collect the keys while keeping away from the arachnids.
c64:168116.title: Spiders

c64:168117.description: Based on the Greek legend: Icarus flies on wings of feathers and wax in search of his father Daedalus, crossing the Greek countryside while dodging the evil Roc and giant bees.
c64:168117.title: Little Icarus

c64:168138.title: Electric Crayon Deluxe: At the Zoo

c64:168187.description: An educational reasoning program for upper-elementary pupils and older: uncover the king's hidden rules by forming hypotheses, testing them and weighing alternative explanations for the patterns observed.
c64:168187.title: The King's Rule: Mathematics and Discovery

aliases: Erben des Throns II: Krieg um die Krone
c64:168214.title: Krieg um die Krone

c64:168320.description: Compete as a contestant on the TV quiz The Krypton Factor, facing rounds testing different mental skills; in Observation, a story and picture are shown again with subtle changes that must be identified.
c64:168320.title: The Krypton Factor

c64:168355.description: A licensed squash game for one or two players with four difficulty levels and realistic rebounds, with Jonah Barrington calling the score.
c64:168355.title: Jonah Barrington's Squash

c64:168398.description: Illustrated adventure blending Greek myths, in which you direct both Jason and Hercules through a three-part labyrinth full of traps and monsters to reach the Golden Fleece at its centre.
c64:168398.title: Labyrinth of Crete

c64:168406.title: Rocky Memphis: The Legend of Atlantis

c64:168424.title: From Out of a Dark Night Sky

c64:168554.description: Based on François Bourgeon's comic series and closely following its plot. On the eve of the French Revolution, Hoel and Isa end up in Brittany and journey from Europe to the African coast, facing many dangers.
c64:168554.title: Passengers on the Wind

c64:168557.description: A graphical adventure by Australian writer Daryll Reynolds that mixes PETSCII and custom characters with animated sprites and sound. It begins with a delirious explorer staggering out of the jungle raving about King Solomon's mines.
c64:168557.title: The Search for King Solomon's Mines

aliases: Kingdom of Myrrh: Olin in Emerald
c64:168568.description: An educational treasure hunt for children covering reading, map skills and decision making. Collect clues to rescue King Olin of Myrrh from the sorcerer Vargor, with Anara the wise woman as guide.
c64:168568.title: Olin in Emerald: Kingdom of Myrrh

aliases: Attack of the Tomato: Angriff der Killertomaten
c64:168570.title: Attack of the Tomato

c64:168571.description: Alien hatcheries drift toward Earth, their eggs cracking open to release monsters. As the lone fighter pilot, smash every egg as it hatches so that no creature escapes.
c64:168571.title: Star Eggs

c64:168572.description: Pilot a laser-armed spaceship and destroy enough enemy craft to move on to the next, tougher level. Touching an enemy costs a life.
c64:168572.title: Ollo

c64:168586.description: Adventure based on a legend: the knight Tristan must rescue Isolde from the castle of the wicked Baron Wumper of Wummerstein, where magic shoes let him fly.
c64:168586.title: Tristan and Isolde

c64:168602.description: Alf Yngve's SEUCK shoot-'em-up casts you as a UNICEF aid worker, equipped with a rifle and bulletproof vest, who went missing for five years while vaccinating isolated tribes deep in South America's rain forest.
c64:168602.title: The Last Amazon

c64:168603.description: Psytronik collection of Alf Yngve's Last Amazon shoot 'em ups: enhanced versions of parts one and two with weapon power-ups, a sideways-scrolling Special Edition remix, and Richard Bayliss's bonus game Amazon Tales.
c64:168603.title: The Last Amazon Trilogy

c64:168615.description: A platform game set in rat-infested sewers, where the hero must cut down the rat population while avoiding a furious monster that is fond of the rodents.
c64:168615.title: Ratsplat

c64:168700.description: Penniless in the Skintsville Saloon, Luke Warme hears an Indian chief has died and been buried with his gold. He drives his wagon off in search of the grave to see whether the legend is true.
c64:168700.title: The Legend of the Apache Gold

c64:168774.description: A text adventure in a castle and its grounds, full of monsters, mazes and magic items. The right objects must be gathered before facing Fordel, the Leopard Lord, with no second chance. Written by a science fiction author for Kayde.
c64:168774.title: Leopard Lord

c64:168778.description: A Dutch spelling game with about two thousand words, for ages 8 to 80. In Woord-Zeppelin you bomb letters in an orange landscape to build the word shown top left, while wrong letters cost a bomb and bring an enemy zeppelin; in Ladders en Monsters you run across floors collecting letters in order, and mistakes set monsters on you.
c64:168778.title: Letterstress

c64:168785.description: A menu-driven strategy game of the Punic Wars between Rome and Carthage, concentrating on naval battles, including the Roman boarding tactics that used their strong infantry against ramming ships.
c64:168785.title: Legions of Death

c64:168798.description: A karate tournament against six qualified opponents, closely modelled on Karate Kid II. Released in Italy as Scontro Finale and as Ito Joshi.
c64:168798.title: The Last Fight

c64:168799.description: Enter the Colosseum as a gladiator or gladiatrix. Each level begins with picking up a weapon, then strange creatures come into the arena singly and must be killed.
c64:168799.title: The Last Gladiator

c64:168827.description: Rebels set out to destroy Lincoln, a supercomputer ruling the universe that demands women as sacrifices. Its stages cover hopping hidden capsules between planets on transport ships, sniping defence systems so they can land, freeing the captives with a flute-playing creature, and infiltrating the city to plant nine viruses.
c64:168827.title: Lincoln

c64:168829.description: A strategy game about Operation Deadstick in the early hours of D-Day, when British 6th Airborne troops landed by glider at night to seize the bridges over the Caen Canal and the Orne.
c64:168829.title: Pegasus Bridge

c64:168835.description: Command the Enterprise through ten levels of multiple rounds, fighting Klingon fighters and other threats, before a final confrontation with NOMAD to save the Federation.
c64:168835.title: Star Trek: Strategic Operations Simulator

c64:168890.description: An educational logic game: get Buddy or Betty down through a five-floor building from the roof to the ground by flying a bird that sets down bridges, springs, walls and ladders on the route.
c64:168890.title: Linking Logic

c64:168893.description: Trivia combined with bowling for one or two players: each little person bowls on a six-pin lane, with two balls per frame over ten frames.
c64:168893.title: Little People Bowling Alley

c64:168894.description: Railroad switching strategy on a small layout with a main line, six switches and seven places to load cars, in either a Flat Yard or a Hump Yard version, with detailed simulation of car movement.
c64:168894.title: Locomotive Switcher

c64:168895.description: Direct the Magic Hand to place walls, bridges and springs in a maze so that a rolling ball hits as many prizes as possible.
c64:168895.title: Logic Levels

c64:168896.description: The last survivor of a company rides into hostile desert territory and enters an Indian camp's cave to free comrades taken prisoner.
c64:168896.title: Lonely Rider

c64:168897.description: Steer a constantly swaying balloon, fighting gravity, along a path from its start point to a landing pad, picking up every object on the screen first. Each level is a single side-view screen.
c64:168897.title: Looney Balloon

c64:168916.description: An illustrated text adventure: an explorer in the South American jungle searches a lost Mayan city for ten valuable relics hidden in its buildings and temples, among traps and red herrings.
c64:168916.title: The Lost City

c64:168917.description: A top-down maze: find staircases to climb through the labyrinth's levels and reach the exit. Bumping into a creature switches to a close-up battle that must be won.
c64:168917.title: Lost in the Labyrinth

c64:168920.description: A Uridium-style space shooter: command a powerful ship patrolling sectors held by alien fleets, each sector closer to the fleet's core and harder. Released in Italy as Planet Six.
c64:168920.title: The Last Survivor

c64:168922.description: Pilot a small glider through a sprawling underground labyrinth of hell, picking up energy symbols, recharging at refuelling pads, braving teleporters, timed energy barriers and magnetic fields, and hunting hidden keys that open locked gates.
c64:168922.title: Xiphoids

c64:168961.description: Spin-off of the ITV series Magic Micro Mission. The first part is a cockpit shooter in which a crosshair is lined up on flying saucers sweeping across the screen on elliptical paths.
c64:168961.title: The Magic Micro Mission

c64:168992.description: Two basketball games in one: a realistic version with a saveable league for one or two players, and a faster game with Flow-Control for easier shooting. Shot clock, match length and team kits are adjustable, with three skill levels.
c64:168992.title: Omni-Play Basketball

c64:169002.description: A kit for hosting a murder mystery party, the parlour game where guests play characters, receive clues in turns and try to work out the culprit.
c64:169002.title: Make Your Own Murder Party

c64:169005.description: Secret agent Uri Kurchatovium must find and eliminate a C.R.O.W. agent whose formula would turn Americans into zombies, but the adventure begins after his lemonade is drugged at Zazas.
c64:169005.title: The Man from G.R.A.N.N.Y.

c64:169006.description: Guide Manchester United through the European club competitions, either playing the matches directly or picking the team and letting the computer decide the result. Sequel to Krisalis' Manchester United.
c64:169006.title: Manchester United Europe

c64:169017.description: A side-view fighting game defending the land from the forces of Sanjo, with special weapons such as blinding powder, throwing stars and katanas, and a practice mode beforehand. Paragon's first commercial release.
c64:169017.title: Master Ninja: Shadow Warrior of Death

c64:169020.description: A mystical knight able to vanish into walls and pass through doors evades tracker robots that pursue him relentlessly, in a mix of skill and strategy.
c64:169020.title: Master of Camouflage

c64:169050.description: A maze game with platform and shooting sections, played as a series of mini-games, in which an agent recovers stolen top secret papers.
c64:169050.title: The Man from N-10

c64:169061.description: An educational history quiz: Earth's past has been erased, and a time-machine pilot moves across a 3D field locating time holograms to record historical events.
c64:169061.title: Masters of Time

c64:169064.description: A typing tutor set in space: the MasterType wizard defends a command ship in the middle of the screen from missiles launched from the four corners, each destroyed by typing the word or letters attached to it.
c64:169064.title: MasterType: The Typing Instruction Game

c64:169072.description: Mathematics combined with racing: steer a formula car from above through a network of forks, where each branch's sign applies an arithmetic operation to the mileage, aiming for the target in the best route.
c64:169072.title: Math Mileage

c64:169073.description: Goofy climbs the Matterhorn in a side-scrolling jumping game, scaling ropes and leaping to ledges, empty bobsleds and gondolas, and hopping over goats and snowmen; icicles and crumbling ledges appear at higher levels.
c64:169073.title: Matterhorn Screamer!

c64:169080.description: Golf from overhead: aim by placing the golfer's stance around the ball, then pick a club, one of five shot strengths from light to strong, and the amount of curve, with wind and terrain affecting the result.
c64:169080.title: Maxi Golf

c64:169082.description: Find the treasure in a randomly generated, edgeless maze of about 100 locations and carry it back to the start. Prisoners give directions, food and swords help, and the maze is roamed by Maziacs.
c64:169082.title: Maziacs

c64:169177.description: A short illustrated text adventure for children: on Christmas Eve at the North Pole, solve simple puzzles so Santa can finish his preparations and get the presents delivered in time.
c64:169177.title: Merry Christmas from Melbourne House

c64:169179.description: Three Metallamas are all that stand between the Zzyaxians and outpost OP/37 on the galaxy's rim, which the invaders want as a launching point for their attack.
c64:169179.title: Metagalactic Llamas: Battle at the Edge of Time

c64:169183.description: Solid Snake infiltrates Outer Heaven, a fortified nation led by a secretive war hero, to stop Metal Gear, a nuclear-armed walking tank. A top-down stealth action game where avoiding guards matters as much as fighting.
c64:169183.title: Metal Gear

aliases: Metamorphosis II: Earth Warrior: Attack on Cyglorx
c64:169203.description: Four single-screen stages inside the Creator's fortress. On the first, reach the exit at the top while robots roam and leave impassable walls behind them; the goal is to destroy the Creator and his robots.
c64:169203.title: Metamorphosis

c64:169259.title: MicroLeague Baseball 1987 NL and AL Teams

c64:169260.description: Baseball management with real stats for pitching, hitting, fielding and running. Manage famous teams from past and present, with a Quick-Play option menu.
c64:169260.title: MicroLeague Baseball II

c64:169263.description: Coach an American football team: choose home and visiting sides, each human or computer, adjust rosters, then call plays and pass patterns during the game.
c64:169263.title: MicroLeague Football: The Coach's Challenge

c64:169378.description: Jet combat over MiG Alley in the Korean War, where F-86 Sabres battled Soviet MiG-15s near the Chinese border in the first large jet-versus-jet air battles.
c64:169378.title: MiG Alley Ace

c64:169404.description: A Centipede-style shooter: move a ship left, right and a short distance up and down at the bottom of the screen, firing at a Millibug that splits apart each time it is hit.
c64:169404.title: Millie-Bug

c64:169410.description: Software by Timothy Leary for mapping thoughts on a scope, comparing them with others and role-playing, usable as a party game along the lines of Scruples.
c64:169410.title: Timothy Leary's Mind Mirror

c64:169412.description: A trivia game for one to four players on various subjects, with three modes: race to a points target, score as much as possible against the clock, or play on a board moving by dice rolls.
c64:169412.title: Mind Pursuit

c64:169431.description: As a starship captain, warp between quadrants, dock for repairs and take on a Klingon war fleet with phasers and torpedoes while the warp drive, scanners and torpedo systems suffer damage. Probes scout ahead, stars can go supernova, and wiping out the fleet saves the universe.
c64:169431.title: Mind Warp

c64:169445.description: An abstract sliding-block puzzle with 999,999 levels: use a crosshair to rearrange up to 24 dice-like spotted blocks, stacked in columns of up to four, so each column matches its number.
c64:169445.title: Mindtrap

c64:169621.description: A Centipede-inspired shooter in a summer garden: blast the mutant mushroom monster Minipede to clear each of 15 levels, and shoot spiders, snails and ladybirds for extra score.
c64:169621.title: Minipedes

c64:169642.description: A text adventure with role-playing statistics such as life energy, spell points and armour class: explore a village, canyons, woods and caves, face a stone golem and the fierce Om-nivore, and rise to spellmaster or lord to learn the secret password.
c64:169642.title: Mission Om

c64:169647.description: Follow-up to Mission 1: Project Volcano, a mostly text adventure with some pictures. A Soviet spy has got inside a nuclear complex on Gibraltar; enter the secure zone, learn what the Blue Room hides and remove the agent.
c64:169647.title: Mission 2: Project Gibraltar

c64:169680.description: Fly an Eagle craft low over the lunar surface to protect moon bases from enemy time bombs, grabbing them quickly and dumping them in the fusion disposal site before they explode.
c64:169680.title: Moon Crisis 1999

c64:169692.description: An experimental piece by Jaron Lanier in which a spacewalker and six bouncing spaceships drift across the screen, and the player's movements both steer the action and generate the music.
c64:169692.title: Moondust

c64:169731.description: Rescue Princess Lalena from the Dark Lord across four levels of flick-screen platforming, armed with a sword against creatures that sap energy on contact.
c64:169731.title: Moontorc

c64:169733.description: Drive and fly the transforming car Morphicle to find and defuse a bomb that threatens the world. Each level has three parts, starting with a road drive in search of an underground compound's entrance.
c64:169733.title: Morphicle

c64:169734.description: MOT, a three-metre monster with horns and a tail who roams time and space at will, has taken to hiding in the hero's cupboard and wrecking the furniture around the house.
c64:169734.title: MOT

c64:169742.description: Motocross racing through three timed scenes with different viewpoints, starting with a desert stage seen from behind the bike, where rocks, cacti and scorpions must be avoided.
c64:169742.title: Motocross Racer

c64:169747.description: Manage a motorcycle racing team in Grand Prix world championship seasons, choosing the team and main sponsor and aiming for both the riders' title and the Constructors' Championship.
c64:169747.title: Motorcycle 500

c64:169748.description: An illustrated text adventure about a motorcycle rally that starts and ends at Ariel Castle, where the rider searches the countryside for the Award, using found objects and equipment in the right places.
c64:169748.title: Motorcycle Crazy

c64:169749.description: A tricky text adventure that starts on a mountain ledge beside the entrance to a lost palace in a mythical land, rumoured to hold great riches and full of odd surprises.
c64:169749.title: Mountain Palace Adventure

c64:169809.description: A musical movie-making kit: pick locations such as the city, the jungle or outer space, cast the three Jazz Scats (Mr. Bassman, Wahoo and Swivel Hips) and compose the score for each film.
c64:169809.title: Movie Musical Madness

c64:169810.description: Move a snowman around single-screen platforms collecting snowballs against the clock to build three giant snowmen while dodging killer penguins.
c64:169810.title: Mr. Frosty and the Killer Penguins

c64:169814.description: Mr Wino, stuck in a drunken nightmare, must pick up every bottle on each multi-screen level to lift the barrier blocking the way out; some bottles also open doors on the way. A flick-screen platformer.
c64:169814.title: Mr Wino

c64:169815.description: A Mr. Do! variant: guide a wizard around a garden eating cherries and dodging gremlins, defeating them with a thrown crystal ball or by dropping apples on them.
c64:169815.title: Mr. Wiz

c64:169816.description: Mrs. Mop must clean a terrible school section by section while pupils, teachers and dogs attack her. Her back worsens as she works, and when it gives out she is off for a week, though she has weapons to fight back.
c64:169816.title: Mrs. Mop

c64:169817.description: Based on MTV's game show: three human or computer contestants answer questions about TV, films and their stars over two board rounds, followed by a rapid-fire final round.
c64:169817.title: MTV Remote Control

c64:169818.description: Football management for up to four players over four divisions of 16 clubs, each with squads of up to 16; every manager starts at a randomly assigned Division 4 club.
c64:169818.title: Multi-Player Soccer Manager

c64:169820.description: A menu-driven detective game aboard the French liner Bourgogne in 1938, where wealthy passengers and spies after new computer technology mix, and two murders must be solved.
c64:169820.title: Murder on the Atlantic

c64:169824.description: A Centipede-inspired shooter: after overnight rain, mushrooms have sprung up in the garden and insects are moving in, so move along and slightly up and down the bottom of the screen shooting them.
c64:169824.title: Mushroom Alley

c64:170877.description: A farmer arrives at his field one morning to find every sheep gone, and has to track them all down in this typed-command text adventure.
c64:170877.title: The Mystery of the Lost Sheep

c64:170879.description: A short Magnetic Scrolls text adventure set in ancient Greece: as Poseidon, journey into the Underworld to obtain the Dark Helmet of Hades.
c64:170879.title: Myth

c64:170907.description: The first computer game based on C.S. Lewis's first Narnia novel, packaged with the book, game cards and dice used in play. The witch has put Narnia under ice and dispatched wicked dwarves to stop the player.
c64:170907.title: Narnia

c64:170908.description: A Dutch game in which a scuba diver collects every key on a level before escaping.
c64:170908.title: Nautilus

c64:170909.description: A strategic and tactical simulation of the 1942 Guadalcanal naval battle, commanding the US Navy's task force, its aircraft squadrons and ships against the Japanese.
c64:170909.title: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal

c64:170920.description: Command a naval cruiser in the Persian Gulf on one of three missions (escorting a convoy, patrolling, or Dawn of Death), protecting shipping and destroying hostile forces.
c64:170920.title: Navcom 6: The Persian Gulf Defense

c64:170931.description: A statistics-driven basketball simulation with animated play, coaching pro teams based on player data from the bundled 1985-86 season disk.
c64:170931.title: NBA

c64:170934.description: Illustrated text adventure set on an orbiting cemetery staffed by robots, whose chief Arch-mandroid has begun building weapons to attack a disarmed Earth. You are a special forces agent smuggled aboard in a coffin to stop him.
c64:170934.title: Necris Dome

c64:170935.description: As Illuminar the wizard, fight the necromancer Tetragorn and his spiders, ogres and Hammerfists across three stages, steering a long-range Wisp from the centre of the screen.
c64:170935.title: Necromancer

c64:171041.description: Cross a park from top to bottom through a simple maze, viewed from above; points along the way trigger random single-screen mini-games.
c64:171041.title: Nightmare Park

c64:171050.description: An icon-driven adventure with pointers and drop-down menus, 110 locations, animated graphics, over 35 objects to examine, interactive characters and built-in arcade sequences, centred on an inhuman killer.
c64:171050.title: NO

c64:171069.description: Strategy with light role-playing and trading: the old king's son must find five magic rings to defeat the sorceress Medusa, who has seized the kingdom.
c64:171069.title: Rings of Medusa

c64:171094.description: Terrorists have taken hostages on a North Sea oil platform and hidden a nuclear bomb. A special agent has 30 minutes and several weapons to free the captives and disarm it.
c64:171094.title: North Sea Inferno

c64:171129.description: An enhanced version of Not Even Human: two players each control a squad of eight small aliens, switching between them one at a time, in quick battles across single-screen arenas.
c64:171129.title: Not Even Human: Inhumane Edition

c64:171147.description: MASTA, the NORAD supercomputer, has taken over the nuclear defence system and is about to start a global war; only the absent-minded, recently fired Dr. Norton sees the danger.
c64:171147.title: Nuclearwar Games

c64:171296.description: A 3D space shooter with three-axis control: a split screen shows the instrument panel and the view of space while invading ships are destroyed and their fire avoided.
c64:171296.title: Perplexian Challenger

c64:171297.description: An Epyx turn-based strategy game for up to eight players, played with a physical board and 200 pieces: survey terrain from arctic to desert, pick drilling sites and strike oil to build the largest fortune.
c64:171297.title: Oil Barons

c64:171318.description: Move a crosshair around single-screen levels to shoot abstract-shaped Oisac soldiers that appear in the centre and head for the edges before they escape.
c64:171318.title: Oisac

c64:171320.description: Fly a UFO armed with lasers for approaching aircraft and bombs for ground targets, levelling enough buildings and ground defences to advance without losing a life.
c64:171320.title: Ollo II: The Final Conflict

c64:171382.description: A one-day international cricket tournament between Australia, England, New Zealand and the West Indies, played under floodlights at the M.C.G., batting to keep up the run rate.
c64:171382.title: One Day Cricket

c64:171383.description: Captured after crash-landing on the alien world Oo-Topos with valuable cargo bound for Earth, escape from prison, recover the cargo and patch up the ship to leave. Interactive fiction with optional graphics.
c64:171383.title: Oo-Topos

c64:171384.description: A spelling game: each everyday word spelled correctly opens Ali Baba's treasure cave door a little further, while mistakes bring the forty thieves leaping out.
c64:171384.title: Open Sesame

c64:171386.description: A text adventure about a chorus singer suddenly lifted out of obscurity to sing at the Palace Theatre, where the National Opera Company is based, whose dream of stardom gets complicated soon after arrival.
c64:171386.title: Opera House

c64:171387.description: A text adventure: the expedition camp lies in ruins, Lord Townsend is dead, and the only other person who knows the radio frequency for rescue, Kate Mallender, has been carried off by the QA tribesmen.
c64:171387.title: QA!

c64:171392.description: In 1942, captain a lone submarine near an Allied Mediterranean landing site and sink as many enemy ships and shoot down as many planes as possible before they can strike the invasion convoy.
c64:171392.title: Operation Swordfish

aliases: The Sesame Street Crayon: Opposites Attract
c64:171409.title: Opposites Attract

c64:171415.description: Based on the CITV puppet show: Cheep helps Orm organise his birthday party in three parts, with a reaction test at the start setting the difficulty.
c64:171415.title: Orm and Cheep: The Birthday Party

c64:171417.description: Four mini-games starring the CITV puppets Orm the worm and Cheep the bird: three single-screen side-view stages and a final vertically scrolling one.
c64:171417.title: Orm and Cheep: Narrow Squeaks

c64:171428.description: A flick-screen platformer based on Jack and the Beanstalk: climb the beanstalk, hop across clouds and search the Giant's 23-screen castle for the golden harp, golden egg and bag of gold.
c64:171428.title: Out on a Limb

c64:171430.description: Hop Alex from cube to cube to colour every one while dodging gumdrops, Grody the Witch, Buzzbat, Eraser Rabbit and Croak the Frog; ride a cloud to melt the witch with rain or hit Buzzbat with lightning.
c64:171430.title: Over the Rainbow

c64:171433.description: Educational arithmetic with Paddington Bear: help him through a muddled shopping trip from 32 Windsor Gardens by working out simple sums.
c64:171433.title: Paddington's Shopping Mix-Up

c64:171434.description: A Paddington Bear storybook-and-cassette pack for young children: left in charge of Mr Gruber's antique shop for the morning, Paddington drops one of the pictures, which turns out to be a mosaic.
c64:171434.title: Paddington's Problem Picture

c64:171447.description: A paddle-controlled game that placed third in the 2011 16KB cartridge competition: keep Redhead alive in his cave by catching falling water droplets and fireballs.
c64:171447.title: Panic Analogue

c64:171448.description: As Agent X, walk forward along the roofs of 14 carriages, one per screen, to reach the engine and halt a runaway train before the enemy gets hold of it, all against the clock.
c64:171448.title: Panic Express

c64:171461.description: Tactical WWII simulation of small unit combat on the Eastern Front, in North Africa and in Western Front campaigns without US forces, with over 250 weapon types modelled.
c64:171461.title: Panzer Strike!

c64:171465.description: Command 25 armoured and infantry platoons on the WWII Eastern Front, advancing across randomly generated maps full of ambush points; survivors carry over to the next encounter.
c64:171465.title: Panzer-Jagd

c64:171466.description: A solitaire strategic simulation of Germany's 1941 invasion of the Soviet Union: direct the whole Axis force and take objectives within 24 weeks while destroying the Soviet army.
c64:171466.title: Panzers East!

c64:171474.description: Swim Parky through underwater rooms gathering gold tokens against the clock, avoiding sea creatures such as crabs, jellyfish, clams and stingrays; several rooms have multiple exits, so routes vary.
c64:171474.title: Parky and the Yellow Submarine

c64:171498.description: A single-screen shooter: Heinz 'Hurricane' Solo uses a Sauce Squirter with limited Pasta Powda to stop the Pasta Pinchas carrying off six ravioli tins. The ship rotates freely and drifts on when thrust is released.
c64:171498.title: Pasta Wars: Pasta Blasta

c64:171500.description: A first-person space shooter from the cockpit of the last scout ship in a squadron after an alien attack, with twin forward lasers and limited shields against waves of enemy fighters.
c64:171500.title: The Last Warrior

c64:171506.description: A puzzle game in which a bulldozer driver pushes lemons into rows next to each other to complete each level.
c64:171506.title: Lemon Blues

c64:171508.description: Leppard, a diamond-collecting robot, must gather twenty diamonds in a labyrinth to reach the next level while four hostile pursuers try to touch him.
c64:171508.title: Leppard

c64:171512.description: A Bomberman-style game: bomb every target and ghost to clear a level. While any target remains, each destroyed ghost is replaced by another, returning ghosts are tougher, and a timer runs throughout.
c64:171512.title: Lethal Bombs

c64:171513.description: A sequel to the 1988 shooter Lethal by the same team, now playing like Bounder but with horizontal scrolling.
c64:171513.title: Lethal II

c64:171514.description: A German R-Type-style horizontal shooter: fly a spaceship blasting enemy craft and obstacles while dodging enemy fire and the cave surfaces.
c64:171514.title: Lethal Zone

c64:171516.description: Guide gyrocopters through caves, avoiding blocks, falling weights, walls and trolley cars; any collision costs one of six lives and restarts the cave. Released in Italy as Sea Chopper.
c64:171516.title: Lex Feareon

c64:171520.description: A small text adventure with a verb-noun parser where the first puzzle is working out whether the vessel you escaped was a spaceship or a cruise liner.
c64:171520.title: Lifeboat

c64:171529.description: In 2197, alien infiltration has wiped out all life on Platar. Starting aboard the mother ship beside a teleporter to the base Amigar, find the aliens and destroy them if they prove hostile.
c64:171529.title: Lifeform

c64:171536.description: A Children's Television Workshop thinking game: build and control energy networks, experiment with how they behave and guide the Light-riders to the source.
c64:171536.title: Light-waves

c64:171537.description: A side-scrolling space shooter much like Armalyte: fight through maze-like territory against waves and lone enemies, picking up weapon-boosting tokens that lie in the open.
c64:171537.title: Lions of the Universe

c64:171538.description: A text adventure starring a robot that wakes in a refuelling sphere after a power failure, with no memory beyond that and no visible way out.
c64:171538.title: Little Adventure

c64:171539.description: Guide a little figure around collecting puzzle pieces; touching anything else is fatal.
c64:171539.title: Little Blue

c64:171542.description: Light every tile on 24 single-screen grids; stepping on a lit tile switches it off again, which some levels require to be exploited by doubling back.
c64:171542.title: Lights On

c64:171543.description: An unreleased platformer by Fairlight with two levels themed on LEGO Town and Classic Space. A preview appeared in 1992 between the scenes of Fairlight's LEGOLAND 2 demo.
c64:171543.title: Linking Leroy Visits LEGOLAND

c64:171544.description: A scrolling platformer: jump through the level collecting stars while avoiding Owlbats, a bee, saucers and other monsters.
c64:171544.title: The Little Dragon

c64:171553.description: An arch-enemy has trapped the hero in a maze of twisting passages to make him miss a dream job appointment; unlock the doors with the keys found inside and get out in time.
c64:171553.title: Living in a Maze

c64:171554.description: Fill the wait while a Mastertronic tape loads: rotate around the screen and fire inertial pulse spheres at the crawlers, since it is kill or be killed.
c64:171554.title: Load'n Play

c64:171582.description: Learn to write geometry proofs using nine basic proof patterns and their extensions: read the documentation pages, then work through exercises in figure or angle mode, chosen by pattern number or at random, entering the most obvious deduction each time.
c64:171582.title: Logic Workout

c64:171585.description: A text adventure navigated by choosing from offered answers: as a Texas ranger, put on a mask and bring the villains to justice.
c64:171585.title: The Lone Ranger

c64:171586.description: A word game for up to four players on a diamond-shaped grid of 109 letters. From their own side, players take turns forming words by moving horizontally, vertically or diagonally within a time limit.
c64:171586.title: Pathwords

c64:171589.description: A tactical naval simulation of World War II in the South Pacific for one or two players, commanding American or Japanese forces, with a computer opponent for solo play.
c64:171589.title: Long Lance: A Computer Game of Tactical Naval Combat in the South Pacific

c64:171590.description: Two educational games: Old MacDonald's Farm, with Memory, Observation and Reflections sections featuring farm animals, and SORT, the Space Observer Recruitment Test.
c64:171590.title: Look Sharp!

c64:171595.description: Text adventure in the land of Golconda, where you earn karma through good deeds, offerings and prayer to reach Heaven; the map shifts between games, characters follow you around, and dying means rebirth on a mountain with your belongings scattered.
c64:171595.title: Lords of Karma

c64:171601.description: A text-only adventure about a poor gambler deep in debt to Luigi of the New Jersey mob, looking for the one way out that doesn't end in pain or an early grave.
c64:171601.title: The Pay Off

c64:171603.description: Guided by the ghost of Backpack Sam, search Arizona's Superstition Mountains for the legendary Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine.
c64:171603.title: Lost Dutchman's Gold

c64:171604.description: A satirical take on the Greenham Common protests: you steer the Cee-5 Special, a tiny low-slung vehicle hard for radar to spot, through the Ministry of Defence's defences to break through the missile base's perimeter fence.
c64:171604.title: Peace Women

c64:171606.description: A multi-screen platform shooter: a lonely robot lost in a strange world searches for the way home, fending off attackers.
c64:171606.title: Lost Robot

c64:171607.description: Escape an ancient pyramid room by room, collecting treasures, dodging traps and fighting enemies such as scorpions.
c64:171607.title: Lost Tomb

c64:171608.description: Based on Conan Doyle's novel: as reporter Edward Malone, reach the plateau where his friend Maple White discovered a lost world, find out how he died and explore it.
c64:171608.title: The Lost World

c64:171610.description: A two-player game of forfeits and rewards with over 13,000 possible combinations.
c64:171610.title: Love Bytes

c64:171611.description: A quiz-format party game for as many as 18 players with playful trivia and an unusual scoring system.
c64:171611.title: The Lovegame

c64:171612.description: A questionnaire program: one or more people answer a series of questions to learn about themselves and build a compatibility profile to match with others who have used it.
c64:171612.title: The Love Quest

c64:171613.description: Hurdle fences, leap spiders and dodge crows on the way to rescue and reunite with Trampette.
c64:171613.title: Love Tramp

c64:171616.description: Low on fuel over an alien planet, a pilot can only land in a city, so the buildings must be bombed flat to make a runway. A single-screen game flying left to right.
c64:171616.title: Lunar Blitz

c64:171620.description: A shooter in the vein of Uridium where a lone fighter takes on the defences of a huge space station.
c64:171620.title: Lunari

c64:171621.description: Lupenio, history's greatest thief, breaks into an old house full of guardians and deadly traps to steal King Solomon's diamond; each key opens just one door, so they must be used carefully.
c64:171621.title: Lupenio

c64:171622.description: A personality test based on preferences for colours, shades and shapes, producing a profile of the respondent's current attitude to work, relationships and life.
c64:171622.title: The Lüscher Profile

c64:171628.description: Play goalkeeper in a penalty shootout: save 10 shots before the striker scores 10 to advance. Over ten levels the game speeds up while the keeper slows down, and the choice of penalty taker sets the difficulty.
c64:171628.title: Penalty Soccer

c64:171631.description: A clone of Sega's Pengo: Willy the penguin pushes ice blocks around a maze to crush mutant sea lions against the walls.
c64:171631.title: Pengon

c64:171634.description: A Pengo-like game with normal and fast modes: a penguin slides ice blocks around the board to rearrange it and crush enemies shaped like green balls.
c64:171634.title: Percy Penguin

c64:171635.description: An Amidar-style grid game: Peter the Painter carries out three tasks for the King, first moving along the lines of a grid of rectangles to clear the dots of dirt around them.
c64:171635.title: Pesky Painter

c64:171636.description: A French role-playing game with an open world and turn-based play, set on the small planet Kalvor, with its two continents Primaterra and Kalimater, once peaceful under the good King Philoxal.
c64:171636.title: Phalsberg

c64:171637.description: Solve mazes to reach safety while evading a computer or human opponent, across 200 levels plus 50 advanced ones unlocked after finishing the main game.
c64:171637.title: Pharaoh's Revenge

c64:171638.description: A puzzle game in which a banished deity uses ancient stones to overthrow the gods: each of 50 levels is cleared by swapping coloured gems so that two or more of a colour meet, while black gems and fixed bricks block the way.
c64:171638.title: Phase Out

c64:171642.description: Phileas Fogg pauses his round-the-world trip to help the Allies, flying his hot-air balloon over enemy territory to map it and bomb enemy shacks, controlling height with thrust, wind, hydrogen and sandbags.
c64:171642.title: Phileas Fogg's Balloon Battles

c64:171643.description: Barney the Bellhop inherits his late Aunt Mabel's fortune, but must earn it by finding treasures hidden in her 90-room mansion and getting past the traps and puzzles she left behind.
c64:171643.title: Mabel's Mansion

c64:171645.description: A Pac-Man variant: clear each single-screen maze of dots while avoiding three ghosts, using the power pills in the corners to turn the tables.
c64:171645.title: Macman

c64:171646.description: Split-screen shoot 'em up by Lars Sneftrup in which waves of aliens attack in repeating patterns; rejected by Hewson, it leaked through crackers with only 8 of its 16 stages and later appeared in Italy as Son Guay.
c64:171646.title: Mad Mission

c64:171648.description: A falling-block style puzzle: rearrange columns of symbols so that each column holds only identical symbols, at which point it disappears.
c64:171648.title: Pick'n Pile

c64:171669.description: Screenplay's take on the snake game: Monty, a ravenous python, slithers around a garden snapping up frogs for his lunch, with the occasional mouse appearing as a tasty extra.
c64:171669.title: Mad Monty

c64:171671.description: A simple platformer in which every green key must be collected and taken to the exit at the foot of the screen.
c64:171671.title: Magdom II

c64:171672.description: A conversation program in the vein of Eliza: Maggie invites the user to talk about problems, thoughts and fears.
c64:171672.title: Maggie AIP
