c64:171677.description: As a space pirate, raid 21 cargo ships for precious materials, each raid made up of three stages that must be completed in turn. Three craft are available to choose from at the start.
c64:171677.title: Pirates in Hyperspace

c64:171678.description: A single-screen platformer based on Raymond Briggs' book: gather snow, clothes, toys and ice and take them to the right spot to build the snowman, eating food to stay awake and avoiding gas flames that melt him.
c64:171678.title: The Snowman

c64:171692.description: An educational Pac-Man variant about dental care: move a toothbrush through a maze of teeth, turning them from yellow to white, while three plaque blobs give chase and stain teeth they pass.
c64:171692.title: Plaqueman

c64:171693.description: A two-player duel between wizards in which the one landing the most successful attacks wins. An entry in RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:171693.title: Magic Duel

c64:171694.description: A multi-event sports game made for the 1988 Seoul Olympics, featuring swimming and several track and field events, with music by Markus Schneider.
c64:171694.title: The Magic Events

c64:171695.description: A puzzle with 99 levels: pressing fire flips the surrounding fields in four directions, and the goal is to clear every visible mussel from the board.
c64:171695.title: Magic Fields

c64:171697.description: A platformer in which the hero searches for a magic book, throwing stars at the witch Anabel's goblins while racing against time.
c64:171697.title: Magic Mouse in Goblin Land

c64:171698.description: Sequel to Magic Duel: two players control rival wizards attacking each other, and the first to reach the set points total wins.
c64:171698.title: Magic Duel: DoReCo Edition

c64:171699.description: Poker in a Wild West saloon, sitting down at a corner table with four tense card players on a hot afternoon.
c64:171699.title: Magic Poker 64

c64:171700.description: An educational program teaching children aged 6 to 10 spelling and grammar rules through three animated mini-games, with words drawn from categories such as animals, the orchestra and fruit.
c64:171700.title: Magic Spells

c64:171703.description: A puzzle in which every available piece must be placed on a chessboard to clear the level; the number of pieces left is shown at the bottom and an arrow marks the current piece. Also known as Duddo.
c64:171703.title: Magic Tile

c64:171704.description: Collect mushrooms, some of which may be poisonous, while bats, a snake and a lightning-throwing witch attack; survivors face ever more dangerous enemies.
c64:171704.title: Magic Wood

c64:171705.description: Skeletons have raided Snail Meadow, looting homes, killing cattle and kidnapping the snails, and Sonny the Snail, about to marry Dawny, sets out to put things right.
c64:171705.title: Magical Formula

c64:171706.description: A sample adventure written with AdventureWriter: it begins south of a dark castle beside a sign demanding the return of the Orb and the Scroll.
c64:171706.title: Magician

c64:171707.description: As Wuntvor, apprentice to the vanished magician Ebeneezum, find and rescue his master.
c64:171707.title: A Magician's Apprentice

c64:171708.description: Based on the BBC children's series: over ten educational activities for ages three to eight with the show's characters, including Why, Bird, Lizzie and Peggy, covering numbers and word recognition across four self-adjusting difficulty levels.
c64:171708.title: Playdays

c64:171709.description: Fly a World War II plane over a single screen, bombing the man-eating plants that grew from seeds brought back by botanist Sir Hubert Flog and have since eaten him.
c64:171709.title: Plop

c64:171718.description: As Red O'Blair, save a gold research base in Lee Valley from a rockslide by replacing the broken lever that powers the giant pneumatic hammers driving bridge pillars into the river bed.
c64:171718.title: Pneumatic Hammers

c64:171724.description: A two-player board game on a 10x10 grid: players take turns placing tiles of their colour, and a single opposing tile sandwiched between two of a player's tiles changes to that colour. The most tiles wins.
c64:171724.title: Magnetic

c64:171730.description: A side-scrolling quest: a dragon has stolen the Magic Orb from the village hall, leaving the village defenceless, and Pod, whose grandfather brought the orb there, must get it back.
c64:171730.title: Pod

c64:171731.description: Bounce Pogo Joe from barrel to barrel, recoloring each one he lands on until the entire level has changed color; a Q*Bert-inspired game whose layouts take a variety of shapes.
c64:171731.title: Pogo Joe

c64:171736.description: An upgrade of a 1993 mahjong solitaire: remove matching tiles to clear the board, either racing the clock or in untimed solitaire mode.
c64:171736.title: Mah Gong: Special Edition

c64:171749.description: A race-around-the-board game for two to four players in the vein of Sorry, written by Laze Ristoski.
c64:171749.title: Man Don't Get Angry

c64:171754.description: Five-card stud poker against Pokersam, a computer dealer with personality, humor and a voice of his own.
c64:171754.title: Pokersam

c64:171762.description: An Arkanoid variant for one or two players, with paddles on the top and left edges; clearing the cubes uncovers a manga-style picture, and bonuses range from twin balls to penalties like shrunken paddles.
c64:171762.title: Manganoid

c64:171763.description: Somewhere near Upper Puddleton stands the mansion of your eccentric late uncle; track it down to claim your inheritance in this adventure.
c64:171763.title: Mansion Quest

c64:171764.description: Fly over a map of Canada and halt exactly on named cities, testing Canadian geography solo or racing a second player.
c64:171764.title: Map-Race 2

c64:171766.description: Geography teaching software for the United States with three modes: Search, where names of states, rivers, seas and mountains are typed in, a Test mode, and a helicopter game.
c64:171766.title: Maps 64: USA

c64:171767.description: A Dutch geography trainer for primary school pupils built on a mid-1980s world map, offering look-up, quiz and helicopter game modes.
c64:171767.title: Maps World

c64:171768.description: A Breakout-style game where each level replaces the wall of bricks with a moving, segmented centipede-like creature that the ball must knock apart.
c64:171768.title: Marble Springs

c64:171769.description: Aboard a stolen space yacht drifting toward a pirate ship, find the pirates' treasure and dymenthium ingots for your own vessel, carry everything back to the ship's utility room, and learn what became of the pirates.
c64:171769.title: Marie Celeste

c64:171786.description: A modification of I Want More Diamonds by AEG Soft that puts Mario in the lead role and adds multiple levels.
c64:171786.title: Mario Goes to Diamonds

c64:171787.description: A Donkey Kong clone that puts a beer machine in place of the giant ape.
c64:171787.title: Mario's Brewery

c64:171788.description: A multi-event sports contest with more than seven disciplines, playable alone or with several people, released on the Golden Disk 64 magazine disk.
c64:171788.title: Mark Set Go!

c64:171789.description: Bundles two text adventures: Dial M for Marlo and The Museum Caper.
c64:171789.title: The Marlo Files

c64:171790.description: Filling in for Delivery Man Dan, who has broken his leg, Pat drives his van to drop telephone directories at as many houses as he can over five days, dodging obstacles without running out of fuel, in a Paperboy-like game.
c64:171790.title: Postman Pat 3: To the Rescue

c64:171792.description: Bring a rocket down onto Martian landing pads with keyboard thrusters; the border color shows descent speed and turns green when touchdown is safe, and good landings earn bonus fuel. Included on the compilation 4 in 1 Game Pack.
c64:171792.title: Mars Lander

c64:171794.description: A free text adventure in the style of the original Zork games, made to promote Zork: Grand Inquisitor. In 1066 the hero, a seventh-class private in the Inquisition Guard, has just come off duty at the Port Foozle gift kiosk.
c64:171794.title: Zork: The Undiscovered Underground

c64:171795.description: Marzio heads out on a training course to get fit before the holidays, and you steer him along the marked path while other joggers follow their own hidden routes and knock him off the track if he gets in their way. Four screens add one more runner each, and Marzio has three tries.
c64:171795.title: Marzio

c64:171810.description: A top-down driving game for children aged four to six, based on the British TV series: drive Pat's van around the scrolling village to find vehicles and animals, including his cat Jess.
c64:171810.title: Postman Pat's Trail Game

c64:171821.description: Ice hockey between the USA and USSR, with either one skater or five per side and periods of two, twelve or twenty minutes, featuring wrist and slap shots, drop passes, face-offs and body checks.
c64:171821.title: Powerplay Hockey: USA vs. USSR

c64:171822.description: A home version of the TV game show for four to eight contestants, recreating many of its pricing games along with the big wheel and the showcase.
c64:171822.title: The Price is Right

c64:171823.description: Run the campaign for any candidate in US presidential elections from the 1960s onward, or design a custom candidate through a character-creation process.
c64:171823.title: President Elect: 1988 Edition

c64:171826.description: A football management game built for two: each player runs a club, taking turns over managerial decisions and playing out their matches.
c64:171826.title: 2 Player Soccer Squad

c64:171834.description: An espionage puzzle game: a COPNET agent investigating the car-crash death of the head of the secret S.D.I. project New-wave soon finds himself the prime suspect.
c64:171834.title: Presumed Guilty!

c64:171835.description: Starting from nothing but a logon prompt, break into an unfamiliar computer system and explore what is hidden inside.
c64:171835.title: The Master Hacker

c64:171838.description: A Sokoban variant: as a warehouse keeper, push crates one at a time onto marked spots, with a single-move undo on the P key.
c64:171838.title: Master Head

c64:171843.description: Boxing against a friend or the computer, with eight joystick moves for guarding and landing punches.
c64:171843.title: Pro Boxing

c64:171844.description: An educational quiz about the computer hardware and technology of its day.
c64:171844.title: Master Mind 64

c64:171895.description: Instead of running a team, steer one player's career through the top four English leagues, the cups and European competition, after choosing position, nationality and starting year.
c64:171895.title: Professional Footballer

c64:171897.description: Strategic top-down golf for one to four players, who can also face computer-controlled versions of great golfers from the past; wind and weather affect every shot.
c64:171897.title: Professional Tour Golf

c64:171899.description: An educational trivia game for one or two players: timed logic games earn credits, and after each round those credits claim squares on the board.
c64:171899.title: Professor I.Q.

c64:171905.description: As a droid aboard the cargo ship Dreadnought Nine, search flick-screen platform rooms for the nine lost pieces of the pulsebomb Earth needs to survive.
c64:171905.title: PSI-Droid

c64:171909.description: Broke after a night of drinking and unable to pay the landlord, find the right equipment to venture into the sewers, the one place money is known to be hidden.
c64:171909.title: Pub Quest

c64:171911.description: A statistics-driven baseball simulation for replaying single games or whole seasons, keeping permanent team records with its Stat Compiler; great teams such as the 1927 New York Yankees are included.
c64:171911.title: Pure-Stat Baseball

c64:171913.description: A statistical football simulation with rosters and stats for NFL teams from the 1986 season: let the computer play a game out, or coach and call the plays.
c64:171913.title: Pure-Stat Football

c64:171914.description: A text adventure where a trainee's final test to earn the title of Matchmaker is seeing the royal couple, a Prince and his Princess, wed at the church in suitable clothes, along with a properly attired page boy.
c64:171914.title: Match Maker

c64:171915.description: Teacher-designed geography drills built on matching U.S. facts with words and phrases, with an authoring mode for typing in your own quizzes and games.
c64:171915.title: Match Maker: U.S. Geography Facts

c64:171930.description: Guide Benny the light bulb through small pattern puzzles; each level can be played alone or in sequence and holds a symbol needed for the final puzzle, and some stages are timed.
c64:171930.title: PuzzlePanic

c64:171933.description: A Swedish take on Q*Bert: recolor the block pyramid against the clock while two opponents give chase.
c64:171933.title: Q-hop

c64:171934.description: A maze game for one to four players: steer Mr Quadro along dotted paths linked by gapped discs, eating every dot while avoiding spirits and other creatures.
c64:171934.title: Quadro-Power

c64:171937.description: As Yucatan Sam, scale the outside of the temple of Quintana Roo past snakes and lightning bolts, then search inside for the hidden vault and its treasure.
c64:171937.title: Quest for Quintana Roo

c64:171940.description: Travel back through history to stop Adam eating the apple, dodging hazards such as Robert Bruce's spider, Cleopatra's asp and Dr. Livingstone's gorilla; play in arcade mode, adventure mode or both.
c64:171940.title: Quest for the Garden of Eden

c64:171942.description: Your character runs, jumps and swims around a cave where number monsters lurk. Gather digits and symbols from outside to build an equation that equals a monster's number and it is destroyed, while a dog can trip you up and a machine on the left replaces used numbers.
c64:171942.title: Math Busters

c64:171944.description: An educational math adventure from the Math Magic collection that mixes shooting demons with solving arithmetic problems.
c64:171944.title: Math Manor

c64:171945.description: Part of the Let's Count collection for children aged four and up: at the fairground, help Maths Muscles ring the bells in ascending order to practise the numbers 0 to 9.
c64:171945.title: Maths Muscles

c64:171946.description: Answer arithmetic problems quickly enough to outdraw Bad Math Mac in the town of Math Tombstone.
c64:171946.title: Math Shootout

aliases: Mathbooster: An Arithmatic Drill and Practice Program
c64:171947.description: A Space Invaders-style shooter from Australia's Satchel Software that drills addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
c64:171947.title: Mathbooster

c64:171953.description: A text adventure with still pictures, made with the Graphic Adventure Creator: Florida private eye Matt Lucas follows clues and infiltrates the underworld after his partner John Harpinger is kidnapped.
c64:171953.title: Matt Lucas

c64:171954.description: As Merravid, son of Aranoid, recover the Dwarves' magical firestone from a dragon-guarded mountain in Thargon, but only after finding the right armour.
c64:171954.title: The Quest of Merravid

c64:171956.description: Two maths games for young children. In Peter Piper Problems you help Peter in the pickle field by working out sums about his harvest and pay, at three levels of difficulty; Weight Wizardry poses problems about weights in metric or imperial units.
c64:171956.title: Magic Maths

c64:171967.description: A computer version of the moral-dilemma board game for three to ten players, any of whom can be computer-controlled; human players set their personality traits and choose a face before play.
c64:171967.title: A Question of Scruples: The Computer Edition

c64:171972.description: A quiz program derived from Quiz Master on the VIC-20 that also lets users write their own quizzes and save them to tape or disk.
c64:171972.title: Quizzer

c64:171973.description: A Q*Bert-style game: hop R-Nest diagonally across a pyramid of cubes to paint their tops, with later levels needing several visits per cube.
c64:171973.title: R~Nest

c64:171974.description: Made by Hungarian programmers, this early flight game stood out for drawing a moving horizon on such limited hardware; PSS advertised it, but Commodore and Markt & Technik ended up releasing it.
c64:171974.title: QX-9

c64:172001.description: Control rail traffic around the Crewe locomotive works, routing every train movement so passenger services keep to time and contracts are met.
c64:172001.title: R.T.C. Crewe

c64:172003.description: Play a mother rabbit searching a maze for her four babies while a hunter, hired by a gardener tired of losing crops, moves around taking shots at her.
c64:172003.title: Rabbit Pie

c64:172004.description: Tied to Sport Aid '88 and its worldwide 10km charity run against hunger, poverty and disease, with the player in the role of the runner Omar.
c64:172004.title: The Race Against Time

c64:172007.description: As secret agent Mr. White, collect every microdot in a maze while guards hunt you down, using speed boosts to escape. Survival mode has no gun; Escape mode gives you bullets but fewer exits. Unused boosts and bullets add bonus points.
c64:172007.title: Maze Dash

c64:172012.description: A reworking of the text adventure Nogard with PETSCII graphics: an elite Nogard warrior must bring six items to the king, who hides under a bed in his storeroom, starting out with a plastic-bag battlepack, a newspaper and clean underpants.
c64:172012.title: Maze of Nogard

c64:172015.description: A constantly scrolling top-down racer over six courses at the closing day of the Interplanetary Terra-Races, now in their 17th year, with a split screen so two players can race at once.
c64:172015.title: The Race

c64:172016.description: Run a racing stable: pick your horses, train them within a limited number of hours, enter them in group and non-group races with orders for the jockey, and bet with the bookmakers. Fees, stewards' enquiries and even a virus in the stable affect your season's finances.
c64:172016.title: The Racing Game

c64:172045.description: A two-player duel: the green and yellow worm races of planet Schneik each send their five best warriors into the Maze of Death, and the players steer and shoot their worms there, grabbing pills for extra bullets, shields, speed and faster shots.
c64:172045.title: Mazer

c64:172049.description: The medicine man's excess has put the village at risk of flooding, so the elders summon Copecoee, ancient god of energy; move him with the cursor keys and fire energy rays with Shift.
c64:172049.title: The Medicine Man

c64:172060.description: A pool game offering eight-ball, nine-ball, rotation and straight pool.
c64:172060.title: Rack 'em Up!

c64:172062.description: A rail traffic simulation covering the 85-mile Bristol to Exeter line, once part of the Great Western Railway, with every locomotive movement under your control.
c64:172062.title: R.T.C. Exeter

c64:172067.description: A strategy game of 19th-century railroad speculation for one to eight players, up to four of them computer-run; the long scenario spans 1870 to 1900, while the short one starts in 1890 and ends in 1895 or 1900.
c64:172067.title: Rails West!

c64:172068.description: Help the Rainbow Dragon escape a cave system by destroying ten magic chests, using magic to clear the obstacles that block them.
c64:172068.title: Rainbow Dragon

c64:172072.description: A baby owl hops square by square across a rainbow high above the clouds, coloring in its gray bands.
c64:172072.title: Rainbow Walker

c64:172078.description: Create a boxer and train him through weeks of bag work, running and sparring between fights to climb to the top at heavyweight, middleweight or welterweight.
c64:172078.title: Star Rank Boxing II

c64:172080.description: A side-scrolling jet fighter shooter over four levels with bosses, a charged laser alongside the normal shot, and extra weapons dropped by enemies.
c64:172080.title: Steel Eagle

c64:172084.description: Race three rivals over three laps of three maze-like circuits, following arrows on the road; straying too far, running dry or suffering too much damage ends the game.
c64:172084.title: Rally Simulator

c64:172090.description: A vertically scrolling shooter with a medieval theme, made with the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit.
c64:172090.title: Medieval Mayhem

c64:172091.description: A text adventure played with single-key commands: explore caverns, catacombs, an underground lake and a bridge over lava, fight orcs, trolls, vampires and a balrog with weapons, potions and wands, and reach Medusa's lair without meeting her stare.
c64:172091.title: Medusa's Cave

c64:172092.description: A dueling shoot 'em up for one or two players by Paul Kubiszyn and Jonathan Hunt, published with Commodore Format issue 52.
c64:172092.title: Mega Force

c64:172093.description: A four-stage game: a space shooter, a stop where the right three ship add-ons must be chosen, a very long snake game, and a safe-cracking finale.
c64:172093.title: Mega Paratrooper

c64:172095.description: A Space Invaders variant with power-ups and boss stages.
c64:172095.title: Mega Starforce: Return to the Great Star

c64:172105.description: Based on the late-1980s TV game show: pick the 11 correct answers out of 16 on the board while avoiding the 5 wrong ones, with a Hot Spot prize hidden behind one correct answer.
c64:172105.title: Wipeout

c64:172112.description: Find the exit from one of 26 mazes in smooth first-person 3D with full 360-degree turning; movement units are counted, and best scores and up to nine games in progress are saved to disk.
c64:172112.title: Wayout

c64:172113.description: A Ghosts 'n Goblins-style action game: hunt down the ancient relics needed to defeat The Unspeakable One, collecting drops of vitality, magic, armor, treasure and risky mystery items.
c64:172113.title: Warlock

c64:172114.description: A single-screen space shooter: wipe out snakes of smiley faces and descending alien ships, picking up power-ups left behind by fallen enemies.
c64:172114.title: Turn n Burn

c64:172115.description: Chronoclasm bomb experiments in the war between humanity and Proxima go wrong and tear apart the space-time continuum, leaving the player to fly a Thunderbolt jet through the aftermath.
c64:172115.title: ThunderBolt

c64:172116.description: A board game for one to four players racing to a cash goal between $10,000 and $90,000 through lotteries, investments and spending.
c64:172116.title: T.G.I.F.

c64:172118.description: Based on the TV drawing show: a teammate sketches on the board and you guess the phrase, often a common expression drawn literally, like a light bulb for 'bright idea'.
c64:172118.title: Win, Lose or Draw: Second Edition

c64:172119.description: Pinball over eight rounds on three tables, mostly soccer-themed: knock out the defenders guarding the goal and score three goals to move on.
c64:172119.title: Soccer Pinball

c64:172120.description: Guide a rabbit across the screen past critters to grab a dangling carrot, which turns it into Super Bunny.
c64:172120.title: Super Bunny

c64:172121.description: A forced-scrolling shooter in which AL, a globular droid, enforces the Ransack clause against the Ryvian System's eight planets for failing to pay the Democratic Council of Planets.
c64:172121.title: Ransack

c64:172123.description: Seymour the stuntman works through four themed movie sets in a side-scrolling platformer, shooting enemies and keeping out of the water with five lives.
c64:172123.title: Seymour Stuntman

c64:172125.description: A light-cycle duel in a future arena: box the opponent in with your bike's energy trail, using a force field up to three times to avoid crashing.
c64:172125.title: Raster Runner

c64:172126.description: A top-down stock car race against the clock from Florida to California across the southern USA, on freeways, bridges, back routes and rural roads.
c64:172126.title: Stocker

c64:172127.description: A former mercenary captured by the CIA and pressed into the US Navy flies one-man helicopter missions.
c64:172127.title: Steigar

c64:172129.description: As a rat in a cheese warehouse, eat the six cheeses spelling THE RAT on each floor; once the first is eaten, the others start moving around.
c64:172129.title: The Rat

c64:172130.description: As Mike the Spy, travel through Europe, including Switzerland and Venice, to recover vital plans left behind by a dead fellow agent, beginning by boarding a plane with fake ID.
c64:172130.title: Spy Trek Adventure

c64:172131.description: Explore the flick-screen caverns of Pylpapa as Sqij, gathering the six scattered pieces of the Enertree, key to eternal life, and returning them to the Lotz-Too-Weet cave.
c64:172131.title: Sqij!

c64:172132.description: A vertical shoot 'em up: pilot a new spacecraft against alien hordes bent on destroying the space federation, protected by a shield of limited energy.
c64:172132.title: Speed Zone

c64:172133.description: Testing jet packs for the Space Rider company, fly to the test site on the 23rd planet, which turns out to have been taken over by aliens.
c64:172133.title: Space Rider

c64:172155.title: SAFTS: Spin All Four Table Soccer

c64:172167.description: The Planetary Orbiting Co-ordinator has failed and the planets are drifting from the Sun; send robot XR3 into its core to repair it and find the missing planets.
c64:172167.title: Realm

c64:172181.description: Outmaneuver an opponent to break into missile control and fire the missile.
c64:172181.title: Red Alert

c64:172184.description: A tile puzzle framed as debugging a virus-hit nuclear plant computer: toggle tiles with a cursor until the whole board is in the same state, all colored or all blank.
c64:172184.title: Reaxion

c64:172186.description: Simulates the Confederacy's last major Civil War offensive at Chickamauga, built on a refined Gettysburg engine and played in 13 two-hour turns over two days, scored on casualties and objectives.
c64:172186.title: Rebel Charge at Chickamauga

c64:172188.description: A remake of Megamania made for Visionparty 2002: from the bottom of the screen, fend off waves of bizarre attackers such as flying hamburgers, bow ties, steam irons, space dice and diamonds.
c64:172188.title: Mega64

c64:172192.description: A memory puzzle: six symbols are shown in their places for a few seconds, then the player rebuilds the layout from memory against the clock, picking each symbol from the bottom row and setting it in its spot.
c64:172192.title: MegaBrain

c64:172193.description: A platform game set in a stronghold: collect the magic swords and find your way out to bring an era of darkness to an end.
c64:172193.title: Megamax

c64:172194.description: A keyboard-controlled board game with spaces lettered A to X; place characters by typing letters, then move them around the board.
c64:172194.title: Melee: The Battle Boardgame

c64:172195.description: A snake game written to fit in 2 KB.
c64:172195.title: Melting Trail

c64:172196.description: A memory game: uncover matching pairs of pictures on a 6x6 board within a limited number of moves.
c64:172196.title: Memologie

c64:172197.description: A pairs memory game where matched pictures vanish from the board and a counter shows how many more mistakes are allowed.
c64:172197.title: Memomania

c64:172198.description: Memorize 25 pairs of icons shown for 10 seconds, then find all the matches before time runs out. Released in Italy as Memoteca.
c64:172198.title: Memorix

c64:172199.description: As an agent of the SAROS resistance disguised as a merchant, fly the Caydia to the colony worlds Tropos, Halmuris and Arcadion, meeting freedom fighters and gathering intelligence against the alien Arcadians.
c64:172199.title: Rebel Planet

c64:172202.description: Pilot a jumping buggy-like scout capsule across eight side-scrolling planets, shooting aliens and gathering the scattered parts of your spaceship.
c64:172202.title: Scout

c64:172203.description: Steer Fisher-Price's school bus along country roads, collecting the Little People and dropping them off, in a game that trains coordination, judgement and recall.
c64:172203.title: School Bus Driver

c64:172204.description: Buy your way into football club ownership: win by holding at least 501 shares in each of the ten top clubs when a season ends.
c64:172204.title: Soccer Director

c64:172205.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter about saving Mars colonists from hostile aliens.
c64:172205.title: Rescue from Mars

c64:172206.description: Sequel to Snowball: on the planet Eden, being colonised by Snowball's command robots, native plants and animals fight back, and Commander Kim must survive around the crumbling walled city.
c64:172206.title: Return to Eden

c64:172207.description: Football trivia for one to four players: throw a ball across a row of stadiums using a power bar, and answer questions based on where it lands.
c64:172207.title: Saint & Greavsie: The Ultimate Soccer Trivia Game

c64:172208.description: A two-player duel between a submarine firing missiles and an aeroplane dropping bombs, both constantly moving across the screen, where neutral ships must not be hit.
c64:172208.title: Seawar

c64:172209.description: Drive an armed car, seen from above, shooting down a biker gang during their annual race; kill too few before refueling and you die.
c64:172209.title: Road Warrior

c64:172210.description: An Asteroids-like shooter where your shots rebound off the edges of the play area instead of wrapping around.
c64:172210.title: Zone 7

c64:172211.description: A point-and-click adventure: control four travellers who have landed a helicopter on a shopping centre roof in search of fuel while zombies roam the earth.
c64:172211.title: Zombi

c64:172212.description: Roll a ball across single-screen platforms to the exit, planning the route carefully because each tile vanishes once crossed.
c64:172212.title: Sensitive

c64:172215.description: A platform game with puzzle elements in the mould of Gods: Robin sets out to rescue Maid Marion from the Sheriff of Nottingham, gathering treasure and shooting gargoyles and trolls with his bow.
c64:172215.title: Robin Hood: Legend Quest

c64:172216.description: The Xanthidian are spreading across Earth; from a South Pacific base, send four Raider Craft out over a world map showing alien-held and human-held regions to drive the invaders back.
c64:172216.title: Raid 2000

c64:172217.description: Explorers from the year 2891, unwilling to risk themselves, reach back to 1981 for help raiding the Star Maze, an alien artifact whose energy crystals are guarded by powerful aliens.
c64:172217.title: Star Maze

c64:172218.description: A fruit machine modelled on English pub slots: start with a 2.00 stake, bet 10p per spin and use features such as hold to land winning combinations.
c64:172218.title: Sooper Froot

c64:172219.description: A side-scrolling fighting game across an airport, a harbor and a military base, punching and kicking enemies and picking up weapons for an edge.
c64:172219.title: Shanghai Warriors

c64:172229.description: A multidirectional scrolling shooter inspired by the Book of Revelation: descend through more than 40 caverns of Hell, constantly sinking unless thrusting, to reach the Monster of the Apocalypse.
c64:172229.title: Revelation

c64:172233.description: Wake up tied to a bed in what looks like a hospital room, with no memory of who you are or how you got there, and find a way to escape.
c64:172233.title: Memory

c64:172234.description: A tile-flipping memory game for young children, one or two players, pairing pictures, tunes, words, colors and shapes across a variety of board layouts.
c64:172234.title: Memory Building Blocks

c64:172235.description: As a knight inside a castle, memorize the instructions you are given, then answer questions on what to do next to move forward.
c64:172235.title: Memory Castle

c64:172236.description: A memory game playable with joystick or lightpen, with modes for matching pairs of shapes or of numbers.
c64:172236.title: Memotest

c64:172237.description: Detective Hatherton of the Yard investigates a murder at a country mansion the night after Madam Properidge's house party, interviewing fourteen suspects, searching rooms for evidence and collecting Jigclues before naming the killer, motive and weapon.
c64:172237.title: The Menage

c64:172238.description: Three puzzles in one, including Free Fall, a 3D Tetris where complete layers vanish, and Mental Detector, which asks which of four flattened cube nets matches the cube shown.
c64:172238.title: Mental Blocks

c64:172240.description: A turn-based what-if World War II war game pitting Patton against Rommel for control of Normandy, with points scored as the battle unfolds.
c64:172240.title: Patton vs Rommel

c64:172241.description: Based on the 1975 Parker Brothers board game for two to four players: move around a board laid out as a monthly calendar, starting with $325, aiming to finish with the most money.
c64:172241.title: Pay Day

c64:172242.title: Jeffrey Archer: Not a Penny More, Not a Penny Less: The Computer Game

c64:172243.description: Explore an alien planet collecting robot parts while keeping up your energy; the laser blaster kills enemies but drains that same energy.
c64:172243.title: Project S.O.L

c64:172244.description: A Fisher-Price music program: listen to one of more than thirty songs, then play it note by note along with the computer, with no music reading needed.
c64:172244.title: My Grand Piano

c64:172279.description: Disguised as a cassette operating system, this is actually a shoot 'em up about fighting the Zorn to protect the planet.
c64:172279.title: ACOS+

c64:172280.description: Take a boxer from the bottom of the rankings toward the top in a side-view boxing game, with attributes governing his left and right high and low punches and his defence.
c64:172280.title: Ringside

c64:172288.description: A Uridium-style shooter from the Game On disk magazine, later heavily reworked and reissued as Counter Force.
c64:172288.title: Metal Force

c64:172290.description: Foster pilots his spherosorb craft through a wormhole into the epsilon dimension, a radially structured world sending out waves of pure energy.
c64:172290.title: Metal

c64:172321.description: Move a crosshair to shoot down a meteor shower before it hits your ship.
c64:172321.title: Meteor Madness

c64:172322.description: As a silver orb, navigate a twisting labyrinth to collect puzzle pieces, shooting or dodging enemies and using teleporters and floor switches to open new areas before time runs out.
c64:172322.title: Methodos

c64:172324.description: Ring worlds are converging on the solar system and devouring all in their path: follow intelligence reports to find them, jump through hyperspace and battle each ring world's defense fleet.
c64:172324.title: Ring Wars

c64:172325.description: A real-time text adventure set in 1900 with eerie music throughout, featuring Florence Nightingale, Madame Curie and Sherlock Holmes among its characters.
c64:172325.title: Ripper!

c64:172327.description: Fly a spaceship and destroy mines, cruisers and star bases; cruisers appear and circle you when you near their base, and red rocks hold minerals that add to your score.
c64:172327.title: Metron

c64:172329.description: Command the German Army against the computer's Soviet forces on the Eastern Front between Finland and the Crimea, on a map oriented so east points up, with 10 skill levels.
c64:172329.title: Road to Moscow

aliases: Michael Jordan vs Larry Bird: One On One
c64:172333.description: One-on-one basketball between Michael Jordan and Larry Bird, plus a slam dunk contest and a three-point shootout with five racks of five balls around the arc.
c64:172333.title: Jordan vs Bird: One On One

c64:172334.description: Drive a car in an island-wide treasure hunt.
c64:172334.title: Micro Drivin

c64:172336.description: A small game meant to be played while the main program on the tape loaded: rescue six stranded men from a planet's surface and bring them back to the mothership.
c64:172336.title: Micro Rescue

c64:172337.description: A faster, graphically improved version of the PET port of Microchess, a chess program first released in 1977.
c64:172337.title: Microchess #3

c64:172339.description: A licensed baseball strategy game with real teams and players and classic teams from the past; each play is shown graphically with running commentary.
c64:172339.title: MicroLeague Baseball

c64:172361.description: Guide the robot Robbo through 76 levels of Boulder Dash and Sokoban-style puzzles, collecting the screws needed to repair his ship and reach his escape capsule while avoiding aliens and traps.
c64:172361.title: Robbo

c64:172362.description: An add-on for MicroLeague Baseball that compiles box scores for stored teams across a full season, with printable statistics.
c64:172362.title: MicroLeague Baseball: Box Score Stats Compiler Disk

c64:172363.description: A single-player version of Multi User Dungeon where the computer controls the other characters; reach wizard status by scoring 102,400 points through fighting other players and completing tasks.
c64:172363.title: Micro MUD

c64:172365.description: Under a spell and not quite yourself, escape a dusty study and brew a remedy in the cauldron before midnight.
c64:172365.title: A Mid: Hallow Night's Scream

c64:172367.description: A vertical shooter: fly a jet with an unlimited-ammo cannon over Jupiter's surface to destroy the Communist rebel base, past fighters, tanks and unidentified craft.
c64:172367.title: Tamer

c64:172369.description: As a robot aboard a spaceship hit by a Space Virus and radiation, clear each level by carrying four Death Pods, one at a time, to an Assembly Unit.
c64:172369.title: Robobolt

c64:172370.description: A simulation of the June 1942 Battle of Midway: command the outnumbered American forces against a large Japanese fleet sent to capture the island.
c64:172370.title: Midway Campaign

c64:172371.description: Bloody Zenon terrorises the land with a Cyclops eye, and King Aldir must stop him by exploring forest and underground labyrinths, using single-use items in the right places to open passages.
c64:172371.title: Miecze Valdgira II: Władca Gór

c64:172372.description: Fly a MiG-19 jet, dodging oncoming fighters and tank fire, and bring it safely back to the runway.
c64:172372.title: Mig-19

c64:172374.description: A platformer written in BASIC: archaeologist Dr. Mike Holehead is trapped in an old pyramid and must find the way out before his air runs out.
c64:172374.title: Mike the Cave-Man

c64:172389.description: A Hungarian-made computer version of Nine Men's Morris (Mühle), the traditional board game in which players place and shift their pieces to line up three in a row, forming a mill that lets them take one of the opponent's pieces.
c64:172389.title: Mill Mania

c64:172390.description: Help a reconnaissance probe returning from Astral 4 refuel by landing on planets along its route home to Earth.
c64:172390.title: The Milky Weigh

c64:172391.description: As Prince Kronos, son of Emperor Iridon I, undergo the ancient Iridani Test of Arms on the toughest battlefields to become heir to the throne and Prince of the Southern Nebular.
c64:172391.title: Millenium Warriors

c64:172393.description: With the Empire building three new Death Stars, fly the Millennium Falcon through the guarding asteroid fields and over each half-built station to its ventilation shaft, where an R2 unit drops the explosive charge.
c64:172393.title: Millennium Assault

c64:172394.description: Personality analysis software for building a profile of someone you know, revealing their likes, dislikes and hidden traits to help with relationships.
c64:172394.title: Mind Prober

c64:172397.description: An all-text real-time adventure: as a Mind Adventurer, journey through the minds of four dead residents of your world to find the Wheel of Wisdom and end the planet's chaos. It shipped with a hardbound book.
c64:172397.title: Mindwheel

c64:172399.description: A Minesweeper clone with selectable difficulty, custom board sizes, redefinable controls, a choice of background tunes and saving and loading.
c64:172399.title: Mine Sweeper 9000

c64:172401.description: Minesweeper under another name: uncover squares on a grid, each revealing how many bombs lie next to it, and clear the board without setting one off. There are no options to adjust, and the clock gives you 1,000 seconds to finish.
c64:172401.title: Minefield

c64:172402.description: Christoph Cemper's take on Minesweeper, with sound and music by Patrick Peters.
c64:172402.title: Minefields

aliases: Robot Rascals: A Zany Scavenger Hunt
c64:172404.description: A turn-based scavenger hunt across Laustenfownd mixing strategy, action and board-game play: physical cards dealt to each player list the objects to find, and luck cards can swing the outcome.
c64:172404.title: Robot Rascals

c64:172405.description: A text adventure about the dragon Cavilan, sole survivor of the Master's dragon slaughter, whose egg was seized by his orcs and stored away.
c64:172405.title: The Mines of Lithiad

c64:172410.description: A PETSCII day at the speedway: choose how many cars, up to ten, enter the race, watch them advance at random across the screen and see which number wins, then press space for the next race.
c64:172410.title: Mini Racers

c64:172413.description: A Pac-Man game on a single screen, with one unchanging maze and only two or three ghosts.
c64:172413.title: Mini-Munch

c64:172414.description: In each shaft of a diamond mine you must dig out a set number of gems against a countdown clock, dodging falling boulders and roaming enemies. Eight shafts come ready to play, and an editor lets you build up to 26 of your own, setting the time limit, gem quota, start point and exit.
c64:172414.title: Mining

c64:172415.description: A two-player-only Tron light-cycle game that requires two joysticks, with speed adjustable using the + and - keys.
c64:172415.title: Minitron

c64:172416.description: A condensed remake of Infocom's Zork I, best known for its 1990 magazine release.
c64:172416.title: Mini-Zork I

c64:172421.description: A question-and-answer game on the 50 states, covering capitals, major industries, history and geography.
c64:172421.title: Roll Call USA

c64:172423.description: A hex-based wargame on the Battlefront engine covering the North African campaign, with eight scenarios playable from either side, including Operation Exporter in Syria and Sidi Rezegh, both 1941.
c64:172423.title: Rommel: Battles for North Africa

c64:172437.description: Fly a jetpack into a heavily defended fortress maze, avoiding guns, traps and laser guardians, and destroy the generators at its heart; walls collapse once every brick is shot out.
c64:172437.title: Minotax

c64:172438.description: A text adventure in which Ebenezer Scrooge must perform twelve good deeds to make amends for his miserly life, first working out what those deeds are.
c64:172438.title: The Miser

c64:172439.description: The official Major Indoor Soccer League game: build an expansion team into a champion through trades, roster changes and training, acting as coach, general manager, player or all three, with stats kept for nine seasons.
c64:172439.title: MISL: Major Indoor Soccer League

c64:172441.description: A Mastermind-style puzzle: guess a five-digit sequence in six tries, with symbols showing exact and partial matches after each attempt.
c64:172441.title: Miss Mind: Ania

c64:172442.description: Defend your bases from waves of incoming missiles, aiming with a joystick or trackball; options set the starting wave and shot accuracy, and clearing waves earns bonuses and new bases.
c64:172442.title: Missile Attack

c64:172443.description: Rebuild a passage of text by filling in its missing letters one at a time, winning by completing the most gaps while missing as few guesses as possible.
c64:172443.title: M-ss-ng L-nks

c64:172448.description: A whimsical egg-collecting game set in 2020, after a nuclear war has left the world with giant chickens laying giant eggs.
c64:172448.title: Mission Egg

c64:172451.description: Collect and defuse bombs planted across several systems before time runs out, steering against shifting gravity and keeping clear of the walls.
c64:172451.title: Mission II

c64:172452.description: Descend through ten levels into the depths of Jupiter in a smooth-scrolling one- or two-player shooter, conserving fuel and laser power and collecting boosters from the planet's surface.
c64:172452.title: Mission Jupiter

c64:172472.description: During the Vietnam War, Sergeant Tan drives an armed jeep through a horizontally scrolling shooter on an urgent secret delivery, jumping mines and obstacles and destroying tanks and bouncing balls.
c64:172472.title: Mission Monday

c64:172474.description: Fly a ship through five deadly stages, from Terror Spears, Slave-Balls and the Killer Mountains to the Mad Pipes and the Balls of Death, before choosing the exit, with only a few ships to spare.
c64:172474.title: Mission Nada

c64:172479.description: A text adventure in which aliens carry you to a distant planet built to resemble an English village, and the goal is to get back to Earth.
c64:172479.title: Mission X

c64:172522.description: Clear intelligent bugs out of Igos Transputer mega-chips, entering each in a Vector Module and wiping out the bugs in every channel before moving on through a transition stage.
c64:172522.title: Romulus

c64:172527.description: Trapped inside a game a wizard invented for his own amusement, gather the pieces of an amulet on a grid; each collected piece blocks movement back in that direction, and breaking the rule unleashes a beast.
c64:172527.title: The Scrolls of Abadon

c64:172530.description: A platformer about raiding the starbank of Astra, the galaxy's richest store of gems and metals, protected by advanced alarms and cyber guards.
c64:172530.title: Mission X-2

c64:172531.description: An Italian vertically scrolling shooter in the style of Moon Cresta, where rebels rise again just after an intergalactic peace treaty is signed.
c64:172531.title: Missione H

c64:172532.description: Design model cars by choosing engines, transmissions and fuel systems, then test their speed and handling on the track.
c64:172532.title: Model Builder

c64:172533.description: Whack moles as they pop up at random from a 3x3 grid of holes, one of the earliest computer takes on Whac-a-Mole, released on a Japanese MAX cartridge.
c64:172533.title: Mole Attack

c64:172534.description: Defend the Roomlord inheritance against demons, cyclopes, Chinese dragons, gangsters and other foes across 16 screens to become Super Roomlord.
c64:172534.title: RoomLord

c64:172553.description: Las Vegas-style roulette for up to eight players, each starting with 5000; play continues until the last human player is out of money.
c64:172553.title: Roulette Simulator

c64:172556.description: Protect a lunar module by launching rockets at incoming meteors; too many ground hits trigger an earthquake, while surviving 60 meteors earns a bonus and pickup by the mothership.
c64:172556.title: ROX

c64:172571.description: Manage a rugby league club in the north of England from behind your office desk, using a joystick-controlled hand to click items before each match.
c64:172571.title: Rugby Manager

c64:172576.description: Drive through mazes sown with mines, scooping up as many money bags as you can before you run into one. The playfield is drawn entirely in PETSCII characters.
c64:172576.title: Money Minefield

c64:172578.description: A Towers of Hanoi variant: move a stack of monkeys one at a time between three spots, never putting a bigger monkey on a smaller one, to reach two apples in a tree.
c64:172578.title: Monkey Business

c64:172583.description: A monkey on an assembly line must punch the right digit as numbers 0 to 9 scroll quickly past, answering addition, subtraction, multiplication and division problems.
c64:172583.title: Monkeymath

c64:172584.description: A vertically scrolling one- or two-player tank shooter made with the Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit, battling jets, enemy tanks and fortifications while dodging or destroying tank traps; part of ECP's War Games Pak.
c64:172584.title: Monolith Tank

c64:172585.description: A Space Invaders and Gorf-style shooter at a carnival, where aliens disguised as smiling masks attack from every direction, even from below. Released in Italy as Le Maschere.
c64:172585.title: Monster Attack

c64:172586.description: Quarter-mile drag racing in nitro-burning top fuel dragsters, featuring Don 'Big Daddy' Garlits and three-time world champion Shirley 'Cha-Cha' Muldowney.
c64:172586.title: Monster Power

c64:172603.description: The Sorcerer's Apprentice has brought every broom to life with a misjudged spell and must shoot them down over five levels, the first three set in flip-screen caves with movement in depth as well as sideways.
c64:172603.title: Wilberforce: The Sorcerer's Apprentice

c64:172610.description: A small ship that moves in any direction and fires straight up battles three huge aliens that cannot be destroyed; each hit scores points but makes the monster start shooting back. Five lives.
c64:172610.title: Monster Tribe

c64:172611.description: Cross a labyrinth to the other side while monsters try to strike you down, never touching its radioactive walls.
c64:172611.title: Monster Walk

c64:172612.description: A Pac-Man variant with no power pills: eat every object on the board while dodging roaming creatures that drain energy on contact.
c64:172612.title: Monsters

c64:172613.description: A text-based role-playing adventure where the computer acts as Dungeon Master, rolling up a character with hit points and gold to spend on armor and weapons, then levelling them up through fights in monster lairs.
c64:172613.title: Monsters & Magic

c64:172614.description: A platformer about reaching and defeating a deadly creature hidden in a maze, finding and using items along the way while facing mummies, knights, bats and spike traps.
c64:172614.title: Monstrum

c64:172615.description: A Cybernoid-like shooter with puzzle elements, built around matching keys to their doors.
c64:172615.title: Montrix

c64:172619.description: Investigate the 1899 loss of the steamship Victoria, which may not have been the weather's fault, to unmask a century-old spy and find the gold.
c64:172619.title: Salvage III

c64:172642.description: A Frogger variant in space: dodge planets and meteors and hop between rocket ships to reach four docking bays, each closing once filled, with tougher rounds after all four are occupied.
c64:172642.title: Moon Bug

c64:172643.description: A vertically scrolling shooter built with SEUCK, with forward-only fire, several enemy types and bosses.
c64:172643.title: Moon Ceti

c64:172645.description: In a jam factory, Sam eats drops of jam falling from a vat on a conveyor belt and bites into strawberries while avoiding a giant rat across several single-screen levels.
c64:172645.title: Sam's Jam

c64:172657.description: Steer Santa's sleigh over a sleeping Canadian city on Christmas Eve, dropping candy canes down onto the houses for points while dodging aircraft and helicopters. A simple scrolling game played against the clock.
c64:172657.title: The Santa Game

c64:172668.description: In a bad year for Santa, with Rudolph's nose turned black and the goblins having eaten the elves, guide his sleigh over the world's rooftops past dangers and obstacles.
c64:172668.title: Santa's Grotty Christmas

c64:172673.description: A side-scrolling shooter: fly over the landscape protecting ten programmers who escaped prison on the planet Tubark as they walk the long way to a rescue ship at the far right.
c64:172673.title: Scarper!

c64:172674.description: A Polish football management game: run one of eighteen Extraklasa clubs, or take charge of Poland in a League of Nations mode or Legia Warsaw in a Europa League mode.
c64:172674.title: Trener

c64:172677.description: A Balloon Rescue-style game in space: steer a ship down into dangerous diamond fields, collecting crystals against tight time and fuel limits. It was the B-side of To Hell and Back.
c64:172677.title: Moon Crystals

c64:172679.description: A fantasy-themed racing game for two players at once on a split screen.
c64:172679.title: Moonracer

c64:172680.description: A single-player shooter in which an elite unit, called to arms by humanity's Central Council, battles enemy fighters.
c64:172680.title: Moons

c64:172683.description: As janitor of the worst school imaginable, clean it section by section while pupils, teachers and dogs attack, all with a bad back that worsens the more you clean.
c64:172683.title: Mopper

c64:172688.description: A turn-based World War I strategy game for four human or computer players, each starting with one province and a small army on a map of Europe, aiming to conquer the whole continent.
c64:172688.title: Scenario: Theatre of War

c64:172689.description: An illustrated text adventure set in Scarthorpe, a dreary 1980s English town no one visits and no one can leave; the goal is to escape it.
c64:172689.title: Urban Upstart

c64:172691.description: As the Caliph, recover the sacred sceptre stolen by an evil wizard who turned your palace into a trap-filled puzzle maze; a Dizzy-like game of enemies, platform jumps and object use.
c64:172691.title: Sceptre of Baghdad

c64:172701.description: An early edutainment title of seven games built around the Moppets of Moptown, teaching strategic reasoning, pattern recognition and problem solving.
c64:172701.title: Moptown Hotel

c64:172702.description: A logic game for children aged 4 to 7: pick traits for each Moppet creature so they line up in a parade, obeying a numbered rule.
c64:172702.title: Moptown Parade

c64:172703.description: A flip-screen platformer: gather diamonds and treasure on each screen against the clock, creating a limited number of stepping stones to get around.
c64:172703.title: Moribund

c64:172711.description: A reporter at a struggling local paper goes through a morning routine, gets to work and investigates the jobs the boss hands out, hoping for the big scoop.
c64:172711.title: Scoop!

c64:172714.description: A Scottish football management game with over 500 players, match commentary and graphics, the Scottish Cup, and coaching, training, injuries, wages and retirements to handle.
c64:172714.title: Scottish League Football

c64:172716.description: An illustrated text adventure: search the walled desert city of Akbar Khan for the hidden scroll holding the secret of eternal life.
c64:172716.title: The Scroll of Akbar Khan

c64:172718.description: A two-player aerial duel with three planes to choose from.
c64:172718.title: Mortal Dogfight

c64:172722.description: A constantly scrolling horizontal shooter: navigate a deep underground tunnel over four stages, avoiding walls, bouncing balls and doors that switch their electric charge on and off.
c64:172722.title: Warlok

c64:172723.description: A vertical shooter: the Zogrons have seized the planet Scuttle and keep its people in line with a nuclear time bomb buried somewhere in the caverns below.
c64:172723.title: Scuttle

c64:172724.description: Action sequences based on the film, including a dungeon escape, the ice caves and fleeing guards in the woods, played in order or reached by clicking keywords in a scrolling manuscript of the story.
c64:172724.title: Willow

c64:172734.description: Pilot a submarine through underwater caves in a side-scrolling shooter to destroy a reactor under heavy guard, using missiles, torpedoes and a Big Kill weapon that hits everything onscreen against mines, turrets and other foes.
c64:172734.title: Sea Dragon

c64:172746.description: A children's game for one or two players: guide a little seahorse to the shipwreck at the right of the screen, dodging lagoon fish and using tunnels to slip elsewhere.
c64:172746.title: Sea Horse Hide'n Seek

c64:172749.description: Captain the pirate ship Banshee across Khul's Inland Sea, hunting treasure and plundering to fill the hold, then carry the haul safely onward from Tak in the north.
c64:172749.title: Seas of Blood

aliases: The Secret of St. Bride's: A Schoolgirl Adventure
c64:172751.description: A schoolgirl adventure set at the real St. Brides School, a 1980s Irish holiday venue where grown women relived 1920s boarding school life, and which went on to make computer games.
c64:172751.title: The Secret of St. Brides

c64:172755.description: Dash across a road from left to right, dodging cars, to rescue a girl; part of the Cassette 50 collection.
c64:172755.title: Motor-Way

c64:172756.title: Secrets of the Pyramid of Light

c64:172764.description: Fight inward to the innermost ring of a concentric enemy base past locks, keys and puzzles, plant an explosive, then escape within 90 seconds.
c64:172764.title: Sector 90

c64:172765.description: A Battleships-style game: command your fleet to hunt down enemy submarines and battleships.
c64:172765.title: Seek & Destroy!

c64:172769.description: A two-player board puzzle on a seven-by-seven grid where each player has 24 stones and one square stays empty, with players taking turns to move into the gap.
c64:172769.title: Move It

c64:172770.description: A puzzle framed as saving the universe from runaway entropy by moving icons to recombine scattered energy structures.
c64:172770.title: Move On!

c64:172771.description: As a field service worker for CP-Verlag, push boxes down grates in a logic puzzle.
c64:172771.title: Move Out

c64:172772.description: Slide pieces to form matches that vanish from the board, clearing each level to reach the next.
c64:172772.title: Move: The Ultimate Challenge

c64:172773.description: A computer version of a board game, against the computer or a second player: drive a path across the board to the far side while the opponent tries to block it.
c64:172773.title: September

c64:172774.description: A toolkit for making animated films: choose actors in the casting office, dress sets with static and animated props, add a soundtrack in the music studio and cut scenes together in the edit room, then save the movie or put it on a movie disk.
c64:172774.title: Movie Studio

c64:172777.description: A terrorist in the attic of a tall house keeps dropping lit sticks of dynamite, and you stand below with a bucket of water to catch each one and douse its fuse before it lands. Every stick that hits the ground costs a life, while reaching set scores moves you up through the levels.
c64:172777.title: Mr. Dynamite

c64:172778.description: Two measuring games for young children: Growing Races and Climbing and Growing.
c64:172778.title: Mr T's Measuring Games

c64:172779.description: Two number games for young children: How Many? and the Elephant Game.
c64:172779.title: Mr T's Number Games

c64:172780.description: Two shape games for young children: Jigsaws and Shape Maker.
c64:172780.title: Mr T's Shape Games

c64:172781.description: Children build early programming skills by creating designs and drawings.
c64:172781.title: Mr. Pixel's Programming Paint Set

c64:172782.description: Two memory-style matching games for young children: Animal Wildcard and Switcharoo.
c64:172782.title: Mr T's Meets His Match

c64:172783.description: Guide a blobby character around a grid to collect sixteen piles of dynamite while avoiding lit fuses moving across it; the grid wears away wherever the player or the fuses pass.
c64:172783.title: Mr. TNT

c64:172786.description: Steer a multi-segmented snake through a maze and eat the three enemy snakes that enter each level, taking care with rivals longer than your own snake.
c64:172786.title: Serpentine

c64:172787.title: The Sesame Street Crayon: Numbers Count

c64:172797.description: A traffic-light race for one or two players: each runner has a street of their own on the split screen, waggling the joystick left and right to dash forward while the light shows green and halting before it turns red, or falling behind.
c64:172797.title: Muggin

c64:172798.description: A computer version of Nine Men's Morris, the ancient board game also known as Mühle, Merels or Mill.
c64:172798.title: Mühle

c64:172799.description: A Pac-Man game for one player or two at the same time.
c64:172799.title: Munch

aliases: Shamus Case II: Die Suche geht weiter!
c64:172805.description: The villain Shamus caught last time has escaped, so the detective descends into his underground lair, surviving traps, monsters and wrong turns to bring him back.
c64:172805.title: Shamus: Case II

c64:172812.description: A wargame of the April 1862 Battle of Shiloh in Tennessee, the bloody Western Theater clash where Ulysses S. Grant's Union forces defeated the Confederates.
c64:172812.title: Shiloh: Grant's Trial in the West

c64:172813.description: Three activities for kindergarten to first grade: Discovery for exploring the keyboard, Letters for recognising upper and lower case, and Numbers for counting pictures at several difficulty levels.
c64:172813.title: Muppets on Stage

c64:172814.description: Interactive fiction from Bantam's Living Literature series: Holmes, in his sixties, and Dr. Watson are drawn into a murder investigation on the steamship S.S. Destiny.
c64:172814.title: Sherlock Holmes in "Another Bow"

c64:172818.description: Solve a murder at Lord and Lady Osbourne's castle; everyone stays where they were when the body was found, and the killer has thrown the weapon into another room.
c64:172818.title: The Murder at Osbourne Castle

c64:172819.description: Play detective: question suspects, collect information, and accuse the killer.
c64:172819.title: Murder in Flight

c64:172820.description: A talking illustrated text adventure: find Mary before time runs out and she is killed.
c64:172820.title: Murder on the Waterfront

c64:172821.description: A text adventure from The Lockerby Collection: track down and kill a dangerous mutant roaming the area.
c64:172821.title: Mutant

c64:172822.description: Billiards of the year 3000 as a 20-level puzzle: drive a black sphere around big halls, shoving giant balls into holes of the same colour within a time limit while working around square blocks and grey balls that may be moved but never sunk.
c64:172822.title: Muzzy Zoophyte

c64:172824.description: Based on John Astrop's Puffin book, part game and part personal database for storing private secrets about yourself, your friends and your family.
c64:172824.title: My Secret File

c64:172842.description: A Pac-Man clone: clear every dot while four monsters give chase, using power pills to turn them blue and eat them.
c64:172842.title: Mysterix

c64:172843.description: As a security guard, run along the roof of the ITA Express from the last carriage to the front, jumping gaps and kicking off the Redmen who have taken over the train.
c64:172843.title: Stop the Express

c64:172847.description: An update of ShareData's Wheel of Fortune with over a thousand fresh phrases to solve.
c64:172847.title: Wheel of Fortune: New Second Edition

c64:172856.description: Explore an island for ten hidden treasures and store them in the cave behind the waterfall; only five items can be carried at once.
c64:172856.title: Mystery Island

c64:172865.description: Write a script and combine music, characters and backgrounds to stage your own show.
c64:172865.title: Show Director

c64:172868.description: A three-part text adventure: adrift on a raft after abandoning ship in shark-infested waters, find a way home through quests and encounters with monsters.
c64:172868.title: Mystery Voyage

c64:172869.description: Use the Stack lightpen to sort a shuffled grid of letters into alphabetical order, sliding letters singly into the vacant square.
c64:172869.title: Shuffler

c64:172872.description: A H.E.R.O.-style game across 12 rooms: collect every gem, swinging between platforms with a grappling hook and occasionally a gun.
c64:172872.title: Mystical Mission

c64:172873.description: A platform shooter: find the key, ride teleport lifts and open the door, never touching sprites, mines or death zones.
c64:172873.title: NaCl: Natriumchlorid

c64:172875.description: A hack of the Pac-Man clone Munch Mania that plays the game upside down and backwards.
c64:172875.title: Namcap

c64:172876.description: Third of the Mojon Twins' Classic Japanese Monster Castle games and the first starring Nanako; a puzzle platformer that started out on the ZX Spectrum.
c64:172876.title: Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle

c64:172877.description: A real-time strategy game of the 1815 Battle of Waterloo: command Napoleon's army on a top-down wargame-style map of terrain and unit symbols.
c64:172877.title: Napoleon at Waterloo

c64:172904.description: Guide a spacepod through miles of underground caverns without touching the walls; the score rises for every second survived.
c64:172904.title: Navigator

c64:172905.description: Text adventure that opens in a hotel room one floor up in present-day Athens, with the Acropolis ruins in view, as you hunt for the legendary wine that grants immortality.
c64:172905.title: The Nectar of the Gods

c64:172906.description: A coin slot machine that keeps running totals of spins, coins put in and paid out, and how many times you hit a WOW or the jackpot.
c64:172906.title: Neg Slot Machine

c64:172907.description: Recover four treasures that the banker Mr. Klinkoyn has lost around his nine-room house, and bring a bowl of milk to Nellan, his thirsty cat, helped by a magic map and the household's residents.
c64:172907.title: Nellan is Thirsty

c64:172909.description: Trace the lines of a grid to capture its boxes in this Amidar-style game from the Swedish publisher ScandSoft.
c64:172909.title: Net Nut

c64:172910.description: An unfinished preview of a planned Doom-style shooter that plays more like an exploration game, distributed on the Commodore Scene #31 disk.
c64:172910.title: Nether

c64:172911.description: Repeat the computer's sequences by pointing the Stack Lightpen at the right squares; after eight successes the pace quickens, across up to seven levels.
c64:172911.title: Stack 64 Simon

c64:172923.description: A racing game played against opponents over the internet, with IRC support built in.
c64:172923.title: NetRacer

c64:172928.description: Head-to-head Pong-style tennis for one or two players, an updated take on the earliest video tennis games, released on Magic Disk 64 in September 1988.
c64:172928.title: Neutmare

c64:172929.description: Box against a computer-controlled champion or a second player, or watch the computer fight itself; released in Italy as Megabox.
c64:172929.title: Neutral Corner

c64:172930.description: A cover-disk intro with a game attached: after showing off scrolling effects you can play with, press fire to fly a spaceship along a course and reach the end without hitting any obstacle, with only one life per attempt.
c64:172930.title: New Intro Game

c64:172931.description: A set of 20 new Boulder Dash caves, credited in the game to Prof. Knibble.
c64:172931.title: New-Boulderdash 01

c64:172937.description: A rogue Master Control Unit has turned every machine and robot against humanity; as a survivor, gather the pieces of the shutdown code that its programmer spread among others and switch it off.
c64:172937.title: Skegpool Rock: Operation Annihilation

c64:172939.description: Steer a growing snake around single-screen mazes, eating every dot without boxing yourself in; after sixteen levels the mazes start over.
c64:172939.title: Nibbly '92

c64:172940.description: Golf simulation built on Arc's Reality3 3D engine, with two courses plus a hidden low-gravity nine-hole course on Mars, and match or stroke play against eight computer golfers of varying skill.
c64:172940.title: Nick Faldo's Championship Golf

c64:172941.description: A shooting gallery with a 30-second limit: hit as many targets as possible, and on later levels some of them return fire.
c64:172941.title: Nick Nack

c64:172943.description: Race at night along one of four tracks, scoring by passing checkpoints; hitting the roadside, oncoming cars or obstacles drops your speed to nothing.
c64:172943.title: Night Driver

c64:172946.description: Ski down Slalom, Giant Slalom or Alps courses as fast as possible without wiping out; best times are kept until the computer is switched off.
c64:172946.title: Ski-er 64

c64:172966.description: The mathematical strategy game Nim: players alternately remove one or more objects from a single pile. Part of the Cassette 50 compilation.
c64:172966.title: Nim

c64:172970.description: Steer a runaway sleigh down a steep mountainside, dodging trees, hidden snowmen and moguls as the speed keeps building.
c64:172970.title: Sleigh Surprise

c64:172978.description: Side-view tennis in which players can only move forward and back or jump, with the joystick shaping the height and power of each shot.
c64:172978.title: Smash

c64:172979.description: Catch barrels and throw each back aboard the ship while dodging hazards such as kangaroos and penguins; every screen sets its own quota of barrels.
c64:172979.title: Smuggler

c64:172980.description: Guide a lengthening snake to apples while avoiding walls and its own body; after ten apples a door opens to the next level.
c64:172980.title: Snake Byte

c64:172981.description: A beginner-level vertical shooter made with the Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit: gun down ninjas and spiders and collect weapons, treasure and potions.
c64:172981.title: The Ninja Strikes Back

c64:172982.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter in which the Federation sends its best pilot to repel yet another alien invasion of the solar system; released in Italy as Raid.
c64:172982.title: Niobia

c64:172985.description: Text adventure loosely based on the Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale, set in a land spoiled by the scattered shards of a mirror that makes everything look ugly.
c64:172985.title: The Snow Queen

c64:172995.description: Fly an F-14 'Rapier' against drug traffickers in Colombia, striking labs, refineries and convoys from land bases, or sinking drug ships and enemy carriers from an aircraft carrier.
c64:172995.title: Snow Strike

c64:172999.description: Steer four elastic star cruisers through the rotten part of Temakulum, avoiding evil-looking creatures while rescuing helpless humans and picking up cute little monsters, by joystick or keyboard.
c64:172999.title: The Nite-Express

c64:173000.description: Tile puzzle in which you swap and flip tiles to form matches without leaving other tiles stranded; published on Game On 1992/06.
c64:173000.title: No Deeper Meaning

c64:173001.description: Top-down racing game featuring Porsches, distributed on Tiger-Crew-Disk #020.
c64:173001.title: No Limit

c64:173002.description: Bounce a ball across 99 levels of tiles to reach the exit before time expires; each tile type rebounds differently and vanishes once left, and missing a tile costs a life.
c64:173002.title: Nocturno

c64:173003.description: Text-only fantasy adventure: as an elite Nogard warrior, collect six items for your king, who is hiding under a bed in his storeroom during a war. Later reissued with graphics as Maze of Nogard.
c64:173003.title: Nogard

c64:173005.description: Fight through three kinds of combat: on foot with a rifle against waves of troops, then in a tank, then in an attack helicopter.
c64:173005.title: Soldier

c64:173009.description: As the space pirate Nomad, weave through the outer galaxy evading those who want your cargo of precious metals; part of the Sky Fighters game pack.
c64:173009.title: Nomad: The Space Pirate

c64:173010.description: Railroad traffic control simulation spanning 325 miles of track from Washington, D.C. up to Wilmington, Delaware.
c64:173010.title: Northeast Corridor

c64:173011.description: A speedway management game set in the 1960s National League: manage one of eight clubs through fourteen league matches, renaming riders, picking line-ups and reserves for each heat, and bringing in loan riders to cover injuries.
c64:173011.title: Nostalga Speedway

c64:173013.description: Light-hearted American Civil War strategy based on the Belgian comic Les Tuniques Bleues. Move Union or Confederate armies across a map of the States, then fight real-time side-view battles with infantry, cavalry and cannon, plus fort raids and train robberies.
c64:173013.title: North & South!

c64:173029.description: Puzzle game in the vein of Deflektor: place tiles on the board to route light beams to a target, using deflectors, solid blocks and blocks the light destroys.
c64:173029.title: Nova

c64:173030.description: Side-scrolling shooter defending four domed cities from air and ground invaders; each shield absorbs one hit, and the ship fires lasers forward and drops bombs.
c64:173030.title: Nova Blast

c64:173031.description: Vertical space shooter made with the Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit: armed with an experimental Nova-Proton weapon, strike back after the Rutilians seize the base holding the defense codes on Deimos.
c64:173031.title: Nova Force

c64:173033.description: Space Invaders-style shooter where your ship slides left and right firing at seven kinds of attackers descending from above; released in Italy as Stronghold.
c64:173033.title: Nucleus

c64:173034.description: Adventure in which you must stop the deranged General K.A. Boom, who has set computers in motion to destroy the world and does not welcome intruders.
c64:173034.title: Nuke

c64:173035.description: Educational bowling game in which children solve fraction and decimal problems; aimed at ages 11 and up.
c64:173035.title: Number Bowling

c64:173036.description: Math game where the creature Wumblechum hops across numbered and sign cubes, adding or subtracting values to reach target numbers.
c64:173036.title: Number Tumblers

c64:173038.description: Puzzle in which colored nuts sit in two square grids; slide whole rows or columns of the left grid to match the layout of the right one. Released in Italy as Snocciolando.
c64:173038.title: Nuts in the World of Fantasy

c64:173067.description: Occult detective text adventure: as a private investigator, begin in your office piecing together clues from an envelope on your desk. It became the basis for the author's later Methyhel games.
c64:173067.title: Nythyhel

c64:173069.description: Command the White Fleet to retake a South Pacific island from the Black Fleet, using a carrier, patrol planes, bombers, PT boats, destroyers, battleships and landing ships.
c64:173069.title: South Pacific Task Force

c64:173075.description: Crosshair shooter casting you as Lee Enfield, retaking a space station from invading soldiers by tracking down and shooting each one across a multi-directional scrolling map.
c64:173075.title: Space Ace

c64:173077.description: As a bounty hunter in a newly colonized star system, track down the source of the attacking alien ships and destroy it.
c64:173077.title: Space Ace 2101

c64:173085.description: Shoot down enemy ships that appear ever faster using your ship's laser shield; six hits freeze you and end the game.
c64:173085.title: Space Freeze

aliases: The Oakflat Nuclear Power Plant Simulator
c64:173087.description: Shareware nuclear power plant simulation: work the control rods and primary and secondary cooling pumps to keep the reaction stable, scored on the power produced in each attempt.
c64:173087.title: Oak Flat Nuclear Power Plant Simulator

c64:173088.description: Minimalist adventure in which you ignore a warning sign and enter the Tomb of Shalimar in search of its treasures.
c64:173088.title: The Oasis of Shalimar

c64:173090.description: A text adventure aboard the starship Zeus 11, beginning in its entrance hall: collect items such as a sonic spanner, a bottle of chemicals and an oil can, get past a guard droid, decode a leaflet with a mirror and avoid being blown into space.
c64:173090.title: Oddessy

c64:173094.description: Viking text adventure in which you must rescue Sif; praying at altars brings random hints, and food keeps hunger away. Shared on Q-Link in 1986.
c64:173094.title: Odinshrine

c64:173096.description: Party game for four based on Warlords: each lord moves a shield to deflect plasma balls away from their own space station at the edge of a spiral nebula.
c64:173096.title: Space Lords

c64:173105.description: Stranded in the Tessican system, fly a hijacked Star Five gunfighter over varied landscapes while fighting off the local pilots.
c64:173105.title: Space Relief

c64:173107.description: Release a ball from moving wires so it bounces through a maze collecting treasure; it has limited hit points, so the timing of each release matters.
c64:173107.title: Ograton

c64:173109.description: Escaped from a cell beneath planet Morgon, flee through tunnels chased by robots, some destructible and some not, while watching your oxygen supply.
c64:173109.title: Space Trap

c64:173114.description: Run the Spare Change Arcade, a hall of token machines, jukeboxes, phones and popcorn machines, restocking token machines with money from the register when they run dry.
c64:173114.title: Spare Change

c64:173127.description: Two arithmetic drill games, Speed Math and Bingo Math, on one release.
c64:173127.title: Speed/Bingo Math

c64:173131.description: Manage a 1992 speedway club such as Belle Vue Aces, Bradford Dukes or Coventry Bees through a fourteen-match league, choosing riders like Hans Nielsen and Greg Hancock for each heat, using reserves and chasing the title.
c64:173131.title: Speedway: Team Championship

c64:173132.description: Word-recognition games for readers six and up: as a diver, uncover words hidden by lettermoss on the sea floor while avoiding flipper-nippers and sharks.
c64:173132.title: Spelldiver

c64:173133.description: Spell words correctly to keep a helicopter in the air; 400 words in 40 categories across beginner, intermediate and advanced levels.
c64:173133.title: Spellicopter: The Action Spelling Game

c64:173135.description: Oil's Well-style game: prospect for oil with a drilling rig without touching the enemies underground. Published in 64'er Sonderheft 54.
c64:173135.title: Oil Challenge

c64:173136.description: An Oil's Well-style drilling game in which you prospect for oil while avoiding the hazards of the trade; published on Golden Disk 64 in July 1991.
c64:173136.title: Oilmania

c64:173138.description: A dice betting game: start with 100 in capital, stake an amount on a number from one to six and roll three dice, winning according to how many show your number until you go broke.
c64:173138.title: Old Bones Dice

c64:173139.description: A board game like draughts in which you capture by moving onto an enemy piece rather than jumping it; the computer always moves first, moves are typed as board coordinates, and the first to capture six pieces wins.
c64:173139.title: Oldbones

c64:173140.description: Horizontally scrolling shooter: destroy aliens that keep attacking in new formations. Published in 64'er Sonderheft 37.
c64:173140.title: Omega Force One

c64:173155.description: Arcade adventure across 384 screens of a haunted mansion, where touching ghosts knocks your ghost hunter off course, sometimes down a whole screen.
c64:173155.title: Spooked
