c64:173156.description: MLBPA-licensed baseball featuring stars like George Brett, Ozzie Smith and Roger Clemens, plus the option of a Hall of Fame team; play a friend or the computer, or watch the computer play itself.
c64:173156.title: The Sporting News Baseball

c64:173157.description: Quiz game based on the late-1980s British TV show: three human or computer players each pick from 12 sport categories such as soccer, cricket and Pot Luck across seven rounds.
c64:173157.title: Sporting Triangles

c64:173158.description: 7Up-licensed strategy board game for up to four players: spread your colored spots from your corner by cloning into adjacent squares or jumping further.
c64:173158.title: Spot: The Computer Game!

c64:173166.description: A 1987 rework of Omega Race with new character sets, sprites, hi-res pictures and selectable speeds; shoot the attacking Droid ships and the mines they drop.
c64:173166.title: Omega Race II

c64:173169.description: A timed sliding-block puzzle over 40 levels: push coloured stones through walled mazes until they touch stones of the same colour, which turns them into fixed walls, leaving no stone unmatched. Bombs blast open a path you have blocked, and finishing the game reveals a password for the level editor.
c64:173169.title: On a Move

c64:173187.description: Text adventure where you captain a long-range maritime patrol aircraft at 15,000 feet over the Arzelean Sea, hunting enemy boats and submarines.
c64:173187.title: Spyplane

c64:173188.description: Columns-like puzzle: drop groups of three colored blocks into a 6x18 grid and line up three of the same color.
c64:173188.title: Stack Up

c64:173189.description: Crosshair military shooter inspired by Operation Wolf.
c64:173189.title: Operation Fox

c64:173190.description: Unfinished 1987 fighting game: kick enemies or attack with a gun, bazooka and grenades across two floors, backed by Rob Hubbard music.
c64:173190.title: Operation Ironhawk

c64:173191.description: As agent Rip Steel, pilot a small submarine to destroy the Yellow Shadow's undersea mining bases while defending your own.
c64:173191.title: Operation Neptune

c64:173192.description: Single-screen first-person shooter set at a church: aim at the windows and shoot the priests who appear every few seconds; two difficulty levels.
c64:173192.title: Operation Proboszcz

c64:173193.description: Espionage action game: hunt through the mysterious Antimatter Complex for secret documents, with a two-player mode over modem.
c64:173193.title: Operation Terminal

c64:173194.description: Infiltrate the military base that invaders from Zekloke have built on Mars, destroy it, and recover the hidden plans for a defense shield.
c64:173194.title: Operation: Sabotage

c64:173195.description: Snake game for two players at once, published on Magic Disk 64 in June 1991.
c64:173195.title: Opium

c64:173196.description: As a frog, hop between tiles and the blank island to bring all matching pieces together without stranding yourself.
c64:173196.title: Oracle

c64:173197.description: Space combat in 3D: hunt enemy saucers, using the scanner to track individual ships and to find your base.
c64:173197.title: Star Fights

c64:173198.description: Clear colored stones within 99 seconds per level by matching identical ones, guiding an arrow-shaped figure that jumps between them.
c64:173198.title: Oracle II

c64:173199.description: Push blocks so two or more identical squares meet and vanish; 32 levels on each of four difficulty settings, the last unlocked by beating hard mode.
c64:173199.title: Oracle III

c64:173200.description: Puzzle game: move the four-ball Orbs into pillars to clear them from each level. Published on Magic Disk 64 in June 1994.
c64:173200.title: Orb

c64:173201.description: As a new Starfleet Academy graduate commanding the training ship U.G.A.S. Republic, defend the Antares III region against the Krellan and Zaldron empires.
c64:173201.title: Star Fleet I: The War Begins!

c64:173219.description: Adventure set in King Elrad the Second's palace: restore the missing Orb of Light to its empty crystal cage before darkness takes the land.
c64:173219.title: The Orb of Light

c64:173222.description: Lander game from Cassette 50: from a decaying orbit, pick a spot on a fissured high-gravity planet and touch down before fuel runs out.
c64:173222.title: Orbitter

c64:173226.description: Parker Brothers' cartridge version of the Atari arcade game: as Luke Skywalker, Red Five, fly a first-person rail shooter that imitates the arcade's color vector graphics.
c64:173226.title: Star Wars: The Arcade Game

c64:173231.description: Tetris variant where blocks of matching color and pattern combine to keep the well from filling; keep stacking until the counter reaches zero.
c64:173231.title: Orbits

c64:173235.description: Soccer management sim covering both sport and finances: lead a club from the German fourth division to the top league, reaching a goal chosen before play.
c64:173235.title: Starbyte Super Soccer

c64:173239.title: Stories of Beryland II: Ormus II

c64:173240.description: 2D RPG set in Beryland in 1227, where the Ormus Cult has seized power; your hero starts on the southwest shore beside the city of Remfield.
c64:173240.title: The Ormus Saga

c64:173241.title: The Ormus Saga II: Guild of Death

c64:173242.title: The Ormus Saga III: The Final Chapter

c64:173245.description: Single-screen shooter: hit an alien with your laser while dodging its fire, which blasts holes in the ground that restrict your movement and cost a life if touched.
c64:173245.title: Osar II

c64:173247.description: Scrolling platformer in which farmer Oskar takes on cow-sized killer wasps and cockroaches mutated by a reactor accident in a small New Arizona town.
c64:173247.title: Oskar

c64:173249.description: Humorous parody of sports compilations like California Games, with events such as cow milking and fishing.
c64:173249.title: Ostfrieslandgames

c64:173254.description: Arcade conversion: first-person space combat, shooting incoming fighters with a laser sight before fuel runs out; packaged with Fire One.
c64:173254.title: Starfire

c64:173268.description: Early party-based RPG: lead one to six fighters, priests, thieves and other classes through a multi-level dungeon, gaining loot and experience while characters age and can die.
c64:173268.title: Oubliette

c64:173274.description: Flick-screen platformer in the style of Thing on a Spring starring a bouncing red-and-white ball, flipping switches across six themed levels, among them Kitchen, Toys and Plants, to open each exit.
c64:173274.title: Otherworld

c64:173275.description: Two pink blobs square off beyond the city limits in this two-player-only sequel to Ouch!, each drifting around the screen and trying to drop heavy weights onto the other.
c64:173275.title: Ouch! 2

c64:173300.description: Two-player-only space duel viewed from above, with Asteroids-style rotate-and-thrust ships trying to shoot each other down.
c64:173300.title: Stellar Triumph

c64:173319.description: Vertically scrolling space shooter: blast everything in sight except the diamond-shaped ship, which must be dodged.
c64:173319.title: Outcrush

c64:173325.description: Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit sample game set in the Wild West: two outlaws fight through dangerous territory to escape to Mexico.
c64:173325.title: Outlaw (Palace Software)

c64:173326.description: Galaxian-style shooter with oddball enemies such as umbrellas, slices of toast, fish and snakes and ladders; released at Replay Expo 2011.
c64:173326.title: Out-Space

c64:173328.description: A two-player race: each player has five cars to drive anticlockwise around the track faster than the opponent, with an accelerator that gives bursts of speed but burns fuel; run dry and you coast, and crashing all five cars loses the game.
c64:173328.title: Overtake

c64:173329.description: Boulder Dash-style digger: collect a set number of diamonds before time expires, dropping boulders by clearing the earth beneath them.
c64:173329.title: P. P. Digger

c64:173332.description: Collect every dot to advance while avoiding enemies that follow fixed routes.
c64:173332.title: Pac Mann

c64:173334.description: Multi-directional scrolling shooter: fly an advanced starfighter with a particle beam cannon into the Star Bee system to find the Star Queen's hive and destroy her.
c64:173334.title: Stinger!

c64:173335.description: Collect treats around the stockade while dodging arrows from Native American attackers.
c64:173335.title: Stockade

c64:173340.description: Pac-Man clone with four difficulty levels and 25 starting lives.
c64:173340.title: Pac-Family

c64:173341.description: One to six players trade stock in four mining firms as prices rise and fall; whoever first reaches a million pounds wins.
c64:173341.title: Stockmarket

c64:173346.description: Paddington tries out the vanishing ink from his conjuring set while writing a postcard to Aunt Lucy in Peru, in this Collins storybook-and-cassette pack for young children.
c64:173346.title: Paddington and the Disappearing Ink

c64:173347.description: Pong variant for one or two players, scoring more for catching faster balls, with a flashing energy field at the center of the playfield.
c64:173347.title: Paddles

c64:173348.description: Single-player Tron-style trail game from the Crazy Corners and Arcade Action packs.
c64:173348.title: Paint & Corners

c64:173376.description: Children type simple sentences like 'The girl jumps over the flower' and watch them animated, building short stories of around 40 words.
c64:173376.title: Story Machine

c64:173377.description: A terrorist bomb has crashed a shuttle into the Stratton Air Terminal, cutting life support and leaving survivors trapped by active defense units; you are sent into the wreck.
c64:173377.title: Stratton

c64:173381.description: Defender-style shooter: protect human prisoners on the ground from aliens that abduct and kill them while firing at your ship.
c64:173381.title: Paladin

c64:173382.description: Hop around the world as a runaway pancake, grabbing fruit that birds knock down while avoiding hazards; released in Italy as Urca.
c64:173382.title: Pancake

c64:173383.description: Football career game: start as an 18-year-old striker in the English Fourth Division and chase promotion and trophies until retiring at 34, with moves to European and national teams possible.
c64:173383.title: Striker

c64:173384.description: Football management where you are both manager and striker, taking your team from the English Fourth Division to the First, with chances to run a European or national side.
c64:173384.title: Striker Manager

c64:173385.description: Fly a small prop plane through stunts at an airshow, viewed in first-person 3D or a side-scrolling 2D mode.
c64:173385.title: Stunt Flyer

c64:173388.description: Hulk Hogan movie tie-in mixing space shooting, platform jumping and beat-'em-up action.
c64:173388.title: Suburban Commando

c64:173413.description: Aliens have drained Earth's energy and hidden it in a cave at the world's end; with three armed shuttles, fly out to bring it back.
c64:173413.title: Suicide Voyage

c64:173427.description: Q*bert-style isometric puzzle: hop Pancho onto every square to paint it while avoiding the Mad Mexican Muncher; included in the French compilation 3 Super Jeux.
c64:173427.title: Pancho

c64:173433.description: Survive in a field of blocks while monsters keep hunting you: walk up to a block and press fire to send it sliding into a monster, though a block with another one behind it shatters instead. The on-screen instructions are in Dutch.
c64:173433.title: Pango

c64:173436.description: Work a multi-level production line, gathering three kinds of parts that drop from chutes and assembling them in the right order to keep up with orders.
c64:173436.title: Panic Button

c64:173439.description: Rescue parachutists dropping into the sea by catching them in your boat or throwing a net overboard; they jump in pairs or threes, and any you miss try to swim for it.
c64:173439.title: Supa Catcha Troopa

c64:173477.description: Comic text adventure: track down the president of Paranoids Anonymous after being invited to its weekly meeting by members who will not reveal its location or the way in.
c64:173477.title: Paranoids Anonymous

c64:173494.description: Slide and drop pieces to match and remove them, opening up further combinations without blocking yourself in; published on Game On 1991/05.
c64:173494.title: Paranoimia

c64:173495.description: Interwar spy adventure: as French Secret Service agent Phillip Groucy, wake up penniless in a seedy Paris suburb and recover your stolen credit card.
c64:173495.title: Parisian Nights

c64:173497.description: Horizontally scrolling shooter with attack waves, power-ups, mini-bosses and boss fights, published on Game On 1993/10.
c64:173497.title: Parsec

c64:173502.description: Based on the TV show in which kids from the four home nations of the UK competed on motorcycles, quad bikes, mini-hovercraft and jet skis.
c64:173502.title: Super Champs

c64:173586.description: With the Emperor dead and the Parthian Empire splintered, command a king's army, hire mercenaries, form alliances and levy taxes to conquer rival city states and take the throne.
c64:173586.title: Parthian Kings

c64:173587.description: Trivia game with 2,500 questions for one to four players or teams, played on four hand-held response controllers; game length and answer time are adjustable.
c64:173587.title: PQ: The Party Quiz Game

c64:173588.description: UK driving theory quiz in 40 lessons, each covering a topic likely to come up in the written test.
c64:173588.title: Pass Your Driving Test

c64:173589.description: Adventure based on Francois Bourgeon's comic series: direct the heroes' choices through many locations and events, with the story branching on the paths you take.
c64:173589.title: Passengers on the Wind 2

c64:173590.description: As a tour guide for 12 tourists who wander off and pocket priceless British treasures, search a maze of London streets to recover the missing objects.
c64:173590.title: Passport to London

c64:173591.description: As a tour guide whose group's flight home has been moved up an hour, round up all 12 wandering tourists around Paris before it leaves.
c64:173591.title: Passport to Paris

c64:173595.description: Two-player edition of the game OsWALD of the Ice Floes, which was first designed to be played by push-button telephone on Danish TV2's Eleva2ren show.
c64:173595.title: Super OsWALD

c64:173614.description: Spy mission to locate a fighter jet armed with a nuclear warhead that vanished on a training flight, and defuse it; the game opens as a text adventure.
c64:173614.title: Super Spy

c64:173640.description: Race a truck through nine European cities such as London, Brussels and Paris, beating the time limit on each section despite blind hills and roadworks.
c64:173640.title: Super Trux

c64:173646.description: Top-down action soccer with a ten-team league. Besides the usual passing, shooting and tackling there is a curling cross, control switches to your goalkeeper once the opposition enters the box, and the pitch colour can be changed mid-match.
c64:173646.title: Supercup Football

c64:173649.description: Your family has settled on the swamp planet Sylva 7, and on guard duty at the colony's edge you hold back multiplying killer spores, carnivorous plants and giant insects with a photon cannon through nights that last six Earth days.
c64:173649.title: Swamp Attack

c64:173661.title: Sydney Hunter and the Sacred Tribe

c64:173663.description: Fly an impulse-drive fighter to stop the Syntax assault on Earth by collecting ten radio-deactivation crystals and dropping them down the Syntax ventilation shaft.
c64:173663.title: Syntax

c64:173728.description: Table tennis against seven computer opponents for the championship, with exhibition and tournament modes and settings for match length and skill.
c64:173728.title: Table Tennis

c64:173729.description: Two programs for practicing multiplication tables from 1 to 10, for children aged six and up.
c64:173729.title: Tablesums

c64:17373.description: Mondain and Minax left behind a child, Exodus, who now menaces Sosaria; lead a party of four adventurers across the land to find and destroy it.
c64:17373.title: Ultima III: Exodus

c64:173741.description: WWII tactical armor combat: pick a British, American, German or Russian force, build a team of tanks, tank destroyers and assault guns, and hunt the enemy while the computer takes care of technical details.
c64:173741.title: TAC: Tactical Armor Command

c64:173742.description: The villain Vincent Ratatoui has stolen the world's cheese, and a martial-arts tortoise sets out across over 100 screens of platforms and ladders to get it back.
c64:173742.title: Tai Chi Tortoise

c64:173745.description: A talking early-learning program for children aged two to eight: synthesized speech asks things like which letter 'rooster' starts with, as children learn capital and small letters, find their way around the keyboard, practise spatial ideas and link letter sounds to pictures of over 100 animals and objects.
c64:173745.title: Talking Teacher

c64:173747.description: Two to four players battle in tanks until one remains, across ten maps from deserts and snowfields to arenas, mountains and swamps, with an adjustable number of mines.
c64:173747.title: Tanks 3000

c64:173750.description: To win Princess Kelly's hand, a prince must complete seven tasks set by her doubting father King Otto, starting with surviving a night outside the castle.
c64:173750.title: Taskmaster

c64:173753.description: Pac-Man clone with six levels: eat money while dodging the Taxmen trying to bankrupt you; modeled on Taxman for the Apple II.
c64:173753.title: Tax Man

c64:173755.description: Overhead horizontal shooter against an alien invasion over six levels in three stages, the first modeled on Uridium's runs across a planet or spacecraft surface.
c64:173755.title: Terra Fighter

c64:173756.description: Steer a tank through a trap-filled maze to find seven parts of the Hypercom machine; ammunition is limited, depots refill it once, and touching walls is fatal.
c64:173756.title: Terror Tank

c64:173757.description: Mixing strategy, action and crosshair shooting, lead Red Leader's anti-terrorist squad to a town under attack, with four difficulty levels, randomized attacks and 3D battles on over 8,000 maps.
c64:173757.title: Terrorist

c64:173768.description: Bookware text adventure based on Colin Kapp's science fiction stories: as Lt. Fritz van Noon, lead the Unorthodox Engineers to learn the purpose of an indestructible pillar of darkness.
c64:173768.title: The Unorthodox Engineers: The Pen and the Dark

c64:173772.description: Sliding-block puzzle: maneuver the large red block out through the gap at the bottom by entering block numbers and directions; three invalid moves lose the puzzle.
c64:173772.title: The Thinker

c64:173778.description: Vietnam War flight sim as an F-105 Thunderchief pilot, flying strike and defense-suppression missions into North Vietnam's Route Package target zones.
c64:173778.title: Thud Ridge: American Aces in 'Nam

c64:173786.description: Learn Spanish language and culture by exploring Spain, completing tasks such as visiting monuments, eating at restaurants and shopping at grocery and department stores.
c64:173786.title: Ticket to Spain

c64:173796.description: Battle of the Bulge wargame: as the German commander in December 1944, push division and regiment-sized units through the Ardennes and across the Meuse.
c64:173796.title: The Battle of the Bulge: Tigers in the Snow

c64:173799.description: Rescue Anacron, who meddled with your time machine, fell in, and is now tumbling through history.
c64:173799.title: Time Bound

c64:173800.description: As a trans-temporal mercenary, fight through seven time zones from prehistory, the Middle Ages and the Wild West to Prohibition, WWII, the space age and 1980s New York.
c64:173800.title: Time Fighter

c64:173804.description: Text adventure: explore the countryside around your village to locate a time machine before you can use it.
c64:173804.title: Time Search

c64:173806.description: Rescue five warriors held in different eras, from the Primitive Age and Rome to the World Wars and Future World, each held by a henchman of Gylend.
c64:173806.title: Time Soldier

c64:173810.description: Seal eight portals that dark forces opened in the space-time continuum by returning objects to the Minds guarding them and forming spells from the runes they give.
c64:173810.title: TimeTrax

c64:173824.description: Five spelling and vocabulary games in which children travel to town with Tuk through four changing places on eight different vehicles, at adjustable difficulty.
c64:173824.title: Tink! Tonk! Tuk Goes to Town

c64:173827.description: Text-only boxing sim with more than 600 fighters, including retired boxers at various points in their careers who can face each other across eras; adjust tactics between rounds.
c64:173827.title: TKO Pro Boxing

c64:173828.description: Chase a top-ten hit: walk a street visiting homes, a recording studio, a disco and a TV station as you create a song.
c64:173828.title: To be on Top

c64:173832.description: Tactical wargame of the May-July 1942 battle for Tobruk in Libya, where control of the Allies' six supply points is vital.
c64:173832.title: Tobruk: The Clash of Armour

c64:173841.description: Early-learning package covering the alphabet and numbers, with memory and matching games.
c64:173841.title: Toddler Tutor

c64:173842.description: Control both Tomarc and Senta at once: Tomarc searches the caves for his magic sword, then frees Senta from her magical cage, avoiding rats and other dangers.
c64:173842.title: Tomarc the Barbarian

c64:173843.description: Drag racing with tire and engine setup, shown in split first-person and side views; win four races in a 16-car bracket to take the title.
c64:173843.title: Top Fuel Eliminator

c64:173844.description: Strategy game for one to ten music producers: starting with 75,000 pounds, fund songs at one of three budgets, naming the title and artist, with bigger spending making bigger hits.
c64:173844.title: Top of the Pops

c64:173855.description: A top-hatted policeman searches four floors of rooms linked by corridors and a lift for clues, pinning the crime on one of seven suspects before time runs out.
c64:173855.title: Topper the Copper

c64:173871.description: Golf with two 18-hole courses featuring traps and gophers, plus a driving range and putting green for practice.
c64:173871.title: Tournament Golf

c64:173876.description: Switch traffic lights to steer cars, buses and motorbikes through the crowded streets of London, getting a set number of vehicles off the screen to advance.
c64:173876.title: Traffic

c64:173878.description: Drive a train collecting passengers along the track, scoring one point per carriage, while avoiding the Ghost Train; clear all passengers and enter the tunnel for more.
c64:173878.title: Trax!

c64:173880.description: Text-only management game: pick and train England's squad and follow matches through running commentary on the road to the World Cup.
c64:173880.title: Trevor Brooking's World Cup Glory

c64:173906.description: Three math games featuring a hungry space invader, a haunted house and a Digitosaurus.
c64:173906.title: Tri-Math

c64:173913.description: As Polly, walk beneath cards and flip them until you find the one requested; up to 52 cards are spread across a chosen number of screens, some hiding jokers.
c64:173913.title: Patience Polly

c64:173914.description: Towers of Hanoi puzzle, published on Game On 1992/12.
c64:173914.title: Patternia

c64:173915.description: Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game steering Paul the beetle through a dangerous world where anything that moves is a threat; published on Magic Disk 64 1988/08.
c64:173915.title: Paul der Käfer

c64:173917.description: Collect green peas around a maze while a giant pea monster hunts you; swinging doors can be broken but the monster repairs them, and at times it can be eaten.
c64:173917.title: Pea Picker

c64:173918.description: For ages 4-8: solve randomly generated mazes to get Peanuts characters to their destinations.
c64:173918.title: Peanuts Maze Marathon

c64:173919.description: Rebuild Peanuts pictures split into four blanked sections by choosing the right piece for each, then watch an animation; timed or untimed.
c64:173919.title: Peanuts Picture Puzzlers

c64:173920.description: Dizzy-style arcade adventure in a medieval fantasy world: explore a castle and its surroundings to recover the Pearl of Dawn, fighting or avoiding enemies along the way.
c64:173920.title: The Pearl of Dawn

c64:173921.description: Frogger-style crossing game: get a pedestrian over a busy highway, past spiders and aliens and across a crocodile-filled stream to reach home.
c64:173921.title: Pedestrian

c64:173922.description: Joust-style action on a single screen of mountains and a glowing volcano, flying a pegasus against enemy riders.
c64:173922.title: Pegasus Odyssey

c64:173925.description: Turn-based strategy: move a castle across a checkerboard from bottom to top, with one to four moves per turn set at the start.
c64:173925.title: Pensate

c64:173926.description: Horizontally scrolling shooter guiding Peppi the dragon through a hostile cityscape, defeating bosses to reach each new area.
c64:173926.title: Peppi's Quest

c64:173930.description: Across 64 levels, brown blocks win over grey ones simply by touching them, but each brown block has a limited number of moves, so every step needs planning. No time limit, and passwords record your progress.
c64:173930.title: Perplex

c64:173931.description: A puzzle of 64 levels in which every blank square on the board must be coloured in: drag an already coloured square next to a blank one and release it to colour its neighbour, which can then be moved in turn, while both a timer and a move counter run down. Level codes and an editor are included.
c64:173931.title: Perplex II

c64:173932.description: Roll a ball over coloured tiles without falling off: green is solid ground unless cracked, blue slides you like ice to the next colour, and the flashing violet squares that must be collected vanish once crossed. One life, and an editor for building or changing levels.
c64:173932.title: Pertharion

c64:173933.description: Checkers against the computer under standard rules, with pieces crowned on reaching the far side.
c64:173933.title: PET Checkers

c64:173939.description: Simulation of the 1905 Battle of Tsushima, where Japan's fleet defeated Russia's Baltic Fleet; one or two players, with strategic and combat-only scenarios.
c64:173939.title: Tsushima

c64:173940.description: Horse racing program that takes form data for each horse and uses a prediction routine to suggest likely winners.
c64:173940.title: Turf-Form: Beat the Bookie!

c64:173959.description: Quiz on UK geography with five modes covering naming and locating towns, regions and mountain ranges.
c64:173959.title: U.K. Geography

c64:173960.description: Detailed simulation, played one day at a time, of the WWII daylight strategic bombing campaign against Nazi Europe, tracking every serviceable aircraft before and after each mission.
c64:173960.title: U.S.A.A.F.: United States Army Air Force

c64:173961.description: Uhg the hungry caveman climbs down vines through four cave levels to find five dinosaur eggs and bring them to the surface, clubbing small dinosaurs on the way.
c64:173961.title: UHG

c64:173962.description: Casino simulation set in Trump Castle with blackjack, poker, roulette, craps, keno and slots, and an adjustable $10,000 default bet limit.
c64:173962.title: Trump Castle: The Ultimate Casino Gambling Simulation

c64:173963.description: WWII tactical land combat with American, German and Russian troops across nine scenarios, from open firefights to house-to-house battles.
c64:173963.title: Under Fire!

c64:173964.description: Text adventure: a wizard has trapped you in the underworld, and you must find a way out using verb-noun commands.
c64:173964.title: Underworld of Kyn

c64:173965.description: As secret agent Rupert Pettigrew, track down five agents and the Safras sword in four parts; partly combines Shards' Pettigrew's Diary and Operation Safras.
c64:173965.title: The Pettigrew Chronicles

c64:173966.description: Stack falling polygons so their faces fit exactly, clearing complete horizontal lines to keep the tower low; released in Italy as Fadrika.
c64:173966.title: Phaedra

c64:173967.description: Short adventure with odd puzzles in which you must reach the princess, who will then rescue you.
c64:173967.title: Phantasmagoria

c64:173980.description: Word game: grab letters off a rotating cube before your opponents and arrange them into words in your playing area.
c64:173980.title: Up for Grabs

c64:173981.description: Two learning games on one cartridge: Number Nabber for arithmetic and Shape Grabber for recognizing shapes.
c64:173981.title: Number Nabber, Shape Grabber

c64:173982.description: One- or two-player space shooter: nearing your galactic outpost, attack an Alderon mothership orbiting above a settlement.
c64:173982.title: Space Ric-O-Shay

c64:173985.description: Maze game across 250 rooms on four levels joined by elevators, collecting eight treasures as a squid-like character; finishers could enter a $500 prize drawing.
c64:173985.title: Tyler's Dungeons

c64:173986.description: Children aged 5-10 build and animate Wild West scenes from a set of critters, characters and shapes.
c64:173986.title: Ranch

c64:173990.description: Illustrated text adventure set in a sleepy English village where odd things start happening after Professor Blowitovitz moves in.
c64:173990.title: Upper Gumtree and Professor Blowitovitz

c64:173992.description: Medieval fantasy platformer and scrolling shooter inspired by Ghosts'n Goblins, with a hero battling monsters; by Alberto Frabetti, who went on to write Dragon's Kingdom.
c64:173992.title: Vardan

c64:173993.description: As a master thief, descend through a Swiss bank's underground vaults to the chairman's chamber nine levels down and steal the OPEC oil deeds.
c64:173993.title: The Vaults of Zurich

c64:173994.description: Casino game with video poker, roulette, blackjack and slots, starting with $500; limits are $200 for blackjack and roulette and $5 for poker and slots.
c64:173994.title: Vegas Gambler

c64:173995.description: A casino collection picked from one menu: keno, craps, draw poker, blackjack, a slot machine and horse racing, plus a Spin-a-Fortune phrase-guessing game with a file maker for writing your own phrase sets.
c64:173995.title: Vegas Games

c64:174000.description: Egyptian-themed multi-screen platformer that borrows some sprites from Myth; published on Game On 1992/09.
c64:174000.title: Pharaoh

c64:174005.description: Computer jigsaw puzzles of 25 or 50 pieces, with or without outlines: study the picture, then move pieces into the empty square to rebuild it.
c64:174005.title: Viduzzles

c64:174007.description: One- or two-player shooter: roam a single screen guarding a central core from aliens over nine levels while its energy steadily drains.
c64:174007.title: Vortron

c64:174016.description: Fire a phaser at waves of attackers descending the screen; part of Cassette 50.
c64:174016.title: Phaser

c64:174017.description: Puzzle with four test tubes holding three colors each: stack them to reproduce the color combination shown by the lamps above the lower box.
c64:174017.title: Philippic

c64:174018.description: Crosshair shooter: hit as many Psychoballs as possible within one minute and compare scores with friends.
c64:174018.title: PHU

c64:174022.description: In a future where cats are precious, travel between planets bartering cards and playing a poker-like game to raise the 8,000-cat ransom for your kidnapped cat.
c64:174022.title: Wanderer 3D

c64:174034.description: Top-down Formula 1 racing with eight cars differing in gearbox, acceleration and top speed, plus tunable tires, spoiler, dampers and steering.
c64:174034.title: Warm Up

c64:174035.description: Tactical WWII Pacific naval wargame with four historical battles and a scenario builder; Japanese and US sides can both be human-controlled.
c64:174035.title: Warship

c64:174036.description: Elected sheriff of Dodge City after Wyatt Earp was run out of town, you are now the target of the outlaw Cockeyed Frank Loving.
c64:174036.title: Watch Out

c64:174040.description: Five minigames based on the German comic character Werner, including the bluffing dice game Meiern.
c64:174040.title: Werner: Let's Go!

c64:174041.description: Hamurabi with simple graphics: each turn, decide how much land to buy or sell and how much grain to feed your people and to plant, while random events intervene.
c64:174041.title: Picture Kingdom

c64:174045.description: Text adventure played in real time, set in 1885: as a sheriff, recover the loot a gang of bank robbers hid in town and get away, reacting quickly to random events.
c64:174045.title: West

c64:174052.description: Motor trade sim: acquire gearboxes, tyres and engines to build cars, form syndicates, trade parts and buy dealerships while staying clear of bankruptcy.
c64:174052.title: Wheeler Dealer

c64:174053.description: Multi-directional scrolling platformer in which up to four players guide hungry Nurds through 50 levels, each hiding four pieces of food.
c64:174053.title: Whirlinurd

c64:174058.description: Transformed into Pegasus, Circe battles dragons, hawk men and skeletons to free Odysseus from a wizard's spell.
c64:174058.title: Wings of Circe

c64:174059.description: As an anthropologist invited by your Soviet friend Sergio, investigate the lost civilization he has found in the Himalayas of Tibet.
c64:174059.title: Winter Wonderland

c64:174060.description: Vocabulary-building game for young children set in an adaptive storytelling environment; part of the Children's Collection pack.
c64:174060.title: Picture This

c64:174061.description: Put matching pieces next to each other to remove them, clearing each set completely, since a single leftover shape ends the game.
c64:174061.title: Pieces

c64:174062.description: Dr. Mario-style falling-block game: line up pills to wipe out viruses; published in 64'er 1994/12.
c64:174062.title: Pill-Box

c64:174064.description: One-button pinball: hold the space bar to set launch power and land the ball in all nine bins within 15 shots.
c64:174064.title: Pinball 9

c64:174065.description: Guide your pinfaball to the X-it area to score a point while avoiding the bumping enemies that cost a life; ten points take you on to the next level.
c64:174065.title: Pinfaball

c64:174067.description: Oil's Well clone: extend a pipeline from the tunnel entrance through the passages to collect oil, retracting it piece by piece with the fire button.
c64:174067.title: Pipeline Run

c64:174072.description: A target word is hidden twice inside a grid of jumbled letters, and you frame it with a movable window. Alone you race a frog or butterfly that nibbles the letters away; two players each get their own window.
c64:174072.title: Word Feud

c64:174078.description: Players take turns finding anagrams hidden in rows of letters on a grid, earning more for longer words and a bonus for using a whole row.
c64:174078.title: Word Wizard

c64:174083.description: Manage heavyweight boxers' careers from an icon-driven office, planning training around their strengths, weaknesses and injuries from earlier fights.
c64:174083.title: World Championship Boxing Manager

c64:174084.description: Squash for up to eight players in single matches or tournaments, with an adjustable number of rounds, skill and ball type; only the server can score.
c64:174084.title: World Championship Squash

c64:174087.description: Arcade soccer built around the 1990 World Cup in Italy with every competing nation under fictional player names, plus custom teams and two-player matches.
c64:174087.title: World Cup 90

c64:174090.description: Quiz on 166 countries in eight difficulty groups: each is marked on a hi-res world map and you name its capital or population.
c64:174090.title: World Geography

c64:174104.description: Rugby management: pick and train a national side, tend to injuries, and lead it from the third division to the first.
c64:174104.title: World Rugby

c64:174108.description: Platform shooter in which Alberto boards pirate ships to rescue his girlfriend, held in one of the cabins.
c64:174108.title: Pirati

c64:174110.description: Deliver pizzas around a grid map by entering the coordinates of each order's address.
c64:174110.title: Pizza

c64:174112.description: Shoot down waves of aliens before they reach the danger zone where your ship flies, dodging any you miss; each cleared wave earns bonus points and a shield you can switch on with the space bar.
c64:174112.title: Planet Force

c64:174113.description: The planet Nap is still occupied by PAO invaders a century after they arrived; fly an upgraded spaceship to liberate it. Released in Italy as Planet War.
c64:174113.title: Planet of War

c64:174114.description: 2D fantasy RPG with a party of up to four humans, dwarves or elves, mixing melee and magic and spending gold from slain monsters on new gear.
c64:174114.title: Xyphus

c64:174115.description: Shoot down attacking mini planets in this blaster by Richard Bayliss, released with Scene World #22.
c64:174115.title: Planet Popper

c64:174116.description: A solar-system lesson joined to a landing game: read short passages on the planets and astronomers such as Copernicus and Kepler, name the planet shown to win bonus fuel, then touch a lander down on each world in turn under its own gravity.
c64:174116.title: Planet Probe

c64:174117.description: Moon Buggy-style driving game starring a Smurf in space.
c64:174117.title: Planet Ranger

c64:174118.description: Yahtzee adaptation: roll five dice, reroll any of them up to twice, and fill categories from ones to sixes through full house, straights, chance and five of a kind.
c64:174118.title: Yahtcee

c64:174121.description: Pac-Man clone: guide Whirly around mazes collecting Alpha Particles while avoiding Zooks, grabbing Power Drain Plugs to make them safe to touch.
c64:174121.title: Zappy Zooks

c64:174122.description: Space Invaders-style game in which a wizard runs along the ground shooting down the thunderbolts that an angry Zeus hurls at him.
c64:174122.title: Zeus

c64:174124.description: Guide missiles into a fleet of UFOs speeding down to bomb your planet, with 20 missiles to down 10 UFOs and a hyperthrust for extra speed.
c64:174124.title: Planets Defender

c64:174125.description: Fly past asteroids and space mines, shooting the sides of plasma bolt barriers to clear a path but never the mines; part of Cassette 50.
c64:174125.title: Plasma Bolt

c64:174126.description: Pipe-fitting puzzle: add one shaped section at a time, previewed in the corner, to build your pipe network, with goals set by the chosen game type. Also released as Work Pipes.
c64:174126.title: Plasto

c64:174127.description: Puzzle for one or two players: bounce across a board whose squares crumble behind you to reach all squares of your color; landing on an empty space costs one of three lives.
c64:174127.title: Platou

c64:174129.description: Lone survivor of an exploration mission, fight your way through a galaxy ruled by Zordian warlords in a constantly upward-scrolling shooter.
c64:174129.title: Zodia

c64:174139.description: Clear Alien Cycloids from each zone of a 7x7 grid, moving around the zone's edge and firing up to eight bullets at a time.
c64:174139.title: Zone 49

c64:174140.description: Shoot the unpredictable Zwarks before they reach the bottom of the screen, where they become deadly; more appear as your score climbs.
c64:174140.title: Zwark

c64:174141.description: Top-down vertical shooter over four alien planets with pseudo-3D touches; steer and set forward speed, even stopping, while fighting tanks, turrets and planes.
c64:174141.title: Zyron

c64:174149.description: Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game: pushed off course by a solar wind, a lost pilot ends up on the strange planet Sector RCM1972.
c64:174149.title: Across the Galaxy on Sector RCN1972

c64:174152.description: Tennis against the computer or a friend, released on Magic Disk 64 1993/09.
c64:174152.title: Play a Match

c64:174153.description: Play through 91 bridge deals devised by Alfred Sheinwold, paired with his book Bridge Puzzles Number 1, with guidance toward the correct play.
c64:174153.title: Play Bridge with Sheinwold

c64:174164.description: Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game that is not a shooter: Alain, locked in his countryside hotel room over an unpaid bill while the owner calls the police, makes his escape.
c64:174164.title: The Adventures of Alain

c64:174176.description: Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game: fight enemy mechs to liberate your oppressed world; published in Commodore Free #067.
c64:174176.title: Alesta

c64:174192.description: Turn-based tactical American football with 16-player squads, 11 on the field; each turn move any number of players, block, or set up a pass.
c64:174192.title: Plazma Ball

c64:174193.description: Arkanoid-style game with 33 levels: break into the fortress of the tyrant Gohd on Gohdinia to free your captured friends.
c64:174193.title: Plexonoid

c64:174205.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter in the vein of Armalyte, published on Game On 1991/12.
c64:174205.title: Plural

c64:174206.description: Two-player strategy game on a lattice of atomic nuclei that hold two, three or four electrons depending on their position, all starting out neutral.
c64:174206.title: Plutonium

c64:174207.description: Bounce Poga, a remote-controlled robodroid, through a mechanical world, avoiding spinning nuts and bolts, robot birds and electromagnetic coils; from the Red Ribbon Game Pak.
c64:174207.title: Poga

c64:174208.description: Bounce around mazes on a pogo stick fixing bricks and collecting bonuses, repairing every brick before the hourglass empties.
c64:174208.title: Pogo Stick

c64:174209.description: Two-player Pong remake with extra twists; the first to nine points wins.
c64:174209.title: PoInG!

c64:174249.description: Not a playable game: this prank asks for a police security password but ignores whatever you type. It is believed to have been aimed at crackers who had pirated Crystal Computing releases.
c64:174249.title: Police Academy

c64:17425.description: Nina, sister of the slain ninja from Saboteur, uses kung-fu moves across 700 screens to avenge him.
c64:17425.title: Saboteur II

c64:174250.description: Snake variant: as the lead wolf, touch party guests to recruit them into a growing polonaise line.
c64:174250.title: Polonäse

c64:174252.description: Find the hop pattern that guides a frog safely across the pond to the farthest lily pad, choosing how many hops to make and in which direction at each step.
c64:174252.title: The Pond

c64:174268.description: Christmas activity collection with the Popples toys, combining simple games, mazes and music.
c64:174268.title: A Popples Christmas Adventure

c64:174282.description: Climb ladders and leap over shooting robots to collect the pots guarded on each floor.
c64:174282.title: Pot Nabber

c64:174283.description: Klax-like puzzle as a restaurant pot washer: stack falling pots so five of the same type sit atop one another to clear them.
c64:174283.title: Pot Panic

c64:174286.description: As a German spy working for the Allies, break into an English POW camp, steal a set of plans and deliver them to the resistance within two hours.
c64:174286.title: POW Adventure

c64:17429.description: Compete in winter sports events such as ski jump, hot dog aerials, biathlon, bobsled, free skating and figure skating.
c64:17429.title: Winter Games

c64:174298.description: Remix of Mega Starforce, a Space Invaders-style shooter subtitled Return to the Great Star.
c64:174298.title: Mega Starforce Remix

c64:174303.description: Pilot an outboard powerboat around a hazard-filled course, completing the required laps within a tight time limit; released in Italy as Fuori Bordo.
c64:174303.title: Power Boat Race

c64:174304.description: Railway signalling sim: control traffic through the Leicester and Stafford power boxes over two four-hour shifts on a mid-1980s summer day, keeping trains to schedule.
c64:174304.title: Leicester Power Box

c64:174305.description: Railway signalling simulation of a power signal box on the Highlands routes.
c64:174305.title: PSB

c64:174306.description: Guide an orb through a flashing maze to the exit before time expires; touching the walls sends you back to the start.
c64:174306.title: Power Surge

c64:174307.description: An explosion has cut the northern polar thermal reactor's power links and contact with its engineers; set out to restore it. Made for RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:174307.title: Powerglove

c64:174311.description: Pilot a lone spaceship down a narrow, heavily defended tunnel toward the core of the enemy's attack system, weaving past meteorites and hostile craft while firing lasers to clear the way.
c64:174311.title: Powerstar

c64:174312.description: After the comet Blazer 76 swept past Delos V and poisoned it with gas, a handful of survivors in sector 98 must make their way to the central sector's spaceport, their only route off the planet.
c64:174312.title: Powertrak

c64:174313.description: A falling-block puzzle in the Tetris mould for one or two players, controlled by joystick or keyboard, with high scores saved to disk.
c64:174313.title: Powertris

c64:174316.title: The Aftermath of the Asimovian Disaster

c64:174319.description: A two-player head-to-head contest: guard your own goal while knocking the ball into your rival's. Goals and obstacles move to new spots every round, and whoever leads after 20 rounds wins.
c64:174319.title: Pozitronic

c64:174320.description: Items drop from the top of the screen; catch them, shift them between columns and pair identical shapes to clear them. Two matched bombs also destroy the piece beneath, and a full column ends the game.
c64:174320.title: Pra-Se

c64:174321.description: Gollum of Fairlight's unofficial Arkanoid follow-up, released a year ahead of the real sequel: steer the Vaus to bounce the ball into the blocks, with capsules hidden behind some of them and five lives to spend.
c64:174321.title: Arkanoid II (FLT)

c64:174322.description: Serve as campaign manager in US presidential races from the 1960s up to the 1984 election, or build a custom candidate through a role-playing-style creation process and send them into the contest.
c64:174322.title: President Elect

c64:174323.description: An unofficial Arkanoid sequel with a fresh set of brick-breaking stages; after the mothership Arkanoid is destroyed, the escaping Vaus craft is once again trapped in space by an unknown captor.
c64:174323.title: Arkanoid IV

c64:174328.description: Steer a ball with the joystick to eliminate a set number of coloured pieces on each screen and move up to the next level, a puzzle that leans on quick reactions and dexterity.
c64:174328.title: Pride

c64:174330.description: A Pong-style bat-and-ball game dressed up with bright, colourful graphics.
c64:174330.title: Primitive Ping-Pong

c64:174335.description: A final unofficial Arkanoid level pack: keep the ball in play with the Vaus paddle until every block is gone, grabbing the helpful power-ups and dodging the harmful ones.
c64:174335.title: Arkanoid V

c64:174341.description: A text adventure in which a wager with a millionaire commits you to breaking out of a prison.
c64:174341.title: Prisoner-Island

c64:174342.title: Pro Golf: 18 Best Holes in the World

c64:174362.description: A text-commentary hockey game between NHL-named teams: play unfolds as running play-by-play while you change lines, switch offence between attacking and setting up, set defence to aggressive or goal-protecting and swap goalies, with full scoring and penalty summaries.
c64:174362.title: Pro Hockey

c64:174364.description: A short platformer by Steve Skillcorn set on the lunar surface in 1997, where experts from twelve nations have spent seven years perfecting P.R.O.B.E., a programmable robot battle unit.
c64:174364.title: P.R.O.B.E.

c64:174392.description: Two casino card games in one package: Banco, a baccarat simulation with its rules built in, and a game of draw poker.
c64:174392.title: Professional Gambler

c64:174393.description: Take charge of a speedway motorcycle team, choosing which side to run at the outset, in a blend of racing and management simulation first released in Italy as Speedy in 1993.
c64:174393.title: Professional Speedway Manager

c64:174396.description: A tutorial program that teaches magic tricks, presenting them through simple on-screen graphics.
c64:174396.title: The Professional Touch

c64:174399.description: A Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game about blasting a path across an alien world, distributed by Binary Zone PD and later included on a Commodore Zone cover disk.
c64:174399.title: Alien Taskforce

c64:174402.description: In the 22nd century, an ordinary man is captured and rebuilt as the cyborg Argus to fight for the conquering Kansler, then turns on his masters; he and fellow cyborg Venix battle across the solar system for their freedom.
c64:174402.title: Project Argus

c64:174403.description: Fly the Hell-Storm attack helicopter through an underground cave labyrinth in a horizontal shooter, chasing Lord Rübe, who stole the world's entire beer supply in a single night.
c64:174403.title: Project Hell-Storm

c64:174409.description: As the half-man, half-machine Protectoid, fly low over the Earth destroying mines dropped by an alien mothership, collecting power-ups while a temporary shield wears away.
c64:174409.title: Protectoid

c64:174438.description: Roll a ball through maze-like screens shooting everything in sight and running over stars for points, while steering clear of spikes that cannot be destroyed. Made with SEUCK.
c64:174438.title: Roll-About

c64:174446.description: Fight off advancing waves of Psion attackers with a cannon, moving up and down and using hyperspace, while avoiding fatal space mines; fuel pods, fighters, cruisers and battlestars score differing points.
c64:174446.title: Psion Attack

c64:174447.description: An unusual shooter-puzzle hybrid: move your ship up and down, fire to the right and pick from seven puzzle pieces to throw, only one of which fits. Pieces never run out; contact with enemies is what kills you.
c64:174447.title: Psychic Kaos

c64:174450.description: A study game on Macbeth framed as a therapy session: you visit Sigmund, alchemist and psychiatrist at Cawdor Castle, and as Macbeth answer his probing questions about the witches, the battle and your own words by typing replies or picking numbered options.
c64:174450.title: Psycho I

c64:174451.description: The last of the Macbeth therapy sessions: now king and weighed down by the past, Macbeth summons his psychiatrist again and answers questions about Banquo, the witches' prophecy and Banquo's murder through typed and multiple-choice replies.
c64:174451.title: Psycho III

c64:174452.description: Gather every energy pod on each of 24 levels before the timer hits zero and the craft self-destructs, in a mix of arcade action and puzzle solving that won a Loadstar programming contest.
c64:174452.title: Psycloid

c64:174453.description: A motorbike races up a busy highway, dodging reckless drivers in this Spy Hunter-flavoured Alf Yngve shoot-'em-up built with SEUCK. Planned by Psytronik for 1994 but shelved, it was finished and enhanced by Richard Bayliss in 2008, gaining a two-player option.
c64:174453.title: Psykozone

c64:174454.description: Fly a glider over a vertically scrolling landscape to save the world by destroying every atomic reactor on screen, while avoiding being shot down by enemies of every kind. Built with SEUCK.
c64:174454.title: Psyxx

c64:174456.description: A Pac-Man variant with no ghost pen and no wraparound tunnels; new ghosts emerge from existing ones or from the middle of the maze.
c64:174456.title: Crest's Pacman

c64:174457.description: Steer a fairy through the air dodging flying Christmas puddings; each hit drains energy, and the game ends when it runs out.
c64:174457.title: Pudding Breath

c64:174458.description: A sparse shooter with a strategic bent, full of ladders and routes for creeping up on enemies, first given away on a Commodore Format cover disk.
c64:174458.title: Pudwerx and Dawsy

c64:174460.description: Dodge tanks and bulldozers while keeping the snakes from spreading out of control.
c64:174460.title: Pulz 64

c64:174461.description: Pete strolls along the lines of a short story while you add the missing full stops, commas and capitals, with speech marks joining in on the hardest of three levels. When the passage is done he walks back through it, pointing out mistakes and jumping for joy once everything is right.
c64:174461.title: Punctuation Pete

c64:174510.description: Guide a puppy through 24 house screens of floors and ladders, eating ten pieces of fruit on each while jumping over holes and ducking under four birds that fly back and forth.
c64:174510.title: Puppy's

c64:174511.description: A horizontal shooter built around a bouncing ball: release it in order to fire, recover it by touching it with the button held, and carry it upward before its limited bounces are used up.
c64:174511.title: Pure Seed

c64:174512.description: A statistics-driven basketball simulation for replaying single games or whole college seasons, past or present, with a Stat Compiler that keeps a permanent record; teams span 1960s UCLA through the 1980s.
c64:174512.title: Pure-Stat College Basketball

c64:174583.description: A box-pushing puzzle in the Sokoban style: shove crates onto their marked spots, taking care not to trap yourself, since a box can only move when there is free space beside it.
c64:174583.title: Push'em

c64:174587.description: Two players race each other to solve a 5x5 sliding-tile puzzle first.
c64:174587.title: Push-It

c64:174588.description: Each level shows a picture and then shuffles it, and you must put it back together before your moves and time run out, with bonuses for moves and seconds left over and level codes to resume later.
c64:174588.title: Puxxle

c64:174621.description: A SEUCK shooter designed for two players working together, as a heroic duo storms a giant floating prison fortress where aliens are holding hostages.
c64:174621.title: Brothers in Arms

c64:174623.description: A picture puzzle with eight images to choose from plus adjustable difficulty and timer; the screen is split into the scrambled pieces, a clock and the frame to fill.
c64:174623.title: Puzzlacki

c64:174624.description: Each Incan gate is split into nine sections, one of which breaks the pattern; spot the odd one out before time expires to continue the journey.
c64:174624.title: Gates of the Incas

c64:174625.description: A 25-piece sliding puzzle: return the numbered tiles to their proper order to reassemble a larger picture.
c64:174625.title: Puzzle Mania

c64:174626.description: A timed tile puzzle: the computer scrambles the blocks of a picture shown in the top right corner, and the player must restore them against the clock.
c64:174626.title: Puzzle Shuffle

c64:174643.description: A jigsaw-style game in which every piece is supplied and must be locked into its correct place to score points and complete the picture.
c64:174643.title: Puzzlemaster

c64:174644.description: Slide square tiles to rebuild the pattern shown in the right-hand panel, racing a clock with only a limited number of moves to spend. Easy and hard modes are offered, and completing all 30 levels earns a congratulation from the programmers.
c64:174644.title: Puzzlenoid

c64:174648.description: An isometric puzzle-platformer modelled on Q*bert, later reissued in Italy on the Go Games tape series.
c64:174648.title: Pyramid Pete

c64:174649.description: One or two players climb a pyramid by answering multiplication questions, moving up a step for each correct answer given within ten seconds, with three levels of question difficulty.
c64:174649.title: Pyramid Puzzler

c64:174650.description: A maze-like platformer with many branching paths but only one exit, populated by enemies that move entirely at random.
c64:174650.title: Die Pyramide

c64:174651.description: Explore the ten-level Pyramid of Pyro in the desert of Lost Sands, gaining experience and seeking the Eternal Flame, in a simple adventure with role-playing elements; you may leave at any point.
c64:174651.title: Pyro's Pyramid

c64:174656.description: A fan-made Lode Runner edition with 104 new levels from 4711-Soft and blue bricks instead of red; a damaged copy in circulation has only 21 working levels.
c64:174656.title: Lode Runner II

c64:174659.description: Another fan edit of Lode Runner, with bright green bricks and 127 levels, 32 of them new and the rest reused from Lode Runner II; its story concerns Egyptian statues from Giza stolen by the collector Goldstar.
c64:174659.title: Lode Runner IV

c64:174660.description: A fan edit of Lode Runner with blue bricks and 107 levels, only 14 of them new; the rest are borrowed from the second and fourth fan editions.
c64:174660.title: Lode Runner V

c64:174661.description: A remixed Lode Runner by DrHonz of Reengine & Mod, also called Hansmanns Lode Runner, updated in 2010 and reworked in 2016 as the cleaned-up Tricky Mix.
c64:174661.title: Lode Runner Mix

c64:174732.description: Four-sided Arkanoid: each player handles a pair of paddles on the screen edges to clear the stones, catching bonus items released by some of them but avoiding the skulls.
c64:174732.title: Quad II

c64:174733.description: Four-in-a-row across four stacked levels, a four-dimensional take on noughts and crosses for one or two players against a human or the computer.
c64:174733.title: Quadra

c64:174734.description: Arkanoid-style brick breaking for two players cooperating on the same screen.
c64:174734.title: Quadranoid

c64:174735.description: Drop silver spheres from above to form lines of four in any direction, which then vanish; the computer opponent drops two pieces per turn, and some pieces recolour ones already placed.
c64:174735.title: Quadrant

c64:174736.description: A tricky isometric collecting game starring a Pac-Man-like character, blending ideas from Pac-Man, Marble Madness and several other games.
c64:174736.title: Quadratic Area

c64:174738.description: Bring order back into chaos by restoring every dot on the board to its colour; pick from nine difficulty levels and medium or large squares, or let the computer play by itself.
c64:174738.title: Quadromania

aliases: Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness
c64:17475.description: In Sosaria, ravaged for a thousand years by the sorcerer Mondain, a lone hero must assemble a time machine and travel back to defeat him before he becomes invulnerable.
c64:17475.title: Ultima I

c64:17476.description: Minax, Mondain's apprentice, seeks vengeance on the hero who slew her master and throws history into chaos; travel through different eras of time to track down and stop the enchantress.
c64:17476.title: Ultima II: The Revenge of the Enchantress

c64:174808.description: A draughts variant for one or two players against a friend or the computer at three skill levels; captures are compulsory, multiple jumps must be completed, and either side can offer or accept a draw.
c64:174808.title: Queens

c64:174900.description: A text adventure on an artificial planet that serves as a power and genetic research station: woken from hyper-sleep after a disaster, with power failing and the crew silent, you search areas like the shuttle bay and labs, dodging acid-spitting mutant rats, to reach the main computer.
c64:174900.title: Quest for Tarek

aliases: Questmaster I: The Prism of Hekeulotal
c64:174901.description: A re-release of the Apple II adventure Dondra: A New Beginning, with cartoon-style graphics and typed commands; the hero is pulled into another dimension to face and overthrow the villain Colnar.
c64:174901.title: Questmaster: The Prism of Hekeulotal

c64:174909.description: Up to four players drive trucks, hauling building materials from supply depots to construction sites and using map scales to measure distances across two maps.
c64:174909.title: Quick-Cartage Company

c64:174910.description: Play the ghost of someone who once died in quicksand, throwing ropes to a man and his dog so they can climb out, with devils and pebbles appearing on later levels.
c64:174910.title: Quicksand

c64:174933.description: A trivia board game on 26 hexagons: move to a neighbouring space each turn and claim it by answering a question; players speak their answer aloud, then report whether they got it right.
c64:174933.title: Quizagon

c64:174937.description: A trivia game for one to eight players: tackle odd questions generated by eight malfunctioning satellites orbiting Earth, combining knowledge with strategy to get aboard and destroy them.
c64:174937.title: Quizam!

c64:174938.description: A German-language TV quiz hosted by Marty McButler on the game-show channel METV: contestants choose subject fields, score points for right answers on topics such as sport, and a sudden-death round settles ties before the champion is crowned.
c64:174938.title: Quiz-Show

c64:174945.description: Gather the green Moonunits and the blue energy pills, lift off from the pad when fuelled, shoot aliens in flight and land again to refuel; clear all Moonunits and aliens to leave through the exit hole.
c64:174945.title: Quota

c64:174955.description: A two-player race to clear your own fields: click your coloured start arrow, then all your fields in any order, then your finish field, but click one of the opponent's fields by mistake and it becomes yours to clear.
c64:174955.title: R: The Ultimate Joystick Killer

c64:174964.description: A racing game for up to eight players via the poly.play adapter, with countryside, desert and city tracks and new courses unlocked by collecting stars.
c64:174964.title: Race+

c64:174988.description: Drive around a maze collecting gas while avoiding other cars and potholes.
c64:174988.title: Race Chase

c64:174989.description: A quiz of facts and trivia about the US states.
c64:174989.title: Race for the States

c64:174991.description: Run a racing team: budget for maintenance, sign sponsors and follow championship points in pursuit of the overall title.
c64:174991.title: The Racing Manager

c64:174992.description: Help Barry the Bear, stranded on an alien planet, gather food from colourful gardens for a feast while avoiding the angry alien bugs that guard them.
c64:174992.title: Racked Off

c64:174993.description: A landing exercise for a jet: raise or lower the nose and manage power so the nose wheel touches down at the very start of the runway, staying above 100 to avoid a stall and under 300 for the landing itself.
c64:174993.title: Radar Landing

c64:174994.description: A vertical shooter in which you battle your way back to your mothership.
c64:174994.title: Radax

c64:174995.description: Help Heinrich Gluhwein, a reluctant Swiss hero, gather all 48 cruise missiles, picking up keys for locked doors, spare Heinrichs for extra lives, exclamation marks as restart points and mystery question marks. Finishing reveals four passwords for an adventure; the text is in Dutch.
c64:174995.title: Radeloos

c64:174997.description: A cooperative educational game for two to six players stranded on a riverbank after a rafting accident, who must work together to build a new raft and escape downriver.
c64:174997.title: Raft-Away River

c64:174998.description: A two-player duel shooter: since neither the Omega nor the Theta galaxy can win their war, each side sends its best pilot into a fight to the death.
c64:174998.title: Rage

c64:175097.description: Losing altitude after being hit at Pearl Harbor, a kamikaze pilot must bomb New York's skyscrapers flat to land, repair the plane and take off again to attack new areas.
c64:175097.title: Raid on New York

c64:175098.description: Grab all the treasure while dodging flapping monsters that speed up and grow more aggressive with each cleared level.
c64:175098.title: Raiders of the Lost Arch

c64:175106.description: Control the signals and points around Penzance, routing every kind of train so passenger services run to time and contracted schedules are met.
c64:175106.title: R.T.C. Penzance

c64:175109.description: Rail traffic control at Birmingham: set routes for passenger and freight movements, keeping services punctual and honouring timetable contracts.
c64:175109.title: R.T.C. Birmingham

c64:175111.description: Direct the train movements around Buxton, juggling passenger services and other traffic so everything keeps to the timetable and contracts are fulfilled.
c64:175111.title: R.T.C. Buxton

c64:175173.description: Run the signalling at Doncaster, threading passenger and freight trains through the junctions on schedule to meet contracted timings.
c64:175173.title: R.T.C. Doncaster

aliases: Rail Traffic Control: Liverpool Lime Street
c64:175175.description: Manage train movements into and out of Liverpool Lime Street, setting routes so passenger services stay punctual and timetable contracts are met.
c64:175175.title: R.T.C. Liverpool Lime Street

c64:175177.description: Take over rail traffic control at Reading, steering trains of all types through the area on time to satisfy the contracted schedule.
c64:175177.title: R.T.C. Reading

c64:175178.description: Signal trains through Leeds City, keeping passenger services punctual and every scheduled movement on track to meet the contracts.
c64:175178.title: R.T.C. Leeds City

c64:175179.description: Handle the rail traffic at Carlisle, routing passenger and freight trains through the station area in line with the timetable and its contracts.
c64:175179.title: R.T.C. Carlisle

c64:175180.description: Control the busy rail network at Manchester Piccadilly, setting routes for every train so services run punctually and contracted timings are met.
c64:175180.title: R.T.C. Manchester Piccadilly

c64:175181.description: Route trains around Bristol Temple Meads, keeping passenger services to time and meeting the contracted schedule for every movement.
c64:175181.title: R.T.C. Bristol TM

c64:175183.description: Oversee rail traffic at Peterborough, guiding passenger and freight trains through the area on schedule to fulfil the timetable contracts.
c64:175183.title: R.T.C. Peterborough

c64:175221.description: An environmental game named after the sunk Greenpeace ship, with seven campaigns in different game styles based on real Greenpeace actions, such as blocking pipes to stop nuclear waste escaping while dodging mutated wildlife.
c64:175221.title: Rainbow Warrior

c64:175222.description: A set of ten games, puzzles and activities, with results that can be printed out and shared.
c64:175222.title: Rainy Day Fun

c64:175223.description: A motorcycle rally through the African desert across four stages, each unlocked only by finishing the previous one inside the time limit.
c64:175223.title: Rallye

c64:175244.description: A sample adventure supplied with The Graphic Adventure Creator: find enough gold to pay the ransom for a kidnapped king.
c64:175244.title: Ransom

c64:175245.description: A polished falling-block puzzle in the Tetris style, with side-by-side play for two.
c64:175245.title: Rasdumje

c64:175344.description: Fly through space dodging everything that comes at you.
c64:175344.title: Raumpatrouillie

c64:175347.description: Steer a nimble radio-controlled racing car along a course full of computer-driven vehicles that swerve and feint as they try to ram it head-on.
c64:175347.title: RCA: Radio Controlled Action

c64:175560.description: A multi-genre game of separate sections modelled on Space Invaders, Tetris, Frogger and other well-known titles, mixing puzzles, shooting and action.
c64:175560.title: Reactor

aliases: Dylan Dog ed Il Castello delle Illusioni
c64:175596.title: Bob Nixie and the Castle of the Illusion

c64:175600.description: The sequel to Reactor, this time a horizontally scrolling space shooter crowded with skulls.
c64:175600.title: Reactor II

c64:175601.description: In the year 2990, the cooling system at the nuclear station beside the town of Barninghum overheats, setting off an emergency evacuation.
c64:175601.title: Reactor Run

c64:175603.description: Four word games for children aged three to seven that build reading and spelling: a word sorter, picture labelling, the Word Train and a memory-style matching game.
c64:175603.title: Reader Rabbit and the Fabulous Word Factory

c64:175643.description: A text-only adventure: starting on a beach, search a small island kingdom for the King's stolen Crown Jewels and any other treasure to bring back.
c64:175643.title: Realm of Darkness

c64:175644.description: A maze collecting game in the Pac-Man mould.
c64:175644.title: The Realm of Zaroc

c64:175645.description: As a galleon, defend the city in each realm by firing cannonballs at invaders while friendly farm carts try to reach it and bad weather hampers you. Made with SEUCK.
c64:175645.title: Realms of Midgard

c64:175646.description: A tile-flipping logic puzzle with over 100 levels: each move inverts the chosen square and its neighbours, and the grid must be turned one colour before time runs out to purge a virus from a nuclear plant's computer.
c64:175646.title: Reaxion Extended

c64:175683.description: Kick enemies from just the right distance to defeat enough of them to earn a key, use each key to close one gate, then finish off the rest to move on to the next level.
c64:175683.title: The Rebels

c64:175691.description: A word memory test: as words flash up, use the joystick to mark each one as new or already seen, with repeats arriving quickly.
c64:175691.title: Recog-Nice

c64:175692.description: A Robbo-like puzzle: guide a robot to gather every screw on the board while avoiding magnets, nuclear signs and other hazards, covering magnets with boxes so they cannot pull it in.
c64:175692.title: Red 200

c64:175732.description: A Lunar Lander-style game: get past the asteroid belt, land to pick up stranded scientists, then fight back up to dock with the mothership.
c64:175732.title: Lunar Rescue

c64:175733.description: A word with letters missing drifts slowly down the screen; fill the gaps by choosing letters from the alphabet along the bottom before it lands.
c64:175733.title: Webster: The Word Game

c64:175736.description: A six-level platformer by Jason Kelk printed as a type-in listing in Retro Gamer issue 100, squeezed into under 4 KB of code and data.
c64:175736.title: RG Rampage

c64:175745.description: A boxing simulation in which you manage fighters from a roster of more than 45 greats across eight weight classes; one or two players, or let the computer run both corners.
c64:175745.title: Ringside Seat

c64:175746.description: An Electric Company educational game for practising spelling, rhyming and word recognition on a spinning word machine.
c64:175746.title: Roll-a-Word

c64:175747.description: A two-player business game: bizlings stranded on Planet Simian must earn enough money to buy paint and repair their ship's damaged shield.
c64:175747.title: Run for the Money

c64:175748.description: Space hero Brad Stallion is sent by the Federated Government to stop The Tribe, a band of Amazon raiders terrorising the galaxy, helped by the ship's computer Sandie in an illustrated adventure across two planets.
c64:175748.title: Sex Vixens from Space

aliases: The Adventure of the Rosetta Stone
The Mystery of the Clock Seller
c64:175749.description: Two text adventures: a clock-seller mystery in which Holmes and Watson look into the death of antique clock dealer Otto Meinwold, and a second case involving the Rosetta Stone.
c64:175749.title: Sherlock Holmes Returns

c64:175750.description: The King of Averon sends his son to slay Skariten, a dragon that has ravaged the land for two hundred years and cannot be harmed by any spell or weapon.
c64:175750.title: Skariten

c64:175751.description: An illustrated text adventure: with a map from an old sea chest left by your great-grandfather, search Skull Island for its buried treasure.
c64:175751.title: Skull Island

c64:175752.description: Leap from a plane over a gorge and parachute down while avoiding the protected condors.
c64:175752.title: Sky Diver's Danger

c64:175757.description: A stress-reduction program designed by Timothy Leary, with a few game-like elements.
c64:175757.title: Relax

aliases: Human Anatomy Series: Skeleton Bones Tutorial
c64:175762.title: Human Skeleton Tutorial

c64:175763.title: World Geography Series: States & Capitals Tutorial

aliases: US Geography Series: Utah Counties Tutorial
c64:175764.title: Utah Counties Tutorial

c64:175767.description: Play a single one-armed bandit, stopping whenever you like, while the program tracks the money paid in and won.
c64:175767.title: Slot Machine Version I

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 2-3 Schuljahr
c64:175768.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 2-3 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 3-4 Schuljahr
c64:175769.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 3-4 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Geometrie: 3-4 Schuljahr
c64:175770.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Geometrie: 3-4 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Mathematik: 1 Schuljahr
c64:175771.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Mathematik: 1 Schuljahr

c64:175772.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Multiplikation und Division: 2-3 Schuljahr

c64:175773.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Multiplikation und Division: 3-4 Schuljahr

c64:175774.description: An updated one-armed bandit simulation with brighter colours and fruit images that tracks stakes and winnings; included in Timeworks' second Programming Kit.
c64:175774.title: Slot Machine Version II

c64:175775.description: Race a futuristic hoverbike against computer-controlled rivals across alien planet surfaces, avoiding collisions to reach the finish first.
c64:175775.title: Space Racer

c64:175805.description: A text-based strategy game about a rogue F-16 pilot carrying a nuclear weapon toward an American city, built around a list of possible targets and fail-safe codes.
c64:175805.title: Renegade F-16

c64:175889.description: A text adventure: track down your enemy Dave by following clues and talking to everyone, then take your revenge before getting the band back together at The Nip club to land a recording contract.
c64:175889.title: Retaliation

c64:175897.description: Dock manually with the deserted Earth Orbital Station 1, then explore the damaged station, which shows signs of alien intrusion, to find a way to contact Earth.
c64:175897.title: Return to Earth

c64:175942.description: A drawing program for doodling, sketching and painting on screen.
c64:175942.title: Sketch and Paint

c64:175945.description: Stickybear lands in sticky situations, such as needing enough balloons to get over a small wall, and children aged six to nine solve arithmetic problems to rescue him.
c64:175945.title: Stickybear Math

c64:175946.description: Numbered ducks swim around a pool; toss rings around them so their numbers add up to the target shown on the scoreboard. Aimed at ages 8 to 12.
c64:175946.title: Sum Ducks

c64:175947.description: Drive a truck around an overhead map collecting produce from farms and delivering it to a depot while practising time skills; one of the three maps is printed in the manual and the other two are secret.
c64:175947.title: Time Trucker

c64:175960.description: Three text adventures in one package: History's Twist, A Place of Safety and, finally, Challenge of the Pirate King.
c64:175960.title: Trilogy of Time

c64:175962.description: A Trivial Pursuit-style quiz board game for two to four players, with colour-coded questions on Geography, History, Science & Nature, Sport & Leisure, Arts & Literature and Entertainment.
c64:175962.title: Trivia U.K.

c64:175966.description: Trapped in a chamber crossed by seven tunnels, your ship slides up and down a central vertical corridor, darting into the tunnels to blast the enemies that stream along them.
c64:175966.title: Turmoil

c64:175969.description: A Hungarian joystick-driven adventure in which you travel through time to save the Earth, and the four items chosen at the start decide your chances; English text was added unofficially in 2019.
c64:175969.title: Wasted Time

c64:175970.description: The Muppets teach computer literacy through five activities, including steering the ship with Kermit through a Logo-style programming language, an arcade game played over Sam the Eagle's objections, and a joke library.
c64:175970.title: Welcome Aboard: A Muppet Cruise to Computer Literacy

c64:175971.description: The TV word game: spin the wheel, call letters and solve hidden puzzles in categories such as place, person, landmark, title and event, avoiding Bankrupt as you build up money and prizes.
c64:175971.title: Wheel of Fortune: Third Edition

c64:176012.description: A children's edition of the TV game show for ages 8 to 15: one team member draws on the big board and the other guesses what it shows, often a common phrase pictured literally.
c64:176012.title: Win, Lose or Draw Junior

c64:176015.description: Two birds perch on letter towers at either side of the screen as letters and words of up to four letters grow and drift toward the players, who race to pick the right match with the joystick.
c64:176015.title: Word Flyer

c64:176016.description: A Yahtzee-style dice game for up to four players: roll, re-roll a limited number of times and aim for straights, full houses and multiples of a kind.
c64:176016.title: Yantzee

c64:176017.description: A Quill-made text adventure with a verb-noun parser: in 3065, with Earth's fuel reserves nearly exhausted, you must find two Zacaron crystals to save the planet.
c64:176017.title: The Zacaron Mystery

c64:176027.description: As Cedric, a vampire without teeth, fetch your dentures from the dentist so you can feed again, then escape town while steering clear of garlic and crucifixes.
c64:176027.title: Revenge of the Toothless Vampire

c64:176093.description: A version of Reversi with distinctive graphics: place discs to outflank the opponent's pieces and flip them to your colour.
c64:176093.title: Reversi (Eagleware)

c64:176094.description: The board game Reversi on screen: trap the opponent's discs between your own to turn them over, aiming to own most of the board.
c64:176094.title: Reversi GTI

c64:176095.description: Your ship stays fixed while the joystick rotates everything around it; collect power-ups, destroy asteroids and destroy or avoid aliens, building firepower and guarding your shields.
c64:176095.title: Revolution

c64:176098.description: An electronic picture word book for children aged five to eight, with scenes such as an airport and a grocery store and hundreds of labelled objects to build vocabulary.
c64:176098.title: Richard Scarry's Best Electronic Word Book Ever!
