c64:183298.description: Compilation of four shooters designed by Alf Yngve, including the side-scrolling Silverfish and a cargo plane mission carrying medical supplies, with Zap Fight 2: SE as a bonus.
c64:183298.title: Shoot Em Up Destruction Set

aliases: Shoot Em Up Destruction Set II
c64:183299.title: Shoot Em Up Destruction Set 2

c64:183315.description: Win by guiding the ball through each of the 12 rooms.
c64:183315.title: Top 12

c64:183523.description: Steer a balloon to the bomb and back to the exit that appears once it is armed, avoiding moving and fixed objects and lasers against the clock; arming the bomb turns all enemies into collectable points.
c64:183523.title: Topsy-Turvy

c64:183526.description: In the 21st century a faulty Soviet military computer sends waves of guided missiles and fighter jets toward a European city, and flying an upgraded Tornado you must shoot down as many as possible, since every intruder that gets through costs a thousand lives. Text is in German.
c64:183526.title: Tornado

c64:183527.description: Text adventure as Maithros, saved from death weeks earlier by the mystic Mitherful, who asks him to join the monks in return.
c64:183527.title: Torquest

c64:183670.description: Freescape reworking of Total Eclipse: recover the 12 fragments of the sphinx hidden in the passages under the pyramid within two hours to break an ancient curse.
c64:183670.title: Total Eclipse II: The Sphinx Jinx

c64:183671.description: A mercenary fights through a series of checkpoints, crossing rivers, forests and villages and shooting all who stand in the way, collecting items for extra points.
c64:183671.title: Tottem

c64:183673.description: SEUCK shooter in which the goal is to fight a way up to the tower's summit.
c64:183673.title: Tower Commando

c64:183674.description: Platformer in which the player battles knights and monsters across four levels of a tower.
c64:183674.title: The Tower of Terror

c64:183691.description: Firemen holding a net under a burning building catch falling residents, often several times as they bounce, while heavy residents cannot be caught safely and have to be left to fall.
c64:183691.title: Towering Inferno

c64:183692.description: Side-scrolling platformer like Bobix set in an alien-infested city and its sewers, where all 180 sacks must be gathered before the exit chamber allows escape.
c64:183692.title: Toxic

c64:183737.description: Software for printing out parts of 20 working mechanical models, such as cars and trucks with turning wheels, a crane, an oil pump and a balloon-powered vehicle, to be assembled following the instructions.
c64:183737.title: The Toy Shop

c64:183739.description: Tidy up the toys by kicking them around the garden in this puzzle game, made single-handedly by Jan Schulze, that plays like a blend of Puzznic and Sokoban. It was entered in the 2014 RGCD 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:183739.title: Toyz

c64:183798.description: Lead a wagon 2000 miles west during the Gold Rush, managing food, ammunition, clothing and supplies, with mini-games such as hunting each turn; included in the Micro-Dozen One compilation.
c64:183798.title: Trail West

c64:183799.description: Run a railroad traffic control center through a sped-up eight-hour shift, routing as many as 12 trains each way across 150 miles of track by setting switches and signals to keep them on time.
c64:183799.title: Train Dispatcher

c64:183800.description: Keep several trains running around a shared track by flipping the switches at junctions A to R before the trains reach them, avoiding collisions, dead ends and junctions closed for repairs; the score reflects how much track your trains cover before the first crash.
c64:183800.title: Train Dodgers

c64:183803.description: Run a shipping company over 100 days with five vessels starting from London, buying eight kinds of goods cheaply in one port and selling them dearer in another, and taking on time-limited contracts.
c64:183803.title: Trans-Atlantic

c64:183804.description: A logic puzzle that also calls for fast joystick work under tight time limits, as the player restores order to a completely scrambled arrangement.
c64:183804.title: Translogic

c64:183805.description: A two-player race to haul a set number of crates out of a cave: fly your ship on four joystick-fired thrusters against gravity and drag, load up to three crates at the lower pad and land them gently on the upper one, watching fuel and coolant, which drains in your rival's exhaust flame. German text.
c64:183805.title: Transporter

c64:183806.description: In this sequel to Slap N Tickle, the mutant Matthew Slim has recovered a lost circuit board and now hunts for the Transputer of Learning, the only thing that can cure him. It was one of the sample games bundled with the 1988 Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit.
c64:183806.title: Transputer Man

c64:183810.description: Aim a crosshair and shoot flying clay targets in a simulation of shotgun trap shooting.
c64:183810.title: Trap-Shooting

c64:183824.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter set on the space platform Traxxion, which is breaking apart after a comet strike while its robot cars race around out of control.
c64:183824.title: Traxxion

c64:183938.description: A text adventure played by picking from offered answers to the computer's questions while exploring an imaginary world; part of The Big 100 collection.
c64:183938.title: Treasure Quest

c64:183939.description: Lead Frank through maze-like tombs viewed from above, hurling swords at swarms of monsters while hunting for treasure.
c64:183939.title: Treasures of Ra

c64:183947.description: A text adventure aboard the starship from the original Star Trek series, which is stuck in a decaying orbit with its engines dead.
c64:183947.title: Trek Adventure

c64:184108.description: An Italian side-scrolling shooter mixing ideas from Gyruss and Defender, where a quota of enemy ships must be destroyed to reach the next stage.
c64:184108.title: Triacus

c64:184236.description: Three arcade tests in one package: a shooting duel, a dodging game and a crosshair shooting gallery.
c64:184236.title: Triple Tournament

c64:184239.description: Unarmed, Triss explores Hephyr's mansion to recover 20 magic stones of Thefrog and stop Hephyr's bid for world domination, carrying up to eight useful items at once past hostile creatures and traps.
c64:184239.title: Triss

c64:184244.description: A question quiz for several players or teams; each turn draws a category at random, such as geography or sports, and the first side to reach the agreed number of correct answers wins. Stronger players can give beginners a head start of points.
c64:184244.title: Trivia Quest!

c64:184246.description: Trivia for one or two players across 50 categories of 10 multiple-choice questions each, 500 in all, plus the option to write and save new questions.
c64:184246.title: Trivia Trek

c64:184251.description: A two-player science and nature quiz from Commodore Canada: rivals answer multiple-choice questions on their own keys or joysticks, and each right answer adds to a trophy, with the first to complete it winning.
c64:184251.title: Trivia: Science

c64:184257.description: An adventure from the tenth issue of Compute!'s Gazette, written for an article on teaching a computer English, in which the player collects magic items and defeats a troll.
c64:184257.title: Troll Castle

c64:184263.description: Steer a light-cycle around a grid, leaving a trail behind you, and score a point for every square covered while avoiding the walls, randomly placed boxes and your own trail. Skill level and speed are each set from 1 to 9.
c64:184263.title: Tronic Cycle

c64:184265.description: A logic puzzle where stones must be arranged to match a pattern shown by the computer, though they can only be shifted by moving whole rows and columns according to set rules.
c64:184265.title: Tronic Force

c64:184266.description: In the year 2525, an expedition leader raids six temples on planet Tronix for ancient treasures, using one lever to open the treasure hatch and another to beam the loot away while avoiding snakes.
c64:184266.title: Tronix

c64:184267.description: A text adventure in which the stand-in manager of Bridgeton Asylum left the front door unlocked and must track down every escaped patient before the real manager returns.
c64:184267.title: Trouble at Bridgeton

c64:184268.description: A Marble Madness-like platformer for one or two simultaneous players, born from a nightmare in which colored bubbles turn into sticky globes that swallow Andrea's toys.
c64:184268.title: Trouble Bubble

c64:184355.description: A Pipe Mania-style puzzle: lay the longest possible pipeline in 90 seconds before liquid starts flowing from the start square, with more pipe pieces required on each successive level.
c64:184355.title: Tube Madness

c64:184356.description: An adventure built around an intricate tunnel maze that has to be mapped on paper to survive.
c64:184356.title: Tunnelmaze Adventure

c64:184357.description: A Shanghai-style tile game where matching tiles can be removed only when they line up with no other tile between them, with the goal of clearing the whole board.
c64:184357.title: Turn It II

c64:184366.description: A two-player duel between a blue wizard and a red wizard, each trying to destroy the other first.
c64:184366.title: Wizard Fight

c64:18448.description: A Defender-style shooter: a jet-pack spaceman flies fast over a barren scrolling landscape, fighting aliens ranging from simple Planters to the creeping Blunder Storm.
c64:18448.title: Dropzone

c64:18449.description: A fast side-scrolling shooter crowded with enemies, where the ship has an energy bar rather than dying on one collision, and certain targets release power-ups.
c64:18449.title: Enforcer: Fullmetal Megablaster

c64:184497.description: A holiday program with four options: an illustrated rhyming story, a greeting card printer, a letter writer for printing notes to Santa, and a puzzle of reassembling a scattered picture.
c64:184497.title: 'Twas the Night Before Christmas

c64:18450.description: Flimbo sets out to rescue his girlfriend Pearly from Fransz Dandruff across platform levels where he can drop down through platforms as well as jump up to higher ones.
c64:18450.title: Flimbo's Quest

c64:184501.description: A multi-directional scrolling shooter where the real danger is the scenery: touching any wall is deadly, as in Berzerk, so careful steering matters more than firing.
c64:184501.title: Twilight Zone

c64:184504.description: A Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit shooter with Mario-like sprites, playable by one or two players together.
c64:184504.title: Twin Russian

c64:184507.description: A single-screen platformer set in 2010, after the underworld's evil emperor has cursed the Earth and the forces of darkness have seized the world.
c64:184507.title: Twin Terrors

c64:18451.description: A little robot dashes through five sideways-scrolling worlds in Mario fashion, fighting enemies with upgradable bouncing-ball shots and a flamethrower and breaking rocks and walls to uncover diamonds and extras.
c64:18451.title: Hard 'n' Heavy

c64:184518.description: A head-to-head falling-block game where lining up three identical blocks in a row, column or diagonal clears them; three jokers help in emergencies, and blocks reaching the top end the game.
c64:184518.title: Twin-Down

c64:18453.description: Ride a trials motorbike across side-view courses inspired by the Kickstart TV show, leaping steps, crashing through tyres and hedges and slogging through mud; 24 courses come with a designer for building new ones.
c64:18453.title: Kikstart 2 Plus Course Designer

c64:18454.description: A reworked edition of Last Ninja 2: the evil Shogun Kunitoki has escaped through time to set up a new tyranny in modern Manhattan, and the gods bring the Last Ninja across the ages to face him again.
c64:18454.title: Ninja Remix

c64:18455.description: A forerunner of The Sims: after being personalized with the owner's name, a cutaway house with kitchen, living room and bedroom gets a small resident who inspects it and, if satisfied, settles in to live his daily life.
c64:18455.title: Little Computer People

c64:18456.description: Mayhem the dinosaur sets out, with help from apprentice Theo Saurus, to undo the gloom that fell on Monsterland after Theo, drunk on cactus juice, tried his master's spells.
c64:18456.title: Mayhem in Monsterland

c64:18457.description: Soccer with a choice of full 11-a-side games on grass or 6-a-side indoor matches modeled on the American indoor league, plus World Cup and indoor tournaments, a ladder of tougher computer teams, and two-player friendlies.
c64:18457.title: Keith Van Eron's Pro Soccer

c64:18458.description: A top-down budget shooter in the vein of Gridrunner with 25 levels, where the goal is to survive until a timer expires; finishing a level grants an extra life, up to five.
c64:18458.title: P.O.D.: Proof of Destruction

c64:184580.description: A puzzle game in which stones scattered randomly across each level must be rearranged into an orderly layout, controlled through an unusual interface.
c64:184580.title: Twist

c64:184583.description: A two-player-only take on Pac-Man where both players move through the maze at once, made for the 2009 MiniGame Compo.
c64:184583.title: Twopac

c64:184584.description: Steer a rotating magic wand through 20 mazes, collecting clocks attached to a time bomb before time expires without bumping into obstacles; with two players, each one steers an end of the wand.
c64:184584.title: Two-To-One

c64:184585.description: A new version of the arcade shooter Phoenix, published on Magic Disk 64 in 1990.
c64:184585.title: TX: The Game

c64:184586.description: An Australian strategy game that simulates the international shipping trade, with the aim of making the most money.
c64:184586.title: The Tycoon Itch

c64:184587.description: A typing tutor in the style of Space Invaders: letters drop down in columns and are destroyed by typing them, with wrong keys draining energy; offers 99 speeds and 39 lessons.
c64:184587.title: Type Attack

c64:18459.description: After a Soviet attack on the United States, lead a US fighter squadron through a series of action stages to destroy defense bases before a bomb's timer runs out; from the makers of Beach Head.
c64:18459.title: Raid Over Moscow

c64:184592.description: A Battleship-style game of hunting down and sinking the opponent's hidden ships, based on the pencil-and-paper game played in classrooms.
c64:184592.title: U-96

c64:18460.description: In 17th-century Japan, torn by civil war among warlords fighting over the Shogunate, play Usagi Yojimbo, a ronin rabbit warrior standing against the dark forces.
c64:18460.title: Samurai Warrior: The Battles of Usagi Yojimbo

c64:18461.description: Fly a hovering taxi through 25 screens of obstacles, picking up passengers from landing pads and delivering them to the pads they ask for; slow trips shrink the fare.
c64:18461.title: Space Taxi

c64:18462.description: Fly a ship governed by inertia and gravity through vector-drawn side-view caverns as a Resistance fighter, towing away a Klystron pod on a swinging line.
c64:18462.title: Thrust

c64:184627.description: Ride a gun-mounted hover-board along a beach boardwalk and shoot down as many of the colored balloons streaming past as possible.
c64:184627.title: The Ultimate Event

c64:184628.description: A word-guessing gambling game similar to Wheel of Fortune but without the wheel.
c64:184628.title: The Ultimate Game Show

c64:184629.description: An RPG begun in 1989 and finished in 2013, with a dungeon, wilderness regions and a town map to explore; the original slow BASIC code was replaced with machine language.
c64:184629.title: Ultimate Quest: Catacomb

c64:18463.description: Guide a rolling ball along patchwork tracks of colored squares that speed it up, slow it down, warp it or reverse its controls, jumping over holes along the way.
c64:18463.title: TrailBlazer

c64:184630.description: Terrorists in New York threaten to blow up a skyscraper at nine o'clock unless handed America's secret weapons. In this illustrated adventure you roam the city streets, buy gear from shops and reach them by stealth before the deadline.
c64:184630.title: The Ultimatum

c64:184631.description: Guide a snake across a grid, collecting the required number of items to reach the next level while avoiding traps and your own body. Bombs clear everything within one block, and the game ends when your health runs out.
c64:184631.title: Ultra Snake

c64:184632.description: Table football transplanted into outer space.
c64:184632.title: Ultra-Smash

c64:184633.description: Steer a large, angry yellow snake as it gathers blue balls while staying clear of a thin blue line.
c64:184633.title: Ultrazoyd

c64:184635.description: An adventure that opens with a Secret Service spy waking in a cellar with no memory, apparently on the brink of the biggest case of his career.
c64:184635.title: Undercover

c64:184639.description: Fly a helicopter through a scrolling labyrinth, refuelling along the way and shooting barricades for points. A built-in editor lets you build, save and load your own levels with the keyboard.
c64:184639.title: Underground Zone

c64:184642.description: A quiz on the fifty states: choose whether to name the state or its capital, then answer each question, with the correct answer shown when you miss and a total score at the end.
c64:184642.title: The United States of America

c64:184647.description: Dodge meteors and other flying objects while keeping the starship Enterprise from touching the top or bottom of the screen.
c64:184647.title: Universe

c64:184651.description: As a wagon operator moving left and right, catch every lump of coal falling from above on a single screen; each one missed costs a life.
c64:184651.title: Under the Ground

c64:184653.description: A BASIC role-playing game: roll a character and class, then fight monsters in the Caverns and the tougher Dungeon for treasure and experience, buying arms and healing in town. Reach level 10 and retire on your loot, or brave the Pit of Pandemonium.
c64:184653.title: Untergarte

c64:184744.description: An educational program that teaches U.S. states and their capitals and then quizzes the player on them.
c64:184744.title: US Map

c64:184745.description: A learning game on U.S. states and their capitals, part of the Fun in Learning pack.
c64:184745.title: USA Geogramania

c64:184746.description: A Manic Miner-style platformer with extra sub-games, programmed by Jason Fox with graphics and music by Adam Gilmore and left unreleased for over 20 years.
c64:184746.title: UXB: The Unexploded Bomb

c64:184747.description: A BASIC supertanker simulation in which the helmsman must reach the Alaskan port of Valdez from the northern Pacific, a demanding trip of about 62 miles.
c64:184747.title: Valdez

c64:184838.description: An adventure pitting the player against Dracula as night falls, based on a 1980s BASIC game for Tandy computers.
c64:184838.title: Vampire Castle

c64:184866.description: A computer version of Kalaha, the board game of sowing stones from pit to pit.
c64:184866.title: Vari

c64:184867.description: A Lode Runner-style game: grab all the gold bars on each level and reach the exit within the time limit while avoiding monsters.
c64:184867.title: Vault Man

c64:184878.description: Fearless Bill explores a dungeon in this 2D arcade adventure, battling monsters and gathering treasure, weapons, armor and spells.
c64:184878.title: Venture-Quest

c64:184880.description: A fixed-screen Space Invaders-style shooter in which holding the fire button speeds up the whole game.
c64:184880.title: Venusian

c64:184881.description: An educational game about map reading and traffic rules: drive through a large, unfamiliar city to find six transmitters within an hour, each running on a battery that lasts only ten minutes.
c64:184881.title: Verkeers Rally

c64:184882.description: Steer a tank through tight passages collecting yellow bombs, blasting tank traps and avoiding lava, with only one life and limited damage to absorb.
c64:184882.title: Verminator

c64:184884.description: Control a bouncing ball armed with lasers and infiltrate an enemy stronghold, wiping out its defenders; a 1988 public domain release.
c64:184884.title: Vicious Circle

c64:184885.description: A text-based casino with three games: Even-Odd, Dice and High Numbers.
c64:184885.title: Victory Casino

c64:184954.description: Pub darts for two players over three rounds against the character Jimmy Riddle, centering the aim with the joystick before firing each throw.
c64:184954.title: Video Darts

c64:184959.description: A trading and strategy simulation for one to four players, each a landowner who farms, buys and sells land, expands a fishing fleet, builds up a manufactory, grows the population and trains soldiers.
c64:184959.title: Viking

c64:185049.description: A peg solitaire puzzle on a cross-shaped board, with water drops in place of pegs.
c64:185049.title: Vision

c64:185050.description: An action game in which the antiserum Vitamin is used to destroy colonies of computer viruses that a virus mafia planted in the vital systems of many planets.
c64:185050.title: Vitamin

c64:185051.description: An adventure in Raka-Tua National Park, where five treasures must be found and brought back to the Jail; followed by Escape from Raka-Tua.
c64:185051.title: Volcano of Raka-Tua

c64:185052.description: A Breakout and Pong hybrid for exactly two players.
c64:185052.title: Voltage

c64:185053.description: Oregon Trail on the ocean: pick the right provisions and sail across the Atlantic, relying on good winds and luck to reach the New World alive.
c64:185053.title: Voyage of the Mayflower

c64:185072.description: A two-player shoot-out for Gamesware's Gamma-Strike target system, which fires soft pellets at a target: the players take quick turns shooting, with speech, music and on-screen displays accompanying the action.
c64:185072.title: Voyager 19

c64:185073.description: A lander game: with fuel nearly gone, descend through dangerous caverns to an abandoned refueling depot and help underground aliens fight mutant surface dwellers.
c64:185073.title: Voyager 64

c64:185077.description: A fast scrolling shooter with parallax scrolling across ten levels; the Walker moves forward or back, jumps and fires a laser cannon.
c64:185077.title: Walker

c64:185114.description: A fantasy text adventure as helper to Menra the Magician, whose wand and gold were stolen by the evil wizard Dran; recover the wand for him and the people of Ghopasia.
c64:185114.title: The Wand

c64:185116.description: A scuba diver moves continuously from the left and fires straight ahead at enemy divers who shoot back; hits score points but the enemies stay on screen, and three hits end the game.
c64:185116.title: War Lord of Atlantis

c64:185117.title: The War of the Worlds (Task Force)

c64:185118.description: Up to four wizards take on a series of magical exercises set by Merlin, such as lifting a stone, exploding a pot, rescuing a bird or vaporizing a beast, spending magic energy as they go. The best earn places in Merlin's magic circle.
c64:185118.title: The War of Wizards

c64:185122.description: A Breakout-style bat-and-ball game featuring speech synthesis.
c64:185122.title: Warball

c64:185124.description: Cosine's horizontally scrolling space shoot 'em up, first given away on the cover disk of Commodore Zone issue 4 in 1996. Typing "the magic roundabout" on the title screen switches on invincibility.
c64:185124.title: Warflame

c64:185125.description: Cosine's 2006 remix of its 1996 shooter Warflame, rebuilt for release through Cronosoft with new background colours, a more detailed loading picture and reworked collision detection that makes it noticeably easier.
c64:185125.title: Warflame RX

aliases: Computer War: Based on the Hit Movie WarGames
c64:185127.title: Wargames (Creative Sparks)

c64:185130.description: A domination strategy board game fought over the Ancient Continent, released in shareware and registered versions.
c64:185130.title: Warlords: The First Battle!

c64:185143.description: The second Warriors of Ras game, an early graphical roguelike: explore the monster-filled dungeon Kaiv turn by turn with typed commands such as MOVE NORTH, killing monsters and taking treasure.
c64:185143.title: Kaiv

aliases: Warrior of Ras Vol.III: The Wylde
c64:185272.description: Third in the Warriors of Ras series: Grimsweord came back from the Kaiv crippled, the wizard's magic failed to heal him, and a new quest must find the one thing that can cure him.
c64:185272.title: The Wylde

c64:185278.description: The fourth Warrior of Ras role-playing game takes you into the Ziggurat of Ras, tomb of a tyrant king, in search of the Sapient Scepter of Sirocco. You climb randomly built levels using typed commands, defeat the guardian mummy at the top and then make your way back out.
c64:185278.title: Ziggurat

c64:185290.description: A typing game where attacking words descend toward a city and are destroyed by typing them and pressing space; blinking words give bonuses, with blitz attacks and six difficulty levels.
c64:185290.title: Warrior Words

c64:185294.description: On planet Zypar, 18-year-olds must face their peers in a special arena to decide their future, battling each other while riding inertial platforms.
c64:185294.title: The Warriors of Zypar

c64:185298.description: Over 15 levels, gather falling gems while dodging boulders and bricks; one boulder hit can be survived, but a brick is fatal.
c64:185298.title: Washout

c64:185317.description: Similar to Air-Sea Battle on the Atari 2600: sink an endless convoy of ships while avoiding depth charges dropped from a plane.
c64:185317.title: Water Castle

c64:185319.description: Alfredo the Idiot ferries water back and forth to fill a bucket before time runs out, dodging falling objects, to the tune of Morning Has Broken.
c64:185319.title: Water Loop

c64:185329.description: Beneath Annapurna in Nepal, Micro digs tunnels through cold rock and sets detonators to blast open waterfalls that carry lake water down to an accumulator for the people of the Rajistan Valley.
c64:185329.title: Waterfall

c64:185385.description: An educational game that teaches U.S. geography through weather.
c64:185385.title: Weather Tamers

c64:185386.description: An artillery game for two players, enhanced from Ouranos!, in which rivals at either side of the screen attack each other's castles with hail, rain, lightning or tornadoes from a drifting cloud.
c64:185386.title: Weather War II

c64:185390.description: Teleported to the moon, uncover the secret work at the Mad Scientists Association's lunar lab, codenamed Wega, and find a way back to Earth.
c64:185390.title: Wega Station

c64:185393.description: An interactive fiction story where the player becomes the main character, shaping the tale through decisions and interaction with its world.
c64:185393.title: Weird World

c64:185505.description: An adventure with an animated hero: break out of captivity, gather supplies at the saloon, keep a canteen filled while crossing the desert in search of an outlaw, and win the final shootout.
c64:185505.title: A Western Adventure

c64:185507.description: A crosshair shooting game with five Wild West events, including bottle shooting, calf roping and a sheriff challenge.
c64:185507.title: Western Contest

c64:185509.title: What's the Use in Rain VIII

c64:185662.description: Stop enemy helicopters from escaping off either side of the screen using a machine gun and five nuclear missiles; one getting through ends the game.
c64:185662.title: Whirly Bird Attack

c64:185664.description: A platformer set in trap-filled areas around and beneath the White House, scoring by surviving and collecting treasure.
c64:185664.title: The Whitehouse Blues

c64:185669.description: Jump from a plane and open the parachute to steer the jumper onto a base at the foot of the screen, watching the wind indicator, since the chute can only be steered when open.
c64:185669.title: Parachutist

c64:185762.description: A detective text adventure: search the Carr estate for a necklace that vanished during a party when the lights went out.
c64:185762.title: Who Dun-it

c64:185778.description: In 2025, play a self-delivering Burger King Whopper making its way to a hungry customer while others try to grab it and stray ingredients try to pile on.
c64:185778.title: Whopper Chase

c64:185780.description: An educational quiz on U.S. presidents through Ronald Reagan, covering birthplaces and birth and death years.
c64:185780.title: Who's Chester Arthur

c64:185793.description: A bonus game on the Quedex disk in which Willy returns with inertia-based movement.
c64:185793.title: Willy the Worm: Part II

c64:186627.description: A Mastermind-style code-breaking game that allows up to 999 players.
c64:186627.title: Witts End

c64:186865.description: A modified set of levels for Wizard, based on 33 New Levels and including the Wizard Game Construction editor.
c64:186865.title: Wizard Expert

c64:186867.description: A new collection of hard levels for Wizard, built with Wizard Game Construction.
c64:186867.title: Wizard Expert I

c64:186868.description: A follow-up to Wizard Expert I with more expert levels made in Wizard Game Construction.
c64:186868.title: Wizard Expert II

c64:186876.description: An educational grammar and spelling program built from word subgames such as Word Spinning, Dragon's Spell, King Author, Herald's Hark and Jester's Jumble.
c64:186876.title: Wizard of Words

c64:186880.description: A 2D RPG drawn in PETSCII graphics with Dungeons & Dragons flavor, whose world is randomly generated at the start of every game.
c64:186880.title: Wizard's Tower

c64:186888.description: Guide a ball through a dangerous maze without touching its walls or obstacles.
c64:186888.title: Wobbling Ball

c64:186898.description: The wizard Nerkus has abducted Sherlie and transformed her sweetheart Dave into a ball of iron; as the constantly bouncing Dave, clear the zones guarding a magic door to reach Nerkus' castle, steering over water and spikes.
c64:186898.title: Wonderball

c64:186903.description: A tiny public-domain adventure with PETSCII pictures: type commands such as climbing a tree, going into a fireplace or up a ladder to find a lost green emerald and drop it in the right place.
c64:186903.title: Wonderland Adv

c64:186910.description: A snake game for up to four players, with three- and four-player matches requiring two linked computers and a special cable.
c64:186910.title: Wonky Worms

c64:186913.description: As a woodpecker guarding the Sacred Tree, use its holes to catch prey and keep the tree healthy.
c64:186913.title: Woodpecker

aliases: Woolly Jumper: Sheep in Mind Space
c64:186916.description: Guide Pepito the sheep out of Mindspace across 16 levels, past Space Chickens, Wiggly Worms and Green Martians; an expanded 64K version of an RGCD 16K cartridge competition entry with better graphics and jump physics.
c64:186916.title: Woolly Jumper

c64:186918.description: A Boggle-like solo word game: find as many words of three or more letters as possible in a 4x4 grid of random letters before time runs out, chaining adjacent letters and using each only once.
c64:186918.title: Word Challenge

c64:186941.description: Reading games for children aged 5 to 8 starring Roger Hargreaves' Mr. Men, such as Mr Noisy's Word Game, which teaches opposites, comparatives and superlatives.
c64:186941.title: Word Games with the Mr. Men

c64:186943.description: A word search puzzle that comes out on a printer; after solving it on paper, the player is quizzed on the answers.
c64:186943.title: Word Search 2: Printer Version

c64:186944.description: A vocabulary and spelling trainer for ages 11 and up, with more than 1,200 words in sections on synonyms, similes, collective nouns, and nouns with their adjectives.
c64:186944.title: Wordpower

c64:186945.description: Collect diamonds and items in shifting platform levels, using the items to reshape the level so it can be cleared within the time limit; three difficulty settings let players start at harder levels.
c64:186945.title: Workman

c64:186947.description: Ice hockey with practice matches or a world cup for up to nine players; games last 90 seconds plus possible overtime, controlling one skater at a time.
c64:186947.title: World Champion Icehockey

c64:186948.description: International soccer with tournaments for up to eight human players or single friendlies, three skill levels and adjustable match length, viewed from the side.
c64:186948.title: Rick Davis's World Trophy Soccer

c64:186951.description: Casino blackjack for one player or a table of seven, with an exercises mode for practice. Place bets, take insurance and keep records of your results, including return on investment and average bet size.
c64:186951.title: World Class Casino Blackjack

c64:187058.description: Restore a scrambled field to match the pattern shown beside it by rotating its pieces; turning one piece also turns every piece connected to it.
c64:187058.title: Wozzle

c64:187065.description: Drive against oncoming traffic starting on the screen's right side, dodging vehicles and pit crews trying to box the car in, and last as long as possible; four difficulty levels.
c64:187065.title: Wrong Way Racer

c64:187338.description: Fly a glider through tight underground mazes shooting the 75 energy blocks on each level. Moving and firing burn energy, which hitting energy blocks restores; barriers fall only when hit at their ends, and landing on a base sets a restart point. Seven gliders.
c64:187338.title: Xama

c64:187579.description: A Drelbs-like maze puzzle: flip revolving doors to form as many squares as possible while guardians give chase; some completed squares reveal a door to the next phase.
c64:187579.title: X-Change

c64:187586.description: A four-in-a-row strategy game where stones are pushed onto the board from the bottom and from the right, shoving other stones off the opposite side.
c64:187586.title: Xenodron

c64:187597.description: Fuzzle works in Santa's present factory, dropping gifts into boxes of the matching colour as they roll along a conveyor belt, while a cheeky character pelts him with snowballs to slow him down.
c64:187597.title: Xmas Crazy

c64:187598.description: Blast Christmas-themed asteroids with a ship shaped like a tree in this bonus game from the European disk of Delta.
c64:187598.title: Ubik

c64:187610.description: A Scramble-style shooter set at the dawn of the 22nd century, when interplanetary wars make skilled pilots of advanced attack craft constantly in demand.
c64:187610.title: Xonox

c64:187617.description: Blast the force field guarding the Star Fortress to weaken it while avoiding the field and falling planets; made for the 2007 Minigame Competition's 2K category.
c64:187617.title: XPLORE: The Star Fortress

c64:187619.description: A text adventure answered by choosing from options: a newcomer wanders a seedy small town, visiting its casino and arcade, spending his cash on its attractions and trying to stay out of the sheriff's jail, which can only be escaped through a maze.
c64:187619.title: X-Rated Game

c64:187660.description: A falling-block game for one player or two at once, where clearing several lines adds rows to the opponent's stack: two for a double, four for a four-line clear.
c64:187660.title: X-Tris

c64:187664.description: Rebuild a picture cut into pieces, some of them interchangeable, on grids of 2x4, 4x3 or 8x6 depending on difficulty.
c64:187664.title: Yaba

c64:187670.description: A dice game in the Yahtzee mold: roll for scoring combinations, clicking dice to keep them between rolls.
c64:187670.title: Yathzee

c64:187795.description: An exploration platformer through linked underground rooms full of deadly pits, spikes, water, moving platforms and strange plants, with tricky puzzles barring the way.
c64:187795.title: You Have to Win the Game

c64:187796.description: A quest to obtain the sword and become King of Britain, ported from the VIC-20 and requiring a 22-column formatter from the same disk to be run first.
c64:187796.title: Young Arthur's Quest

c64:187798.description: A stock market simulation in which the player trades on Wall Street to build wealth and power.
c64:187798.title: The Yuppie Trainer

c64:188101.description: Explore a haunted castle for five diamonds amid traps and hostile creatures; every touch drains energy that cannot be restored, locked doors need keys, and falls cost nothing.
c64:188101.title: Zamczysko

c64:188103.description: Space Invaders-like shooting with triple shots, where a new volley comes only after the last one hits or leaves the screen; stop the alien ships before they get across.
c64:188103.title: Zap!

c64:188106.description: As Fax McSheen with three attack drones, investigate a zone of space that defies the laws of physics, blasting every planet and alien in the way over 15 levels.
c64:188106.title: Zarjaz

c64:188112.description: A logic puzzle where clicking blocks changes their color, with the goal of turning every yellow block white.
c64:188112.title: Zaxon

c64:188498.title: Ghosts'n Goblins Arcade / Commando Arcade SE / Bruce Lee II

c64:188761.description: Pilot a spacecraft with twin lasers through waves of enemy fire, beating a mothership to end each wave; some waves demand threading a set path without touching walls.
c64:188761.title: Zelta Pass

c64:188856.description: Pilot a zeppelin through a trap-filled maze around a sunken city, avoiding walls and managing fuel while searching for the wreckage of seven earlier zeppelin expeditions.
c64:188856.title: Zepp

c64:188858.description: A text-only American football game set in the fictional ZFL league.
c64:188858.title: ZFL Football

c64:188950.description: A slot machine simulation from the Magic Disk 64 disk magazine that lets you gamble on the reels without spending real money.
c64:188950.title: Zillion

c64:188954.description: A 2D arcade adventure that begins in 1993, when a satellite spots unusual heat in the Arizona desert above hot-water caves and a government science team finds something huge underground.
c64:188954.title: The Zinj Complex

c64:188960.description: A Scramble-style scrolling shooter: destroy everything possible and hit fuel targets to keep flying.
c64:188960.title: Zoggon

c64:188964.description: A blend of Centipede and a wild variant of Space Invaders with cute-style graphics.
c64:188964.title: Zompy Stomp

aliases: Zone VII: Part II: The Battle Continues
c64:188965.description: An Asteroids-like shooter starting at the screen's center, where shots bounce off the edges of the play area instead of wrapping around and keep flying until they hit something.
c64:188965.title: Zone 7 Part II: The Battle Continues

c64:188966.description: The last of the Zone 7 trilogy, a diagonally scrolling shooter where, as in Asteroids, play starts mid-screen, but shots ricochet off the arena borders.
c64:188966.title: Zone 7: Part 3

c64:188967.description: Defend a city from a huge enemy assault across several zones, driving various vehicles against tanks, with the main goal of reaching zone six to defuse a bomb that could level the city.
c64:188967.title: Zone Six

c64:188968.description: A vertical shooter over a smooth-scrolling landscape, with limited forward and back movement, a miniboss and an end boss on each level, followed by a bonus stage for extra points.
c64:188968.title: Zone Z

c64:188969.description: A match-three puzzle about capturing animals for a zoo: line up three or more of the same kind vertically or horizontally, and new animals drop in from above.
c64:188969.title: Zoo Mania

c64:188973.description: A primal duel for two players only, fought over who gets to eat meat tonight.
c64:188973.title: Zuul

c64:188974.description: A vertically scrolling SEUCK shooter with two stages of enemy ships to destroy using built-in lasers; a crash or a hit costs a life.
c64:188974.title: Zygon Warrior

c64:188977.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter: the Interplanetary Federation drops the player onto the Zynon-Lotec platform, a rebel base for revenge attacks, to fight through enemy territory.
c64:188977.title: Zynon

c64:188980.description: A puzzle in which arrows creep onto the board from each side and must be turned and slid so they stop on board squares, arranging them into the correct formation around two fixed points.
c64:188980.title: Zyx

c64:189206.title: Alien Kill II: The Final Encounter

c64:189370.title: The Isle of the Cursed Prophet

c64:19022.description: As Inspector Snide of Scotland Yard, investigate the death of Angus MacFungus at his mansion, gathering clues around the house to name the murderer; the screen border flashes near anything worth examining.
c64:19022.title: The Detective

c64:19024.description: Crockett and Tubbs work up a drug ring run by Mr. J, from street dealers to suppliers to the bosses at the casino, through overhead driving and shooting.
c64:19024.title: Miami Vice

c64:192157.description: A public domain clone of the Atari 2600 game Haunted House.
c64:192157.title: Haunted House

c64:192636.description: Accept a challenge from a friend of the hero's father to escape his labyrinth alive, seeing only the rooms adjoining the current one, so drawing a map is advised.
c64:192636.title: Laberinto

c64:192728.title: Match Maker: Elementary Science Facts: Grades 5 & 6

c64:192732.title: Match Maker: Grammar Word Use Skills

c64:193471.title: Ramsbottom Smith and the Quest for the Yellow Spheroid

aliases: Behind Closed Doors III: Cockroach Edition
c64:194479.title: Behind Closed Doors 3: Revenge of the Ants

c64:194987.description: A reading program aimed at understanding and remembering what has been read.
c64:194987.title: Stickybear Reading Comprehension

c64:195025.description: A shoot-'em-up closely resembling Sea Ranger, but with a far bigger play area and reworked graphics.
c64:195025.title: Das Sub

c64:195056.title: Survival of the Fittest (The Guild Adventure Software)

c64:195671.description: A Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit shooter for two cooperating players: the Federation strikes back at the Xenians, whose border raids keep hitting its convoys.
c64:195671.title: Alien Commando II: Planet X

c64:195693.description: A Spanish-language shooter about defending a city from alien ships.
c64:195693.title: Alien Raid

c64:195703.description: On a distant planet, young Amazons prove themselves by surviving a night in the Forest of a Thousand Dangers. Armed with a blaster and a protective suit, you shoot robots and rockets for trophies, spare the birds and other animals, and refill ammo and energy before time runs out.
c64:195703.title: Amazon (CA-Verlags)

c64:195705.description: A solo or two-player board game resembling an enlarged tic-tac-toe.
c64:195705.title: Amöba (Rom Software)

c64:195749.description: A Swedish-language first-person adventure with monochrome pictures and a menu of five commands: go, take, use, give and hit.
c64:195749.title: Arne Weise

c64:195750.description: A wargame of the clash at the Shevardino Redoubt, fought the day before Borodino, serving as a prequel to Krentek's Borodino: 1812 game.
c64:195750.title: Assault on the Shevardino Redoubt

c64:195751.description: A Commodore BASIC port of Assembloids: face tiles drop into a central window and you flick each one with the joystick into one of the surrounding windows before the timer runs down, building four-piece faces, with bigger scores when a face is made from one matching set.
c64:195751.title: Assembloids BASIC

c64:195752.description: Steer a spaceship through a series of mazes while avoiding very strange enemies.
c64:195752.title: Attack of the Megagalactic Cows

c64:195756.description: A Bubble Bobble parody in which enemies are knocked about by shouting Swedish into their ears.
c64:195756.title: Bable Bable

c64:195785.description: A single-screen platformer about collecting every diamond while avoiding crawling aliens.
c64:195785.title: Baby Jack II

c64:195859.description: As Special Inspector Francis, find the murder weapon in the English market town of Harboro so an arrested suspect can be convicted; also part of a trilogy alongside St. Jives and Lost in the Amazon.
c64:195859.title: Harboro

c64:195862.description: The only survivor of a plane crash on an expedition seeking the Golden Condor must find a way out of the South American jungle.
c64:195862.title: Lost in the Amazon

c64:195863.description: The village of St. Jives is terrorized by a mad scientist, and only casting a spell can stop his takeover.
c64:195863.title: St. Jives

c64:195865.description: A multiplayer RPG drawing on Chaos: The Battle of Wizards, Magic: The Gathering and Dark Legions.
c64:195865.title: Battle Khaos II

c64:195886.description: Control the Super Ball to destroy asteroids among other threats in this Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit game for one or two cooperating players.
c64:195886.title: Ball Fighter

c64:195926.description: Never officially released, this unfinished side-scrolling shoot 'em up supports one or two players and was coded by Duncan MacDonald with graphics by Dave Edwardson. It offers only a handful of attack waves, and its Rob Hubbard music is borrowed from Deep Strike.
c64:195926.title: Battlefield Earth

c64:195927.description: The Grixlons have taken the universe, and a house down the road, to wage eternal war; destroy every power orb to defeat them in this space shooter.
c64:195927.title: Battletrance

c64:195928.description: Push through enemy lines to find and destroy the enemy's secret headquarters.
c64:195928.title: Behind the Front

c64:196037.description: A one-player cute-'em-up built with the Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit, featuring unusual bosses and a road-crossing section in the style of Frogger.
c64:196037.title: Bluey Blob

c64:196057.description: Wicked Dr. Dactor has abducted the king and seized a once-peaceful land, and the hero Bogue emerges to save it.
c64:196057.title: Bogue

c64:196060.description: Bogue, a grape, returns to rescue all his friends from the evil Dactor, who plans to turn them into robots.
c64:196060.title: Bogue II

c64:196061.description: Explore a tomb full of traps, beetles, snakes and bats, the last of which shove the explorer around.
c64:196061.title: Pyramid

c64:196125.description: An early Bomberman-style game made with the Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit, for one player or two at once.
c64:196125.title: Bomberman

c64:196167.description: A follow-up to Border War that frees movement across the whole screen, with eight-way shooting and a weapon that sends walls of fire in from the left and right.
c64:196167.title: Border Blast II

c64:196213.description: Fight through a heavily defended fortress, destroying guard troops and robots to claim a bounty.
c64:196213.title: Bounty Hunter II

aliases: Bounty Hunter III: The Myth of Time
c64:196219.description: A bounty hunter shoots his way in all directions through an enemy stronghold, battling many defenders and bosses.
c64:196219.title: Bounty Hunter III

aliases: Bounty Hunter IV: The Reality of Time
c64:196241.description: Another Bounty Hunter fortress assault, with improved graphics, more enemy types and a tougher challenge.
c64:196241.title: Bounty Hunter IIII: The Reality of Time

c64:196247.description: Storm a fortress whose defenses grow ever stronger, facing threats drawn from the distant past to the far future.
c64:196247.title: Bounty Hunter V: The Test of Time

c64:196248.description: A bounty hunter battles through a fortress guarded by warriors from many different eras.
c64:196248.title: Bounty Hunter VI: The Need for Time

c64:196467.title: Brothers in Arms III: The Next Generation

c64:196685.description: The fourth demo game supplied with Sensible Software's Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit: a straightforward blaster whose sprites were drawn by a crowd of well-known names from the games industry.
c64:196685.title: Celebrity Squares

c64:196795.description: A hacked version of Championship Sprint, the overhead racer for one to three players, with added tracks.
c64:196795.title: Championship Sprint 1993: The Raceists II

aliases: Behind Closed Doors II: The Sequel
c64:197404.title: Behind Closed DoorsI: The Sequel

c64:197493.title: Sherlock Holmes: His Most Difficult Case

c64:198078.description: Dizzy hunts down all his friends to invite them to his rave.
c64:198078.title: Dizzy Goes Raving

c64:19858.description: As Louie the construction worker, bolt down girders that slide back and forth, then return to the starting point; across 100 levels, some also require placing girders in specific spots.

c64:27118.description: Rick tries to stop the Fat Guy helping aliens seize the world, crossing Hyde Park, ice caverns, a forest and atomic mines full of booby traps, laser bolts, robots and penguins.
c64:27118.title: Rick Dangerous 2

c64:27119.description: Based on the Schwarzenegger film: an ex-cop framed for mass murder is forced into a hugely popular deadly TV show and has to survive it.
c64:27119.title: The Running Man

c64:27121.description: Qualify for pole and then race Richard Petty and 18 other pros on the superspeedway, planning pit stops, drafting to gain time and fuel, and handling yellow caution flags.
c64:27121.title: Richard Petty's Talladega

c64:27122.description: A journalist from The Clarion infiltrates a drug ring's headquarters in Colombia to free a friend whom the Drug Baron is holding hostage.
c64:27122.title: Nexus

c64:27475.description: Stranded on a strange planet without fuel, Rocket Roger has to gather 99 fuel crystals scattered across its surface while hostile locals try to kill him.
c64:27475.title: Rocket Roger

aliases: I Found a Moonrock in My Nose
c64:278182.title: I Found a Moon Rock in My Nose

c64:28688.description: A huge asteroid is heading for Earth; fly a jet-pack around it to bring 36 uranium cubes together to destroy it, refuelling at depots and watching the oxygen supply.
c64:28688.title: Phantom of the Asteroids

aliases: Genius II: Into the Toy Caves
c64:295001.title: Genius 2: Into the Toy Caves

c64:29700.description: Wally assembles ten cars, each from six parts scattered around the stock room, placing them correctly at the assembly area while dodging robots, bouncing tyres and air hazards.
c64:29700.title: Automania: Manic Mechanic

c64:29702.description: Caveman B.C. Bill swings his club to stun or kill roaming creatures and drags cavewomen home to his cave to start a family.
c64:29702.title: B.C. Bill

c64:29703.description: On each single-screen level the burglar Blagger must pick up every key and open the safe before time runs out, walking and jumping in fixed arcs.
c64:29703.title: Blagger

c64:29704.description: Cabin boy Jim searches the 20 holds of the Black Galleon for loot, and after clearing a hoard has 45 seconds to find the Bronze key that leads to the next.
c64:29704.title: Booty

c64:29705.description: Based on the 1985 film: vigilante Paul Kersey takes to the New York streets after a friend is killed, helping the police wipe out the gangs.
c64:29705.title: Death Wish 3

c64:29706.description: Ocean turns its hunchback hero into a text adventure: Quasimodo seeks to help Esmeralda by exploring Notre Dame and places in, around and beneath Paris, gathering items to solve puzzles and get past the Bishop's and Cardinal's servants.
c64:29706.title: Hunchback: The Adventure!

c64:29707.description: Sequel to Jammin': the musician Rockin' Rodney, or alternatively his girlfriend Rachel, collects notes for a new song across 60 screens of vertical alleys in three colours that cannot be crossed directly.
c64:29707.title: Beat-it

c64:29708.description: Kokotoni Wilf travels across six time zones and 63 side-view screens to gather all seven fragments of the Dragon Amulet, flying and hovering with precision.
c64:29708.title: Kokotoni Wilf

c64:29709.description: Bounce a tennis ball across courses of tiles hanging high above the ground, getting past walls and enemies without plunging over the edge.
c64:29709.title: Bounder

c64:29710.description: Wally Week is stuck in his own nightmare and must find the key to wake his alarm clock before he is late for work, using escalators, lifts and locked doors to get around.
c64:29710.title: Pyjamarama

c64:29712.description: Time Pilot-inspired multi-directional shooter: a time-travelling fighter crosses five eras, battling aircraft of each period; downing 56 enemies moves on to the next.
c64:29712.title: Space Pilot

c64:29715.description: Recreate the stunts of British daredevil Eddie Kidd, beginning with bicycle jumps over oil barrels.
c64:29715.title: Eddie Kidd Jump Challenge

c64:29824.description: Three-on-three basketball with time limits, free throws, a three-point line and realistic backboard rebounds, played in three 200-second periods.
c64:29824.title: International Basketball

c64:29825.description: Life simulation from the female perspective: shape a character's personality through questions or at random, then make choices across seven stages from infancy to old age.
c64:29825.title: Alter Ego: Female Version

c64:29826.description: Life simulation from the male perspective: a character's personality is set by answering questions or at random, then guided through decisions in seven stages of life, from infancy through old age.
c64:29826.title: Alter Ego: Male Version

c64:29827.description: Still trapped by aliens in an alternate reality, the player leaves the City and descends into the dungeon below, following a largely linear route where survival is the goal.
c64:29827.title: Alternate Reality: The Dungeon

c64:29828.description: Fight up the rankings against twenty computer boxers; released in Britain as Barry McGuigan World Championship Boxing.
c64:29828.title: Star Rank Boxing

c64:29830.description: Golf follow-up to the original Leader Board and its Tournament edition with the same swing control, adding bunkers and trees and a choice of two courses for up to four players.
c64:29830.title: Leader Board: Executive Edition

c64:29831.description: Crawl through 13 dungeons of linked rooms to collect seven crowns and defeat the evil cleric Wistrik.
c64:29831.title: Realm of Impossibility

c64:29833.description: In 2010 disputes are settled by Rocket Ball: five-player teams on skates from Houston, Tokyo, Moscow and Madrid battle to grab a ball fired into the arena and score.
c64:29833.title: Rocket Ball

c64:29835.description: Real-time space strategy in which the dictator of the Epsilon Galaxy fights alien empires for barren planets in buffer dimensions. Terraform worlds into farming, mining, energy or city planets, tax citizens, and build and equip armies and cruisers to invade.
c64:29835.title: Overlord (Virgin Mastertronic)

c64:29836.description: Hijack a steam train to flee Nazi-occupied territory in World War II, keeping the engine running while fighting off attacks; loosely based on the Burt Lancaster film.
c64:29836.title: The Train

c64:29900.description: Real-time strategy aboard a high-tech aircraft carrier with fighters, amphibious vehicles and decoy drones, setting up resource, factory and defence bases across an island chain against an enemy carrier.
c64:29900.title: Carrier Command

c64:30136.description: Graphical dungeon crawl in the Rogue style. Descend randomly generated levels full of traps, treasure and monsters to recover the stolen Sword of Fargoal from the depths and escape with it.
c64:30136.title: Sword of Fargoal

c64:30341.description: Early business simulation where one to eight players compete for profit by setting production levels and prices according to basic economic principles.
c64:30341.title: Cartels & Cutthroat$

c64:30395.description: Command six counter-terrorists retaking an embassy: move three snipers into position around the building, then send the other three inside to clear out the terrorists.
c64:30395.title: Hostage: Rescue Mission

c64:30438.description: Infocom's only romance text adventure: a young noblewoman sailing to the Caribbean to reach her sick father is taken by pirates and has to find her own way through intrigue on land and sea.
c64:30438.title: Plundered Hearts

c64:30479.description: Ozark Softscape's exploration game: sail from Spain to the New World in 1492 (or to a randomly generated continent), meet native peoples, found missions and forts, and bring back gold to win promotions from the Queen.
c64:30479.title: The Seven Cities of Gold

aliases: Caverns of Khafka: Die Grabkammern des Pharao
c64:31005.description: Search a labyrinth for five holy seals to open Pharaoh Khafka's temple gate, then enter the tomb past ghost guards, bugs and still-working traps to claim the treasure.
c64:31005.title: Caverns of Khafka

c64:31006.description: The heir of Apshai's greatest hero searches dungeon levels for the lost Temple of Apshai, whose magic alone can save the land from turmoil.
c64:31006.title: Gateway to Apshai

c64:31007.description: Time Master Tim must carry dinosaur eggs to the present to save them from the measles he brought to the prehistoric past, fending off spiders and snakes and the eggs' mother.
c64:31007.title: Dino Eggs

aliases: Jet Set Willy: The Final Frontier
c64:31039.description: The sole official follow-up to Jet Set Willy: Miner Willy explores a greatly expanded mansion, collecting items in many new platform rooms.
c64:31039.title: Jet Set Willy II: The Final Frontier

c64:31422.description: Left by his wife, Finnish film comic Uuno Turhapuro moves to the country in this side-scrolling game, ploughing fields around rocks to earn money, water-skiing past ducks and birds, and fleeing an angry neighbour.
c64:31422.title: Uuno Turhapuro muuttaa maalle

c64:31448.description: Galactic conquest against up to three AI empires, all named by the player, on a 2D star map with no diplomacy and no control over tactical combat.
c64:31448.title: Reach for the Stars: The Conquest of the Galaxy

c64:31502.description: Build bombers, submarines, missiles and ABM defences while spying on a hostile neighbour, until one side launches a first strike and nuclear war breaks out.
c64:31502.title: Nukewar

c64:31505.description: Drive the MX-100 super tank across alien-held Antarctica in 2005, fighting enemy targets in 3D to destroy the invaders' main fortress.
c64:31505.title: Arcticfox

c64:31897.description: As Bond, go after drug lord Sanchez, who murdered Felix Leiter's bride, fighting on land, on the water and in the skies with helicopters, planes and tankers.
c64:31897.title: Licence to Kill

c64:31899.description: Spy Hunter-style vertically scrolling driving and shooting in a gadget-equipped car, with boat sections along the way.
c64:31899.title: James Bond 007: The Spy Who Loved Me

c64:31903.description: Football management in which any league club can be chosen but always begins in the 4th division, with scouts, physios, coaches and an optional youth team to hire before the squad can progress.
c64:31903.title: Football Director

c64:31904.description: Take a club of your choice from the 4th division toward the top flight and cup success over an open-ended career, buying and selling players whose transfer values fluctuate.
c64:31904.title: Football Manager

c64:31906.description: Conversion of Taito's vertical shooter: a lone biplane takes on swarms of enemy aircraft, tanks, gun emplacements and warships.
c64:31906.title: Sky Shark

c64:31908.description: Isometric maze game on ladder-linked platforms that alternates between Flip the kangaroo hopping across the tiles and Mitch the ape swinging beneath them, pursued by a zookeeper and a net; sticky squares can trap the chasers.
c64:31908.title: Flip & Flop

c64:31909.description: Guide the career of a young striker at a Division 4 club toward winning Footballer of the Year, spending money on goal cards that each set up a scoring chance, up to three per match.
c64:31909.title: Footballer of the Year

c64:31910.description: Rather than a whole club, manage one player's career through matches and transfers, starting with ten goal cards of which up to three per match each grant a shot at goal.
c64:31910.title: Footballer of the Year 2

c64:31911.description: Third Football Manager game: take charge of a national side in the real 1990 World Cup qualifying rounds and try to win through the finals tournament.
c64:31911.title: Football Manager: World Cup Edition

c64:31912.description: Race ten international circuits such as Monza, Monaco, Silverstone, Zandvoort and the Österreichring in wet or dry weather, with manual or automatic gears and realistic braking.
c64:31912.title: Formula 1 Simulator

c64:31913.description: Boxing in the mould of Super Punch-Out!!: as Frank Bruno, seen from just behind him, beat eight increasingly tough opponents to win the title.
c64:31913.title: Frank Bruno's Boxing

c64:31916.description: The son of Frankenstein's monster combs the castle for his father's scattered body parts so he can reassemble him and bring him back with 10,000 volts.
c64:31916.title: Frankenstein Jnr.

c64:31919.description: Expansion for the original Gauntlet that adds 512 new dungeons and no other content.
c64:31919.title: Gauntlet: The Deeper Dungeons

c64:31920.description: Side-scrolling football endorsed by Paul Gascoigne, with eight-direction movement and adjustable kick power, playing international sides that range in strength from Brazil to Albania.
c64:31920.title: Gazza II

c64:31921.description: Top-down football licensed around Paul Gascoigne, with a pitch that scrolls either sideways or vertically, plus league and cup competitions, one-off matches and practice of set pieces.
c64:31921.title: Gazza's Super Soccer

c64:31922.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Action Game

c64:31923.description: Conversion of Atari's coin-op adaptation of the second film: Indy cracks his whip through mine levels to free captive children, rides mine carts and raids the temple, repeating the cycle.
c64:31923.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

c64:31954.description: One- or two-player wrestling from the makers of Way of the Exploding Fist, which claimed to be the earliest 3D combat sports game since fighters can move up and down the ring as well as sideways.
c64:31954.title: Bop'n Wrestle

c64:31956.description: Play the center for one of 20 unlicensed US and Canadian teams across four five-team divisions while the computer handles teammates; the top two in each division reach the playoffs.
c64:31956.title: Superstar Ice Hockey

c64:31958.description: After the heroes defeat Mangar, his master the Mad God Tarjan destroys Skara Brae; the party sets out from a refugee camp on a quest to defeat him.
c64:31958.title: The Bard's Tale III: Thief of Fate

c64:31959.title: Tales of the Unknown: Volume I: The Bard's Tale

c64:31960.description: The Archmage Lagoth Zanta has broken the Destiny Wand, protector of the realm for seven centuries, into seven pieces; a party of adventurers must recover them all.
c64:31960.title: The Bard's Tale II: The Destiny Knight

c64:31962.description: Chess opponent with 12 skill levels for novices to grandmasters, a 71,000-move opening library, printable move history, a teaching mode showing legal moves, and hints.
c64:31962.title: The Chessmaster 2000

c64:31963.description: Last entry in the Epyx Games series after Summer Games II, combining four events reworked from the earlier Summer Games titles with four brand-new ones.
c64:31963.title: The Games: Summer Edition

c64:31964.description: Follow-up to Winter Games with a new line-up of events, some returning from the original and some new, including luge, ski jumping and speed skating.
c64:31964.title: The Games: Winter Edition

c64:31966.description: Pinball on tables divided into two parts, each with its own flippers, scrolling between them as the ball moves; finishing a table requires meeting its particular objectives.
c64:31966.title: Time Scanner

c64:31968.description: Miniature golf for up to four players on four courses (Classic, Deluxe, Traditional and Challenge), with full games or practice on any hole; Classic has animated obstacles.
c64:31968.title: Mini-Putt

c64:32000.description: Magneto and Arcade have abducted Professor X, and the X-Men must combine action and exploration inside the Murderworld amusement complex to rescue him.
c64:32000.title: X-Men

c64:32001.description: Arcade side-scrolling brawler starring Bin, a cartoon duck, who punches enemies, grabs bonus weapons and eats food for energy on the way to rescue his kidnapped friend Lucy.
c64:32001.title: Dynamite Düx

aliases: Elvira II: The Jaws of Cerberus
c64:32003.description: The demon Cerberus has abducted Elvira to steal her power; search the Black Widow Productions film studios, whose horror movie sets have come to life, to rescue her.
c64:32003.title: Elvira II

c64:32005.description: The races of the fantasy world GHoLD meet every five years for a tournament of kicking furry Beloms at opponents; win nine matches plus two sub-games, Faulton Feeding and Revenge of the Beloms.
c64:32005.title: Grand Monster Slam

aliases: Infiltrator Part II: The Next Day
c64:32006.description: Jimbo McGibbets returns, flying an advanced attack helicopter and then sneaking through enemy compounds to collect weapons and intelligence from huts, using gas on guards.
c64:32006.title: Infiltrator II

c64:32007.description: Golf on eighteen renowned holes taken from courses in the US, Scotland and England, including Augusta National, Pebble Beach, St Andrews' Old Course, Riviera and Baltusrol.
c64:32007.title: Jack Nicklaus' Greatest 18 Holes of Major Championship Golf

c64:32008.description: Comic mystery in which detective Hercule Holmes must crack a murder case before the crime happens, as five famous mystery writers gather at a hotel and one plans to kill another.
c64:32008.title: Killed Until Dead

c64:32009.description: Detective Tex Murphy investigates a professor's death in a future San Francisco, flying his speeder between locations and calling his secretary and informant for faxed information.
c64:32009.title: Mean Streets

aliases: Might and Magic Book Two: Gates to Another World
Might and Magic II: Gates to Another World
Might and Magic: Gates to Another World
c64:32010.description: The rogue guardian Sheltem flees through the Gates to Another World to CRON, pursued by Corak and a party of adventurers who must stop the chaos he is causing there.
c64:32010.title: Might and Magic II

c64:32011.description: Cinemaware adventure styled after 1950s sci-fi serials, with cut-scenes: a rocket-pack hero flies around the globe in the 1940s to thwart a Nazi plot.
c64:32011.title: Rocket Ranger

c64:32012.description: The warrior Savage, freed from imprisonment in a castle, fights through three levels with distinct play styles; a code earned by finishing each grants extra lives on the next.
c64:32012.title: Savage

c64:32013.description: A wizard places and removes blocks to steer a self-rolling ball to the spot marked 'In', reshaping each level's layout just to reach the ball in the first place.
c64:32013.title: Spherical

c64:32027.description: Charlie the clown performs five circus stunts, among them leaping through rings of fire on a lion while avoiding flaming jugs and crossing a tightrope while hopping over monkeys.
c64:32027.title: Circus Charlie

c64:32028.description: Fly three scored missions in Strategic Air Command's annual bombing and navigation contest at Ellsworth Air Force Base, competing against international crews for the Curtis E. LeMay Trophy.
c64:32028.title: Strike Aces

c64:32029.description: Eight self-contained medieval contests, including crossbow shooting at rotating targets and archery at targets that slide from left to right.
c64:32029.title: Knight Games

c64:32030.description: Former leader Kaimen has turned evil, kidnapped the Holy Ones and handed the peaceful land of Khantun to wicked monks; defeat him through exploration and martial arts combat.
c64:32030.title: Moebius: The Orb of Celestial Harmony

c64:32045.description: Chess in which captures play out as animated fights between the pieces, with the animation optional and several difficulty levels.
c64:32045.title: Battle Chess

c64:32046.description: Stone Age sports for up to six players, with dino racing, clubbing, the dino vault, saber racing, fire making and mate tossing, and six cavemen with different strengths and weaknesses.
c64:32046.title: Caveman Ugh-Lympics

c64:32047.description: Cliff Hanger, a cartoon cowboy, tries to flatten the outlaw El Bandito using contraptions such as boulders, anvils, bombs and cannons, in the spirit of the Road Runner cartoons. Bonus points go to working out each scene's trick at the first attempt.
c64:32047.title: Cliff Hanger

c64:32048.description: Joust-like action: tap fire to keep the Dragon Hawk flapping and swoop down on buzzards, phoenixes and dragon puppies, which can strike back the same way.
c64:32048.title: DragonHawk

c64:32049.description: Assemble a monster from 12 body types such as Tyro, Arachnid and Wasp, add enhancements like tentacles or fiery breath and weapons from rifles to flamethrowers, then send it into battle.
c64:32049.title: Mail Order Monsters

c64:32050.description: Early music game inspired by One Thousand and One Nights: a prince steers a flying carpet over diamond gates through winding tunnels, then repeats genies' melodies to win their lamps.
c64:32050.title: Master of the Lamps

c64:32051.description: Bounty Bob explores an abandoned mine, recolouring every floor section by walking over it to clear each level, while working out how to reach all the sections.
c64:32051.title: Miner 2049er

c64:32052.description: A blue mouse searches a labyrinth for cheese against the clock while red mice roam the maze, deadly on contact and able to surround it.
c64:32052.title: Radar Rat Race

c64:32073.description: Pac-Man-like maze game: collect 250 eggs laid by Queen Squirm before her workers do, avoiding her guardian worms before the lights go out.
c64:32073.title: Squirm

c64:32076.description: Educational maths driving game: estimate the answers to sums while racing a car seen from behind, choosing car speed and either a full race or practice.
c64:32076.title: Number Chaser

c64:32254.description: Basic training under a relentless drill sergeant, made up of four timed events that test coordination, stamina and morale.
c64:32254.title: 19 Part One: Boot Camp

c64:32255.description: Start on a fast motorbike that can jump water and overtake enemies, then collect parts to upgrade it into a sports car and eventually a combat aircraft.
c64:32255.title: Action Fighter

c64:32258.description: Manhattan, 2019, after a nuclear war: Jungle Rogers fights through the ruined city to reach launch platform XV-238 in Professor McJerin's base and escape to the outer colonies.
c64:32258.title: After the War

c64:32260.description: Dropped by helicopter, one-man army Arnie advances along a set route through an isometric, scrolling enemy complex, gunning down soldiers and destroying vehicles.
c64:32260.title: Arnie

c64:32261.description: An isometric shoot-'em-up sequel in which a commando blows up chemical plant valves, clears an airfield of troops, tanks and helicopters, crosses battleships in a harbor, and frees prisoners from a jungle camp, using limited grenades on foxholes.
c64:32261.title: Arnie 2

c64:32262.description: Army training simulator built around a punishing obstacle course: razor wire, water jumps, monkey bars, a log challenge, a rope swing and 12-foot walls.
c64:32262.title: Assault Course: Combat Academy

c64:32263.description: Riding home on his BMX after training, Phil 'Pookie' Wheeler is ambushed by the rival Diamond Backs team, whose leader wants his title of BMX Ninja.
c64:32263.title: BMX Ninja

c64:32275.description: Train in karate, kendo, bo and nunchaku at a martial arts dojo, then enter the Budokan tournament to face a series of opponents.
c64:32275.title: Budokan: The Martial Spirit

c64:32276.description: Pick from warriors ranging from monk to samurai, each with his own strengths, whose magic belt can whisk him back to base to retrain when badly wounded.
c64:32276.title: Bushido: The Way of the Warrior

c64:32277.description: One or two players learn kung fu through demanding training sessions in the Temples of Shaolin, set against a variety of oriental backdrops, before putting the skills to use in combat.
c64:32277.title: Chambers of Shaolin

c64:32278.description: Children help Donald Duck work four jobs, such as running a produce stand, to earn money for playground equipment for Huey, Dewey and Louie.
c64:32278.title: Donald Duck's Playground

c64:32280.description: One- or two-player fighting among five contenders for the Fist Fighter crown, staged in Egypt, Japan and America on a screen that scrolls slightly, with selectable location and difficulty.
c64:32280.title: Fist Fighter

c64:32281.description: Martial arts follow-up from Beam Software: defend the title against ever more skilful opponents on the way to 10th Dan, with sixteen moves available.
c64:32281.title: Exploding Fist+

c64:32282.description: Brian Howarth text adventure based on the film: as Billy, after Gizmo has been fed past midnight, keep the gremlins from overrunning Kingston Falls with Gizmo's help.
c64:32282.title: Gremlins: The Adventure

c64:32283.description: Billy sets out to rescue Gizmo from the Clamp Tower skyscraper before Dr. Catheter experiments on him, fighting through a fresh batch of vicious gremlins across five levels.
c64:32283.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch

c64:32284.description: Jack Burton and Wang Chi descend into Lo Pan's underground empire to save Gracie Law and Miao Yin, green-eyed women he plans to wed and sacrifice to gain a mortal body.
c64:32284.title: Big Trouble in Little China

c64:32285.description: Sequel to Ninja Rabbits: the rabbit keeps fighting to wipe out deadly nerve gases worldwide, facing Chinese dragons, Guardian Angels, crazed pandas and brawling footballers.
c64:32285.title: International Ninja Rabbits

c64:32286.description: Drive a jeep back to base through enemy territory, using speed to set jump height, front and rear guns against grenades and firebombs, and ramps onto upper platforms.
c64:32286.title: Jeep Command

c64:32287.description: Wild West action in four sections, two of shooting and two on horseback, starting with a bird shoot where the aim must lead the targets.
c64:32287.title: Kane

c64:32288.description: The Black Hole Gang is out of jail and has kidnapped the Indian chief's daughter to spark a war; Marshall McGraw must stop them and save the town of Kane again.
c64:32288.title: Kane 2

c64:32289.description: A karate game: head kicks, jump and slide kicks, circle kicks and fireballs on the joystick, plus high and low blocks and a backward jump, with credit points earned spent on raising strength and hit points.
c64:32289.title: Long Life

c64:32290.description: Side-scrolling Pac-Man adventure for one or two players: Pac escorts a fairy back to Fairy Land while the ghosts Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde and Sue chase him.
c64:32290.title: Pac-Land

c64:32292.description: Popeye is kidnapped by the universe-conquering KRAGGS and must represent Earth in an intergalactic wrestling contest against five vicious aliens on a desolate asteroid.
c64:32292.title: Popeye 3: WrestleCrazy

c64:32293.description: Percy the pigeon plucks ten nesting twigs from a busy road to build his home, dodging traffic, a pigeon-eating cat and a starving ferret.
c64:32293.title: Percy the Potty Pigeon

c64:32294.description: Wrestle in the ring with moves like knockout punches, body slams and flying pins, and also wheel and deal as a wrestling manager.
c64:32294.title: Sgt Slaughter's Mat Wars

c64:32295.description: Mickey, newly arrived in New York from the countryside, fights his way through side-scrolling streets to win gang membership by snipping a curl from the leader's hair.
c64:32295.title: Street Gang

c64:32296.description: Skate down the road collecting Colts bottles and grabbing drinks from friendly drivers, avoiding crossing chickens and hostile cars without stopping.
c64:32296.title: Street Surfer

c64:32297.description: Five athletic events: fencing, hurdles, high diving, triple jump and a shooting contest.
c64:32297.title: Summer Challenge

c64:32298.description: Isometric one-on-one fighting with high, middle and low attacks plus dodges and blocks, where harder or more effective blows score more points.
c64:32298.title: Thai Boxing

c64:32299.description: Karate fighting around the world for one or two simultaneous players, against the computer or each other; originally released on the Golden Disk 64 magazine disk.
c64:32299.title: Tough Guys

aliases: Comando Parachutiste: Who Dares Wins II
c64:32300.description: Commando-style shooter in vertical flick screens: retake eight occupied townships with a rifle and five grenades, killing enemy troops and rescuing captured comrades.
c64:32300.title: Who Dares Wins II

c64:32301.description: Follow-up to Summer Camp in which Maximus Mouse, now on rescue duty at Camp Nice'n'Icy, must stop a bird from dislodging a pebble that would bury the camp in an avalanche, over eight levels.
c64:32301.title: Winter Camp

c64:32302.description: Five winter sports: ski jumping, bobsleigh, biathlon, slalom and downhill racing; also sold under the names Winter Olympiad 88 and Winter Olympiad.
c64:32302.title: Winter Challenge

aliases: World Class Leader Board: The Ultimate Golf Challenge
c64:32303.description: Golf on three famous 18-hole courses, including St Andrews and Doral Country Club's Blue Monster, with each hole's length, bunkers, trees, rough and water hazards reproduced.
c64:32303.title: World Class Leader Board

c64:32304.description: Kwon, known as the Human Killing Machine, travels from country to country in one-on-one fights to prove the power of his martial arts.
c64:32304.title: HKM

c64:32524.description: Sid Meier's flight simulator: fly solo across several US states, carrying mail between airports.
c64:32524.title: Solo Flight

c64:32527.description: Fast reflex puzzle based on Photon Storm's Quartet: build faces from four different sets at top speed; a refined version of a 2012 16KB cartridge competition runner-up.
c64:32527.title: Assembloids

c64:32528.description: Official conversion of the one-button indie runner Canabalt, designed for a 16KB cartridge: a man sprints and leaps across the rooftops of a collapsing city.
c64:32528.title: C64anabalt

c64:32531.description: Horace dodges traffic on a Frogger-like road to reach the ski shop, paying ambulance fees from his $40 if hit, and then skis down a slalom course.
c64:32531.title: Horace Goes Skiing

c64:482066.title: Van Helsing

aliases: Ecos: The Last Orbit of Kepler-9
c64:482131.title: Ecos

c64:6381.description: Knight Arthur fights to rescue the Princess from Astaroth, the Demon King, over six levels of forest, village, mountain and cavern, each with a three-minute limit.
c64:6381.title: Ghosts 'n Goblins

c64:6383.description: One or two players choose from four heroes with different weapons, such as Thor the Warrior, and battle hordes of monsters through 100 levels.
c64:6383.title: Gauntlet

c64:6384.description: Gorth, the mightiest barbarian, duels eight of the sorcerer Drax's best warriors with his sword and then Drax himself to free Princess Marina from his spell.
