c64:6384.title: Death Sword

c64:6386.description: Clear all 99 sectors of the alien Restrictor Shield surrounding Earth, flying the Beamrider armed with a short-range laser lariat and a few torpedoes.
c64:6386.title: Beamrider

c64:6387.description: Play a giant camel firing blue shots and powering up through pickups against bizarre foes such as British phone boxes, Polo mints, exploding sheep and skiing kangaroos.
c64:6387.title: Revenge of the Mutant Camels

c64:6388.description: Bub and Bob, turned into dinosaurs, clear single-screen cave levels by trapping monsters in bubbles and popping them, with a two-player cooperative mode.
c64:6388.title: Bubble Bobble

c64:6389.description: Jack leaps and glides around screens set at sites like the Sphinx, the Acropolis and Neuschwanstein Castle, collecting the 24 bombs planted on each.
c64:6389.title: Bomb Jack

c64:6391.description: Football with advanced control where players slow down and turn naturally rather than stopping dead, layered on top of the usual running, passing and shooting.
c64:6391.title: Emlyn Hughes International Soccer

c64:6392.description: Simple football for one or two players, with selectable shirt colours, nine computer difficulty levels and no offside rule.
c64:6392.title: International Soccer

c64:6393.description: Frogger clone: hop across a busy street and then a river on logs and turtles, earning bonuses for lady frogs and flies.
c64:6393.title: Frogger 64

c64:6394.description: Elvin Atombender seeks revenge in this sequel; infiltrate his fortress, exploring its towers for codes while avoiding his robots.
c64:6394.title: Impossible Mission-II

c64:6396.description: In the far future a resistance movement discovers that Macro-Genetic Mutoids are being bred purely as weapons and sets out to destroy them.
c64:6396.title: Mutants

c64:6397.description: Rescue five hostages from a concentration camp across six stages: setting up communications, then the jungle, a village, an ammunition depot, the camp itself and the airport.
c64:6397.title: Operation Wolf

c64:6398.description: Drive a Ferrari with a passenger across a series of short routes, seen from above and behind, through sharp bends and hazards that can flip the car and cost time.
c64:6398.title: Out Run

c64:6400.description: Giana wakes in a strange dreamworld and fights monsters and giant spiders across 32 side-scrolling levels to find the magic diamond that will return her home.
c64:6400.title: The Great Giana Sisters

c64:6402.description: One of three heroes battles Death-Adder, who has locked up the royal family and stolen the Golden Axe, in a side-scrolling fantasy brawler.
c64:6402.title: Golden Axe

c64:6403.description: An adventurer begins beside a white house and explores the Great Underground Empire below in search of treasure in this text adventure.
c64:6403.title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire

c64:6404.description: Horizontal shooter: a spacecraft battles swooping alien waves over a crowded landscape, collecting fuel pods to upgrade its weapons.
c64:6404.title: Zynaps

c64:6405.description: As resistance leader Mike Donovan, plant explosives at key points aboard the Visitors' huge mothership to destroy its reactor, evading aliens and security robots.
c64:6405.title: V

aliases: The Way of the Exploding Fist
c64:6406.description: One-on-one martial arts duels with sixteen moves, from kicks to somersaults and roundhouses, selected by joystick direction, facing and the fire button.
c64:6406.title: Kung-Fu: The Way of the Exploding Fist

c64:6407.description: A ninja infiltrates a warehouse, dark tunnels and a secret command centre to steal a disk and escape, watching his energy bar and the time limit.
c64:6407.title: Saboteur!

c64:6408.description: Play poker against TV personality Samantha Fox, presented with digitised pictures.
c64:6408.title: Samantha Fox Strip Poker

c64:6409.description: Drive an armed sports car up a vertically scrolling freeway, destroying enemy vehicles while protecting civilian traffic.
c64:6409.title: Spy Hunter

c64:6411.description: Steer a bouncing wizard ball through grey landscapes, shooting enemies and collecting droplets of coloured paint to restore each level's colour.
c64:6411.title: Wiz Ball

c64:6412.description: Spies Head and Heels are captured and separated on Blacktooth; they must reunite, liberate the enslaved worlds of Safari, Penitentiary, Book World and Egyptus, and defeat the Emperor.
c64:6412.title: Head Over Heels

c64:6413.description: Break into Magma Ltd's computer system with no instructions, then steer a remote robot around the world to collect pieces of a secret document exposing the company.
c64:6413.title: Hacker

c64:6416.description: A secret agent infiltrates Professor Elvin Atombender's stronghold, dodging his robots while searching the rooms for fragments of a password needed to reach the central control room. Room layouts and puzzle pieces are reshuffled each game.
c64:6416.title: Impossible Mission

c64:6419.description: Steer Pitfall Harry through a jungle maze to recover 32 treasures within 20 minutes, jumping and climbing past crocodiles, scorpions, rattlesnakes, fire, rolling logs, quicksand and pits.
c64:6419.title: Pitfall!

c64:6420.description: Run and fly through the Fantasy Zone, a vividly colored world with a checkerboard floor, blasting prehistoric beasts, Chinese dragons and alien pods with an arm-held cannon as the stage scrolls ever forward.
c64:6420.title: Space Harrier

c64:6421.description: Qualify with a timed lap at the Fuji circuit, then take a Formula One car into a race against a field of rival cars.
c64:6421.title: Pole Position

aliases: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
c64:6422.description: Pick one of eight international fighters, among them Ken and the fire-breathing yoga master Dhalsim, and battle through a series of one-on-one bouts.
c64:6422.title: Street Fighter II

c64:6423.description: On the abandoned man-made world of Alterra, made up of five bio-engineered habitats, a lone armored soldier fights the forces of the rogue ecosystem network MORGUL.
c64:6423.title: Turrican

c64:6424.description: Ride a bicycle along a suburban street delivering newspapers to subscribers while dodging motorcycles, tricycles, dogs, skateboarders, breakdancers and traffic, and foiling robbers along the way.
c64:6424.title: Paperboy

c64:6425.description: Drive an off-road buggy over five courses, a looping offroad track plus north, east, west and south runs, finishing every leg before the timer expires and grabbing pickups on the way.
c64:6425.title: Speed Buggy

c64:6434.description: Pilot the Super Ace, a P-38 Lightning lookalike, across the WWII Pacific toward Tokyo, shooting down Japanese aircraft and looping out of the way of enemy fire.

c64:6435.description: Seven-a-side football with league and cup modes, plus a Diamond Deflection System that gives control over the direction, power and height of each kick.
c64:6435.title: Match Day II

c64:6436.description: Steer a rotating ship through space with momentum-based thrust, blasting asteroids; coming to a halt means turning around and burning the engines to cancel the drift.
c64:6436.title: Blasteroids

c64:6439.description: As soldier Super Joe, fight alone deep into enemy territory armed with a machine gun and a handful of grenades, under a hail of mortar shells and bullets from rebel troops.
c64:6439.title: Commando

c64:6440.description: Guide Dirk the Daring through a wizard's castle to save Princess Daphne from the dragon Singe, timing joystick moves and sword strikes to survive each animated hazard.
c64:6440.title: Dragon's Lair

c64:6441.description: The first Speedball: a brutal future sport on a compact court with five players a side, no fouls and a goal at each end. Bribe the referee or boost your squad between matches in a knockout cup or a two-player game.
c64:6441.title: Speedball

c64:6442.description: Control the Influence Device aboard a robot-infested spaceship seen from above, clearing every deck of hostile droids by shooting them or seizing control of them through a circuit transfer game.
c64:6442.title: Paradroid

c64:6443.description: A Phoenix-style shooter: blast waves of swooping aliens from the bottom of the screen, avoiding their shots and collisions, then assault the fortified Eagle Empire itself.
c64:6443.title: Eagle Empire

c64:6444.description: Run a ghost-catching business in a haunted New York City, buying equipment, driving to haunted buildings and trapping spooks with proton packs and ghost traps.
c64:6444.title: Ghostbusters

aliases: Yie Ar Kung-Fu 2: The Emperor Yie-Gah
c64:6446.description: Lee Young sets out to rid China of the self-proclaimed Emperor Yie-Gah, last survivor of the Chop Suey Gang, battling through three-part levels that each end with a boss fight.
c64:6446.title: Yie Ar Kung Fu II

c64:6447.description: Humanity abandoned its colonies after a plague in 2150; now a skimmer pilot heads to Tau Ceti III, silent since a meteor struck, to deal with the robot systems left running there.
c64:6447.title: Tau Ceti: The Lost Star Colony

c64:6448.description: Trapped in a cave-filled other dimension after activating a strange 19th-century machine, the player pilots the Eidolon through 3D tunnels as the creatures it woke close in.
c64:6448.title: The Eidolon

c64:6449.description: Command a US Navy fleet submarine in the WWII Pacific, running patrols of up to two months out of Hawaii, Australia or New Zealand against Japanese shipping, with adjustable realism and time period.
c64:6449.title: Silent Service: The Submarine Simulation

c64:6450.description: Mercenaries are secretly breeding the prized Tasty Space Griffin on a distant moon to wreck its market and grab power, and a space-faring dog is sent to round up the birds.
c64:6450.title: Star Paws

c64:6477.description: Soldiers Ricky and Mary, alone or together, sweep eight-way scrolling alien bases to free captured comrades; once enough are rescued, the exit opens onto a boss guardian.
c64:6477.title: Alien Syndrome

c64:6478.description: Swipe the neighbor's mower and cut up to 16 lawns while staying clear of the flower beds; trampling them brings an irate gardener out after the machine.
c64:6478.title: Hover Bovver

c64:6479.description: Dave leads a team of teenagers into the creepy Edison mansion to rescue Sandy, a missing classmate, solving puzzles with a verb-based point-and-click interface.
c64:6479.title: Maniac Mansion

c64:6481.description: Parachute behind enemy lines as a lone Ranger on missions such as killing an officer, destroying a bunker, knocking out a SAM site or freeing a POW, with maps and objectives generated randomly.
c64:6481.title: Airborne Ranger

c64:6482.description: A left-to-right scrolling shooter across 8 sectors of the Delta region, where pilots fight to salvage the valuable leftovers of an ancient war.
c64:6482.title: Delta II: Armalyte

c64:6483.description: Bruce Lee fights through a wizard's underground fortress, collecting the lanterns in each room to open the way onward while a ninja and a green sumo give chase.
c64:6483.title: Bruce Lee

c64:6484.description: Move a lone ship left and right to dodge alien waves descending halfway down the screen, and shoot down as many as possible before it is destroyed.
c64:6484.title: Annihilator

c64:6485.description: Sun-soaked West Coast events: surfing, half-pipe skateboarding, BMX, roller skating, footbag and flying disc, with judges scoring the surf runs.
c64:6485.title: California Games

c64:6486.description: Fly the experimental Cybernoid fighter to win back the minerals and gems plundered by Zoggian pirates from three hidden asteroid storehouses, using lasers, missiles and special weapons.
c64:6486.title: Cybernoid: The Fighting Machine

c64:6487.description: After their colony ship crash-lands on an uncharted Pacific island, the fuzzy aliens from planet Blot come under attack, and hero Clyde Radcliffe must rescue captured friends from elaborate torture devices.
c64:6487.title: Creatures

c64:6488.description: Commander Jameson begins docked at Lave Station holding 100 credits and a Cobra Mark III, free to trade, fight pirates and travel between star systems in open-ended wireframe 3D.
c64:6488.title: Elite

aliases: Gunship: El Helicoptero De Combate Del Siglo XXI
c64:6489.description: Fly an AH-64A Apache attack helicopter armed with Hellfire missiles, a helmet-aimed 30mm cannon, rocket pods and air-to-air missiles across combat missions.
c64:6489.title: Gunship: The Helicopter Simulation

c64:6490.description: A horizontally scrolling platformer where a synthetic life form, guided from a Xamoxian bunker, hunts four puzzle pieces per level, with flashing hawk eyes on the status panel pointing the way.
c64:6490.title: Hawkeye

aliases: Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance
c64:6491.description: Swept from feudal Japan to 20th-century New York, the Last Ninja fights through the city to face the returned Shogun again, solving object puzzles in an isometric world.
c64:6491.title: Last Ninja 2

c64:6492.description: Tiki the kiwi runs through each level dodging spikes and enemy fire to rescue a caged kiwi friend, firing arrows that can be upgraded to bombs, lasers or bouncing fireballs.
c64:6492.title: The NewZealand Story

c64:6494.description: Defend planet Choom from seven warring dictators, jetpacking across the surface and through the skies, in a mix of side-scrolling shooting and overhead combat.
c64:6494.title: Retrograde

aliases: Rainbow Islands: The Story of Bubble Bobble 2
c64:6495.description: Climb each sinking island to the top by casting solid rainbows that serve both as bridges and as weapons against enemies.
c64:6495.title: Rainbow Islands

c64:6496.description: Recreate key scenes from the film in Chicago, taking down Al Capone's henchmen before finally arresting Capone himself.
c64:6496.title: The Untouchables

c64:6497.description: Eight national sports to compete in: weightlifting in Russia, slalom in France, log rolling in Canada, cliff diving in Mexico, caber toss in Scotland, bull riding in the US, barrel jumping in Germany and sumo in Japan.
c64:6497.title: World Games

c64:6498.description: Race a police squad car through the streets of San Francisco, past its trams and the Golden Gate Bridge, in a national police car steeplechase championship.
c64:6498.title: Cisco Heat: All American Police Car Race

aliases: Spy vs Spy II: The Island Caper
c64:6499.description: The rival spies are marooned on a volcanic island, racing to gather three missile parts and escape by submarine before the eruption, while avoiding quicksand and setting traps for each other.
c64:6499.title: Spy vs Spy: The Island Caper

c64:6501.description: A Muay Thai fighting game: battle opponents starting from a cliff ledge above the home village and onward through the jungle to tougher bouts.
c64:6501.title: Bangkok Knights

c64:6502.description: Hacking into a system once again leads to saving the world: guide remote units through a guarded complex, watching security camera feeds and fooling the guards with replayed footage, to recover the Doomsday Papers.
c64:6502.title: Hacker II: The Doomsday Papers

c64:6503.description: From the cockpit of an RAF Mosquito, attack trains, intercept V-1 flying bombs, sink U-boats and shoot down German bombers.
c64:6503.title: Ace of Aces

c64:6506.description: Brought back from death by Zeus to save Athena, his daughter, a warrior fights undead and demons across Greek-themed levels, collecting power orbs to transform into beasts before facing Neff.
c64:6506.title: Altered Beast

c64:6507.description: On the radiation-mutated colony Terra-12, a small android battles the giant alien Governors that invaded and wiped out the human survivors.
c64:6507.title: Atomic Robo-Kid

c64:6508.description: Bounce an energy ball off the Vaus paddle to break through 33 screens of bricks, catching capsules that power up the craft.
c64:6508.title: Arkanoid

c64:6510.description: A small green creature must topple eight towers that are poisoning planetary water supplies, circling up their outside walkways to the summit while the tower rotates around him.
c64:6510.title: Tower Toppler

c64:6512.description: Comic Viking games: pick one of four barbarians and compete in violent events such as beer drinking, cat throwing, tug of war, rock rolling and tower jumping.
c64:6512.title: Blood 'n Guts

c64:6513.description: Shoot a centipede winding down through a mushroom field; hits leave mushrooms behind, and striking a middle segment splits it into two separate creatures.
c64:6513.title: Centipede

c64:6514.description: Fly the R-9a Arrowhead fighter in the 22nd century against the alien Bydo Empire through horizontally scrolling stages, backed by the detachable Force pod.
c64:6514.title: R-Type

c64:6515.description: Long after a nuclear war wiped out the old civilization, a tribal warrior seeks out the ancient Antiriad battlesuit, an armor immune to radiation and conventional weapons, to fight invaders.
c64:6515.title: Rad Warrior

c64:6516.description: Oolong fights a series of martial-arts masters one-on-one to become Grand Master of Kung-Fu and honor his late father, using punches and kicks.
c64:6516.title: Yie Ar Kung~Fu

c64:6520.description: Race a motorbike against the clock in a rear view similar to Hang-On, leaning through turns and weaving around other bikes, with three skill levels setting the time allowed.
c64:6520.title: Super Cycle

c64:6521.description: Eight Olympic events including track, swimming, diving, shooting and gymnastics, framed by an opening ceremony and medal presentations.
c64:6521.title: Summer Games

c64:6522.description: In the newly renamed Britannia, Lord British seeks a spiritual leader: travel the land mastering the eight virtues to become the Avatar.
c64:6522.title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar

aliases: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
c64:6523.description: Beginning where Zork I ended, in the Barrow, armed with a brass lantern and elvish sword, the adventurer explores more of the underground empire and contends with the senile, exiled Wizard of Frobozz.
c64:6523.title: Zork II

c64:6524.description: Tom-Tom the caveboy sets out to rescue his girlfriend Tanya from a monster, running across seven areas of four rounds each through forests, oceans, caves and ice palaces.
c64:6524.title: Wonder Boy

c64:6525.description: All ten decathlon events over two days, from the 100 metres to the 1500 metres; missing the qualifying mark in an event costs one of three lives.
c64:6525.title: Daley Thompson's Decathlon

c64:6526.description: Stranded on Targ after a crash landing, find a way off the planet in open-ended 3D, playing the native Palyars and invading Mechanoids against each other, with several routes to escape.
c64:6526.title: Mercenary

c64:6527.description: Dizzy explores the fairy-tale-inspired Magicland to free six friends trapped under magic spells.
c64:6527.title: Magicland Dizzy

c64:6528.description: Fly a Navy jet fighter in vector-graphics dogfights, defending a carrier task force from incoming bandits with guns and missiles.
c64:6528.title: Top Gun

c64:6529.description: Roll a marble down six isometric, maze-like courses against the clock, avoiding drops and hazards.
c64:6529.title: Marble Madness

aliases: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: The Arcade Game
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: The Ilearth Stone
Masters of the Universe: The Ilearth Stone
c64:6530.description: Skeletor has seized the Ilearth Stone, taken Castle Grayskull and kidnapped the Sorceress; He-Man first frees Orko from a spell by gathering ingredients, then battles Skeletor's horde.
c64:6530.title: Masters of the Universe: The Arcade Game

c64:6531.description: Sequel to Crazy Comets: shoot growing planets and moons before they smash into the ship, with two-player co-op and Rob Hubbard music.
c64:6531.title: Mega-Apocalypse

c64:6532.description: The runner sprints automatically through 32 futuristic courses against a time limit; steer sideways and adjust speed to dodge obstacles and grab items.
c64:6532.title: Metro Cross

c64:6533.description: A commando battles the Commissar's forces to save his kidnapped family, including a scientist grandfather forced to build a world-conquering weapon.
c64:6533.title: Midnight Resistance

c64:6534.description: Panama Joe explores the underground rooms of Montezuma's Aztec temple, collecting jewels and keys to unlock doors while avoiding enemies and traps.
c64:6534.title: Montezuma's Revenge

c64:6535.description: Patrol the moon in an all-terrain buggy, jumping craters and boulders while shooting bomb-dropping flying saucers, in the style of Moon Patrol.
c64:6535.title: Moon Buggy (Anirog Software)

c64:6536.description: Michael Jackson sets out to rescue kidnapped children, including Katy, from the villain Mr. Big and his gang.
c64:6536.title: Michael Jackson: Moonwalker

c64:6537.description: Eat every dot in the maze while avoiding ghosts; power pellets make them edible, and bonus fruit wanders through for extra points.
c64:6537.title: Ms. Pac-Man

c64:6539.description: Three action scenes from the film, starting with a Ghostbuster lowered by cable down a sewer shaft to collect slime samples while ghosts try to cut his line, followed by a Statue of Liberty march and a showdown in the museum.
c64:6539.title: Ghostbusters II

c64:6540.description: Arthur returns to save Princess Prin-Prin from the demon king Lucifer, battling through ghoul-infested levels in his suit of armor.
c64:6540.title: Ghouls 'n' Ghosts

c64:6542.description: A tube shooter: circle the rim of the screen, firing inward at alien formations in a Galaga-like game with a pseudo-3D perspective.
c64:6542.title: Gyruss

c64:6543.description: A futuristic cop alternates between driving down highways and side-scrolling building raids, gunning down thugs before time runs out.
c64:6543.title: Techno Cop

c64:6544.description: Several different action styles linked together, starting with a side-on brawler, with cutscenes from the film between levels.
c64:6544.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

c64:6545.description: Pilot an attack helicopter with guns and missiles against enemy tanks and helicopters, switching between overhead and behind-the-chopper views; bosses are fought top-down.
c64:6545.title: Thunder Blade

c64:6546.description: Professor Potts is flung back ten million years when terrorists bomb his lab, and must work through five time zones of five screens each in an adventure with action elements.
c64:6546.title: Time Machine

c64:6547.description: Douglas Quaid fights through levels of thugs on his way to Mars to learn why he is being hunted, with some stages switching to different play styles.
c64:6547.title: Total Recall

c64:6548.description: As Berk, carry out chores for the unseen Thing Upstairs, using objects around the castle and the creatures that crawl out of the trap door.
c64:6548.title: The Trap Door

c64:6549.description: Stranded on an island, Dizzy solves inventory puzzles to get hold of a boat and sail home to his friends and family.
c64:6549.title: Treasure Island Dizzy

c64:6550.description: Drive a Ferrari F40 with a girlfriend in the passenger seat from New York to Los Angeles, racing the clock and a rival in a Porsche 959.
c64:6550.title: Turbo Out Run

c64:6551.description: Following his late father's trail, a young explorer searches Africa for the fabled elephants' graveyard.
c64:6551.title: Tusker

c64:6552.description: The sole survivor of the attack on the ship Avalon 1, Bren McGuire dons the Turrican suit to take revenge on the Machine.
c64:6552.title: Turrican II: The Final Fight

c64:6553.description: A telepathic Synthoid absorbs and creates objects to climb checkered landscapes and overthrow the Sentinel on the highest point, moving only by transferring into robot shells it builds.
c64:6553.title: The Sentry

c64:6554.description: Ninja Joe Musashi crosses five missions to free children of the Oboro clan kidnapped by the crime syndicate Zeed, facing a boss at the end of each.
c64:6554.title: Shinobi

c64:6556.description: Bart Simpson thwarts a Space Mutant invasion of Springfield across five levels by collecting or removing items they need for their machine, such as spray-painting purple objects.
c64:6556.title: The Simpsons: Bart vs. the Space Mutants

c64:6557.description: Skateboarding contest with five events: freestyle ramp, high jump, a downhill race, the brawling downhill jam and pool joust.
c64:6557.title: Skate or Die

c64:6559.description: Fly the Skyfox fighter from the cockpit, armed with shields, laser cannons, guided and heat-seeking missiles, to repel an alien invasion across 15 scenarios.
c64:6559.title: Skyfox

c64:6560.description: In 2059, humans who fled the colony Orac are attacked again on planet Theon; fly a fighter in a vertically scrolling shooter against the alien fleet.
c64:6560.title: A.L.C.O.N.

c64:6561.description: Contestants on a violent game show fight from room to room through hordes of enemies, collecting weapons and prizes, before facing the host.
c64:6561.title: Smash T.V.

c64:6562.description: Dizzy reads aloud a powerful spell from Wizard Theo's carelessly left book and must rescue his friends scattered into a magical underground realm.
c64:6562.title: Spellbound Dizzy

c64:6563.description: As the gyroscope probe GERALD, map 385 isometric screens of Hangworld with limited fuel, navigating gaps and diagonal paths.
c64:6563.title: Spindizzy

aliases: MAD Magazine's Official Spy vs Spy
c64:6564.description: Based on the MAD magazine comic, the black and white spies race on a split screen to gather items such as the money, passport and secret plans before time runs out, booby-trapping rooms for each other.
c64:6564.title: Spy vs Spy

c64:6565.description: Strider Hiryu, youngest elite agent of a ninja-like organization, slashes through enemy forces with his cypher sword.
c64:6565.title: Strider

c64:6656.description: A ninja wielding the sword Righteous Cloud slashes in all directions across seven stages of woods, wastelands, swamps, temples and cliffs, with shuriken among extra weapons.
c64:6656.title: Ninja Spirit

c64:6657.description: Jellystone Park is closing and its animals face the zoo, so Yogi Bear makes a run for it.
c64:6657.title: Yogi's Great Escape

c64:6658.description: Race a motorcycle across four continents, each a difficulty level, beating checkpoint time limits while weaving around other riders.
c64:6658.title: Super Hang-On

c64:6659.description: One or two narcotics officers fight through eight stages, including a junkyard, subway and drug lab, to bring down Mr. Big's corporation.
c64:6659.title: NARC

c64:6660.description: A Gauntlet-like overhead adventure: the druid fights monsters with spells across eight levels to destroy four magic skulls.
c64:6660.title: Druid

c64:6661.description: A century after defeating Acamantor, the former druid Hasrinaxx returns to banish his old enemy in Gauntlet-style overhead combat.
c64:6661.title: Enlightenment

c64:6662.description: Eight more Olympic events, including cycling, rowing and fencing, for up to eight players.
c64:6662.title: Summer Games II

c64:6664.description: Play Mike, Neil, Vyvyan or Rick exploring the shared student house, picking up, breaking and fixing objects while the other housemates wander under computer control.
c64:6664.title: The Young Ones

c64:6665.description: The Deceptor switches between three forms to cross four isometric corridors and fulfill a destiny set by its elders.
c64:6665.title: Deceptor

c64:6666.description: One-on-one karate tournament where a single clean hit scores, after which both fighters reset to their starting marks.
c64:6666.title: World Karate Championship

c64:6667.description: A vertically scrolling shooter where I, Ball rescues four friends kidnapped by Terry Ball across 16 stages.
c64:6667.title: I, Ball

c64:6668.description: Pilot a fighter through a horizontally scrolling shooter to destroy an invading mothership, facing aliens, gun turrets, missiles and end-of-level bosses.
c64:6668.title: IO

c64:6669.description: Based on William Gibson's novel: Case wakes up broke in Chiba City, finds a deck and software, upgrades brain implants and hacks databases to get back into cyberspace.
c64:6669.title: Neuromancer

c64:6670.description: Pick a teenager and enter Freddy Krueger's house and his Nightmare World to rescue friends, using special dream powers against him.
c64:6670.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street

c64:6672.description: Fly an X-15 space-plane from runway takeoff through six stages, first within the atmosphere and then into orbit, to destroy a terrorist space station holding America to ransom.
c64:6672.title: X-15 Alpha Mission

c64:6673.description: Playing a Saxon knight, one of four to choose from, in a kingless medieval England, start with a single castle and fight the Normans for control of the land through raids, sieges and jousting tournaments, with Robin of Locksley offering aid.
c64:6673.title: Defender of the Crown

aliases: Infiltrator: The Game that Rocked America
c64:6674.description: Ace pilot and neurosurgeon Johnny McGibbits flies a helicopter behind enemy lines to strike at the Mad Leader, bluffing enemy choppers by radio and showing forged papers to camp guards, with sleeping gas for when the bluff fails.
c64:6674.title: Infiltrator

c64:6675.description: Pitfall Harry explores Andean caverns hunting the Raj diamond and searching for niece Rhonda and her cat Quickclaw, avoiding poisonous frogs, eels, scorpions and bats.
c64:6675.title: Pitfall II: Lost Caverns

c64:6676.description: Sail as a privateer, plundering towns, capturing and sinking ships, courting governors for titles and searching for lost relatives, aiming to retire with wealth, land, rank and a wife.
c64:6676.title: Sid Meier's Pirates!

c64:6677.description: Formula One racing against a computer or human rival, pulling into the pits to refuel and change tires that fade from black toward white as they wear and become fragile once fully white.
c64:6677.title: Pitstop II

c64:6678.description: Lead a squad of five US soldiers through scenes from the Vietnam film, switching between them as each one can take three hits.
c64:6678.title: Platoon

c64:6679.description: F-1 racing with a timed qualifying lap for grid position followed by the race, now across a choice of four tracks.
c64:6679.title: Pole Position II

c64:6681.description: With his unit already wiped out, Dutch fights through the jungle against scorpions and enemy soldiers in a side-scrolling platformer before confronting the Predator.
c64:6681.title: Predator

c64:6682.description: Race dune buggies on five courses of five stages each, from cities to deserts and tracks over water, choosing from 12 drivers.
c64:6682.title: Power Drift

c64:6683.description: LA Lieutenant Mike Harrington, caught up in a war between rival drug gangs, hunts the alien Predator in a crosshair shooter in the vein of Operation Wolf.
c64:6683.title: Predator 2

c64:6684.description: Pigs battle in an arena by throwing countdown bombs at each other, which go off on impact or when their timer reaches zero.
c64:6684.title: Psycho Pigs UXB

c64:6685.description: Sequel to Operation Wolf: terrorists hijack a Paris-to-Boston airliner, land it in Kalubya and hide the hostages, and soldiers shoot their way through to bring them home.
c64:6685.title: Operation Thunderbolt

c64:6686.description: Head-to-head air combat between generic modern fighters, with arcade-style sorties to shoot down the enemy aircraft.
c64:6686.title: ACE 2

c64:6687.description: Command six marines from a remote terminal, viewing their helmet cameras and firing their smart guns as they search a 255-room complex for the Alien Queen.
c64:6687.title: Aliens: The Computer Game (European Version)

c64:6689.description: DOH returns aboard the Xorg, a ship from another dimension, and the Vaus paddle must break through its walls of bricks to defeat him again.
c64:6689.title: Arkanoid II: Revenge of Doh

c64:6690.description: Fly an advanced tactical fighter shown from a third-person view as terrain scrolls beneath it, with a head-up display of thrust, speed, ground height, altitude and selected missiles.
c64:6690.title: ATF: Advanced Tactical Fighter

c64:6692.description: Marty McFly roams 1955 collecting clock icons while a fading family photograph tracks how close he is to erasing his own future.
c64:6692.title: Back to the Future

c64:6693.description: Five arcade and puzzle sections based on scenes from the film, as Marty McFly and Doc Brown journey across time to stop Biff altering the future.
c64:6693.title: Back to the Future Part II

c64:6694.description: Four arcade scenes from the film set in 1885, with Marty McFly and Doc Brown facing Mad Dog Tannen's gang while seeking a way back to the present.
c64:6694.title: Back to the Future Part III

c64:6695.description: A futuristic one-on-one ball sport in split-screen 3D: pilot a Rotofoil to grab a floating ball and shoot it through the opponent's goal, as Earth's first finalists in the year 3037.
c64:6695.title: Ballblazer

aliases: Barbarian II: The Dungeon of Drax
c64:6696.description: The barbarian returns, joined by the princess he once rescued, to hunt the wizard Drax through the tunnels of his dungeon, fighting monsters along the way; either hero can be played.
c64:6696.title: Axe of Rage

c64:6697.description: Five sections based on the 1989 film, opening with platform action in the chemical plant hunting Jack Napier, followed by a Batmobile escape from the Joker.
c64:6697.title: Batman

c64:6698.description: As fictional British flying ace Max Chatsworth, fly a biplane over diagonally scrolling terrain, bombing ground targets and dogfighting enemy planes.
c64:6698.title: Blue Max

c64:6699.description: Play Jake or Elwood across five platform levels, escaping through a prison, along a river and across the city, collecting missing records and throwing crates at foes.
c64:6699.title: The Blues Brothers

aliases: Boulder Dash II: La venganza de Rockford
c64:6701.description: More caves of diamond digging as Rockford, dodging tumbling boulders and the creatures of the caves, with later levels adding tougher puzzle elements.
c64:6701.title: Boulder Dash II: Rockford's Revenge

c64:6703.description: Marshal BraveStarr has nine minutes to find and rescue Shaman, captured by Tex Hex, starting in Fort Kerium where buildings can be entered.
c64:6703.title: BraveStarr

c64:6708.description: An action spin-off where Dizzy climbs from the seabed to the surface by hopping between short-lived bubbles and collecting pearls.
c64:6708.title: Bubble Dizzy

c64:6712.description: Choose among eight rough wrestlers, each with a distinct fighting style, and grapple for the championship.
c64:6712.title: Championship Wrestling

c64:6713.description: A three-part commando mission to rescue POWs from a guerilla outpost, beginning with a dinghy ride up a mined river.
c64:6713.title: Butcher Hill

c64:6715.description: As an undercover Chase HQ officer, drive after five criminals described in mission briefings, weaving through traffic and ramming their cars to make arrests.
c64:6715.title: Chase H.Q.

c64:6716.description: Chip must solve 149 tile-based puzzle levels, using keys and special shoes, to earn membership in Melinda's Bit Busters computer club.
c64:6716.title: Chip's Challenge

c64:6717.description: As Hen House Harry, collect a dozen eggs on each single-screen level of platforms, ladders and lifts, dodging ducks and grabbing corn to pause the timer.
c64:6717.title: Chuckie Egg

c64:6718.description: Caveman Chuck Rock sets out to rescue his wife Ophelia from the village oddball Gary Gritter, belly-bumping enemies and hauling boulders.
c64:6718.title: Chuck Rock

c64:6719.description: The secret agents of the Mortadelo y Filemon comics search an overhead city map to find Dr. Bakterius, kidnapped by the rival agency OMA.
c64:6719.title: Clever & Smart

c64:6720.description: Computer edition of the Waddington's board game supporting up to six players, using deduction to work out who killed Dr Black, in which room and with what weapon.
c64:6720.title: Cluedo

c64:6721.description: Seven military training events, starting with a side-scrolling obstacle course; failing one forces a round of chin-ups to stay in.
c64:6721.title: Boot Camp

c64:6724.description: Roll a ball along a tiled space track against a timer, shooting enemies, slipping through yellow walls whose doors open and close, and destroying Space Harrier-style dragons at the end of some levels.
c64:6724.title: Cosmic Causeway: Trailblazer II

c64:6725.description: Race across the US in a cross-country prestige car event, starting in a Porsche 911 Turbo and earning upgrades to a Lamborghini and a Ferrari.
c64:6725.title: Crazy Cars

c64:6727.description: Demons have kidnapped the nine children of Clyde Radcliffe and his partner Bonnie, and Clyde must save them from elaborate torture contraptions.
c64:6727.title: Creatures 2: Torture Trouble

c64:6728.description: Bentley Bear gathers every gem in a series of isometric castles to escape, while wandering creatures try to stop him.
c64:6728.title: Crystal Castles: Diamond Plateaus in Space

c64:6730.description: Elvira, restoring her inherited Castle Killbragant as a horror attraction, has accidentally revived an evil ancestor, and a hero must explore the castle to stop the witch.
c64:6730.title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark

c64:6731.description: A Liberty City police officer promoted to the ESWAT unit fights crime, eventually suiting up in cyber armor with thrusters, heavier weapons and better protection.
c64:6731.title: ESWAT

aliases: F-15 Strike Eagle: Air Combat in the Jet Age
c64:6732.description: Fly an F-15 through seven missions modeled on real operations in Asia and the Middle East, hitting air and ground targets with guns, missiles and bombs, with an arcade mode and three harder levels.
c64:6732.title: F-15 Strike Eagle

c64:6735.description: Lieutenant Arkos turns against the evil queen Gremla, whose army of Terminators rules five planetary confederations beyond Alpha Centauri.
c64:6735.title: Game Over

c64:6736.description: As a servant to the British Royal Family, complete five tasks: lighting all the fires, retrieving Prince Andrew's toy boat from the bath, finding Diana a wig and Fergie some freckles, plus a mystery job for the Queen.
c64:6736.title: Flunky

c64:6737.description: Galaga sequel where the ship can also move up to halfway up the screen, shooting swarms of insect-like aliens that dive at it.
c64:6737.title: Gaplus

c64:6738.description: Garfield sets out to get Arlene out of the cat pound, picking up objects and trading items with other characters from the comic.
c64:6738.title: Garfield: Big, Fat, Hairy Deal

aliases: Forbidden Forest: Der Wald von Demogaron
c64:6739.description: Lost in a dark forest at nightfall, an archer defends himself with bow and arrow against giant spiders and other monsters.
c64:6739.title: Forbidden Forest

c64:6741.description: Guide a spinning gyroscope down sloping isometric tracks full of hazards, in a game modeled on Marble Madness.
c64:6741.title: Gyroscope

c64:6742.description: Willy must tidy every room of his 60-plus-room mansion before his housekeeper lets him go to bed, avoiding spikes, razors and other hazards on routes with multiple entrances.
c64:6742.title: Jet Set Willy

aliases: The Last Ninja III: Real Hatred Is Timeless
c64:6743.description: Armakuni defends the Tibetan temples that feed his power against Shogun Kunitoki, across levels themed on Earth, Wind, Water, Fire and Void, earning Bushido by fighting honorably with matching weapons and never fleeing a duel.
c64:6743.title: Last Ninja 3

c64:6744.description: Golf across four 18-hole courses with sloped greens, using a power meter on the fire button and timing for hook or slice, for up to four players over four-round matches.
c64:6744.title: Leader Board: Pro Golf Simulator

aliases: James Bond 0007: Der Hauch Des Todes: Das Computer Spiel
James Bond 007: The Living Daylights: The Computer Game
c64:6745.description: Eight side-scrolling levels following the film, from a training mission in Gibraltar through General Koskov's defection to a final battle with an arms dealer.
c64:6745.title: James Bond 007 in The Living Daylights: The Computer Game

c64:6746.title: The Hunt for Red October: Based on the Movie

c64:6749.description: Dr Maybe has taken over Santa's North Pole workshop and holds its toy workers hostage; secret agent fish James Pond, now in a stretching robot suit, must free them.
c64:6749.title: James Pond 2: Codename RoboCod

c64:6750.description: Race a Lotus Esprit across 32 tracks in three difficulty levels, finishing in the top 8 against 15 rivals to progress; a better finish means a further-back start next time.
c64:6750.title: Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge

c64:6751.description: Assign skills to a stream of lemmings so they get past chasms, walls, water, lava and traps from the entrance to the exit, across four difficulty levels.
c64:6751.title: Lemmings

c64:6753.description: Toddler Jack lands in the Australian jungle and makes mischief across 192 platform screens, lobbing coconuts at snakes, monkeys and birds.
c64:6753.title: Jack the Nipper... II in Coconut Capers

c64:6755.description: Mission-based platform game where RoboCop must destroy targets such as nukes or clear out enemies; falling short sends him to a first-person shooting range for training.
c64:6755.title: RoboCop 2

c64:6756.description: RoboCop patrols side-scrolling streets, punching and shooting criminals and picking up their weapons, with levels following the 1987 film.
c64:6756.title: RoboCop

c64:6757.description: Opens with an Operation Wolf-style shooting gallery, then switches to side-scrolling platform levels against Splatterpunks, Rehabs, Otomo Ninjabots, a tank and ED-209.
c64:6757.title: RoboCop 3

aliases: Star Wars: Die Rückkehr der Jedi-Ritter
c64:6758.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi

c64:6759.description: Based on Tom Clancy's novel: command a NATO attack submarine as the Soviet Union, desperate for oil, invades Europe and NATO races to protect reinforcement convoys from the US.
c64:6759.title: Red Storm Rising

c64:6760.description: Equipped with a matter converter and gyro laser, Strider battles across rooftops, underground colonies, a ruined city and woodland to reach the prison ship holding Magenta's leader.
c64:6760.title: Strider II

c64:6761.description: Fly a jet up a vertically scrolling river to bomb enemy bridges, shooting ships, choppers, balloons and planes and passing over fuel depots to refuel.
c64:6761.title: River Raid

c64:6762.description: Two droids race along a long hilly road shooting out the side barriers while avoiding the resulting gaps, and can cooperate or shove each other in.
c64:6762.title: Roadwars

c64:6763.description: Pilot a Valkyrie fighter from the cockpit through the fractal mountains of a fog-shrouded alien world, landing to pick up downed Ethercorps pilots, though some figures at the hatch are disguised aliens.
c64:6763.title: Rescue on Fractalus!

c64:6764.description: As Road Runner, sprint down the road eating birdseed to keep up strength, dodging trucks, mines and falling rocks while luring Wile E. Coyote into them.
c64:6764.title: Road Runner

c64:6766.description: The Ghostbusters fight through a haunted city, blasting ghosts, ghouls and mad monks, capturing the spooks and collecting keys.
c64:6766.title: The Real Ghostbusters

c64:6773.description: Seven levels in two parts: drive a jeep or helicopter across hostile terrain in the first four, then continue on foot as a soldier shooting enemies in the last three.
c64:6773.title: Army Moves

c64:6774.description: Wake up in an asylum cell with a credit card in a box on the bed and try to escape the building, solving problems with found objects and meeting other inmates.
c64:6774.title: Asylum

c64:6775.description: Monty Mole tours Europe collecting money to buy the Greek island of Montos and retire, across flick-screen platform levels including the Pyrenees and the Eiffel Tower.
c64:6775.title: Auf Wiedersehen Monty

c64:6776.description: A cat runs obstacle courses of rising difficulty through the city park, inner city, underground sewer and a bowling pub.
c64:6776.title: Street Cat

aliases: Aztec Challenge: Die Rituale der Azteken
c64:6777.description: Sentenced to sacrifice in the Aztec capital in 1500 AD, run an obstacle course to the temple and through it, dodging a variety of deadly obstacles.
c64:6777.title: Aztec Challenge

c64:6781.description: Bazooka Bill fights through five levels of soldiers and bombing choppers to rescue the kidnapped General MacArthur, mostly with his fists but also with knives, machine guns and flamethrowers.
c64:6781.title: Bazooka Bill

aliases: B.C.'s Quest for Tires II: Grog's Revenge
c64:6782.description: Caveman Thor rides a stone unicycle through mountains in search of the Meaning of Life, collecting clams to pay Peter's toll to reach the next mountain.
c64:6782.title: B.C. II: Grog's Revenge

c64:6783.description: A Ghosts 'n Goblins-style platformer with nine lives across three large levels, throwing daggers at monsters and facing a boss at the end of each.
c64:6783.title: Beyond the Ice Palace

c64:6784.description: Bomb Jack hops between ledges in the four compass directions rather than flying freely, pushing enemies off at a cost in energy.
c64:6784.title: Bomb Jack II

c64:6785.description: Roll Bobby Bearing through isometric Metaplanes to find his four lost brothers and a cousin, nudging the unconscious bearings to safety before time runs out while avoiding evil Bearings.
c64:6785.title: Bobby Bearing

c64:6786.description: Fly a rescue helicopter behind enemy lines to carry as many as 16 hostages on each level back to safety while tanks and aircraft attack.
c64:6786.title: Choplifter!

c64:6787.description: The Cybernoid craft returns to recover cargo stolen by pirate ships in a flip-screen shooter, with weapons including sideways guns, bouncing bombs and seeker smart bombs.
c64:6787.title: Cybernoid II: The Revenge

c64:6788.description: A 32-level horizontally scrolling shooter set in the Delta region, where the Hsiffan Khanate holds sway, with waves of enemy formations.
c64:6788.title: Delta Patrol

c64:6911.description: Dan Dare flies the Anastasia to a hollowed-out asteroid from which the Mekon threatens to destroy Earth unless he is given rule over the galaxy.
c64:6911.title: Dan Dare: Pilot of the Future

c64:6912.description: Aboard the Mekon's new spaceship, Dan Dare must find and disable control boxes to stop the genetically engineered SuperTreens.
c64:6912.title: Dan Dare II: Mekon's Revenge

c64:6913.description: Based on Anne McCaffrey's novels, one to four players lead Weyrs, negotiating alliances with Lord Holders and fighting Thread from dragonback.
c64:6913.title: Dragonriders of Pern

c64:6916.description: The last member of the Time Corps travels to Ancient Greece, the Dark Ages and a space era to defeat a primeval entity summoned by a fanatical sect.
c64:6916.title: Hysteria

c64:6917.description: Miner Willy collects the flashing items in each of 20 caverns before his air runs out, then reaches the exit portal, avoiding poisonous pansies and other enemies.
c64:6917.title: Manic Miner

c64:6918.description: Drive an armed car through 50 rallies, blasting enemy vehicles and collecting fuel; crashes cost fuel, and an empty tank ends the game.
c64:6918.title: Road Blasters

c64:6919.description: Rambo advances up the screen through six zones with a machine gun and a limited supply of explosive arrows, meeting a boss at the end.
c64:6919.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

c64:6920.description: Mayor Mike Haggar and two allies fight through the streets of Metro City to rescue his daughter Jessica from the Mad Gear gang.
c64:6920.title: Final Fight

c64:6921.description: Giant knights, one or two at once, smash buildings in a medieval Rampage clone.
c64:6921.title: Ramparts

c64:6924.description: Four stages of alien combat, starting behind a protective shield and then losing it as enemies swoop in.
c64:6924.title: Gorf

c64:7062.description: Rambo infiltrates Soviet-occupied Afghanistan in three parts loosely following the film to rescue the kidnapped Colonel Trautman.
c64:7062.title: Rambo III

c64:7126.description: On the polluted planet Tantris, a hopping heat probe called the Leg throws its Ball to soak up the heat of smog flames and feed it to three precious plants. Shoot wildlife, use chalk to shield against acid rain, and build the pass counter to reach the next jungle.
c64:7126.title: Heatseeker

c64:7127.description: With his girlfriend beamed into the future and himself thrown into prehistory, the hero brawls through scrolling stages set in eras from prehistoric to Egyptian, medieval and futuristic times.
c64:7127.title: Renegade III: The Final Chapter

c64:7128.description: Guide Henry through the rooms of his house, each a single-screen level of deadly household objects like toothbrushes, teapots, flying toast and coffee machines, avoiding long falls.
c64:7128.title: Henry's House

c64:7129.description: The springy Thing bounces into the Goblin's four-level underground lair to free the captured neighborhood toys, collecting nine jigsaw pieces per floor.
c64:7129.title: Thing on a Spring

c64:7130.description: In a void where indestructible worker cells build cities brick by brick, blast through the bricks to collect enough star cells to reach the next level.
c64:7130.title: Hunter's Moon

c64:7131.description: Six events taken in sequence: archery, swimming, skeet shooting, gymnastics, weightlifting and the triple jump, each needing a qualifying effort to move on.
c64:7131.title: Hyper Sports

c64:7132.description: Rescue Penelope from cannibals across four repeating stages, starting with swinging between jungle vines, then swimming past crocodiles and dodging rolling boulders.
c64:7132.title: Jungle Hunt

c64:7133.description: Fire-breathing former circus strongman Karnov treks through nine levels hunting treasure, battling sword-wielding monks, djinn, hopping fish and skeletons riding ostriches.
c64:7133.title: Karnov

c64:7134.description: Back from training under a karate master to find the village burned and his bride-to-be seized by the warlord Akuma, the hero fights his way into Akuma's fortress to free her.
c64:7134.title: Karateka

c64:7191.description: A left-to-right shooter on a split display, an overhead view up top and a side view below, where flying nearer the screen's center increases scrolling speed.
c64:7191.title: Sanxion

c64:7314.description: Konami's table tennis conversion: rally against the computer across nine skill levels, playing to 10 points with a two-point lead. Scoring rewards long rallies and wide winning margins.
c64:7314.title: Ping Pong

c64:7318.description: In 2066, investigate the silent research ship Prometheus, where a genetic experiment to breed hardy miners went wrong, fighting monsters, piecing together what happened and trying to save a survivor.
c64:7318.title: Project Firestart

c64:7320.description: Fly an American stealth fighter against Warsaw Pact defenses, slipping past radar and enemy fighters to hit primary and secondary targets before returning to base, with promotions up to general.
c64:7320.title: Project Stealth Fighter

c64:7328.description: Hop diagonally down a pyramid of cubes, changing each one's color on landing until the whole pyramid matches the target, while avoiding Coily the snake and bouncing balls.
c64:7328.title: Q*bert

c64:7335.description: Roll an eyeball through a series of timed mazes, collecting keys and solving each maze's puzzles to reach the exit.
c64:7335.title: Mind-Roll

c64:7383.description: Hack through five levels to save the land of Lograth, fighting flying demons, chimeras, valkyries and skeletons with axes, maces and other weapons, with a boss at each level's end.
c64:7383.title: Rastan

c64:7384.description: Bounce a tennis ball over a scrolling grid of tiles to gather all 16 smart bombs, avoiding sand, spikes, traps and enemies, while question-mark tiles may help or hinder.
c64:7384.title: Re-Bounder

c64:7385.description: Brawl through the streets, subway and docks of Brooklyn to rescue a kidnapped girlfriend, using punches, kicks, headbutts and flying kicks across five levels.
c64:7385.title: Renegade

c64:7386.description: The top agent of the secret police force Rolling Thunder starts with only a handgun, working through guarded corridors and hidden passages to rescue captured agent Leila and stop a plot to rule the world.
c64:7386.title: Rolling Thunder

c64:7387.description: As Roy Race, track down the kidnapped Melchester Rovers squad in an adventure section, then play a charity match where the number of players recovered sets the size of the team.
c64:7387.title: Roy of the Rovers

c64:7388.description: Rising from the grave, the warrior Rygar crosses the land of Argool with his Diskarmor shield on a chain to defeat the evil Ligar.
c64:7388.title: Rygar

c64:7389.description: Lee, trapped in a temple by the Triads, fights his way out across scrolling multi-level stages, jumping between floors and collecting energy balls released by defeated foes.
c64:7389.title: Shao-Lin's Road

c64:7519.description: Manage and play for Brutal Deluxe, the worst team in the violent future sport of Speedball, climbing a two-division league and competing in two cup tournaments.
c64:7519.title: Speedball 2: Brutal Deluxe

c64:7520.description: On an iceberg the spies hunt for a gyroscope, fuel canister and key card to escape by rocket before a blizzard hits, trapping each other with saws, dynamite plungers and ice picks.
c64:7520.title: Spy vs Spy III: Arctic Antics

c64:7526.description: Rescue the fairies captured by the wicked queen Badh by touching them across levels of platform adventure, avoiding Venus flytraps, acid rain and dragons.
c64:7526.title: Stormlord

c64:7531.description: Mr. Big holds the hero's brother at Big's Pig Pen across town, and every gang in the city stands in the way; start with bare fists and pick up weapons on the way.
c64:7531.title: Target: Renegade

c64:7543.description: Lee Wong fights through horizontally scrolling levels with high ledges to save kidnapped village children from the villain Ryo Ken Oh, finding better weapons in magic urns.
c64:7543.title: Tiger Road

c64:7554.description: Biff and Jet race down river rapids on inner tubes, steering clear of the banks, crocodiles, logs and fishermen, with a supply of tin cans to throw.
c64:7554.title: Toobin'

c64:7584.description: Based on two Tintin comic books, a multi-stage action game about getting Tintin and his friends to the Moon, alternating rocket flight through space with stages inside the ship tackling fires and a saboteur.
c64:7584.title: Tintin on the Moon

c64:7614.description: The Dark Forces return after generations of peace, and a USS Freedom Forces soldier fights through large levels hunting secrets, upgrading three different weapon types.
c64:7614.title: Turrican III: Return of Darkness

c64:7616.description: Matt Trakker drives the transforming Thunderhawk through four areas, dodging V.E.N.O.M. tanks while completing tasks in order, such as assembling a four-part security key so a scanner can lead him to a captured agent.
c64:7616.title: MASK

c64:7618.description: Third MASK game: a side-scrolling shooter in which Matt Trakker battles the criminal V.E.N.O.M. organization to rescue his kidnapped son Scott.
c64:7618.title: VENOM Strikes Back

c64:7753.description: Drive a Lotus Esprit police car through a city to break up a drug ring, using the in-car map to track the baron's vehicles and waiting until the deal is done before moving in.
c64:7753.title: Turbo Esprit

aliases: James Bond 007: A View to a Kill
c64:7755.description: As James Bond, foil Max Zorin's plan to wipe out Silicon Valley, chasing Mayday through Paris as she parachutes away, then heading to San Francisco City Hall and an abandoned mine.
c64:7755.title: A View to a Kill: The Computer Game

c64:7758.description: A warrior trapped in a dungeon shoots creatures roaming its maze corridors, some of which turn invisible, in a top-down arcade shooter.
c64:7758.title: Wizard of Wor

c64:7760.description: Tabloid writer Zak McKracken teams up with scientist Annie and Yale students Melissa and Leslie to stop the alien Caponians, hidden inside the phone company, from dumbing down humanity.
c64:7760.title: Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders

c64:7762.description: The nameless adventurer is cast into a deep dungeon to face a final test, exploring and solving puzzles to prove worthy of becoming the Dungeon Master.
c64:7762.title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master

c64:8092.description: Two jet-pack soldiers, the Nameless Ones, fly around scrolling stages blasting alien invaders, rotating an orbiting satellite gun to aim.
c64:8092.title: Forgotten Worlds

c64:90295.description: Two-on-two beach volleyball playing Randy Stoklos and Sinjin Smith, with practice, match play and a tournament across Waikiki, Rio de Janeiro, San Diego, Chicago and Australia.
c64:90295.title: Kings of the Beach: Professional Beach Volleyball

c64:90296.description: Race BMX bikes around seven overhead tracks against a second player or the computer, beating a time limit, with slow-motion replays after each race.
c64:90296.title: BMX Simulator

c64:90297.description: Konami's scrolling action game: escaped convicts hold the prison warden hostage, and a police officer fights through city streets, a park and a bridge to the jail. Freeing hostages earns extra weapons, including tear gas, but shooting one costs you all your arms.
c64:90297.title: Jail Break

c64:90298.description: As sheriff of the frontier town Gold Gulch, talk with townsfolk and gunslingers by choosing dialogue responses, deciding when words fail and it is time to draw.
c64:90298.title: Law of the West

c64:90299.description: Returning home to find the family castle in ruins and an evil uncle raising an army, rally the people, enter archery contests, visit taverns and duel knights to build a force of your own.
c64:90299.title: Iron Lord

c64:90300.description: Lone Rider never leaves the saddle in this side-scrolling western, riding both ways across prairie and towns, shooting bandits, jumping obstacles and ducking incoming fire, and losing points for hitting townsfolk.
c64:90300.title: Outlaws

c64:90326.description: A sequel to Velnor's Lair: Grako has slipped back from the Abyss and seized a source of power, and the hero must defeat him in this text adventure with graphics.
c64:90326.title: Kentilla

c64:90334.description: Tend four bars, sliding drinks to advancing customers and catching empty mugs; anyone who reaches the bartender throws him out.
c64:90334.title: Tapper

c64:90382.description: Ride Gandalf on his white horse against an endless stream of Nazgul, blasting the black riders with lightning bolts while avoiding contact.
c64:90382.title: Shadowfax

c64:90383.description: Smiffy, trapped in an Orwellian world run by a Central Computer, sets out to switch it off.
c64:90383.title: 1994 (Ten Years After)

c64:90384.description: Guide an aardvark's tongue through an underground maze to eat food, dodging worms, stinging ants and spiders.
c64:90384.title: Ardy

c64:90392.description: Text adventure: explore the land to rescue a maiden abducted by the Demon Knight, collecting objects, defeating foes and solving puzzles.
c64:90392.title: Demon Knight

c64:90402.description: Choose Buzz, Ty or Kato and brawl against digitized fighters for bonuses and prize purses, with a grudge match every third bout.
c64:90402.title: Pit-Fighter

c64:90420.description: Centipede-style shooter on a grid: blast zigzagging chains of pods, whose dead segments become obstacles and split the chain in two.
c64:90420.title: Gridrunner

c64:90422.description: Steer a motorboat through hazards while the water-skier behind it swings on a different line, making narrow gaps treacherous.
c64:90422.title: Aquaplane

c64:90425.description: Avalon Hill's American football board game on computer: pick teams from the 1966 Packers to the 1982 Redskins and call offensive and defensive formations each down.
c64:90425.title: Computer Football Strategy

c64:90426.description: NFL strategy simulation with semi-pro and pro playbooks (18 or 36 offensive and 14 or 24 defensive plays) and a mode against the computer team, The Robots.
c64:90426.title: Computer Quarterback

c64:90431.description: Text adventure closing Level 9's Middle Earth trilogy: hunt for magical treasures in the defeated Demon Lord's fortress across over 200 locations.
c64:90431.title: Dungeon Adventure

c64:90441.description: Australian-themed events including boomerang throwing, a bellywack contest, Aussie Rules punting, a dry boat race and a skeet shoot at beer cans tossed from a moving ute.
c64:90441.title: Aussie Games: Six Wacky Games from Down Under!

c64:90459.description: Text adventure with graphics where an explorer treks through the Amazon jungle in search of a lost Aztec tomb; finding it ends the game.
c64:90459.title: Aztec Tomb Adventure

c64:90460.description: Defend Earth from invaders in a first-person 3D tank, hunting enemy tanks and planes across a wireframe battlefield.
c64:90460.title: Battlezone

c64:90462.description: Based on the original mainframe adventure: rescue the elves and gather fifteen treasures, managing lamp batteries in dark caves and fighting dwarves with axes while carrying only four items.
c64:90462.title: Colossal Adventure

c64:90463.description: To break an energy embargo, steer a ship against gravity past falling meteors into one of four cosmic tunnels, fly through in a third-person view, then land on each asteroid to gather its energy bars, with every move draining fuel.
c64:90463.title: Cosmic Tunnels

c64:90469.description: Trapped inside a computer by a rogue 6502 processor, run through mazes collecting the exit key and the program disk while the MCP pursues.
c64:90469.title: Escape MCP

c64:90477.description: Hunt the Shadow through more than 120 rooms of his lair, shooting robot minions in a blend of Berzerk-style maze action and exploration.
c64:90477.title: Shamus

c64:90503.description: Drive a racing car up a vertically scrolling road for as many miles as possible, controlling speed up to 80mph and dodging other drivers and obstacles on three road types.
c64:90503.title: Motor Mania

c64:90504.description: Pinball simulation for one to four players with adjustable physics, including ball count, ball speed, table incline and bumper kick.
c64:90504.title: Night Mission Pinball

c64:90505.description: As Plaqueman, protect teeth from the plaque germ D.K. using a toothbrush loaded with fluoride toothpaste and dental floss, without touching the germ.
c64:90505.title: Tooth Invaders

c64:90506.description: A survivor of pirate-raided Corillian hunts the pirates across a galaxy map in a powerful starship.
c64:90506.title: 3D Time Trek

c64:90507.description: Three linked text adventures. As Dr. Alvin Nemesis, poisoned and dumped in a junkyard by opponents of android rights, you must build yourself an android body and transfer your mind into it, then escape past the traps of anti-android terrorists before the last transport leaves.
c64:90507.title: Alvin the Android

c64:90510.description: Tactical tank and mechanized infantry battles, played as strategy or arcade, commanding at company, platoon or squad level with over 70 historical tanks.
c64:90510.title: Combat Leader

c64:90511.description: Defuse terrorist bombs in caverns beneath an erupting volcano across nine platform levels before they detonate.
c64:90511.title: Crisis Mountain

c64:90521.description: A flying, shooting robot rescues children wandering each level of platforms, dropping through gaps between floors while dodging hopping aliens, demons and snakes.
c64:90521.title: Drol

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Forgotten Realms Vol. I: Pool of Radiance
c64:90528.description: Help New Phlan reclaim its monster-overrun districts on the Moonsea, leading a party through AD&D rules-based exploration and turn-based combat.
c64:90528.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Pool of Radiance

c64:90553.description: Command a submarine sinking ships above and below the surface with forward and upward torpedoes, restocking from a dolphin sent by the green supply ship.
c64:90553.title: Seafox

c64:90554.description: Defend Federation space in the starship FSS Demona, using shields, hyperspace and lasers against a horde of barbarian ships.
c64:90554.title: Shootout at the OK Galaxy

c64:90555.description: Climb a mountain past snakes, porcupines, an archer and falling eggs to grab a spear and hit the condor before it reaches the child below.
c64:90555.title: Aaargh! Condor

c64:90556.description: Illustrated text adventure: starting with a pocket of gold coins, recover the magic sword Myraglym through forests, swamps, a maze and cliffs.
c64:90556.title: The Blade of Blackpoole

c64:90557.description: Caesar guards the pantry, catching mice in his mouth and taking them over to the larder door before they eat the food.
c64:90557.title: Caesar the Cat

c64:90558.description: Statistical baseball strategy: manage pinch hitters, fielding positions, relievers and base runners for 28 major league teams, with custom team entry.
c64:90558.title: Computer Baseball

c64:90560.description: Space shooter with configurable rules, including terrain on or off, shots that ricochet off screen edges and four difficulty levels.
c64:90560.title: Cyclons 64

c64:90567.description: Pinball for one to four players modeled on the Black Knight table, with dual flippers, upper and lower playfields, multiball and a tilt mechanism.
c64:90567.title: David's Midnight Magic

c64:90619.description: Shoot Droid ships and their mines in an endless arena, as the last ship of each wave spirals in.
c64:90619.title: Omega Race

c64:90620.description: An underwater Pac-Man variant: the pakacuda fish eats smaller fish through a maze while fleeing octopuses.
c64:90620.title: Pakacuda

c64:90622.description: Sink enemy ships, especially fast PT boats, with four reloading torpedoes over a chosen game length of 1 to 9 minutes.
c64:90622.title: Sea Wolf

c64:90623.description: Guard a bridge against tank after tank, moving left and right and adjusting gun elevation to time shells as they cross.
c64:90623.title: 3D Tanx

c64:90624.description: Sequel to Colossal Adventure: a two-word text adventure in a Tolkien-flavored Middle Earth struck by crop failure, violent animals and a mysterious enemy.
c64:90624.title: Adventure Quest

c64:90625.description: Galaxians-style shooter where enemy ships scroll across the screen in waves over eight looping levels.
c64:90625.title: Arcadia 64

c64:90627.description: The Golden Baton has turned evil, bringing crop failure and sickness to the land, and the cure is to gather the scattered parts of the Arrow of Death. An illustrated text adventure.
c64:90627.title: Arrow of Death: Part 1

c64:90628.description: Holding every fragment of the Arrow of Death, the hero must locate the Fletcher who can put it together, in this illustrated text adventure.
c64:90628.title: Arrow of Death: Part 2

c64:90630.description: Type commands for altitude, course, radar and weapons to guide a B-1 bomber to its Soviet target past MiGs and SAMs.
c64:90630.title: B-1 Nuclear Bomber

c64:90631.description: Guard lunar base supplies from waves of bandits with a mobile laser and shields across 28 levels, earning a bonus ship every 5,000 points.
c64:90631.title: Bandits

c64:90632.description: Galaxian clone: move left and right shooting swooping bats while avoiding their shots and collisions.
c64:90632.title: Bat Attack

c64:90633.description: D-Day wargame: as Allied commander, secure Sword, Gold, Juno, Omaha and Utah beaches and push toward Cherbourg, Caen and St. Lo, or defend as the Germans.
c64:90633.title: Battle for Normandy

c64:90634.description: Find machine parts hidden in a maze of houses and assemble them per the blueprint to stop Ollie Org from catching Daisy.
c64:90634.title: Blueprint

c64:90635.description: Space Panic clone: dig holes for electrocuting Meanies, then bash them through before oxygen runs out.
c64:90635.title: Bonka

c64:90636.description: Regimental and brigade level Battle of the Bulge wargame, scoring victory points as the Germans by taking towns, exiting units and destroying American forces.
c64:90636.title: Breakthrough in the Ardennes

c64:90637.description: Paint every room of a building before time runs out without losing your brushes, choosing from eight painters for up to four players across six skill levels.
c64:90637.title: Bristles

c64:90639.description: Operational carrier warfare in 1942 between US and Japanese fleets, with scenarios for Midway, Coral Sea, the Eastern Solomons and Santa Cruz Islands.
c64:90639.title: Carrier Force

c64:90642.description: Donkey Kong-style climber: scale ladders to the top past barrels rolled by a giant ape to rescue a girlfriend.
c64:90642.title: Crazy Kong (Interceptor Software)

c64:90643.description: Play a movie monster, crawling, swimming or flying, managing health and appetite while destroying cities.
c64:90643.title: Crush, Crumble and Chomp!

c64:90662.description: Defender clone: fly a starcruiser over a side-scrolling alien world protecting ten colonists from a hostile neighbor planet.
c64:90662.title: Defender 64

c64:90663.description: A knight on a flying horse battles dragons across six stages, first jousting dragon eggs and the hatchlings that emerge, then flying through scrolling catacombs past spiders.
c64:90663.title: DragonsDen

c64:90752.description: Escape the dungeon within 60 minutes, past traps and guards, defeat the vizier and reach the princess.
c64:90752.title: Prince of Persia

c64:90753.description: As schoolboy Eric, steal his report card from the staff room safe by completing tasks around a school full of computer-controlled teachers and pupils.
c64:90753.title: Skool Daze

c64:90809.description: Follow-up to the Super Sprint coin-op: one or two drivers race top-down around eight fresh circuits, dodging hazards such as whirlwinds and oil slicks along the way.
c64:90809.title: Championship Sprint

c64:90927.description: As mayor of a brand-new town, zone land and lay down housing, roads, schools, factories and shops so citizens move in, find work and stay content.
c64:90927.title: SimCity

c64:90966.description: Pilot the Q10 Tankbuster across several war zones, strafing with a forward gun and dropping bombs on enemy aircraft, vehicles and installations; shooting a blue helicopter leaves behind a pickup icon.
c64:90966.title: Q10 Tankbuster

c64:91679.description: A pub darts simulation using traditional 501 rules over a best-of-three-sets match, either head to head or through a championship knockout against computer players drawn from a field of eight.

c64:91746.description: Taking cues from Rampage, play an ogre or a dragon smashing buildings across an island in search of an egg that grants super powers, wrecking each structure with horn or fiery attacks to find the right one.
c64:91746.title: AAARGH!

c64:91931.description: Three karate fighters share a beach arena, each racing to be first to six points; every two rounds a bonus stage has a fighter deflecting bouncing balls. Sold in Europe as IK+.
c64:91931.title: Chop N' Drop

c64:95420.description: Steer Gogo, a small friendly ghost, through 150 rooms of a haunted castle, gathering objects and keeping clear of evil forces on the way to rescuing a princess. Level codes let a later session resume where the last one ended.
c64:95420.title: GoGo the Ghost

c64:95421.title: Cuthbert Enters the Tombs of Doom

c64:95670.description: Bugaboo, a tiny yellow flea with very long legs, has tumbled through a crack into a deep cavern; time his jumps to bounce back up the cave walls and escape to the surface.
c64:95670.title: Booga-Boo (The Flea)

c64:95676.description: An arcade adventure in which control switches between Wally the handyman, his wife Wilma, and friends Tom the mechanic, Dick the plumber and Harry the electrician, each needed for different jobs around town.
c64:95676.title: Everyone's a Wally

c64:95710.description: Captain a merchant frigate trading between Barbary Coast ports to raise ransom money for Katherine, a daughter kidnapped by the pirate Bloodthroat.
c64:95710.title: Pirates of the Barbary Coast

c64:99113.description: Cactus Pete, outlaw with a $4000 bounty, rides his horse alongside moving trains, matching speed to grab the ladder and climb aboard for another robbery, all seen from an elevated side view.
c64:99113.title: Train Robbers

c64:99114.description: Fire the button to push puzzle pieces one at a time onto an empty board, then slide each into place to rebuild a hidden picture, guided by a small preview image.
c64:99114.title: Split Personalities

c64:99115.description: Careless tourists have littered Poconose National Park with cans, bottles and rubber balls, and a park ranger must patrol the grounds clearing up the mess.
c64:99115.title: Park Patrol

c64:local-00a0cd23a3.description: Golf for several players on the Fairport Country Club north course: pick a club and angle for each shot and track your score against par. A course creator builds 18-hole courses from 228 tile shapes, with trees, water, greens and sand traps, saved to disk.
c64:local-00a0cd23a3.title: Hole in One Golf

c64:local-0131202220.description: Perseus must make five crossings to reach a magic box and help Andromeda, but Neptune has set a giant octopus in his path. Move left and right with the keys to get past it.
c64:local-0131202220.title: Octopus

c64:local-01a9c01bb0.description: Illustrated Level 9 text adventure in three parts that retells Malory's Lancelot: beat the Black Knight, join the Round Table, and finally seek the Holy Grail, with companions such as Sir Bors who can be given orders through the parser.
c64:local-01a9c01bb0.title: Lancelot - Graphic Version

c64:local-0253bc072a.description: Timeworks spelling practice: set a difficulty from 1 to 10 and spell words from graded lists that run from short ones like 'cat' up to 'insurmountable', or type in your own word lists and save them to a data disk.
c64:local-0253bc072a.title: Spellbound

c64:local-02ca667774.description: Domark's conversion of Atari's isometric Return of the Jedi coin-op. Leia races a speeder bike through Endor's forests, Chewbacca pilots a stolen AT-ST, and the Millennium Falcon flies against TIE fighters and into the second Death Star.
c64:local-02ca667774.title: Return of the Jedi

c64:local-02e5bf40d5.description: Jump and run through caves to find the treasure chest on each screen, avoiding deadly skulls, bats, daggers and spikes as well as long falls, though water is safe. Keys make a level's walls vanish, and an editor lets you design and save your own caves.
c64:local-02e5bf40d5.title: Cave Raid

c64:local-02e64d6e47.description: A hidden passage in a London flat leads to Pirate's Isle in this Scott Adams two-word text adventure, where you build a seaworthy ship and win over a pirate and his parrot to recover Long John Silver's two lost treasures.
c64:local-02e64d6e47.title: Pirate Adventure

c64:local-043c9253b3.description: A freeware chess program for two people playing from their own homes, each move passing between their Commodore 64s over a modem and telephone line.
c64:local-043c9253b3.title: Tele-Chess

c64:local-044f6f7ffc.description: To lift a plague from your village, descend into the catacombs to find a sorcerer's potion formula and its ingredients, playing as the fighter Duke or the cunning Witch in an illustrated text adventure where some creatures talk and others must be fought.
c64:local-044f6f7ffc.title: The Catacombs

c64:local-04aa46fece.description: Backgammon against the computer: enter each move by the point to move from and the die to use, bear off when ready, and adjust the computer's aggression from 0 to 12.
c64:local-04aa46fece.title: Backgammon

c64:local-04e1267800.description: Moonboots the Lunar Explorer, stranded in Metropolis, must find and refuel his spaceship in this flick-screen platformer, turning into Zoid the Droid, Super Spy or the Mad Monk when carrying the right objects to reach areas closed to him.
c64:local-04e1267800.title: Metropolis

c64:local-057a55e5fc.description: System 3's karate contest: two fighters trade kicks, punches and flips in front of a referee, scoring half and full points as the bouts move between backdrops from around the world.
c64:local-057a55e5fc.title: International Karate 1 & 2

c64:local-05ff96f565.description: Ralph the dog watches over his sleepwalking master Lee, bridging gaps, fending off enemies and keeping him from falling into water so that he never wakes up, with dream bonus stages between the main levels.
c64:local-05ff96f565.title: Sleepwalker

c64:local-061b4c3d24.description: A grounded alien cruiser disguised as public toilets on Cleethorpes pier needs protecting: hover overhead stunning the people and dogs who come for the fleet's battle plans, now resembling toilet paper, while avoiding jets and an RSPCA helicopter.
c64:local-061b4c3d24.title: Kami-Kaze

c64:local-064206b5ed.description: Drug captured scientists and deliver them to the supercomputer The Big One, each unlocking one letter of its code, in a multi-directional scrolling overhead shooter where you can dive beneath surface layers or leave the ship on foot.
c64:local-064206b5ed.title: Parallax

c64:local-065e2282e8.description: Level 9's final text adventure, with pictures. Detective Alan Chance, killed when an undercover drugs operation was betrayed, returns as a ghost at his own funeral and has three nights to expose the traitor, clear his name and save his partner Sarah.
c64:local-065e2282e8.title: Scapeghost - Graphic

c64:local-06a79d8f37.description: Roll up a character at the innkeeper's, buy weapons and armor, then explore the temple's monster-filled dungeon levels room by room in a top-down view, with the manual's room descriptions filling in what the sparse graphics show.
c64:local-06a79d8f37.title: The Temple of Apshai

c64:local-077c9ed1c2.description: Illustrated and scored with music, this text adventure begins after Ereth, the evil Lord Death, has turned Carus's beloved royal family to stone, and a wandering traveler vows to find five scattered magic gems that will break the spell.
c64:local-077c9ed1c2.title: The Crystals of Carus

c64:local-07ea3511d7.description: Defend a nuclear reactor from kamikaze fighters with four joystick-aimed lasers that fire automatically, plus smart bombs on the fire button. The fighters speed up the more you destroy, with a bonus base and bomb at 60 points.
c64:local-07ea3511d7.title: Star Warrior

c64:local-07fe2926b5.description: Rule a barony in feudal England from 1156 in yearly turns, setting taxes and tolls, paying scutage to the king and managing your army, with a joust where you aim your lance before the year's battles, revolts and harvest are shown.
c64:local-07fe2926b5.title: Evil Crown

c64:local-08fe816016.description: A statistical boxing game: build boxers by rating their record, size, reach, best punch, stamina and killer instinct, then work the corner, telling your man to jab, go to the body or for the knockout, and patching cuts between rounds.
