c64:local-976fb89168.description: Plasma-eating invaders are draining a far-off planet of its air and water, so its council reawakens Robox, a steel-suited combat robot. Shoot your way through the planet's tunnels against a time limit per level: touching enemies or walls costs energy, any trap ends the game at once, and bonus rounds between stages upgrade your gear.
c64:local-976fb89168.title: Robox

c64:local-98603a9e73.description: Top-secret telex messages report which quadrant of space is under attack; fly to its aid and clear each quadrant of enemy ships before it is lost to them.
c64:local-98603a9e73.title: Star Force

c64:local-98691a8c96.description: Aleksi Eeben's shooters Greenrunner, a Gridrunner-style blaster with two-player mode and sampled speech, and Redrunner, its sequel with 100 freer-form levels, plus the Retroskoi+ two-oscillator synth.
c64:local-98691a8c96.title: Runners - Greenrunner, Redrunner, Retroskoi+

c64:local-999656c9c7.description: Second Scott Adams adventure: a secret passage in a London flat leads to Pirate's Isle, where you must build a seaworthy ship, win over a pirate and his parrot, and bring two of Long John Silver's treasures back home. Played with two-word commands.
c64:local-999656c9c7.title: Pirate Adventure

c64:local-99ee4f8162.description: Illustrated text adventure with music: as a mysterious Stranger from a world of flying men and thinking machines, free the four enchanted heroes of Karn and recover the realm's treasures. Characters cannot be talked with, but they can be given orders.
c64:local-99ee4f8162.title: The Heroes of Karn

c64:local-9a4859f0ea.description: Plain singles tennis under standard rules: move with the joystick, press fire to toss and serve, and hold the button while pushing a direction to aim and power each swing. A flashing line marks where to stand for the serve, and you can pick shirt colours and the computer's skill.
c64:local-9a4859f0ea.title: International Tennis

c64:local-9a5839f628.description: The code-breaking board game: guess the computer's hidden row of coloured pins, using the joystick to choose a colour and move between pin positions, and use the feedback after each try to narrow down the answer.
c64:local-9a5839f628.title: Master Mind

c64:local-9ad018d2f7.description: SAS crosshair shooter at an embassy held by terrorists. People pass behind the windows, and you shoot only those wearing the colour you are told belongs to the gunmen, reloading after six shots; hits earn promotion, while hitting a hostage costs a rank.
c64:local-9ad018d2f7.title: Who Dares Wins

c64:local-9b9e4a83cf.description: Oil business strategy for up to four companies, human or computer, buying and selling oilfields worldwide with goals from market leadership to total domination. Dirty tricks such as torching rival rigs are available, and short action scenes cover drilling, pipe-laying and firefighting.
c64:local-9b9e4a83cf.title: Black Gold

c64:local-9bc280b1c7.description: A first-person vector shooter: flying the Zarquon CAM III fighter, you enter the Deathscape grid, where the Sol Federation and Varg Empire settle disputes by duel, to stop the Varg mothership across ten increasingly twisted levels.
c64:local-9bc280b1c7.title: Deathscape - The Warzones of Terra

c64:local-9bed93eed0.description: Text adventure based on Douglas Adams' book and narrated by Eddie the computer, roaming from a quiet English village, its pub and the rubbish tip to the Heart of Gold, the Total Perspective Vortex and Milliways. Commands are one or two words, and the task is to collect certain objects and store them.
c64:local-9bed93eed0.title: The Hitch Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy

c64:local-9c5bb577df.description: A Psytronik action adventure: a space-suited explorer armed with a laser gun must cross a hostile alien planet to escape a grim fate.
c64:local-9c5bb577df.title: Escape from Arth Special Edition

c64:local-9cf223aafa.description: Benny the Ball stands to inherit a dead woman's fortune unless Top Cat finds the rightful heir. Across an alley, Beverly Hills streets and a mansion you round up the gang, drink milk to keep your energy up and avoid sour milk, rotten apples and skateboarders.
c64:local-9cf223aafa.title: Top Cat - Beverly Hills Cats

c64:local-9dc8172991.description: A nameless knight sets out to free a princess held by a dragon, breaking the lock on the castle gate, fending off magical guards and finally fighting the dragon itself.
c64:local-9dc8172991.title: Save Me Mr. Knight

c64:local-9e1d0a5009.description: You have trespassed into a forbidden garden where multicoloured man-eating weeds spread to surround you. Move with A, Z, comma and full stop to stay free as long as possible; the score reflects how long it takes the weeds to engulf you.
c64:local-9e1d0a5009.title: Intruder

c64:local-9fd65fb65f.description: Dominoes against the computer at three skill levels, from an easy opponent you should beat two games in three to a tough one that plays close to perfectly. The game tracks the boneyard, passes and the largest doublet, and keeps a tally of games won.
c64:local-9fd65fb65f.title: Dominoes

c64:local-a01d94c85a.description: A game construction kit: place the player and the aliens, decide whether your game is about jumping or shooting, set lives, how far the player may fall, alien movement patterns and animation speed, compose a tune from SID instrument presets such as trumpet, piano and guitar, and save the result to cassette.
c64:local-a01d94c85a.title: Banzai!

c64:local-a0362e0a09.description: Pilot a jet through space to clear a path for a following group of spaceships by destroying four death zones; each zone falls once its seven energy points are eliminated. Choose a starting zone and up to nine jets, each carrying 3,500 litres of fuel.
c64:local-a0362e0a09.title: Death Zone

c64:local-a0c533f8c2.description: Educational memory and word games: find where a pictured item was hidden among boxes, seek what is in a box, or spot what is missing, with plants, faces, creatures and vehicles as subjects. Four difficulty levels are offered, and the names can be read or spelled.
c64:local-a0c533f8c2.title: Hide and Seek

c64:local-a0e85a20b5.description: Airline management game from Commodore: start a small commercial airline just after the Second World War and try to keep it flying for forty years, choosing which planes to purchase or sell off, what fare per mile to charge and how to split capacity between passengers and cargo. Progress can be saved after every year of play.
c64:local-a0e85a20b5.title: High Flyer

c64:local-a1555912cf.description: As Egor, Baron Frankenstein's assistant, you have thirty minutes before the great electrical storm to gather corpses and equipment for his experiment. Flick-screen platforming where touching creatures fills a fear meter, and losing a life drops whatever item you carry.
c64:local-a1555912cf.title: Frankenstein

c64:local-a16664bf2f.description: A trivia quiz for several players with categories such as history and politics, geography, sports and games, movies, science and television, including music rounds where you name the composer or song. Players can keep score, and a winner is announced at the end.
c64:local-a16664bf2f.title: Trivia Challenge

c64:local-a19e74d454.description: SSI's second AD&D referee aid rolls up player and non-player characters, henchmen included, on printable character sheets, and generates treasure hoards, gems, jewelry and magic items, intelligent weapons among them.
c64:local-a19e74d454.title: Dungeon Masters Assistant Volume II - Characters and Treasures

c64:local-a2572cd90b.description: England, 1149: with the king dead, you play one of four Saxon lords fighting the Normans and rival Saxons. Raise armies and seize territory, win land in jousting tournaments, batter castles with a catapult, raid enemy keeps for loot and now and then rescue a damsel.
c64:local-a2572cd90b.title: Defender of crown

c64:local-a2d8fdfac1.description: Four-level arcade adventure following the film: armed with his whip and fists, Indy gathers a shield, his father's diary and the Cross of Coronado on the way to the Grail. Stages cover Colorado caves, a circus train, a Zeppelin and Castle Grunwald, each with several routes.
c64:local-a2d8fdfac1.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

c64:local-a479f25a80.description: The card memory game for one to four players: 52 cards are dealt face down, and each turn you flip two by typing their grid coordinates, scoring a point for a match. The player with most pairs wins once all cards are gone; solo play is practice without a score.
c64:local-a479f25a80.title: Concentration

c64:local-a58405e295.description: Epyx's wrestling game with a roster of eight invented grapplers, among them The Berserker, Purple Hays and Zeke Weasel, for one player against the computer or several friends taking each other on.
c64:local-a58405e295.title: champwrs

c64:local-a645487ffe.description: You step off a stagecoach into a small Arizona township after four days on the road, come to claim the mine your old friend Jake left you.
c64:local-a645487ffe.title: Prospector

c64:local-a6abfb0e32.description: Infocom's adaptation of Douglas Adams's comedy, co-written with Steve Meretzky. Arthur Dent wakes with a hangover as his house, then the Earth, is demolished, and escapes with Ford Prefect; survival depends on careful observation, talking to people and consulting the Guide.
c64:local-a6abfb0e32.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

c64:local-a74cdf9567.description: Geoff Crammond's Formula 3 simulator, an early racing game with realistic handling physics. Brands Hatch and Silverstone are reproduced in detail, and the driving foreshadows his later Formula One Grand Prix.
c64:local-a74cdf9567.title: Revs

c64:local-a777b0c306.description: Windham Classics adaptation of Stevenson's novel, written in the second person and closely following the plot as Jim Hawkins. Other characters double as a hint system, answering questions about almost anything, and the parser handles pronouns and chained commands.
c64:local-a777b0c306.title: Treasure Island

c64:local-a7dd46a583.description: Revision quiz for students preparing for O and A level physics exams: multiple-choice questions on units, scientists, laws and formulas are drawn at random and asked until you enter 0, after which your results are shown.
c64:local-a7dd46a583.title: Physics Test - 'O' and 'A' Level

c64:local-a8330d7345.description: Split-screen helicopter duel for one or two players set at an army flight school. Ferry supplies singly to your home pad, refuelling and rearming there, and shoot the rival chopper with a limited-ammo cannon; enough supplies become a bomb to drop on the enemy base.
c64:local-a8330d7345.title: Protector

c64:local-a8914f54b6.description: Football management game built around the World Cup: pick one of 32 national sides, train a 20-man squad and set tactics and style of play. Matches are reported in text, with substitutions and tactical changes possible during play and at half-time.
c64:local-a8914f54b6.title: International Football

c64:local-a93ce0926b.description: Light-gun shooting gallery made for the Magnum Light Phaser: hone your aim at a target range, on the plains against bandit cut-outs and in a saloon shoot-out. Unused ammunition earns a bonus once each stage is done.
c64:local-a93ce0926b.title: Gunslinger

c64:local-a9933fb5ba.description: Alligata's reworked follow-up to its withdrawn Commando-style shooter: a lone soldier with a gun and five grenades battles through eight enemy outposts, destroying vehicles and freeing prisoners before the firing squad gets them.
c64:local-a9933fb5ba.title: Who Dares Win2

c64:local-aa160a4de8.description: A quiz-machine game set in a pub: answer timed multiple-choice questions in four categories (sport, pop, showbiz and trivia) to climb a pyramid of cards, then try for play-money prizes in a second pyramid. Two extra question banks bring the total to 2,000.
c64:local-aa160a4de8.title: Pub Trivia

c64:local-aa6deb221f.description: German space trading game aboard the heavy cruiser Eagle Mk III: fly between planets of the Pegus system, scan for and mine gold, platinum and gemstones, sell them for credits, and buy better lasers, shields, missiles and hyperdrive gear while fighting off enemy ships.
c64:local-aa6deb221f.title: Spacefighter

c64:local-aa8a44d84d.description: Football tournament for one or more players: each picks a national team, with the computer running the rest, and plays through the quarter-finals and semi-finals to the World Cup final and the trophy.
c64:local-aa8a44d84d.title: World Cup Soccer

c64:local-ac31cddbbd.description: Two-word text adventure set in an evil castle. Cross the moat, get through the drawbridge and survive collapsing stairs, killer rats, a giant spider, a ghostly archer and a dungeon of skeletons to claim the treasure of the throne room.
c64:local-ac31cddbbd.title: Terror Castle

c64:local-ad03ad5ea2.description: Accolade card collection offering poker (draw, seven-card stud and hold'em), hearts and blackjack. Choose opponents from a cast of caricatured world leaders such as Gorbachev, Reagan and Thatcher, and play until one player holds all the money.
c64:local-ad03ad5ea2.title: Card Sharks

c64:local-ad5b9d4726.description: Isometric third Gauntlet for one or two players. Choose from eight heroes, the classic four plus newcomers such as a rock man and a lizard man, and fight through the kingdoms of Capra, smashing monster generators and carrying items between areas to open the way onward.
c64:local-ad5b9d4726.title: Gauntlet III - The Final Fight

c64:local-ae1d029f15.description: Career simulation taking a golfer from amateur to world number one. Juggle a bank balance, loans and sponsors, divide practice hours among shot types, choose major or minor tournaments, hire caddies, coaches and hotels, and even bet on rivals at the bookies.
c64:local-ae1d029f15.title: Championship Golf

c64:local-ae8e84f726.description: Based on the TV series about reptilian invaders: as resistance leader Mike Donovan you sneak through the Visitors' mothership, avoiding electrified robots, using teleport pads and alien security codes, and plant bombs at its key points.
c64:local-ae8e84f726.title: V The Game

c64:local-af4500cfa4.description: Shaun Southern's native C128-mode edition of the Kikstart motorbike trials game. Race a friend on a split screen or a computer rider over courses of ramps, fences, tyres and other obstacles, judging speed, wheelies and hops to avoid being thrown.
c64:local-af4500cfa4.title: Kikstart 128

c64:local-af71aa72c2.description: Asteroids-style shooter: flying a Federation ship assigned to clear the space lanes, rotate, thrust and fire to sweep asteroids, alien craft and shooting stars from three sectors per planet between Pluto and Mercury, then slip through a sliding gap into the waiting Factory Ship.
c64:local-af71aa72c2.title: Master Blaster

c64:local-af751bb58e.description: Fantasy graphic adventure with role-playing combat: travel past the forest and the mountains of Sirak to the fortress of the late King Ecreip III, now held by the red dragon Faldakrin and its Orcan guards. Commands are picked with an on-screen cursor, and fights can be fought, fled or bought off with gold.
c64:local-af751bb58e.title: Destiny

c64:local-af8c848d8e.description: Minesweeper in which you first set the field dimensions and the number of mines, then clear the field square by square with the cursor keys or a joystick.
c64:local-af8c848d8e.title: Minesweep

c64:local-b0321ea3ff.description: Kingsoft's sideways-scrolling space shooter by Fido Müller: steer your ship freely and blast or dodge the enemy formations flying in from the right, which never shoot back. Each stage ends with a points bonus rather than a boss, and later levels reuse the houses, pyramids and blocks of the backdrops in new colours.
c64:local-b0321ea3ff.title: Radius

c64:local-b04094b3fb.description: Released as Mountie Mick's Deathride: a tubby Mountie chases the McClusky gang along a gold train, the Trans-Canadian Express, working from the last carriage up to the engine. Ammo is scarce, so flatten outlaws by jumping on them while dodging bullets, grenades, moose, dark tunnels and gas leaks.
c64:local-b04094b3fb.title: Death Ride

c64:local-b08123b989.description: Two-player cricket from 1983 by Colin Doughty. Enter names for both teams, then take turns testing your batting skill against the bowler, swapping joysticks when the sides change over.
c64:local-b08123b989.title: Cricket

c64:local-b0aae2c8b1.description: Graham Relph's exploration game whose world is said to hold four billion locations. Fly over the terrain from above until a beacon points toward one of nine missing objects, then land and continue on foot in a panoramic view, occasionally shooting robot bugs.
c64:local-b0aae2c8b1.title: Explorer

c64:local-b14cd5a195.description: Onslaught's 2008 head-to-head strategy battle for two players: each steers a squad of units in real time, pressing fire to switch between them. Like units grouped together gain energy while unlike ones drain each other, fallen units leave harmful skulls, and the last player with units standing wins.
c64:local-b14cd5a195.title: Not Even Human - Original Edition

c64:local-b15767d94a.description: Computer version of the Bob Holness quiz show. Pick a hexagon marked with the first letter of its answer, buzz in and type a reply to claim it, aiming to link a path across the board; two players each get their own buzzer key.
c64:local-b15767d94a.title: Blockbusters

c64:local-b1686a24ab.description: Command a modern nuclear-powered submarine: study the map of enemy ship movements to plan an approach, rise to periscope depth to sight targets, and torpedo ships and helicopters tracked on radar while watching hull pressure, oxygen, battery charge and fuel. A training mode keeps enemy ships still.
c64:local-b1686a24ab.title: Atom U-Boat

c64:local-b1742ba679.description: A puzzle game in the vein of Bejeweled: press fire and push the joystick to flip coins sideways or vertically, lining them up so matching coins are taken for points. A normal mode resets the timer to 300 after each score, and a challenge mode is also offered.
c64:local-b1742ba679.title: Coins

c64:local-b1c6c1a112.description: Version of the TV game show: guess how many of 100 polled people answered yes to a question, and your opponent calls higher or lower. Winning a question gives control of a row of cards to play High-Low, leading to a Big Bucks round where winnings are bet.
c64:local-b1c6c1a112.title: Card Sharks

c64:local-b1dcce0652.description: Turn-based space conquest for several admirals, or solo against neutral worlds. Each turn is a year: launch fleets from your home world, which builds ten ships annually, to seize other planets with their own industry; orders are typed in secret, and whoever holds the most worlds at the end wins.
c64:local-b1dcce0652.title: Galactic Empire

c64:local-b2914e42d7.description: Joystick-controlled Yahtzee for several players. Each turn you roll five dice up to three times, keeping any you like, then point the hand at one of thirteen scoring boxes, from ones to sixes through straights, full house and chance.
c64:local-b2914e42d7.title: Yaht-Zee

c64:local-b321e18e4b.description: Magic Knight's second adventure: a botched spell has frozen eight people, including the wizard Gimbal, in time, and the Knight must free them. Its Windimation menus let you examine, use and give objects, and you must manage his strength as well as the rescued characters.
c64:local-b321e18e4b.title: Spellbound

c64:local-b32a25a29a.description: World conquest for two to four players in the spirit of Risk. Armies start scattered across a world map; reinforce territories, then attack neighbouring regions, with a brief animated battle deciding each clash, until one player holds every territory.
c64:local-b32a25a29a.title: Armageddon

c64:local-b4c5042d9d.description: You are the last animal in the world and must destroy humanity: collect every diamond in a human settlement to reach the next one, while avoiding the robots that guard them.
c64:local-b4c5042d9d.title: Zodiac

c64:local-b53eff2fd3.description: Fantasy role-playing quest: starting from Fel City you journey through the provinces, choosing a sword and spells such as teleport, healing and divination, and battle dragons, golems, vampire bats and other monsters while hunting for the magical Dragon's Eye.
c64:local-b53eff2fd3.title: The Dragon's Eye

c64:local-b54ba06ca4.description: Role-playing sequel set two years after Lord Marox and the Ormus were defeated: the black book Ulbore has exposed Sullivan and the Brotherhood of the White Rose, and you have about twelve months to finish nine tasks set by the servants of the gods and save the kingdom from Armageddon. Talking to villagers yields vital clues.
c64:local-b54ba06ca4.title: Ormus Saga, The II - Guild of Death

c64:local-b6adfad9f1.description: Aliens are poisoning the seas and turning marine life into monsters. Pilot an advanced submarine through a constantly scrolling side-on shooter, torpedoing mutated creatures before your damage gauge fills.
c64:local-b6adfad9f1.title: Aquanaut

c64:local-b7bf47074f.description: Pontoon for two, one acting as banker: bet on each hand and try to get as close to 21 as possible without busting. You may stick on 16 or more, a 14 on the first two cards lets you take two fresh ones, and five cards totalling 21 or less win outright.
c64:local-b7bf47074f.title: Pontoon

c64:local-b7fde4071f.description: Logic puzzle on nine numbered squares. Pressing the number of a lit square flips a fixed group of other squares, and the aim is to light every square except the centre one, number 5, by working out which presses affect which squares.
c64:local-b7fde4071f.title: Magic Square

c64:local-b82a4cef47.description: A lone laser-gunner battles aliens across five screens, starting from any of 21 levels: blast Plague Pests while dodging egg bombs, land five hits on an egg guarded by Robo Crabs before time runs out, hit a giant Robo Crab between its pincers, fly over an alien landscape destroying ships and bases, then down a landed Interceptor.
c64:local-b82a4cef47.title: Odyssey

c64:local-b8954d2acc.description: The Joker half of Batman: The Caped Crusader, titled A Fete Worse Than Death. Batman punches, kicks and throws batarangs at henchmen and solves item puzzles, with each location drawn as its own comic-book panel on the screen.
c64:local-b8954d2acc.title: Batman_Caped_Crusader

c64:local-ba3df3e1e8.description: The computer generates a small, medium or large maze, optionally letting you watch it being built, and you steer out of it as fast as you can using four direction keys.
c64:local-ba3df3e1e8.title: Maze

c64:local-bade727667.description: Text pontoon against the computer: aces count one or eleven, you cannot stick below 16 unless you hold a five-card trick, a hand over 21 is bust, and only a pontoon of an ace with a ten or court card beats a five-card trick.
c64:local-bade727667.title: Pontoon

c64:local-bb4238fb4b.description: Text adventure in which Jim Hawkins explores the island with items such as a compass, telescope, spade, musket and flasks, dealing with pirates who demand food, swig rum or knock you over the head on the way to the treasure.
c64:local-bb4238fb4b.title: Treasure Island

c64:local-bc192ad4c8.description: Dino Dini's top-down football game where the ball runs free of the players' feet, making control a skill to master. Practise without opponents, then play an eight-team league whose players vary in pace, stamina, accuracy and aggression, under one of a dozen referees.
c64:local-bc192ad4c8.title: Kick Off

c64:local-bcaed9fcdb.description: Isometric shooter in the Zaxxon mould, set in 2024: a madman has seized decommissioned cruise missiles, and you remotely fly an unmanned interceptor through walled passages, shooting missiles and tanks while watching your fuel.
c64:local-bcaed9fcdb.title: Havoc

c64:local-bdaf81a5e6.description: Newspaper-cartoon loafer Andy Capp has a week to find who stole his dole cheque and scrape up money for his wife Flo, wandering between pubs, the Job Centre and the police station, questioning locals and drinking while staying out of jail.
c64:local-bdaf81a5e6.title: Andy Capp - The Game

c64:local-bdb29f239d.description: Turn-based strategy game by James D. Spain: two futuristic fighters from opposing sides square off one on one inside a maze.
c64:local-bdb29f239d.title: Lazer Maze

c64:local-bdd0b562ae.description: Conversion of the Atari arcade shooter styled after 1950s B movies. One or two heroes shoot through isometric factory levels on Planet X, freeing hostages, throwing levers to work escalators and boosting their ray guns, then steer a small ship through an obstacle run between levels.
c64:local-bdd0b562ae.title: Escape from Planet of Robot Monsters

c64:local-be19c10b0f.description: Two-player artillery duel in which each side has three tanks at opposite ends of the map. Move your tanks, set the angle and power of each shot, and win by destroying all of the opposing tanks.
c64:local-be19c10b0f.title: Tanks

c64:local-bed142f95c.description: A high-speed race over eight levels: each lasts one minute, and when the clock reaches zero you move on to a faster level. Weave past the traffic on the course, because hitting another car ends the game.
c64:local-bed142f95c.title: For Speed We Need

c64:local-bf3183d7e0.description: Guide an electron around circuit boards, gaining power by passing certain electrical components so it can light every bulb on the level. An arrow points the way through the circuit.
c64:local-bf3183d7e0.title: Circuit

c64:local-bfa42cc378.description: Land a lunar module on the pad using Z and X to move sideways and F1 and F7 to rise and descend; touch down too fast and you crash, and miss the base entirely and the landing fails.
c64:local-bfa42cc378.title: Lunar Lander

c64:local-c06ffa34ba.description: Sierra's Targ-inspired shooter set on a grid of city blocks. Your craft moves and fires along the streets, stopping only at junctions, while aliens attack from the edges; ammunition is limited, so you must cross a reload marker when running low.
c64:local-c06ffa34ba.title: Crossfire

c64:local-c07297de9a.description: Activision's 1986 Transformers game: send Autobots across a map of nine key sites to meet Decepticon raids, then switch to a first-person view to shoot the invaders down before they steal the resources they need for their ultimate weapon.
c64:local-c07297de9a.title: Transformers - The Battle to Save the Earth

c64:local-c09c61b54a.description: Polish maze game crossing Bomberman with Pac-Man: collect every star on the board while Frix monsters roam. Bombs found in the maze kill enemies and break walls, some of which need several blasts, but blowing up a star costs a life. 123 levels.
c64:local-c09c61b54a.title: Bomb Mania

c64:local-c1f8c76cfd.description: Futuristic real-time strategy: lead a corporate mining operation on an asteroid heading for a collision with a moon and meet your crystal quota before impact. Buy and program survey craft, diggers, trucks and combat robots, solar or fusion powered, and fight a rival company run by the computer or a second player.
c64:local-c1f8c76cfd.title: The Corporation

c64:local-c3d112695c.description: Henrik Wening's take on Galaga: shoot formations of swooping aliens whose behaviour depends on their colour, some needing several hits, while large ships fire beams that narrow your space. Challenge stages give bonuses for kills.
c64:local-c3d112695c.title: Galaxy

c64:local-c474165d05.description: Revision aid for O-level chemistry. Multiple-choice questions on atomic structure, valency, bonding and compounds are drawn at random and keep coming until you answer 0, after which your score is shown.
c64:local-c474165d05.title: Chemistry Test - 'O' Level

c64:local-c4cbb82f48.description: Light-beam puzzle in the style of Deflektor: across 50 levels, rotate mirrors to steer a beam from start to finish, hitting enemies on the way. Barriers, switches and locked areas complicate the route, there is a time limit, and reflecting the beam back on itself causes overload.
c64:local-c4cbb82f48.title: Mindbender

c64:local-c5a92d9e67.description: Table football for two players, each working eleven figures on four rods. Control one rod at a time and spin it to strike the ball; teams change ends after four goals and play on until four more are scored.
c64:local-c5a92d9e67.title: Kick Off

c64:local-c63a295e28.description: Shooter set after contact is lost with the Blue Moon colony, whose scientists have mutated and turned their technology into weapons. Fly through seven two-part levels with boss opponents, upgrading shot strength, charging a beam with the fire button, and play alone or with a second player in team or timed modes.
c64:local-c63a295e28.title: Boom

c64:local-c6adc8a196.description: Psytronik's two-disk set of Alf Yngve's enhanced Cops shoot-'em-ups for one player or two in co-op. Two veteran officers take on gangs in a near-future merged Euro-City, terrorists seizing Greek holiday islands, a Christmas crime wave and a cult that frees a jailed pope; bonus games Death Row and Grunts are included.
c64:local-c6adc8a196.title: Ultimate Cops

c64:local-c6c970af8e.description: Contract bridge trainer built around a set of prepared deals. Pick a deal by number, follow the bidding to the contract, then play the hand yourself or watch the computer play it, with the option of showing all four hands.
c64:local-c6c970af8e.title: Bridge Master

c64:local-c761598bca.description: Text adventure in which you play a free-world spy sent to finish a botched assassination of the dictator of Gvench, who is recovering under heavy guard in a hospital. Explore floors from the lobby to the ICU, get past guards and nurses, and find a way to strike before escaping in the confusion.
c64:local-c761598bca.title: Hospital Adventure

c64:local-c7ce039719.description: Level 9's illustrated sequel to Gnome Ranger. Ingrid Bottomlow, a gnome, sets out to protect Little Moaning, her home village, from the developer Jasper Quickbuck by talking its awkward residents into signing her petition.
c64:local-c7ce039719.title: Ingrid's Back! - Graphic Version

c64:local-c8de8914dd.description: Dana Clapp's text adventure that begins on a seaside holiday: you rent a sailboat, land on an island and explore the tunnels of a dormant volcano in search of its hidden treasure, escaping before the volcano blows.
c64:local-c8de8914dd.title: Shiver Me Timbers

c64:local-c95d78dde3.description: Bat-and-ball duel for one or two players with paddles or joysticks. Each side defends a wall; knock a hole in your opponent's wall, then get the ball through the gap to win.
c64:local-c95d78dde3.title: Battle

c64:local-caa53b3e0e.description: A 2009 remake of Imagic's 1982 Atlantis: the undersea city is under attack, and you hold off the raiders by firing from its gun posts, aiming with the fire button plus a joystick direction, alone or in team mode.
c64:local-caa53b3e0e.title: Atlantis

c64:local-cad44e0b00.description: Three-reel fruit machine simulation with skill-stop holds, nudges and a gamble option on wins, plus a number feature grid and a high-score table.
c64:local-cad44e0b00.title: Las Vegas

c64:local-cca25a2162.description: Miniature golf for up to four players with a score card: place the ball on the tee pad, stretch an elastic line to set direction and strength, and finish the first course at or under par to move on to the second. Playable with joystick or keyboard.
c64:local-cca25a2162.title: Hole-in-One

c64:local-ccc239df6f.description: The Hultén Brothers' 2014 conversion of Century Electronics' 1981 arcade shooter: steer a ship left and right and blast enemy waves through seven zones of 17 sectors each, using a brief light-speed burst that slows foes to an eighth of their speed. Supports one or two players, normal and hard modes.
c64:local-ccc239df6f.title: Cosmos

c64:local-cdafeb3275.description: Tactical naval wargame of Second World War surface actions in the North Atlantic. British ships such as King George V and Prince of Wales take on German raiders like Admiral Scheer, with range checks, main and secondary gunnery, ammunition limits and hit-location damage tables deciding the outcome.
c64:local-cdafeb3275.title: Dreadnoughts - World War II, North Atlantic

c64:local-ce346eaf94.description: Submarine attack game by Mark B. Heller for Susie Software. Set heading and range, dive to evade, and torpedo enemy shipping while watching your air supply; an end-of-patrol report lists time, ships sunk, shots fired and score.
c64:local-ce346eaf94.title: Torpedo

c64:local-ce456d739a.description: Text adventure: you come to on the ninth floor of an unfamiliar building and have to get out one storey at a time, crossing window ledges and quicksand, groping through rooms after a power failure and getting past an alligator.
c64:local-ce456d739a.title: Kidnapped

c64:local-ceb756dd7a.description: Caveman Ugh climbs mountain paths with a single spear to steal pterodactyl eggs before the ice age. Pterry the pterodactyl drops rocks and a tyrannosaurus prowls the trails, and Ugh must put the spear down to carry an egg home.
c64:local-ceb756dd7a.title: Ugh!

c64:local-cef51d0e2b.description: Text adventure by New Zealander Steven Darnold. Explore a castle, find the key to its hidden vault and a secret passage, beware a sorcerer who turns intruders into frogs, and gather treasure for a score out of 100.
c64:local-cef51d0e2b.title: Castle Maze Adventure

c64:local-cfac0cca45.description: German puzzle game in which you push every stone into the holes on each level, with a level editor and options to load and save your own layouts.
c64:local-cfac0cca45.title: Quadrato

c64:local-cfe9178997.description: The electronic memory game: watch and repeat ever longer sequences, with the computer teasing or praising you depending on how far you get.
c64:local-cfe9178997.title: Simon

c64:local-d07c0a280e.description: System 3's isometric ninja adventure. As Armakuni, sole survivor of a massacred clan, you cross the lands of Lin-Fen fighting with sword, staff and shuriken, solving item puzzles and seeking the palace of Shogun Kunitoki to reclaim the sacred scrolls.
c64:local-d07c0a280e.title: Last Ninja1

c64:local-d07fe2160f.description: Collect all the pieces of a mystic symbol in a freshly generated maze and escape the cavern by its ladder. The walls are deadly, so blast new paths with a limited stock of grenades from a safe distance, and pick up gems whose effects can help or hinder until you touch a piece of the symbol.
c64:local-d07fe2160f.title: Cave-Quest

c64:local-d17993e96d.description: Rockford tunnels through caves collecting enough diamonds to open the exit, while boulders fall whenever the earth below them is dug away, crushing enemies or Rockford himself. Sixteen caves and five difficulty settings change diamond quotas and time limits.
c64:local-d17993e96d.title: Boulder Dash

c64:local-d1db869331.description: Contract bridge against the computer with five skill levels: bid and play hands, replay a deal, or enter chosen cards to set up your own. Contracts are scored above and below the line, with overtricks and failed contracts tracked.
c64:local-d1db869331.title: Contract Bridge

c64:local-d1ea2511b9.description: Radarsoft geography program for Europe. Identify the countries, capitals, seas, islands and mountain ranges marked on the map, look up facts about each country, or fly a helicopter in the Heligame to reach destinations against the clock.
c64:local-d1ea2511b9.title: Maps 64 - Europe

c64:local-d273b9bbf9.description: A firefighter scales sixteen burning skyscrapers to reach a girl trapped on the top floor, spraying flames in windows and rescuing others on the way. Dodge falling objects and fireballs, and find power-ups such as a three-way spray, temporary invincibility and a speed boost.
c64:local-d273b9bbf9.title: FireTrap

c64:local-d2dfe33a72.description: Jack Lockerby text adventure: summoned by King Grimmold, ruler of the dwarfs, you set out to recover his fabled hammer from Valk, an evil magician who hides in an impregnable citadel. Friendly folk share vital clues if you say the king's name.
c64:local-d2dfe33a72.title: Hammer of Grimmold

c64:local-d331b845fe.description: Text adventure in which you must get back home after being stranded, climbing trees, dealing with robots, working an airlock, picking locks and pressing coloured buttons, with a laser, a parachute and a space suit among the useful items.
c64:local-d331b845fe.title: Stranded

c64:local-d36fdb4efb.description: A knight battles evil through a string of different challenges: a ball duel against a winged demon, a sword duel with a barbarian, a stormy flight past Storm Birds, a descent through a rock shaft and a platform trek through catacombs to destroy the Sacred Skull.
c64:local-d36fdb4efb.title: Storm Warrior

c64:local-d3eafc2deb.description: Fantasy adventure: once keeper of Castle Talita, you saw the twin princesses Rheayma and Rheasonna and the wizard Calitoc bring the land of Adolan back to life, until the overlord B'aaalcknyte took his revenge and made them vanish. Armed only with a crystal orb from Calitoc, you set out to free them.
c64:local-d3eafc2deb.title: Overlord

c64:local-d480e9b619.description: Text adventure inside the tomb of King Tutankhamun. Light your way with a limited supply of matches, deal with a hungry snake that can be tamed, and get past the knife-throwing goobers.
c64:local-d480e9b619.title: King Tut's Tomb Adventure

c64:local-d5780a36a0.description: Jetpack hero races an 80-minute limit to assemble four parts of a weapon against the Alien Syndicate's leader. Fly through levels of ledges, spikes and lava, collecting extra guns and ammunition; you can fire in any direction but only shoot sideways while moving.
c64:local-d5780a36a0.title: War Machine

c64:local-d5b49eaa06.description: Idea's top-down football game, a version of Dribbling featuring leading European national teams. Play single matches or a full season with three-, six- or nine-minute games, setting mentality, marking and the line-up beforehand.
c64:local-d5b49eaa06.title: European Champions

c64:local-d6dd36c795.description: Energy Warrior on the box: pollution has wrecked the Earth and only a handful of nature reserves survive, so when aliens settle on them you must blast them off in a sideways-scrolling shoot-'em-up spread over ten levels.
c64:local-d6dd36c795.title: Energy

c64:local-d6f315da9f.description: Text adventure in which an office worker wakes in a prison cell after a strange phone call. Rebels hold a machine that can control people's minds, and since you are immune, you must break out, find the device and stop them.
c64:local-d6f315da9f.title: Mindbender

c64:local-d705cf9d0f.description: A strange creature called the Cyberball snatches your girlfriend Laura from a walk in the park, so you set off with a laser pistol to win her back. Shooting the bouncing ball splits it into ever smaller pieces until they crumble, while skulls and UFOs drop in to harass you and power-ups improve your gun; each cleared level restores a little more of Laura.
c64:local-d705cf9d0f.title: Ultrix

c64:local-d708256818.description: Dynacomp bridge program in which you play out deals as declarer from a given auction. It checks for faulty leads and reneges, scores made contracts and overtricks, and keeps statistics and a scorecard over a series of hands.
c64:local-d708256818.title: Bridge Master

c64:local-d758e7a894.description: Command the Enterprise to rid the galaxy of Klingons before time runs out, using numbered commands for long- and short-range scans, warp moves entered as sector vectors, phasers, torpedoes and a galactic map. Docking at a starbase rearms and refuels the ship.
c64:local-d758e7a894.title: Star Trek

c64:local-d7bf5dbc6d.description: Missile Command clone: defend six bases along the ground by firing limited ammunition from a central launcher at incoming missiles. If the launcher is hit you cannot fire for the rest of the wave.
c64:local-d7bf5dbc6d.title: Aftermath

c64:local-d8683363a3.description: Robots are setting your city's buildings ablaze. In each overhead building, spray flames with an extinguisher that overheats and wears out, and lay a limited number of firebreaks to slow the spread. A bonus path-building screen follows each cleared building.
c64:local-d8683363a3.title: Wildfire

c64:local-d88f2e0bc5.description: SSI's turn-based simulation of First World War air combat over France and Germany, with up to twenty aircraft in a dogfight. Scenarios such as Voss's Last Fight and Bloody April take place on a three-dimensional grid of squares and altitude levels, with clouds and wind.
c64:local-d88f2e0bc5.title: Eagles

c64:local-d8f492a36a.description: Play a dustman in this forced-perspective arcade game: carry each house's bin to the lorry, empty it and return it before the bonus timer runs out. Stay off lawns, and avoid maniac drivers, cyclists and barking dogs; three warnings and you are sacked.
c64:local-d8f492a36a.title: Trashman

c64:local-d9489724b8.description: Illustrated text adventure: the Colourful King has lost his mind, and with it the secret of where the crown jewels and the Ring of Power are hidden. Gather the treasures, then find the ring to become king, using two-word commands.
c64:local-d9489724b8.title: The Ring of Power

c64:local-d99aff47f1.description: London Software arcade game for one player or two: battle the Silurians by collecting their Oscillating Gravitronic Generators while moving along the lines of a 12-by-12 grid. Four orbiting launchers circle the edge of the field firing missiles at you, which you can shoot down, and every level brings a new generator layout; two speed settings.
c64:local-d99aff47f1.title: Parallax

c64:local-da98cfd681.description: An unofficial take on The Jewel of the Nile in which three travellers jailed by a desert dictatorship must be reunited and given their chosen weapons, one of them an umbrella. On each later screen the trio is positioned before enemies arrive, then the player steers one while the computer handles the other two.
c64:local-da98cfd681.title: The Mystery of The Nile

c64:local-db110e47ba.description: German point-and-click adventure from Ninjutsu Design. After racketeers burn down the pizzeria Thomas runs with his brother Peter, Peter is killed by their boss in an arena bout, and Thomas sets out to clean up the town and avenge him, building commands from a joystick menu in the style of Maniac Mansion and questioning the locals.
c64:local-db110e47ba.title: Kunst aus China

c64:local-dcb537399e.description: Frogger-style game: hop a frog across a busy motorway while dodging snakes and frog-eaters, then over a rushing river on logs, steering clear of crocodiles and turtles that dive. Park four frogs in the harbour before time runs out to move up a level.
c64:local-dcb537399e.title: Roadtoad

c64:local-dcf6674367.description: Breakout-style defence of Earth against invading creatures from NET Software: bounce your power dot off the force field with a deflector paddle to destroy them. The creatures speed up on later levels, large paddles shrink after level five, and two players can compete.
c64:local-dcf6674367.title: Breakin

c64:local-dd9fce3d6d.description: Avalon Hill strategy game for up to four mining families competing for mining rights across the planets of the solar system. Send ships to claim concessions, check travel times and lodge protests with Earth's mining council.
c64:local-dd9fce3d6d.title: The Planet Miners

c64:local-ddf9a3e895.description: Luxor the Moonprince and his companions resist Doomdark's armies across the land of Midnight, shown as panoramic first-person landscapes in eight compass directions. The war can be won by recruiting lords and defeating the Foul in battle, or by sending young Morkin alone to destroy the Ice Crown.
c64:local-ddf9a3e895.title: Lords of Midnight

c64:local-de165e82d0.description: A caveman runs a pedal-powered helicopter taxi, ferrying passengers between cave entrances across 69 platform levels. Lift comes only from pedalling, hitting walls too hard ends the attempt, and a swooping pterodactyl and a charging triceratops get in the way.
c64:local-de165e82d0.title: Ugh!

c64:local-deb8dd7022.description: Humphrey must recover a princess's gems from aliens or lose his head, grabbing every gem on each of 30 single screens before an earthquake hits. Skull blocks can be pushed to turn them into bombs that clear walls and aliens, and teleports, switches and clocks help along the way.
c64:local-deb8dd7022.title: Snare

c64:local-df4482f3ae.description: Seen from above, trains leave stations bound for set destinations, and the player flips junction points with a cursor to route a quota of them home in time. Wrongly set points halt a train, the wrong station sends it back, and collisions cost a penalty.
c64:local-df4482f3ae.title: Locomotion

c64:local-df8f16779f.description: Ultima-style role-playing game from the 64'er magazine. Fifteen years after the wizard Tenomy and his monster hordes seized the island of Aldora, you are chosen to destroy him: fight monsters for treasure, buy weapons, armour and rations in the villages, and recover the nine magic stones hidden in six dungeons and around the island to open his tower.
c64:local-df8f16779f.title: Magische Steine - Magic Stone

c64:local-e103334d26.description: Epyx's Olympic-style sports collection for up to eight players, each representing a country. Compete for gold, silver and bronze in sprinting, pole vault, platform diving, gymnastics, swimming races and skeet shooting, either as a full medal contest, a few chosen events or practice.
c64:local-e103334d26.title: Summer Games I

c64:local-e189eec5b9.description: Text adventure around an inn: cut padlocks with a hacksaw, find something to stand on to climb, get past barred windows and a fence too high to jump, and sample the whisky along the way. Games can be saved and restored.
c64:local-e189eec5b9.title: Smugglers' Inn

c64:local-e1bd7663f0.description: American football strategy against the computer: name both teams, choose a difficulty or 'wimp factor', divide ten points of strength between rushing and passing offence and defence and special teams, then call offensive and defensive plays from the coin toss onward.
c64:local-e1bd7663f0.title: Football

c64:local-e1fddf9c08.description: A turn-based tactics duel between two pirate ships, solo against the computer or with a friend: launch pirates from your port hatches onto a net, then move them all forward or diagonally together while avoiding the holes in it, aiming to blow out every enemy cabin port or knock all the opposing pirates into the sea.
c64:local-e1fddf9c08.title: Piracy

c64:local-e23092eeca.description: Shaun Southern's 1983 Pac-Man clone for Mr. Chip Software: clear each maze of dots and power pills as ghosts leave their central pen, turning the tables on them after a power pill. Side tunnels offer a quick escape, white H icons whisk you elsewhere in the maze, and every new maze has a different layout.
c64:local-e23092eeca.title: Pacmania

c64:local-e265f1573b.description: Casino keno from Comp-U-Soft: choose 1 to 15 numbers and a stake, then the computer draws 20; the more of your numbers it picks, the bigger the payout, and an odds table shows what each pick can win.
c64:local-e265f1573b.title: Keno

c64:local-e29dbb4a76.description: Dreggon invaders have captured Earth's empire of 36 space colonies, and only three Sentinel fighters remain. Shoot down enemies such as landers, UFOs and needlers while dodging armoured flak, with ten kills needed to free each colony before a final battle.
c64:local-e29dbb4a76.title: Sentinel

c64:local-e2c0345f26.description: European release of Imagine's conversion of Nichibutsu's Galivan. The last Cosmo Police officer runs and jumps through caves, ornate halls and flooded zones on planet Cynep, starting out with only punches and kicks until a POW item clads him in a laser-armed robot suit.
c64:local-e2c0345f26.title: Hero 2020

c64:local-e2c9bbff14.description: Casino dice game with a rules tutorial. Place pass and don't-pass line bets, come bets or wagers on single numbers, then roll the dice as the shooter.
c64:local-e2c9bbff14.title: Craps

c64:local-e337a8415d.description: Pilot a small satellite through labyrinths, alone or with a second player, as little monsters pop out from behind bricks at unpredictable moments to fire at you. Shoot back by holding fire and pushing the joystick in the direction to shoot before you get caught in the crossfire.
c64:local-e337a8415d.title: Crossfire

c64:local-e40370a0a7.description: In 2101 the last old nuclear waste stores deep underground must be cleared, but their security robots can no longer be switched off. Steer a shielded robot vehicle through the contaminated maze collecting the scattered canisters, which also feed your energy; patrols destroy you on contact, while fixed guns sap your fuel.
c64:local-e40370a0a7.title: Underground

c64:local-e6fe7b7841.description: Vertically scrolling shooter: fire missiles at alien ships and pull back on the stick while firing to drop bombs on pulsating ground targets, collect bonus objects, and use the hyperbomb from the diamond carrier. Each level ends once at least 20 of the rectangular targets are bombed.
c64:local-e6fe7b7841.title: Combat Zone

c64:local-e89eaa13e9.description: Part of Brian Howarth's Mysterious Adventures, this text adventure begins when a stranded motorist wanders into a circus that falls silent the moment he enters. Short typed commands are used to explore the big top, wagons and animal pens and to solve puzzles involving the trapeze, tightrope and human cannonball.
c64:local-e89eaa13e9.title: Circus

c64:local-e8ad504eb5.description: Horizontally scrolling shooter over a desert landscape by Steve Lee. Your jet fighter must down a quota of enemy helicopters to clear each level, landing on a pad to take on more fuel and ammunition.
c64:local-e8ad504eb5.title: Falcon Petrol II

c64:local-e8b2403845.description: An Asteroids-style shooter in which a Federation clearance ship sweeps asteroids, alien craft and shooting stars from the space lanes between Mercury and Pluto. After three sectors per planet, the pilot must slip through a moving gap in the Factory Ship to dock.
c64:local-e8b2403845.title: Master Blaster

c64:local-ea2d4f8246.description: Slot machine simulation: start with 50 Susan B. Anthony dollars, pay a dollar a pull, and use keys 1 to 4 to pull the handle until you quit or go broke.
c64:local-ea2d4f8246.title: One Arm Bandit

c64:local-ea6fb7619f.description: Noughts and crosses against the computer at five skill levels or against a second player, entering each move as a row and column number.
c64:local-ea6fb7619f.title: Noughts and Crosses

c64:local-ebe21b3f1b.description: Air combat mission: fly over enemy territory destroying platform guns, double cannons, plasmoid launchers, helicopters, fighter planes and the command centre, reach the POW hospital and wreck the airbase, with points multiplied by the chosen skill level.
c64:local-ebe21b3f1b.title: Combat Zone

c64:local-ec3c6d8675.description: Quiz based on the Bob Holness TV show: pick a square marked with the first letter of an answer, buzz in with your key and type the reply, and complete a path across the board to reach the Gold Run. Play against the computer or a friend, with Bob's face on or off and 500 more questions to load.
c64:local-ec3c6d8675.title: Blockbusters

c64:local-ede34898f1.description: A text adventure that begins in a sunny field clearing; the aim is to explore the surrounding land, find the Crystal Frog and bring it back. A percentage score tracks progress, and 100% requires visiting every location and using certain objects.
c64:local-ede34898f1.title: Crystal Frog

c64:local-ee13b4c85f.description: In 3020 invaders turn on Earth itself, and you must destroy their three battle asteroids. Each takes four stages: walk your pilot to a fighter and fly it out of the space station along a guide beam, beat an enemy fleet in space, fight across the asteroid's surface, then win the final clash in its command centre. One or two players, three difficulty levels.
c64:local-ee13b4c85f.title: Deadzone

c64:local-eec0cf3b4d.description: Inspector Gadget searches a flick-screen circus for six disguised MAD agents. He must first find his binoculars and extending arms to spot and catch them, avoid circus creatures, and rescue the kidnapped Penny within fifteen minutes.
c64:local-eec0cf3b4d.title: Inspector_Gadget

c64:local-eef27b8749.description: As a Human Fly you climb the faces of city skyscrapers to exterminate pesky bugs. You cannot actually fly, so stay on the building, and take care: wounded bugs turn nasty.
c64:local-eef27b8749.title: Laserblaster

c64:local-f03fdd6d5c.description: German action game from the year 3099: alien plasma-eaters are draining the air and water of an outpost in the Beta system, so its people reactivate the old combat robot Robox. Clear each area within the time limit, picking up stronger weapons as you advance.
c64:local-f03fdd6d5c.title: Robox

c64:local-f047e41637.description: Crossword construction software from L&S Computerware and Mindscape: type in answer words and clues and it interlocks them into a grid for you, then edit, save, print the puzzle on paper or solve it on screen. A demo puzzle is included on the disk.
c64:local-f047e41637.title: Crossword Magic 4.0

c64:local-f06c29662c.description: Swedish game: after ten years of misery in an old people's home, you and a fellow pensioner decide to finally take on the system and see justice done.
c64:local-f06c29662c.title: The Escape

c64:local-f0c7a82900.description: Conway's Game of Life with a light pen: set up cells and watch generations evolve in two-colour mode, or in four-colour mode where newborn, surviving and just-dead cells are shown in different colours.
c64:local-f0c7a82900.title: Life

c64:local-f0da836f66.description: An isometric prisoner-of-war escape from a German camp. The prisoner must keep up the daily routine of roll calls, meals and exercise to avoid raising the alarm while gathering items for a break-out by tunnel, fence or back door, and he follows the routine by himself when left alone.
c64:local-f0da836f66.title: The Great Escape

c64:local-f1a9680ae4.description: Seek out and destroy every Klingon before the time limit, entering numbered commands to navigate, fire phasers and photon torpedoes, adjust shield strength, read damage reports and use the library computer and tractor beam.
c64:local-f1a9680ae4.title: Star Trek

c64:local-f205d89c53.description: Educational text adventure that begins on Earth and leads across the planets of the solar system to solve the mystery of the Brangeans, a people wiped out by nuclear war whose last explorers left a message of peace. Facts about stars and planets come up along the way, and your air supply must be watched.
c64:local-f205d89c53.title: Odyssey

c64:local-f26f4adef8.description: Help Moosh, who has failed his people, cross deadly paths that crumble away behind him, so there is no turning back, on his way to crush the bridge and save the world.
c64:local-f26f4adef8.title: Stranded

c64:local-f3299a6050.description: As Police Chief Brody, the player hunts the great white shark off Amity Island, shooting other sea creatures while searching the seabed for four pieces of the weapon needed to kill it, all with the mayor demanding quick and cheap results.
c64:local-f3299a6050.title: Jaws

c64:local-f332545160.description: The sequel to Transylvania sends the player with Princess Sabrina and Crown Prince Erik to recover the stolen crown, a powerful amulet, and to defeat the vampire lord Drakul. Sabrina's magic and Erik's right as heir to certain items are needed to solve puzzles in this illustrated adventure.
c64:local-f332545160.title: Crimson Crown

c64:local-f41f659471.description: A first-person crosshair shooter in which a policeman leading the Untouchables takes on the gangsters of Al Capone and Legs Diamond across nine locations. Civilians must be spared, and each scene ends when its countdown runs out with the player still alive.
c64:local-f41f659471.title: Crossfire

c64:local-f517c951be.description: A high-speed shooter along a chequered floating roadway, dodging barriers, blasting enemies and using jump pads, sometimes flipping over to race along the ceiling. Collected tokens buy better weapons, but each lost life takes away the best one.
c64:local-f517c951be.title: Eliminator

c64:local-f57e09f8eb.description: A scoring card game for 2 to 90 players: each is dealt five cards scored automatically by poker hand, card value and suit, with whole numbers from the poker value and fractions from the cards. The deck size and hands per game can be set.
c64:local-f57e09f8eb.title: Risk

c64:local-f5ce1539f7.description: Level 9 text adventure in three parts based on Malory's Le Morte d'Arthur. Lancelot faces the Black Knight, joins the Round Table, rescues captive knights across the kingdom, and finally seeks the Holy Grail, directing companions through the parser.
c64:local-f5ce1539f7.title: Lancelot - Text Version

c64:local-f63f5bb50f.description: One of the crocodile twins Punk and Funk tries to reach his sweetheart across more than 60 levels of thin platforms, walking around edges upside down and flipping gravity instead of jumping. Each level is cleared by headbutting all of its light bulbs.
c64:local-f63f5bb50f.title: Cool Croc Twins

c64:local-f796820d3f.description: Sega's isometric arcade climber: a safari hunter chases the ape Bongo, who set fire to his tent, across four stages while dodging thrown coconuts and other angry animals.
c64:local-f796820d3f.title: Congo Bongo

c64:local-f87542c89a.description: German strategy game set in civil-war Japan in 1535: four warlords fight over the provinces and the title of shogun. Win by taking every province without losing your home castle, moving troops, fighting duels, sending soldiers and battering rams against neighbours, and managing scarce money raised from taxes and raids.
c64:local-f87542c89a.title: The Shogun

c64:local-f941db0843.description: Ceteka's airline management game. Start with a loan from an American or English bank, buy planes such as an old army DC-3, then choose destinations and fly passengers and cargo for profit while repaying your debts.
c64:local-f941db0843.title: High Flyer

c64:local-f954f42497.description: A text-based dungeon expedition through roughly 40 burial chambers, hunting the wizard who stole a magic chalice. Rooms hold gnomes, trolls and dragons, and the adventurer starts in a random chamber and must manage resources while mapping the barrows.
c64:local-f954f42497.title: White Barrows

c64:local-fc04f6fa57.description: Galactic conquest played in turns for one to twenty players, sending fleets between up to 40 star systems in a randomly generated galaxy. Each turn represents a year, and neutral worlds must be taken from their defenders.
c64:local-fc04f6fa57.title: Galaxy!

c64:local-fc106729d8.description: The sequel to Driller, again in solid 3D: on the moon Tricuspid, the Ketars are charging the Zephyr One weapon through a network of energy collection devices. Destroying them in the right order, since linked ones regenerate, buys time before it can fire on Evath.
c64:local-fc106729d8.title: Dark Side

c64:local-fc597b79f8.description: Text adventure by Peter Iveson for Players: find the lost staff and bring it back to restore a blighted land to its former state.
c64:local-fc597b79f8.title: The Claws of Despair

c64:local-fcf3f24c86.description: Illustrated text adventure: answering an odd ad in The Times, you enter a competition whose prize is a fine house owned by an eccentric, then follow his letter to the property and explore it.
c64:local-fcf3f24c86.title: The House

c64:local-fcf5e7ed38.description: Othello against the computer, which can offer help to beginners. Flank your opponent's pieces to take them over; play ends once the board fills up or one side is wiped out, and the most pieces wins.
c64:local-fcf5e7ed38.title: Othello

c64:local-fd3aed235f.description: Ken Grant's indoor football game, first from Anirog and later reissued by Mastertronic. Name two teams and play a five-a-side match at a chosen difficulty, or take penalty kicks alone or against a friend.
c64:local-fd3aed235f.title: Five a Side

c64:local-fdbdad7060.description: A text-only adventure: after ignoring warnings and wandering into misty woods, the player meets a witch, vanishes by putting on her hat and ends up trapped in a cellar, needing to escape and get back home.
c64:local-fdbdad7060.title: Witch Hunt

c64:local-fdbf30c170.description: Origin's martial-arts role-playing game. As a disciple of Moebius you travel the four elemental planes, Earth, Water, Air and Fire, to take back the Orb of Celestial Harmony, stolen by the evil Kaimen, with side-view hand-to-hand fights and a karma score that shifts with your deeds.
c64:local-fdbf30c170.title: Moebius - The Orb of Central Harmony

c64:local-fdf8c357dd.description: Spider-Man must rescue Mary Jane from Mysterio across a film studio full of traps, stunning enemies with webs, climbing walls and solving puzzles that undo Mysterio's tricks such as altered gravity.
c64:local-fdf8c357dd.title: Amazing Spiderman

c64:local-fe78fa48d2.description: Driving a Wild West steam engine, the player collects gold wagons for the bank, switching points, coupling trucks carrying livestock, fuel or a sheriff, and stopping for fuel and water. Mexican bandits and ghost trains are the threats, and an arcade mode is pure survival.
c64:local-fe78fa48d2.title: Locomotion

c64:local-fe998e78cc.description: Instrument flight training simulator, the second German edition, adding eight new airports to fly approaches into using instruments.
c64:local-fe998e78cc.title: D-2000 IFR-Trainer - Germany 2

c64:local-ff0d25c7b3.description: Level 9's revised trilogy of illustrated text adventures: Lords of Time, where Father Time sends you through history after nine treasures; Red Moon, recovering a stolen magic crystal; and The Price of Magik, stopping the crazed magician Myglar from draining it.
c64:local-ff0d25c7b3.title: Time and Magik - Graphic Version

c64:local-ff303d08a5.description: SSI wargame from the When Superpowers Collide line, set in 1985: NATO pushes into East Germany to relieve besieged West Berlin while Soviet forces are drawn off to Poland. Command either side against the computer or another player.
c64:local-ff303d08a5.title: Baltic 1985 - When Superpowers Collide

c64:local-ff4610425c.description: Xonox martial-arts game starring Chuck Norris, who has six minutes to get to a monastery. Keep to the scrolling path, since straying onto grass wastes time, and beat ambushing warriors one at a time with punches, kicks and blocks against their thrown shurikens.
c64:local-ff4610425c.title: Chunk Noris

c64:local-ff6323f22f.description: A BurgerTime-style platform game: trainee accountant Charlie sneaks into the silicon chip factory at night, walking over chip parts to push them down through the levels onto the conveyor belt.
c64:local-ff6323f22f.title: Chip Factory

c64:local-ffbfae6944.description: Namco's isometric take on Pac-Man, with large scrolling mazes and a new jump that lets Pac-Man hop over ghosts, though some of them learn to jump too. Power pellets still turn the ghosts blue and edible.
c64:local-ffbfae6944.title: Pac-Mania

c64:local-fff84309d7.description: Version of the TV word puzzle show for up to three players: spin the wheel, call consonants, buy vowels and solve the phrase, dodging the bankrupt spaces, with a bonus round and a champions list.
c64:local-fff84309d7.title: Wheel of Fortune - First Edition

c64:moby-10121.description: Spin-off of Carrier Command: drive a single Mauler assault tank, dropped in by stealth helicopter, through 3D missions such as a railway ambush, an escort and an attack on a hideout by a river. Choose weapons to match each briefing.
c64:moby-10121.title: Battle Command

c64:moby-104715.title: The Hitch Hikers Guide to the Galaxy

c64:moby-10495.description: Konami's top-down jeep shooter for one or two players. Rescue prisoners of war from enemy camps and drive them to a landing zone for airlift, using a forward-firing machine gun and grenades that can be upgraded to rockets.
c64:moby-10495.title: Jackal

c64:moby-10630.description: Mr. Do the clown hammers blocks out of castle floors, dropping them on pursuing unicorns or clearing every cherry block to finish a level. Three key blocks unlock a rooftop door that turns unicorns into letters for spelling EXTRA, and knocking out two skull blocks builds a bridge between them.
c64:moby-10630.title: Mr. Do!'s Castle

c64:moby-109864.description: Checkers against the computer at levels 0 to 4, moved with joystick or keys: pieces move diagonally forward, jumps are compulsory and can be chained, and a piece reaching the far row becomes a queen; illegal moves have to be replayed.
c64:moby-109864.title: Checkers

c64:moby-11068.description: A World War II naval simulation commanding a US Navy destroyer through submarine hunts, rescues, blockade runs, shore bombardments, scouting and convoy escort missions.
c64:moby-11068.title: Destroyer

c64:moby-1112.description: A Manta fighter skims the hulls of giant Super Dreadnoughts, strafing gun emplacements and enemy waves until it can land and shut down each ship's reactor. The craft scrolls left or right at speed and can roll sideways through narrow gaps, with a bonus round between levels.
c64:moby-1112.title: Uridium

c64:moby-11241.description: A boxing game with eleven opponents leading to a title fight against champion Bronx Bomber, each with a signature super punch. It offers a main event, tournament, training and sparring modes, and players can build their own boxer.
c64:moby-11241.title: Fight Night

c64:moby-11282.description: Patrol a fast 3D arena in a probe vehicle shooting saucers and homing missiles; after enough kills, run a stargate barrage of oncoming spheres to warp to the next of eight planets.
c64:moby-11282.title: Encounter!

c64:moby-11493.description: Platform game from Italy's Idea Software. One of the planet's two moons holds back an evil serpent with its magic, but an eclipse by the other is about to free it, so the hero fights and jumps through the land collecting items and solving puzzles.
c64:moby-11493.title: Moonshadow

c64:moby-11755.description: Based on the Nickelodeon game show, players answer trivia questions or take the dare instead, facing toss-up and physical challenges and finally the obstacle course.
c64:moby-11755.title: Double Dare

c64:moby-11899.description: System 3 shoot-'em-up that opens with a vertically scrolling stage before switching to horizontal scrolling, with speed-ups, extra cannons and other power-ups to collect and a large boss at the end of each level.
c64:moby-11899.title: Dominator

c64:moby-124.description: George the gorilla, Lizzy the lizard and Ralph the werewolf, all mutated humans, punch city buildings until they crumble while police and soldiers shoot at them. Up to three can play at once, and each monster must keep eating to avoid shrinking back to human form.
c64:moby-124.title: Rampage

c64:moby-124877.title: Professional Tour Golf: Module #1: Oakmont & Merion

c64:moby-12576.description: Ice hockey built around a USA versus USSR matchup, with one-on-one or five-a-side play and a choice of period lengths. Wrist and slap shots, drop passes and body checks are all available, while roughing and cross-checking draw penalties.
c64:moby-12576.title: Powerplay Hockey

c64:moby-128484.title: Daffy Duck and the Great Paint Caper

c64:moby-12935.title: The Lost Crown of Queen Anne

c64:moby-129828.title: Mission Asteroid & Wizard and the Princess

c64:moby-1304.title: Wizardry: Knight of Diamonds - The Second Scenario

c64:moby-130930.title: N.Y.C.: The Big Apple / Air Support

c64:moby-13106.description: Ocean shooter starring a flying professor caught between two parallel universes. Return the objects swapped between the mirror worlds to their proper places while shooting aliens, ending with a large boss creature.
c64:moby-13106.title: Double Take

c64:moby-136312.title: Daily Crossword Puzzles from The New York Times

c64:moby-13909.description: Fly through Star Quadrant Jupiter dodging solar flares and space debris, then dive down to passing moons to pick up stranded miners. Skim the surface past towers and alien destroyers, carry up to six miners, and lift off through accelerator rings.
c64:moby-13909.title: Moonsweeper

c64:moby-139280.description: Mike Singleton's Postern game: gather the eggs scattered around the pit while a growing number of snakes hunt you; once they are cleared, you can turn on the snakes, but only by eating them tail first.
c64:moby-139280.title: Snake Pit

c64:moby-145174.title: Getting Ready to Read and Add

c64:moby-145221.title: Strip Poker Data Disk #1: Female - Candi and Marlena

c64:moby-145269.title: Strip Poker Data Disk #2: Male - David and Tony

c64:moby-145734.title: Little People's Puzzles: Things That Go

c64:moby-1467.description: Yacht racing on eight courses against computer opponents, steering and trimming the sail and centreboard while the boats are drawn in 3D wireframe. An overhead map traces everyone's course, and you can also race a fast motorboat or play against friends.
c64:moby-1467.title: The American Challenge: A Sailing Simulation

c64:moby-146914.title: TKKG: Das leere Grab im Moor

c64:moby-148411.description: Fly a military helicopter on a two-part mission each level: pick up a bomb from an island and drop it on the enemy battleship, all while a pair of speedboats with angled guns harry you across the water.
c64:moby-148411.title: Whirlybird

c64:moby-148691.title: Mission Control Word Games: Homonyms, Antonyms, and Synonyms

c64:moby-14936.title: Everyone's A Wally (The Life of Wally)

c64:moby-15105.description: Bumble the creature leads children aged 4 to 10 through six games that teach number lines and graphing, such as guessing a secret number from higher-or-lower clues and finding Bumble on a grid by entering coordinates.
c64:moby-15105.title: Bumble Games

c64:moby-151715.title: The Queen's Footsteps (Collector's Edition): All in One

c64:moby-15198.description: The last Magic Knight adventure sends the hero to confront his double, the Off-White Knight, across 64 screens. Actions such as examine, pick up and cast spell are chosen from menus, objects include a chicken, eggs and a disguise, and lightning bolts strike from the sky.
c64:moby-15198.title: Stormbringer

c64:moby-1553.description: Darrian defends human colonies from the Xenites in a vertically scrolling shooter where his craft switches between ground tank and jet, each needed for different targets, collecting upgrades from destroyed enemies.
c64:moby-1553.title: Xenon

c64:moby-157479.title: Wally's Word Works: The Parts of Speech Game

c64:moby-158876.description: Isis Hathor's two-part space flight game: pilot a fighter through an asteroid field and then a network of ice caverns, steering clear of rocks, drifting debris that turns deadly once it glows orange, and missiles fired up from the ground. Hitting the control centre near the caverns wins an extra life, and each completed circuit starts over at a harder level.
c64:moby-158876.title: Laser Strike

c64:moby-15910.title: Xonox Double-Ender: Tomarc the Barbarian and Motocross Racer

c64:moby-161423.description: A Galaxian-style shooter from Micro Power whose invaders are wing-flapping Birdmen; any that reach the bottom lay explosive eggs that hem in your laser base until they fade. Eight phases grow steadily harder.
c64:moby-161423.title: Swoop

c64:moby-1622.description: Origin's adaptation of the Steve Jackson Games tabletop wargame. On a hex map, one side commands infantry, tanks and howitzers against a single giant cybernetic supertank, the Ogre, in turn-based play.
c64:moby-1622.title: Ogre

c64:moby-166856.description: A prehistoric text adventure: while you gather berries, a sabretooth cat steals your child from the cave. Track it through gorges and ravines, light fires with scraper and tinder, catch salmon, get past a mammoth and brave a dangerous river.
c64:moby-166856.title: Caveman

c64:moby-16970.description: An early real-time strategy game: direct your landed army with a cursor across an alien planet, protect your vital bombs, detonate at least two beside the enemy weather control station, then evacuate fast.
c64:moby-16970.title: Invasion

c64:moby-17116.description: The villain Phobos has built 15 planets based on common fears such as spiders, snakes and dentists; fly to each, blast across its surface and through its caverns to rescue the Galactic Emperor, alone or with two players at once.
c64:moby-17116.title: Phobia

c64:moby-1733.title: Disney's Duck Tales: The Quest for Gold

c64:moby-173492.description: Old West text adventure from Victory Software by Bruce Robinson and Alan Stankiewicz. Starting in Dodge City, you track down an outlaw gang and recover the stolen gold, using matches, a canoe and other finds; success earns the reward and makes you sheriff.
c64:moby-173492.title: Bounty Hunter

c64:moby-173633.description: A Joust-style game by Brent Marykuca: lost on an icy planet and riding a mutant bird, you flap into the air and strike foes from above to seize the energy nodules they carry before the warlords use them to melt their icy prison. One player, or two in tournament play.
c64:moby-173633.title: Duel

c64:moby-173677.description: Aliens drop bombs as they descend toward your planet; slide your ship with Z and X and fire a single laser at a time with F7. Each of the 20 aliens is worth a different score, and shooting them in the right order, highest value first, earns an extra ship across 20 levels.
c64:moby-173677.title: Alien Invasion

c64:moby-173701.description: Based on Clavell's novel: as Toranaga or a rival lord you roam feudal Japan, winning characters to your cause or killing them through icon commands, and must gather twenty followers before completing a quest set by the Emperor.
c64:moby-173701.title: Shogun

c64:moby-174265.description: Two-player strategy game on a triangular map of 15 towns joined by one-way roads. Players take turns moving any of four cars to a neighbouring town, each holding at most four cars; whoever cannot move once all four meet at the dead-end town loses.
c64:moby-174265.title: Traffic Jam

c64:moby-174508.description: A typed-answer trivia game: questions on film, TV, history, sport, science and more appear on screen, and you key in each answer before time runs out, choosing the speed and length of the game.
c64:moby-174508.title: The Game of Trivia

c64:moby-1775.description: Thomas M. Disch's text adventure: you wake in a Manhattan hotel with no memory, no money and no clothes, wanted for murder in Texas. Some 4,000 locations recreate the city and subway, shops keep real hours, and you must work, eat and sleep while unravelling your past.
c64:moby-1775.title: Amnesia

c64:moby-182307.description: A treasure hunt through an old manor in the spirit of The Hound of the Baskervilles, written in BASIC with PETSCII pictures and a two-word parser. Prowling dogs catch you if you stay in the open for too many moves.
c64:moby-182307.title: The Secret of Bastow Manor

c64:moby-18250.description: Vertically scrolling arcade shooter in which a US pilot flies the Sonic Boom jet through six levels of planes, tanks, trains and gun turrets. Each stage ends in a timed boss fight, and destroyed waves drop weapon upgrades.
c64:moby-18250.title: Sonic Boom

c64:moby-18637.description: A satirical strategy game as president of the banana republic Ritimba, handling monthly demands from the army, peasants and landowners while quietly moving treasury money into a Swiss account. The goal is to escape abroad before a coup or an assassin gets there first.
c64:moby-18637.title: Dictator

c64:moby-19116.description: The first Magic Knight game. Sent by a king to find a gift for his daughter, the knight explores the castle of Spriteland and its scrolling mazes, combining items and trading them for more valuable ones.
c64:moby-19116.title: Finders Keepers

c64:moby-191856.description: A football management game: take over any of the 92 English league clubs, pick from a squad of up to 20, play league and cup fixtures, deal with injuries and transfer offers, and balance the weekly accounts, or be sacked when the money runs out.
c64:moby-191856.title: League Soccer

c64:moby-196161.description: Steer a ball through every doorway along a route, using one key to switch between high and low and another for left and right; a new route can be chosen before each run.
c64:moby-196161.title: Slalom!

c64:moby-196981.title: Polar Bear in Space! (Collector's Edition Box Set)

c64:moby-196992.title: The Final Conflict: Part One - Cargo Run

c64:moby-198099.title: Kółko i Krzyżyk: O i X

c64:moby-198158.title: The Search for King Solomon's Mines: Part 1

c64:moby-198223.title: Star League Baseball and On-Field Football

c64:moby-198293.title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Język Angielski

c64:moby-198454.description: Concentration puzzle from Magic Disk 64: rebuild the pattern of the reference square shown on the right in your own square on the left by pointing an arrow at any of its four rows or columns and shifting that line one step at a time, all against a strict time limit.
c64:moby-198454.title: Logic

c64:moby-20001.description: Data East's arcade shooter: an exiled pilot is sent on a suicide mission. The ship rotates and the play area scrolls in every direction, with smart bombs on board and weapon tokens dropped by destroyed enemies.
c64:moby-20001.title: Last Mission

c64:moby-200100.description: A 1986 budget take on Amidar from Players Software: move along the lines of a grid, painting around its blocks.
c64:moby-200100.title: Micro Painter

c64:moby-200282.title: Dark Tower / Invaders of the Lost Tomb

c64:moby-20032.description: Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are held in an evil genius's castle, and Scooby must rescue them. Platform and ladder brawler through four levels of ghosts, bats, skulls and Ghoulfish, with Scooby Snacks giving extra lives.
c64:moby-20032.title: Scooby-Doo

c64:moby-200678.description: A pair of slot machines on one disk. Kings Ransom takes up to three coins and pays on one line; Silver Knight takes up to five and pays on five lines. Start with a bankroll you choose and see how long it lasts.
c64:moby-200678.title: Bandit

c64:moby-202097.title: Micro Adventure No. 3: Million Dollar Gamble

c64:moby-202283.title: Micro Adventure No. 8: The Big Freeze

c64:moby-202426.title: A Magic Micro Adventure: Captain Kid and the Pirates

c64:moby-202461.title: A Magic Micro Adventure: The Cats of Castle Mountain

c64:moby-202469.title: A Magic Micro Adventure: Wizards of Wonder

c64:moby-203052.title: De Prijsvraag: Mr. Chip Nibble / Dr. J

c64:moby-203569.title: In den Beginne, Doe mee aan de wedstrijd

c64:moby-204557.title: Marvel Super Heroes Computer Fun: Book One

c64:moby-204583.title: Marvel Super Heroes Computer Fun: Book Two

c64:moby-208583.title: Het Geheim van de drie burchten
