c64:moby-210867.title: COMPUTE!'s Second Book of Commodore 64 Games

c64:moby-210920.title: Willow Pattern Adventure / The Happiest Days of Your Life

c64:moby-210921.title: COMPUTE!'s First Book of Commodore 64 Games

c64:moby-210983.title: In Harm's Way: Naval Battles in the South Pacific

c64:moby-211688.title: Tim Hartnell's Giant Book of Computer Games

c64:moby-211690.title: Creating Simulation Games on your Computer

c64:moby-21280.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back

c64:moby-21314.description: Each of 30 single-screen platform levels has an exit that opens only after every torch has been lit, all within a time limit. Enemies patrol set routes or chase the player, so later stages demand careful route planning to avoid dead ends.
c64:moby-21314.title: Madness

c64:moby-214367.description: Second World War submarine simulation commanding the British T-class boat Beowolf against German and Italian shipping. A periscope view and gauges fill most of the screen, beside switchable engine room, torpedo, map, damage and log displays; missions range from sinking ships to landing agents.
c64:moby-214367.title: Dawn Patrol

c64:moby-2169.title: Castle Master + Castle Master II: The Crypt

c64:moby-217616.description: Assemble the rocket, fill it with fuel and take off, blasting enemies and grabbing bonuses on the way, while your oxygen supply steadily runs down.
c64:moby-217616.title: Rocket Smash

c64:moby-228736.description: An action adventure assembled from Last Ninja 3: its levels are reworked from that game's maps and many of its enemies and scenery are taken straight from it, with a brown beast as the hero in place of the ninja.
c64:moby-228736.title: Beauty and the Beast

c64:moby-230281.title: Write your own Fantasy Games for your Microcomputer

c64:moby-230751.description: A Sesame Street learning game: children lay a route of pipes, waterways and sea creatures to carry Rubber Duckie to Ernie's bathtub, with help from Bert, Grover, Oscar and Cookie Monster, practising logic, sequencing and compass directions.
c64:moby-230751.title: Ernie's Big Splash

c64:moby-23655.description: Barnabee the bee searches a maze-like ant nest for his kidnapped cousin Boris, steering clear of energy-sapping ants and touching flowers to recover strength and open blocked passages. Once found, the slow-moving Boris has to be escorted back up to the surface.
c64:moby-23655.title: Antics

c64:moby-247270.description: Conversion of the arcade beat-'em-up. Twin brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee fight through gang-ruled city streets with punches, kicks and grabbed weapons to rescue Marian from the Black Warriors.
c64:moby-247270.title: Double Dragon

c64:moby-24801.title: Famous Courses of the World: Vol. II

c64:moby-24940.description: Mirrorsoft shooter in which a star fighter navigates the narrow walkways of the Matrix of Zog hunting eight crystals, facing ramps, traps, vanishing barriers and seven kinds of alien. Brain Teaser and Zapper modes set the style of play.
c64:moby-24940.title: Zig-Zag

c64:moby-26379.title: Snooper Troops: Case #2 - The Case of the Disappearing Dolphin

c64:moby-26914.description: Based on the film WarGames: defend six regions of the United States from incoming missiles, bombers and submarines by directing your own missiles and forces, in slower, more strategic action than Missile Command. Written by Scott Pearson and Murphy McIntosh for Thorn EMI.
c64:moby-26914.title: WarGames

c64:moby-27160.description: Arena game for two, against a friend or a robot: each player catches the erratically moving ball with a suction gun and fires it at the bricks on their own side, aiming to clear them first. Getting hit by the ball knocks you down and hands over possession.
c64:moby-27160.title: Hotshot

c64:moby-27204.description: HesWare's version of the faster, tougher Zaxxon sequel. Fly an isometric spacecraft through an asteroid fortress, a narrow tunnel full of fighters and mines, and a second fortress, then shoot three fire-breathing dragons in the mouth to complete the cycle.
c64:moby-27204.title: Super Zaxxon

c64:moby-29280.description: Scott Adams's notoriously hard island adventure: washed up on a remote shore under threat of a volcano and violent weather, you dig, build equipment and cross water with terse verb-noun commands to learn why you are there.
c64:moby-29280.title: Savage Island

c64:moby-29326.title: Scott Adams' Graphic Adventure #2: Pirate Adventure

c64:moby-29328.title: Scott Adams' Graphic Adventure #4: Voodoo Castle

c64:moby-30.description: Infocom's first mystery: industrialist Marshall Robner lies dead in his locked library, apparently a suicide. You have twelve hours to search his Connecticut estate, gather evidence, have Sergeant Duffy run lab tests and question family and staff, who follow their own schedules.
c64:moby-30.title: Deadline

c64:moby-30434.title: The Transformers: Battle to Save the Earth

c64:moby-30470.title: Tony La Russa's Ultimate Baseball: Ultimate Expansion Disk - Great Teams 1901-1968 Disk

c64:moby-31254.description: Guide a crosshair to shield a baby from eagles, spiders and worms while popping the balloons drifting across the screen; every creature that reaches the infant drains milk, and the game ends when milk or ammunition runs out.
c64:moby-31254.title: Baby Blues

c64:moby-31694.title: Electric Crayon Deluxe: Dinosaurs Are Forever

c64:moby-31728.title: Electric Crayon Deluxe: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: World Tour

c64:moby-32414.description: A 1992 Magna Media strategy game: in 2042 a crew lands on an alien planet and must build up modules for research, transport and more, develop technology and mine minerals, while the commander's diary records a crew unsure it will ever see Earth again.
c64:moby-32414.title: Dark Star

c64:moby-32777.description: Dylan Dog, the London nightmare detective, accepts an invitation to a mansion where the dinner wine is poisoned and some guests are killers. He explores the house fighting them with fists, his revolver or found weapons such as a sword, hunting keys against the clock in this Italian platform adventure.
c64:moby-32777.title: Dylan Dog: Murderers

c64:moby-33119.title: Welcome into the Forest of Aurora !!

c64:moby-34720.description: Melbourne House graphic adventure in which you enter a vampire's castle to save a young woman. Scenes are described in text and illustrated, some with animated characters, and the parser accepts several actions in one line; music plays throughout.
c64:moby-34720.title: Castle of Terror

c64:moby-3511.description: Eighty mazes in which you move a small control block to deflect a constantly bouncing ball, smashing blocks or guiding it to an exit. Skulls cost lives, teleporters swap positions and some floor tiles harden into walls; holding space slows the action.
c64:moby-3511.title: Titan

c64:moby-35732.description: An astronaut drifts through space to recover a runaway satellite, shooting or dodging asteroids and hostile spacemen, then holds the fire button to tow it back to the ship. Each new level brings faster enemies.
c64:moby-35732.title: Space Walk

c64:moby-35945.description: Ocean beat-'em-up based on the Schwarzenegger film. As Soviet cop Ivan Danko you punch and head-butt your way through four scrolling levels after drug lord Viktor Rosta, sometimes grabbing a pistol with six shots.
c64:moby-35945.title: Red Heat

c64:moby-37234.title: 4 in 1: Airwolf / Bomb Jack / Commando / Frank Bruno's Boxing

c64:moby-3733.description: Arcade conversion in which a commando dashes left and right at the foot of the screen dodging fire while steering a crosshair to gun down soldiers, tanks and helicopters and level the scenery across five stages. Two players can join in.
c64:moby-3733.title: Cabal

c64:moby-37947.description: Four stages of climbing as Jack goes after the giant's treasure: up the beanstalk and a series of brick walls past worms, spiders and birds, then up the fireplace to the golden goose, and finally up the giant himself to the money bag on his table.
c64:moby-37947.title: Jack and the Beanstalk

c64:moby-38019.title: Box Twenty: Twenty Sports Games In One Pack

c64:moby-39651.description: A sheriff defends his town over five waves of outlaws raiding the saloon and bank, shooting in eight directions as they ride in, throw dynamite and fire from windows, with an undertaker clearing bodies and a quick-draw duel after each wave.
c64:moby-39651.title: Highnoon

c64:moby-39754.description: System 3 action game in the Last Ninja mould: a former soldier, framed by police, must rescue his scientist brother and niece from terrorists. Gather evidence across isometric flick-screen stages, then drive an armed car between them past traffic, bombing helicopters and police checks.
c64:moby-39754.title: Vendetta

c64:moby-3984.title: Wizardry: Legacy of Llylgamyn - The Third Scenario

c64:moby-411.description: Synapse's conversion of Sega's isometric arcade shooter. Fly an attack shuttle through a walled fortress, open space and back, using its ground shadow and an altimeter to judge height when slipping through gaps and force fields; shoot fuel tanks to keep flying.
c64:moby-411.title: Zaxxon

c64:moby-41277.description: Maths game featuring the Wizard of Id comic characters. Spook flees the dungeon by sliding blocks to form correct sums before the jailer Turnkey catches him, with harder problems on higher floors.
c64:moby-41277.title: Wizard of Id's WizMath

c64:moby-41620.title: HeroQuest + HeroQuest: Return of the Witch Lord

c64:moby-43538.description: SSI strategy game of rival lords on a 6x6 field. Over 21 turns each player builds new castles or reinforces existing ones; a stronger castle captures a weaker neighbour, equal strengths lead to a siege, and whoever holds more territory at the end wins.
c64:moby-43538.title: Fortress

c64:moby-45334.title: Jack Nicklaus presents The Major Championship Courses of 1989

c64:moby-48016.description: Imagine's action football for a single player or a tournament of up to eight. Each side controls only the man nearest the ball, so play is about positioning him, beating tackles and getting shots past the keeper before the clock runs out.
c64:moby-48016.title: Super Soccer

c64:moby-49197.description: Platform game about Tommy the tomcat, who used a wizard's magic book and crystal ball to leave the Dream Islands. The ball shattered, so he must gather its pieces and magic potions across several worlds to get home.
c64:moby-49197.title: It's Magic

c64:moby-49910.description: Space Invaders in BASIC, converted from the PET by Chris Smeets in 1983: move your base left and right and fire at the advancing invaders, with an extra base at 1500 points.
c64:moby-49910.title: Space Invaders

c64:moby-49926.description: Question pack for Trivial Pursuit aimed at those who grew up after the Second World War, with 1960s and 70s nostalgia. New categories include Broadcasting, Nightly News, Publishing, Stage and Screen, Life and Times, and RPM.
c64:moby-49926.title: Trivial Pursuit: Baby Boomer Edition

c64:moby-50168.description: Aardvark text adventure: a tractor beam drags your spaceship into a space station, and you must explore it, find the right items and avoid lethal hazards to get away again.
c64:moby-50168.title: Derelict

c64:moby-50660.description: Text adventure that starts by an abandoned cottage in an old forest; find the castle said to house goblins guarding a hoard, recover the treasure and escape, scoring up to 160 points. The parser handles full sentences.
c64:moby-50660.title: Goblin Towers

c64:moby-51.description: Infocom science fiction: a lowly deck-scrubbing ensign escapes his exploding Stellar Patrol ship and crash-lands on Resida, an apparently deserted planet with a vast research complex. Explore labs and transit systems, repair machinery and befriend the robot Floyd.
c64:moby-51.title: Planetfall

c64:moby-53525.description: One of the demo games that came with the Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit: a Gunsmoke-style shooter in which you fight your way up a scrolling Wild West landscape.
c64:moby-53525.title: Wanted

c64:moby-54300.description: Rebuild a given shape, such as a giant letter A, from a limited stock of eight block types that can be rotated and placed, racing a time limit; two players can cooperate, taking turns on one puzzle.
c64:moby-54300.title: Lettrix

c64:moby-54603.description: Chameleon restores balance across five side-scrolling levels themed on fire, water, earth and air, finding hidden exits and triggering power points at the right time of day while switching among four missile types against elemental demons.
c64:moby-54603.title: Chameleon

c64:moby-54620.description: Vertically scrolling shooter against space pirates who have founded eight colonies. Each level is flown twice: first to destroy the reactor at its end, then again in darkness to wreck as many buildings as possible, with marked structures giving bonus points or extra lives.
c64:moby-54620.title: Firetrack

c64:moby-55215.description: An educational reaction-time test. Watch a starry sky and press a key the moment a meteor falls; the skies get busier as you go, and when you stop, a graph plots how quickly you reacted over the session.
c64:moby-55215.title: Meteor

c64:moby-55744.description: Comic text adventure that opens with you being run over by a pink panther in a pink car. God then sends you after his lost golden eggcup, and both score and turn count track your progress.
c64:moby-55744.title: The Quest for the Golden Eggcup

c64:moby-56698.title: Guardian II: Revenge of the Mutants

c64:moby-56922.description: Motor racing management for one or two players: hire drivers and crew from the employee pool and sign their contracts, look up the races, check the bookie's odds and run a practice lap before each race. Seasons can be saved and loaded.
c64:moby-56922.title: Grand Prix

c64:moby-57.description: Infocom's sequel to Enchanter: Belboz, head of the Circle of Enchanters, has fallen under an evil influence and vanished, and the newly promoted apprentice must find him. A text adventure built on spellcasting, now with magic potions to drink as part of the puzzles.
c64:moby-57.title: Sorcerer

c64:moby-57011.description: Sador the reptile man searches nine regions of Haven for magic left by the defeated sorcerer High Vanish, each find giving a cryptic clue to the next, while shooting monsters in a flick-screen overhead maze.
c64:moby-57011.title: The Lands of Havoc

c64:moby-574.description: Atarisoft's conversion of the Nintendo arcade game. As Mario, climb girders and ladders, leap barrels and dodge fireballs to reach the captive Pauline at the top of Donkey Kong's construction site, using hammers to smash obstacles for a short time.
c64:moby-574.title: Donkey Kong

c64:moby-57470.description: Deadly sub-atomic leptons are loose in a research centre; capture them with a robot craft that leaves an ion trail, sealing off areas when you reach the edge in the manner of Qix. Moving into free space halves your speed, and a laboratory is safe once the leptons are caught or 95% is enclosed.
c64:moby-57470.title: Frenzy

c64:moby-57668.title: History in the Making: The First Three Years

c64:moby-57833.title: Zodiac / The Search for the Secret of Life

c64:moby-57895.title: Lords of Chaos: Expansion Kit One

c64:moby-5893.description: SSI's second Dragonlance action game, following Heroes of the Lance and preceding Shadow Sorcerer in the Weiss and Hickman story. The heroes travel in side-scrolling view, one character at a time, each with different abilities.
c64:moby-5893.title: Dragons of Flame

c64:moby-5905.title: The Wizardry Trilogy: Scenarios I, II & III

c64:moby-59168.description: Barnaby picks blocks from five chutes and arranges them on a springboard before sending them to the building site, stacking a stable tower tall enough to climb to the exit ladder; time per level shrinks, though an instructor mode removes the clock.
c64:moby-59168.title: Highrise

c64:moby-59192.description: Adaptation of the Stallone film with level designs unique to the C64. Tough cop Cobra fights through city, countryside and factory, starting with fists and picking up knives, grenades and guns, sparing civilians and escorting model Ingrid to the exit.
c64:moby-59192.title: Cobra

c64:moby-59237.title: COMPUTE!'s Guide to Adventure Games (included game)

c64:moby-5952.description: The sequel to Defender, also sold as Defender II. Fly over a planet's surface that wraps around in both directions, guided by a long-range scanner, blasting alien waves and saving the humanoids they try to carry off.
c64:moby-5952.title: Stargate

c64:moby-59979.title: Famous Courses of the World: Vol. I

c64:moby-59980.title: Famous Courses of the World: Vol. III

c64:moby-60476.description: Bob Morane of the Time Patrol, the hero of Henri Vernes's novels, is sent back to a thirteenth-century castle to keep the Holy Shroud out of the hands of his enemy the Yellow Shadow, who plans to make himself pope and change the course of history.
c64:moby-60476.title: Bob Morane: Chevalerie 1

c64:moby-60598.description: Movie tie-in where terrorists have seized a high-rise to steal $600 million and John McClane must free his trapped wife. Unlike the PC original this C64 version is a side-scroller; explore the tower for useful gear and fight gunmen, who chase you off-screen.
c64:moby-60598.title: Die Hard

c64:moby-60861.description: Recover the twelve Signs of the Zodiac from demon-guarded corridors lined with a lethal force field, 400 of them in all, shooting only while on the move, before a final battle with the demon Jemon.
c64:moby-60861.title: Zodiac

c64:moby-63269.title: The Zzap! 64 Sizzler Collection: Vol I

c64:moby-63377.title: Disk 3: Realm of Darkness, The Cup, Witch Hunt

c64:moby-63467.description: Jeff Minter's shooter in which alien invaders dropping out of hyperspace near Pluto meet the Hellgate, a defence frame whose four wall-mounted laser heads fire at everything inside. There are 20 levels, the first eight of them selectable.
c64:moby-63467.title: Hellgate

c64:moby-63542.title: The Trap Door & Through the Trap Door

c64:moby-63603.description: Up to eight players take turns riding stages of the famous cycling race against the clock, with no computer riders on the road. Practice and competition modes cover the full course, a selection of stages or a single stage.
c64:moby-63603.title: Tour de France

c64:moby-6374.description: Travel through six countries in any order to become king, each a different challenge: a knight jumping hurdles in England, a Viking boat in Scandinavia, a dancing bear in Russia, an island-hopping dragon in Japan, a bridge in India and a flying carpet in Arabia.
c64:moby-6374.title: Crown

c64:moby-63822.title: Spy's Demise & The Spy Strikes Back

c64:moby-63857.description: Sent into Moscow, the player must help agent Felix Hoover steal Soviet spacecraft blueprints from KGB headquarters and then escape, gunning down KGB men across scrolling platform levels. Searching doors turns up money, documents and keys, and elevators connect the floors.
c64:moby-63857.title: Special Agent

c64:moby-63879.description: A private eye searches ten tower blocks for a millionaire's kidnapped daughter, riding lifts, direction-switching escalators and rubbish chutes while gunmen burst from doors. Bullets and lost fist-fights cost money from a $500 budget, while kills and rescues earn it back.
c64:moby-63879.title: Gumshoe

c64:moby-64183.title: Gauntlet and Gauntlet II: Limited Edition

c64:moby-64319.description: Choplifter-style rescue game over eight horizontally scrolling levels. Find a set number of stranded men within the time limit, hover low to winch each one aboard, and shoot or dodge attackers, with smart bombs to clear the screen.
c64:moby-64319.title: Gun Runner

c64:moby-64603.description: Victorious after Troy's fall, Odysseus heads home to Ithaca, where rumours say his throne, wife Penelope and son Telemachus are in danger, in a two-part text adventure of surviving the voyage and then reclaiming the kingdom.
c64:moby-64603.title: The Odyssey

c64:moby-65130.description: An overhead racer: hold fire to accelerate up the scrolling road, weaving through traffic to score 20,000 inside the minute and earn more time; a crash leaves the car smoking until you pull into the pit lane for repairs.
c64:moby-65130.title: Lemans

c64:moby-65428.description: Recover seven pieces of your father's crown from the Ice Queen's palace by rotating hexagonal rooms to link their exits, burning creatures with a firestick and solving object puzzles on a text screen as a candle burns down.
c64:moby-65428.title: Ice Palace

c64:moby-65450.description: Epyx toy-car playground based on Mattel's Hot Wheels: build or pick a car, paint it and cruise around town, stopping at the car wash, gas station or oil change for small mini-games, or entering events like the demolition derby.
c64:moby-65450.title: Hot Wheels

c64:moby-65598.description: In this sequel, Alice steps through a magic mirror at home and walks a scrolling path through a strange land, touching dragons to destroy them and jumping the moving doors that would send her back to her house. Up to four players can take part, with nine skill levels.
c64:moby-65598.title: The Further Adventures of Alice in Videoland

c64:moby-65630.description: Police management strategy set in the fictional British town of Middletown. Assign officers and units to four stations across the map, cover three shifts a day and react to crimes and events, with a traffic-light mini-game each week.
c64:moby-65630.title: The Force

c64:moby-65822.description: Five ancient prison ships full of mutated convicts have reached orbit and the inmates are eating through the hulls. Switch between five transforming Supertronic craft to seal the holes and kill escapees, letting idle craft recharge in solar mode.
c64:moby-65822.title: Diamond

c64:moby-67225.title: Przygody z komputerem i bez komputera

c64:moby-6739.description: Elite's conversion of SNK's Ikari Warriors: one or two commandos fight up a vertically scrolling battlefield of jungle, rivers and ruins, picking up grenades, machine guns and rocket launchers along the way.
c64:moby-6739.title: Ikari Warriors

c64:moby-68294.description: Captain of a cargo ship taking thousands of Blibbles from their overcrowded home world to a new planet, you find their holding pen left open. The creatures roam the decks making trouble and are working their way into the engine room; round them up before the ship is lost.
c64:moby-68294.title: Mayhem

c64:moby-68813.title: 2 on One: Street Surfer + Hollywood or Bust

c64:moby-69079.title: The Electric Crayon Deluxe: Seasons & Holidays

c64:moby-69640.description: A Centipede-style shooter: a centipede winds down through a mushroom field, splitting in two each time it is hit, while the player's craft moves along the bottom of the screen with a little room to advance.
c64:moby-69640.title: Cosmic Split

c64:moby-69878.description: A Frogger-style game: guide the little frog over a road of trucks and cars and on through waters with turtles, snakes and other creatures to the safety of a lily pad.
c64:moby-69878.title: Froggy

c64:moby-69882.description: Steer a trampoline along the ground and bounce higher with the fire button to pick fruit from the treetops. A vulture perches in the branches and carries you off if you touch it, and missing the trampoline also costs a life.
c64:moby-69882.title: Fruity

c64:moby-69975.description: Steer a creature around two mazes, switching between them with the fire button, to carry eight bone-shaped treasures to the maze centres while avoiding roaming creatures; yellow bones let you kill most of them, though survivors may carry treasure off again.
c64:moby-69975.title: Grabber

c64:moby-69996.description: Golf for one or more players over 18 randomly generated holes: a par-3 course where the game hands you a 9 iron, sand wedge or putter, or the normal course with par 3 to 5 holes and a full set of 14 clubs. Match play and foursomes are available, and a round can end early.
c64:moby-69996.title: Golf

c64:moby-70067.description: Play three pawns against three on a 3x3 board, aiming to reach the far row or leave the computer without a move; the program learns from every loss and soon becomes very hard to beat.
c64:moby-70067.title: Hexapawn

c64:moby-70146.description: As a trainee space commander, pass your landing test on the four worlds of Zolopira, Delazari, Colylini and Alinduir, using thrust against gravity to steer through tunnels and touch down on three landing pads in turn.
c64:moby-70146.title: Lander

c64:moby-70251.description: A superhero stranded on Earth after crashing his shuttle decides to defend his adopted home. Fly through a constantly scrolling side-on landscape fighting off the Superbeings attacking the planet, level after level.
c64:moby-70251.title: Krypton

c64:moby-70286.title: Die Gold Collection III: Overseas Edition

c64:moby-70514.description: A steam locomotive chugs along constantly scrolling tracks, switching lines with the help of a map below while puffs of smoke knock down planes and airships and a cannon blasts oncoming trains. Fuel pods keep it running, and each station reached awards a flag; five flags complete a level.
c64:moby-70514.title: Loco

c64:moby-70534.description: Caveman Larry's bride-to-be, the chief's daughter, has been carried off by cannibals. Jump and crouch through flick-screen caves past creatures and arrow-firing cavemen, grabbing each screen's key to progress.
c64:moby-70534.title: Leaping Larry

c64:moby-71046.description: Go on a small 9x9 board against the computer or another person, with a short tutorial for newcomers. Difficulty is set through handicap stones placed before play begins.
c64:moby-71046.title: Microgo1

c64:moby-71161.title: 2 Games: Bangkok Knights / The Last Ninja

c64:moby-71401.title: Triple Crown Challenge: World Championship Motor Racing

c64:moby-72041.description: Klondike patience: turn over every face-down card by building columns in descending order and moving cards to four suit piles from Ace to King. Only a King may fill an empty column, new cards are dealt three at a time, and commands are typed at a prompt line.
c64:moby-72041.title: Patience

c64:moby-72069.title: Plus One: Bionic Granny + Jungle Story

c64:moby-7301.description: Mario and Luigi clear crabs, turtles and fighter flies out of the sewer pipes by bumping the platform beneath them and then kicking them away. Two players can play together, racing to collect the required number of coins first.
c64:moby-7301.title: Mario Bros.

c64:moby-73621.title: Kacze Opowieści czyli...Tabliczka Mnożenia na Wesoło

c64:moby-7377.description: Gravity-based exploration game. Solar Jetman pilots a jetpod down from the mothership on twelve worlds, towing parts of the lost golden warpship and other useful items back against strong gravitational pull.
c64:moby-7377.title: Solar Jetman: Hunt for the Golden Warpship

c64:moby-77422.title: Wizard's Doom: Fifty Levels of Exquisite Torture

c64:moby-77631.description: Frogger with a lumberjack: cross a logging trail busy with trucks, then a river of floating logs and barges, to reach one of the empty cabins on the far bank, watching out for bears on the middle verge.
c64:moby-77631.title: Logger

c64:moby-79948.description: Based on the Concentration TV format: two players take turns flipping squares to find matching pairs, and every pair removed reveals more of a hidden picture to guess. Topics include animals, cities, sports and famous people, and a companion program edits the content.
c64:moby-79948.title: Match Wits

c64:moby-79968.title: The Great Maine to California Race

c64:moby-80.description: Randy Glover's platform classic: defuse every bomb on 30 distinct screens of Jupiter Headquarters, climbing girders, ladders and ropes past robots, homing bullets and falling hazards. Collecting some bombs reshapes the level, and up to four players alternate turns.
c64:moby-80.title: Jumpman

c64:moby-82.description: Learning Company educational game that teaches children aged about 8 to 12 to plot points on a grid through geometry problems presented with playful graphics.
c64:moby-82.title: Bumble Plot

c64:moby-8490.description: subLOGIC's American football game, with complete squads of invented players. Call plays from quick menus, then switch to action mode to control the players, against the computer or a friend.
c64:moby-8490.title: Football

c64:moby-8779.description: Capcom's action platformer where the soldier cannot jump: instead his extendable bionic arm latches onto ledges to swing and climb, and also drags enemies in, on the way to the enemy fortress and its doomsday launch computer.
c64:moby-8779.title: Bionic Commando

c64:moby-8786.description: Early Commodore cartridge game: fight gravity with vertical and side thrusters to set a lander down on one of three platforms on Jupiter. Narrower pads multiply the score by 5 or 10 instead of 2, and each safe touchdown refuels part of the tank.
c64:moby-8786.title: Jupiter Lander

c64:moby-88.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

c64:moby-88078.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Action Game  / Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

c64:moby-9299.description: Typing tutor starring characters from Brant Parker and Johnny Hart's Wizard of Id. As the Wiz you type words fast enough to shrink the Evil Spirit in your vat before it turns into a dragon, then keep pace with Bung the Jester as he hops across a paragraph on a pogo stick.
c64:moby-9299.title: Wizard of Id's WizType

c64:moby-9465.description: Conversion of Capcom's first Street Fighter: as Ryu, fight two opponents each in Japan, the USA, England, China and Thailand, ending with Sagat. Special moves include the fireball, dragon punch and hurricane kick, with plank-breaking bonus rounds.
c64:moby-9465.title: Street Fighter

c64:moby-9709.title: The Supercars: Test Drive II Car Disk

c64:moby-97508.description: Noughts and crosses on a 4x4x4 cube: get four in a row in any direction, diagonals included, while stopping the computer from doing the same. Each move is entered as level, column and row.
c64:moby-97508.title: 3D Tic Tac Toe

c64:moby-9818.description: Scott Adams's first adventure, here with pictures: roam an enchanted land of forests, swamps, caves and a volcano to find thirteen treasures and store them safely. Hazards include quicksand, bees and a dragon, and commands are one or two words.
c64:moby-9818.title: Adventureland

c64:moby-98488.title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Język Polski

c64:moby-98593.description: Hangman against the clock: guess the password letter by letter to save your neck, each wrong guess lowering the gallows a step. A panel tracks the letters already tried, and there are three difficulty levels.
c64:moby-98593.title: Killer

c64:moby-98599.title: Hobbit czyli w te i wewte...

c64:moby-9879.description: First-person dogfighting in a Grumman F6F Hellcat across fourteen Pacific War scenarios, from Pearl Harbor and Midway to Okinawa, against bombers, scouts and agile Zeros. Five kills earn ace status, and the cockpit offers a rear-view mirror for spotting pursuers.
c64:moby-9879.title: Hellcat Ace
